
/* =====================================================
   QR POLAROID SYSTEM v1.0
   PERINGKAT 2 - WEB APP CONNECTION TEST

   TUJUAN:
   - Menguji akses Web App melalui HTTPS.
   - Mengembalikan respons JSON ringkas.
   - Tidak membaca atau mengubah database.
   - Tidak mendedahkan konfigurasi backend.

   KESELAMATAN:
   Endpoint ini hanya untuk ujian sambungan.
===================================================== */

function doGet(e) {
  // BATCH 5.42: Admin HTML Service is separately gated; default endpoint unchanged.
  if (e && e.parameter && e.parameter.admin === '1' &&
      PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperty('ADMIN_UI_541_ENABLED') === 'true') {
    return HtmlService.createHtmlOutputFromFile('AdminPanel541')
      .setTitle('QR Polaroid — Admin');
  }
  // BATCH 5.41: Admin HTML disabled by default; public JSON health route unchanged.
  if (e && e.parameter && e.parameter.view === 'admin') {
    if (PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperty('ADMIN_UI_541_ENABLED') !== 'true') {
      return ContentService.createTextOutput(JSON.stringify({status:'ERROR',code:'ADMIN_UI_DISABLED'}))
        .setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);
    }
    return HtmlService.createHtmlOutputFromFile('AdminPanel541')
      .setTitle('QR Polaroid — Admin');
  }


  // ---- SEDIAKAN RESPONS UJIAN ----
  const response = {
    status: "SUCCESS",
    system: "QR Polaroid System",
    message: "Web App endpoint is working",
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
  };

  // ---- KEMBALIKAN RESPONS JSON ----
  return ContentService
    .createTextOutput(JSON.stringify(response))
    .setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);
}



/* =====================================================
   QR POLAROID SYSTEM v1.0
   LANGKAH 5.03C-1 - SECURE POST ROUTER

   TUJUAN:
   - Mengekalkan semua fungsi Langkah 5.01.
   - Mengekalkan sekatan test_upload.
   - Menambah ujian payload 64 KiB sementara.
   - Tidak membaca atau menulis Sheets/Drive.

   PENTING:
   Fungsi handleTemporaryPayloadTest_()
   mesti wujud secara berasingan dalam Code.gs.
===================================================== */

function doPost(e) {

  // ---- 1. PEMBANTU RESPONS JSON ----

  function jsonResponse(data) {

    return ContentService
      .createTextOutput(
        JSON.stringify(data)
      )
      .setMimeType(
        ContentService.MimeType.JSON
      );

  }

  try {

    // ---- 2. VALIDASI REQUEST ASAS ----

    if (
      !e ||
      !e.postData ||
      typeof e.postData.contents !== "string" ||
      !e.postData.contents.trim()
    ) {

      return jsonResponse({
        status: "ERROR",
        code: "EMPTY_REQUEST",
        message: "Request body is empty"
      });

    }

    const rawBody = e.postData.contents;

    // BATCH 5.14: laluan JPEG berasingan, OFF secara lalai.
    // Hanya permintaan yang menyebut action upload_jpeg boleh melalui had besar.
    // Jangan log rawBody (mengandungi token QR dan imej).
    // BATCH 5.33: JSON action is independent of property order.
    // Enforce request ceiling BEFORE JSON.parse / base64 decoding.
    // The old regex only recognized upload_jpeg as the FIRST property.
    if (rawBody.length > 11200000) {
      return jsonResponse({status:"ERROR",code:"REQUEST_TOO_LARGE"});
    }
    let routedAction;
    try {
      const envelope = JSON.parse(rawBody);
      if (envelope && typeof envelope === "object" && !Array.isArray(envelope)) {
        routedAction = envelope.action;
      }
    } catch (_) {
      return jsonResponse({status:"ERROR",code:"INVALID_JSON"});
    }
    if (routedAction === "upload_jpeg") {
      return jsonResponse(handleProductionRoute533_(rawBody));
    }

    // ---- 3. HAD SAIZ KESELURUHAN ----

    // Had maksimum sementara untuk
    // ujian 64 KiB sahaja.

    const MAX_PAYLOAD_TEST_CHARS = 530000;
    const MAX_TEST_REQUEST_CHARS = 2048;

    if (rawBody.length > MAX_PAYLOAD_TEST_CHARS) {

      return jsonResponse({
        status: "ERROR",
        code: "REQUEST_TOO_LARGE",
        message: "Request exceeds test limit"
      });

    }

    // ---- 4. PERMINTAAN BESAR ----

    // Permintaan melebihi 2048 aksara
    // hanya boleh menggunakan action
    // test_payload_64k.

    if (rawBody.length > MAX_TEST_REQUEST_CHARS) {

      let largeRequest;

      try {

        largeRequest = JSON.parse(rawBody);

      } catch (error) {

        return jsonResponse({
          status: "ERROR",
          code: "INVALID_JSON",
          message: "Invalid JSON request"
        });

      }

      // Kekalkan kontrak had saiz asal untuk test_post.
      if (
        largeRequest &&
        typeof largeRequest === "object" &&
        !Array.isArray(largeRequest) &&
        largeRequest.action === "test_post"
      ) {
        return jsonResponse({
          status: "ERROR",
          code: "REQUEST_TOO_LARGE",
          message: "Request exceeds test limit"
        });
      }

      if (
        largeRequest === null ||
        typeof largeRequest !== "object" ||
        Array.isArray(largeRequest) ||
        !["test_payload_64k", "test_payload_512k"].includes(largeRequest.action)
      ) {

        return jsonResponse({
          status: "ERROR",
          code: "UNSUPPORTED_ACTION",
          message: "Unsupported action"
        });

      }

      // ---- 5. UJIAN PAYLOAD SEMENTARA ----

      // Tidak menyimpan fail.
      // Tidak membuat reservation.
      // Tidak mengubah kuota.

      return jsonResponse(
        handleTemporaryPayloadTest_(rawBody)
      );

    }

    // ---- 6. PARSE JSON REQUEST BIASA ----

    let requestData;

    try {

      requestData = JSON.parse(rawBody);

    } catch (parseError) {

      return jsonResponse({
        status: "ERROR",
        code: "INVALID_JSON",
        message: "Invalid JSON request"
      });

    }

    // ---- 7. VALIDASI OBJEK JSON ----

    if (
      requestData === null ||
      typeof requestData !== "object" ||
      Array.isArray(requestData)
    ) {

      return jsonResponse({
        status: "ERROR",
        code: "INVALID_REQUEST_FORMAT",
        message: "JSON object is required"
      });

    }

    // ---- 8. VALIDASI ACTION ----

    if (
      typeof requestData.action !== "string" ||
      !requestData.action.trim()
    ) {

      return jsonResponse({
        status: "ERROR",
        code: "INVALID_ACTION",
        message: "Valid action is required"
      });

    }

    // ---- 8A. SEMAK QR PESERTA (BACA SAHAJA) ----

    if (requestData.action === "check_qr") {
      return jsonResponse(
        handlePublicQrCheck_(requestData)
      );
    }

    // ---- 9. SEKAT UPLOAD AWAM ----

    if (requestData.action === "test_upload") {

      return jsonResponse({
        status: "ERROR",
        code: "UPLOAD_TEST_DISABLED",
        message: "Public test upload is disabled"
      });

    }

    // ---- 10. ACTION ALLOWLIST ----

    // test_payload_64k hanya diproses
    // melalui laluan khusus di atas.
    //
    // Laluan biasa hanya membenarkan
    // test_post.

    if (requestData.action !== "test_post") {

      return jsonResponse({
        status: "ERROR",
        code: "UNSUPPORTED_ACTION",
        message: "Unsupported action"
      });

    }

    // ---- 11. VALIDASI MESEJ ----

    if (
      requestData.message !== undefined &&
      typeof requestData.message !== "string"
    ) {

      return jsonResponse({
        status: "ERROR",
        code: "INVALID_MESSAGE",
        message: "Message must be a string"
      });

    }

    // ---- 12. RESPONS POST BIASA ----

    return jsonResponse({
      status: "SUCCESS",
      code: "TEST_POST_SUCCESS",
      message: "POST request received",
      receivedText: (
        requestData.message || ""
      ).slice(0, 100),
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
    });

  } catch (error) {

    // ---- 13. RALAT DALAMAN ----

    // Jangan dedahkan error.message.

    console.error(
      "POST_ROUTER_INTERNAL_ERROR"
    );

    return jsonResponse({
      status: "ERROR",
      code: "INTERNAL_ERROR",
      message: "Request could not be processed"
    });

  }

}


/* =====================================================
   QR POLAROID SYSTEM
   LANGKAH 2.5 - JPEG UPLOAD TEST

   TUJUAN:
   - Menerima JPEG melalui POST.
   - Menyimpan fail dalam Google Drive.
   - Mengembalikan ID fail sebagai pengesahan.

   HAD UJIAN:
   - JPEG sahaja.
   - Maksimum 1 MB.
   - Tiada perubahan pada Google Sheets.
===================================================== */

function testUploadJpeg_(data) {

  // ---- SEMAK DATA INPUT ----
  if (!data || data.action !== "test_upload") {
    throw new Error("Invalid upload action");
  }

  if (typeof data.image !== "string") {
    throw new Error("Image data missing");
  }

  // ---- DECODE BASE64 ----
  const bytes = Utilities.base64Decode(data.image);

  if (bytes.length === 0 || bytes.length > 1048576) {
    throw new Error("Invalid image size");
  }

  // ---- SEMAK TANDATANGAN JPEG ----
  const first = bytes[0] & 255;
  const second = bytes[1] & 255;
  const third = bytes[2] & 255;

  if (first !== 255 || second !== 216 || third !== 255) {
    throw new Error("File is not JPEG");
  }

  // ---- DAPATKAN FOLDER GOOGLE DRIVE ----
  const folderId = PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .getProperty("ROOT_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID");

  if (!folderId) {
    throw new Error("Drive folder not configured");
  }

  const folder = DriveApp.getFolderById(folderId);

  // ---- CIPTA FAIL JPEG ----
  const filename =
    "POC_TEST_" + Date.now() + ".jpg";

  const blob = Utilities.newBlob(
    bytes,
    "image/jpeg",
    filename
  );

  const file = folder.createFile(blob);

  // ---- KEMBALIKAN PENGESAHAN ----
  return {
    status: "SUCCESS",
    message: "JPEG uploaded successfully",
    filename: file.getName(),
    fileId: file.getId(),
    size: file.getSize()
  };
}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.7
   DATABASE STRUCTURE VALIDATION

   TUJUAN:
   - Semak 6 tab Google Sheets.
   - Semak nama dan susunan header.
   - Laporkan kesilapan jika ada.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - Read-only.
   - Tidak menambah atau mengubah data.
   - Tidak dipanggil melalui Web App awam.
============================================ */

function validateDatabaseStructure_() {

  // ---- 1. BACA ID DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId = PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error("SPREADSHEET_ID tidak dijumpai.");
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(spreadsheetId);


  // ---- 2. STRUKTUR HEADER YANG DIJANGKA ----

  const expectedSheets = {

    EVENTS: [
      "event_id",
      "event_name",
      "start_date",
      "end_date",
      "start_time",
      "end_time",
      "schedule_enabled",
      "drive_folder_id",
      "event_status",
      "created_at",
      "updated_at",
      "updated_by",
      "deleted_at",
      "deleted_by",
      "deletion_status",
      "created_by"
    ],

    QR_SLOTS: [
      "qr_id",
      "event_id",
      "qr_label",
      "qr_token",
      "qr_status",
      "max_uploads",
      "current_cycle_id",
      "drive_folder_id",
      "created_at",
      "updated_at",
      "created_by",
      "updated_by",
      "last_upload_at",
      "regenerated_at",
      "regenerated_by",
      "deleted_at",
      "deleted_by",
      "deletion_status"
    ],

    UPLOADS: [
      "upload_id",
      "idempotency_key",
      "event_id",
      "qr_id",
      "cycle_id",
      "upload_status",
      "lease_token",
      "lease_expires_at",
      "original_filename",
      "file_mime_type",
      "file_size_bytes",
      "drive_file_id",
      "drive_file_name",
      "created_at",
      "started_at",
      "completed_at",
      "updated_at",
      "error_code",
      "error_message",
      "retry_count",
      "deleted_at",
      "deletion_status"
    ],

    QUOTA_CYCLES: [
      "cycle_id",
      "event_id",
      "qr_id",
      "cycle_number",
      "max_uploads",
      "cycle_status",
      "started_at",
      "ended_at",
      "created_at",
      "created_by",
      "closed_by",
      "reset_reason",
      "successful_uploads"
    ],

    SYSTEM_SETTINGS: [
      "setting_key",
      "setting_value",
      "value_type",
      "setting_description",
      "is_editable",
      "created_at",
      "updated_at",
      "updated_by"
    ],

    ADMIN_LOGS: [
      "log_id",
      "timestamp",
      "admin_id",
      "action",
      "entity_type",
      "entity_id",
      "event_id",
      "action_status",
      "previous_value",
      "new_value",
      "details",
      "error_message"
    ]

  };


  // ---- 3. SEMAK SETIAP JADUAL ----

  let passed = 0;
  let failed = 0;

  for (const sheetName in expectedSheets) {

    const expected = expectedSheets[sheetName];
    const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(sheetName);

    // Semak sama ada tab wujud.
    if (!sheet) {
      Logger.log("FAILED: Tab " + sheetName + " tiada.");
      failed++;
      continue;
    }

    // Baca header daripada baris pertama.
    const actual = sheet
      .getRange(1, 1, 1, expected.length)
      .getDisplayValues()[0];

    // Semak nama dan susunan header.
    const isValid = expected.every(
      (header, index) => actual[index] === header
    );

    if (isValid) {

      Logger.log(
        "PASS: " + sheetName +
        " (" + expected.length + " columns)"
      );

      passed++;

    } else {

      Logger.log("FAILED: " + sheetName);

      // Paparkan kolum yang bermasalah.
      expected.forEach((header, index) => {

        if (actual[index] !== header) {

          Logger.log(
            "Column " + (index + 1) +
            " | Expected: " + header +
            " | Found: " + actual[index]
          );

        }

      });

      failed++;
    }

  }


  // ---- 4. RUMUSAN KEPUTUSAN ----

  Logger.log("==============================");
  Logger.log("DATABASE VALIDATION SUMMARY");
  Logger.log("PASSED: " + passed);
  Logger.log("FAILED: " + failed);
  Logger.log("==============================");

  if (failed > 0) {
    throw new Error(
      "Database validation failed. " +
      failed + " table(s) require correction."
    );
  }

  Logger.log("ALL DATABASE TABLES VALIDATED");

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.8
   EVENT MANAGEMENT - READ EVENTS

   TUJUAN:
   - Membaca jadual EVENTS.
   - Mengambil semua rekod acara.
   - Menukarkan rekod kepada objek JSON.
   - Mengembalikan senarai acara.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - Read-only.
   - Tidak mengubah Google Sheets.
   - Belum tersedia melalui Web App awam.
============================================ */

function getEvents_() {

  // ---- 1. BACA ID DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId = PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error("SPREADSHEET_ID tidak dijumpai.");
  }

  // ---- 2. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(spreadsheetId);

  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName("EVENTS");

  if (!sheet) {
    throw new Error("Tab EVENTS tidak dijumpai.");
  }

  // ---- 3. BACA SEMUA DATA ----

  const data = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();

  // Baris pertama ialah header.
  const headers = data[0];

  // Jika tiada acara, pulangkan senarai kosong.
  if (data.length <= 1) {
    return {
      status: "SUCCESS",
      total: 0,
      events: []
    };
  }

  // ---- 4. TUKARKAN BARIS KEPADA OBJEK ----

  const events = data.slice(1)
    .filter(row => row.some(cell => cell !== ""))
    .map(row => {

      const event = {};

      headers.forEach((header, index) => {

        const value = row[index];

        // Tukarkan tarikh kepada format teks ISO.
        event[header] = value instanceof Date
          ? value.toISOString()
          : value;

      });

      return event;

    });

  // ---- 5. PULANGKAN KEPUTUSAN ----

  return {
    status: "SUCCESS",
    total: events.length,
    events: events
  };

}


/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.8
   MANUAL TEST - READ EVENTS

   Jalankan fungsi ini melalui Apps Script.
============================================ */

function testGetEvents_() {

  const result = getEvents_();

  Logger.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.9
   EVENT MANAGEMENT - CREATE EVENT

   TUJUAN:
   - Mengesahkan maklumat acara.
   - Menjana ID unik.
   - Menyediakan rekod EVENTS.
   - Menyimpan rekod jika dryRun = false.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - Belum dihubungkan ke Web App awam.
   - Fungsi ujian menggunakan dry run.
   - Belum melaksanakan pengesahan admin.
============================================ */

function createEvent_(eventData, dryRun = true) {

  // ---- 1. SAHKAN INPUT ----

  if (!eventData || typeof eventData !== "object") {
    throw new Error("Maklumat acara tidak sah.");
  }

  const eventName = String(
    eventData.event_name || ""
  ).trim();

  if (eventName.length < 3 || eventName.length > 150) {
    throw new Error(
      "Nama acara mesti antara 3 hingga 150 aksara."
    );
  }

  // Format tarikh: YYYY-MM-DD
  const startDate = String(eventData.start_date || "");
  const endDate = String(eventData.end_date || "");

  const datePattern = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;

  function isValidDate(value) {
    if (!datePattern.test(value)) return false;

    const parsed = new Date(value + "T00:00:00Z");

    return !isNaN(parsed.getTime()) &&
      parsed.toISOString().slice(0, 10) === value;
  }

  if (!isValidDate(startDate) || !isValidDate(endDate)) {
    throw new Error(
      "Tarikh mesti sah dan menggunakan YYYY-MM-DD."
    );
  }

  if (endDate < startDate) {
    throw new Error(
      "Tarikh tamat tidak boleh sebelum tarikh mula."
    );
  }

  // Format masa: HH:mm (24 jam)
  const startTime = String(eventData.start_time || "");
  const endTime = String(eventData.end_time || "");

  const timePattern = /^([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d$/;

  if (!timePattern.test(startTime) ||
      !timePattern.test(endTime)) {
    throw new Error(
      "Masa mesti menggunakan format HH:mm."
    );
  }

  if (startDate === endDate && endTime <= startTime) {
    throw new Error(
      "Masa tamat mesti selepas masa mula."
    );
  }

  if (typeof eventData.schedule_enabled !== "boolean") {
    throw new Error(
      "schedule_enabled mesti true atau false."
    );
  }


  // ---- 2. JANA MAKLUMAT ASAS ----

  const eventId = Utilities.getUuid();
  const now = new Date().toISOString();

  // Identiti admin sebenar akan disahkan kemudian.
  const actor = "MANUAL_TEST";

  const record = {

    event_id: eventId,
    event_name: eventName,
    start_date: startDate,
    end_date: endDate,
    start_time: startTime,
    end_time: endTime,
    schedule_enabled: eventData.schedule_enabled,

    // Folder acara belum dicipta dalam langkah ini.
    drive_folder_id: "",

    event_status: "DRAFT",
    created_at: now,
    updated_at: now,
    updated_by: actor,
    deleted_at: "",
    deleted_by: "",
    deletion_status: "ACTIVE",
    created_by: actor

  };


  // ---- 3. DRY RUN: TIDAK SIMPAN DATA ----

  if (dryRun === true) {

    return {
      status: "SUCCESS",
      mode: "DRY_RUN",
      saved: false,
      event: record
    };

  }


  // ---- 4. SIMPAN KE GOOGLE SHEETS ----

  const spreadsheetId = PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error("SPREADSHEET_ID tidak dijumpai.");
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(spreadsheetId);
  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName("EVENTS");

  if (!sheet) {
    throw new Error("Tab EVENTS tidak dijumpai.");
  }

  // Ikut susunan header sedia ada.
  const headers = sheet
    .getRange(1, 1, 1, 16)
    .getDisplayValues()[0];

  const row = headers.map(header => record[header]);

  sheet.appendRow(row);

  return {
    status: "SUCCESS",
    mode: "LIVE",
    saved: true,
    event: record
  };

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.10
   CREATE EVENT - LIVE DATABASE TEST

   TUJUAN:
   - Menyimpan SATU acara ujian.
   - Membaca semula acara daripada EVENTS.
   - Mengesahkan rekod berjaya disimpan.

   PERHATIAN:
   Fungsi ini menulis data sebenar ke Sheets.

   Jalankan SEKALI sahaja.
============================================ */

function testCreateEventLive_() {

  // ---- 1. ELAKKAN UJIAN BERULANG ----

  const existing = getEvents_();

  const testName = "QR Polaroid Test Event";

  const alreadyExists = existing.events.some(
    event => event.event_name === testName
  );

  if (alreadyExists) {

    Logger.log(
      "TEST SKIPPED: Acara ujian sudah wujud."
    );

    return;

  }


  // ---- 2. SEDIAKAN ACARA UJIAN ----

  const sampleEvent = {

    event_name: testName,

    start_date: "2027-01-15",

    end_date: "2027-01-15",

    start_time: "09:00",

    end_time: "17:00",

    schedule_enabled: true

  };


  // ---- 3. SIMPAN ACARA KE DATABASE ----

  // false = LIVE, rekod akan disimpan.
  const result = createEvent_(sampleEvent, false);

  Logger.log(
    "CREATE RESULT: " +
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );


  // ---- 4. BACA SEMULA DATABASE ----

  const verification = getEvents_();

  const savedEvent = verification.events.find(
    event => event.event_id === result.event.event_id
  );

  if (!savedEvent) {

    throw new Error(
      "Acara tidak ditemui selepas disimpan."
    );

  }


  // ---- 5. PAPARKAN KEPUTUSAN ----

  Logger.log("EVENT SAVE VERIFIED");

  Logger.log(
    "EVENT ID: " + savedEvent.event_id
  );

  Logger.log(
    "EVENT NAME: " + savedEvent.event_name
  );

  Logger.log(
    "TOTAL EVENTS: " + verification.total
  );

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.11
   EVENT MANAGEMENT - CREATE DRIVE FOLDER

   TUJUAN:
   - Cari acara berdasarkan event_id.
   - Semak sama ada folder sudah wujud.
   - Cipta folder dalam ROOT_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID.
   - Simpan ID folder dalam jadual EVENTS.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - Hanya dijalankan secara manual.
   - Tidak dihubungkan kepada Web App awam.
   - Folder kekal private mengikut tetapan Drive.
============================================ */

function createEventFolder_(eventId) {

  // ---- 1. SAHKAN EVENT ID ----

  if (!eventId || typeof eventId !== "string") {
    throw new Error("Event ID tidak sah.");
  }

  // ---- 2. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  const spreadsheetId = props.getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");
  const rootFolderId = props.getProperty("ROOT_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId || !rootFolderId) {
    throw new Error("Konfigurasi backend tidak lengkap.");
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(spreadsheetId);
  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName("EVENTS");

  if (!sheet) {
    throw new Error("Tab EVENTS tidak dijumpai.");
  }

  // ---- 3. CARI ACARA ----

  const data = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
  const headers = data[0];

  const idIndex = headers.indexOf("event_id");
  const nameIndex = headers.indexOf("event_name");
  const folderIndex = headers.indexOf("drive_folder_id");
  const updatedIndex = headers.indexOf("updated_at");

  if ([idIndex, nameIndex, folderIndex, updatedIndex]
      .some(index => index === -1)) {
    throw new Error("Header EVENTS tidak lengkap.");
  }

  let eventRow = -1;

  for (let i = 1; i < data.length; i++) {
    if (String(data[i][idIndex]) === eventId) {
      eventRow = i + 1;
      break;
    }
  }

  if (eventRow === -1) {
    throw new Error("Acara tidak dijumpai.");
  }

  // ---- 4. SEMAK FOLDER SEDIA ADA ----

  const existingFolderId = String(
    sheet.getRange(eventRow, folderIndex + 1).getValue()
  ).trim();

  if (existingFolderId) {

    // Sahkan folder benar-benar boleh diakses.
    const existingFolder = DriveApp.getFolderById(
      existingFolderId
    );

    Logger.log(
      "FOLDER ALREADY EXISTS: " + existingFolder.getName()
    );

    return {
      status: "SUCCESS",
      created: false,
      folder_id: existingFolderId,
      folder_name: existingFolder.getName()
    };
  }

  // ---- 5. CIPTA FOLDER ACARA ----

  const eventName = String(
    sheet.getRange(eventRow, nameIndex + 1).getValue()
  ).trim();

  const rootFolder = DriveApp.getFolderById(rootFolderId);

  const folderName = eventName + " [" + eventId + "]";

  const newFolder = rootFolder.createFolder(folderName);

  // ---- 6. SIMPAN ID FOLDER ----

  sheet.getRange(
    eventRow,
    folderIndex + 1
  ).setValue(newFolder.getId());

  sheet.getRange(
    eventRow,
    updatedIndex + 1
  ).setValue(new Date().toISOString());

  // ---- 7. PULANGKAN KEPUTUSAN ----

  return {
    status: "SUCCESS",
    created: true,
    folder_id: newFolder.getId(),
    folder_name: newFolder.getName()
  };

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.12
   QR SLOT MANAGEMENT - CREATE QR SLOT

   TUJUAN:
   - Mengesahkan maklumat QR Slot.
   - Menjana QR ID unik.
   - Menjana token rawak.
   - Menyediakan rekod QR_SLOTS.
   - Menjalankan dry run sahaja.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - Belum dihubungkan ke Web App awam.
   - Belum mencipta folder Google Drive.
   - Belum menyimpan data dalam Google Sheets.
============================================ */

function createQrSlot_(slotData) {

  // ---- 1. SAHKAN INPUT ----

  if (!slotData || typeof slotData !== "object") {
    throw new Error("Maklumat QR Slot tidak sah.");
  }

  const eventId = String(slotData.event_id || "").trim();
  const qrLabel = String(slotData.qr_label || "").trim();
  const maxUploads = Number(slotData.max_uploads);

  if (!eventId) {
    throw new Error("event_id diperlukan.");
  }

  if (qrLabel.length < 2 || qrLabel.length > 100) {
    throw new Error(
      "Nama QR Slot mesti antara 2 hingga 100 aksara."
    );
  }

  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(maxUploads) ||
      maxUploads < 1 ||
      maxUploads > 1000) {
    throw new Error(
      "max_uploads mesti nombor bulat antara 1 hingga 1000."
    );
  }


  // ---- 2. PASTIKAN ACARA WUJUD ----

  const eventsResult = getEvents_();

  const event = eventsResult.events.find(
    item => item.event_id === eventId
  );

  if (!event) {
    throw new Error("Acara tidak dijumpai.");
  }

  if (event.deletion_status !== "ACTIVE") {
    throw new Error("Acara tidak aktif atau telah dipadam.");
  }


  // ---- 3. JANA ID DAN TOKEN ----

  const qrId = Utilities.getUuid();

  // Token awal untuk ujian dalaman.
  // Belum digunakan sebagai bukti kebenaran upload.
  const qrToken = (
    Utilities.getUuid() +
    Utilities.getUuid()
  ).replace(/-/g, "");

  const now = new Date().toISOString();

  const actor = "MANUAL_TEST";


  // ---- 4. SEDIAKAN REKOD QR_SLOTS ----

  const record = {

    qr_id: qrId,
    event_id: eventId,
    qr_label: qrLabel,
    qr_token: qrToken,

    qr_status: "DRAFT",
    max_uploads: maxUploads,

    // Kitaran kuota akan diwujudkan kemudian.
    current_cycle_id: "",

    // Folder QR akan diwujudkan kemudian.
    drive_folder_id: "",

    created_at: now,
    updated_at: now,
    created_by: actor,
    updated_by: actor,

    last_upload_at: "",
    regenerated_at: "",
    regenerated_by: "",

    deleted_at: "",
    deleted_by: "",
    deletion_status: "ACTIVE"

  };


  // ---- 5. PULANGKAN DRY RUN ----

  return {
    status: "SUCCESS",
    mode: "DRY_RUN",
    saved: false,
    slot: record
  };

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.13
   SAVE FIRST QR SLOT TO DATABASE

   TUJUAN:
   - Cari acara ujian.
   - Semak QR Slot Meja 01 belum wujud.
   - Gunakan createQrSlot_() untuk menyediakan data.
   - Simpan SATU rekod ke QR_SLOTS.
   - Baca semula rekod untuk pengesahan.

   PERHATIAN:
   Fungsi ini menulis data sebenar ke Sheets.

   Jalankan SEKALI sahaja.
============================================ */

function testSaveFirstQrSlot_() {

  // ---- 1. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId = PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error("SPREADSHEET_ID tidak dijumpai.");
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(spreadsheetId);

  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName("QR_SLOTS");

  if (!sheet) {
    throw new Error("Tab QR_SLOTS tidak dijumpai.");
  }


  // ---- 2. CARI ACARA UJIAN ----

  const events = getEvents_();

  const testEvent = events.events.find(
    event => event.event_name ===
      "QR Polaroid Test Event"
  );

  if (!testEvent) {
    throw new Error("Acara ujian tidak dijumpai.");
  }


  // ---- 3. SEMAK QR SLOT SEDIA ADA ----

  const existingData = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();

  const headers = existingData[0];

  const eventIdIndex = headers.indexOf("event_id");
  const labelIndex = headers.indexOf("qr_label");

  if (eventIdIndex === -1 || labelIndex === -1) {
    throw new Error("Header QR_SLOTS tidak lengkap.");
  }

  const alreadyExists = existingData.slice(1).some(
    row =>
      String(row[eventIdIndex]) === testEvent.event_id &&
      String(row[labelIndex]) === "Meja 01"
  );

  if (alreadyExists) {

    Logger.log(
      "TEST SKIPPED: QR Slot Meja 01 sudah wujud."
    );

    return;

  }


  // ---- 4. SEDIAKAN REKOD QR SLOT ----

  const result = createQrSlot_({

    event_id: testEvent.event_id,
    qr_label: "Meja 01",
    max_uploads: 5

  });

  if (result.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
      result.saved !== false) {
    throw new Error("QR Slot preparation failed.");
  }


  // ---- 5. SIMPAN KE GOOGLE SHEETS ----

  const record = result.slot;

  const row = headers.map(header => record[header] ?? "");

  sheet.appendRow(row);


  // ---- 6. BACA SEMULA UNTUK PENGESAHAN ----

  const savedData = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();

  const qrIdIndex = headers.indexOf("qr_id");

  const savedRow = savedData.slice(1).find(
    row => String(row[qrIdIndex]) === record.qr_id
  );

  if (!savedRow) {
    throw new Error(
      "QR Slot tidak ditemui selepas disimpan."
    );
  }


  // ---- 7. PAPARKAN KEPUTUSAN ----

  Logger.log("QR SLOT SAVE VERIFIED");

  Logger.log("QR LABEL: " + record.qr_label);

  Logger.log("MAX UPLOADS: " + record.max_uploads);

  Logger.log("QR STATUS: " + record.qr_status);

  Logger.log("QR ID: " + record.qr_id);

  Logger.log(
    "TOTAL QR SLOTS: " + (savedData.length - 1)
  );

  // Token tidak dipaparkan dalam log.

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.14
   QR SLOT MANAGEMENT - CREATE DRIVE FOLDER

   TUJUAN:
   - Cari QR Slot berdasarkan QR ID.
   - Dapatkan folder acara induk.
   - Cipta folder khusus QR Slot.
   - Simpan folder ID dalam QR_SLOTS.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - Ujian manual sahaja.
   - Tidak dihubungkan ke Web App awam.
   - Tidak mengubah permission perkongsian Drive.
============================================ */

function createQrSlotFolder_(qrId) {

  // ---- 1. SAHKAN QR ID ----

  if (!qrId || typeof qrId !== "string") {
    throw new Error("QR ID tidak sah.");
  }


  // ---- 2. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId = PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error("SPREADSHEET_ID tidak dijumpai.");
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(spreadsheetId);

  const qrSheet = ss.getSheetByName("QR_SLOTS");
  const eventSheet = ss.getSheetByName("EVENTS");

  if (!qrSheet || !eventSheet) {
    throw new Error("Tab database tidak dijumpai.");
  }


  // ---- 3. CARI QR SLOT ----

  const qrData = qrSheet.getDataRange().getValues();
  const qrHeaders = qrData[0];

  const qrIdCol = qrHeaders.indexOf("qr_id");
  const eventIdCol = qrHeaders.indexOf("event_id");
  const labelCol = qrHeaders.indexOf("qr_label");
  const folderCol = qrHeaders.indexOf("drive_folder_id");
  const updatedCol = qrHeaders.indexOf("updated_at");

  if ([qrIdCol, eventIdCol, labelCol,
       folderCol, updatedCol].includes(-1)) {
    throw new Error("Header QR_SLOTS tidak lengkap.");
  }

  let qrRow = -1;

  for (let i = 1; i < qrData.length; i++) {

    if (String(qrData[i][qrIdCol]) === qrId) {
      qrRow = i + 1;
      break;
    }

  }

  if (qrRow === -1) {
    throw new Error("QR Slot tidak dijumpai.");
  }

  const qrRecord = qrData[qrRow - 1];

  const eventId = String(qrRecord[eventIdCol]);
  const qrLabel = String(qrRecord[labelCol]).trim();


  // ---- 4. SEMAK FOLDER QR SEDIA ADA ----

  const existingFolderId = String(
    qrRecord[folderCol] || ""
  ).trim();

  if (existingFolderId) {

    const existingFolder = DriveApp.getFolderById(
      existingFolderId
    );

    Logger.log(
      "QR FOLDER ALREADY EXISTS: " +
      existingFolder.getName()
    );

    return {
      status: "SUCCESS",
      created: false,
      folder_id: existingFolderId,
      folder_name: existingFolder.getName()
    };

  }


  // ---- 5. CARI FOLDER ACARA INDUK ----

  const eventData = eventSheet.getDataRange().getValues();
  const eventHeaders = eventData[0];

  const eventIdIndex = eventHeaders.indexOf("event_id");
  const eventFolderIndex = eventHeaders.indexOf(
    "drive_folder_id"
  );

  if ([eventIdIndex, eventFolderIndex].includes(-1)) {
    throw new Error("Header EVENTS tidak lengkap.");
  }

  const eventRecord = eventData.slice(1).find(
    row => String(row[eventIdIndex]) === eventId
  );

  if (!eventRecord) {
    throw new Error("Acara induk tidak dijumpai.");
  }

  const eventFolderId = String(
    eventRecord[eventFolderIndex] || ""
  ).trim();

  if (!eventFolderId) {
    throw new Error(
      "Folder acara induk belum diwujudkan."
    );
  }


  // ---- 6. CIPTA FOLDER QR SLOT ----

  const parentFolder = DriveApp.getFolderById(
    eventFolderId
  );

  const folderName = qrLabel + " [" + qrId + "]";

  // Semak nama folder jika penulisan ID pernah gagal.
  const matchingFolders = parentFolder.getFoldersByName(
    folderName
  );

  let folder;
  let created = false;

  if (matchingFolders.hasNext()) {

    folder = matchingFolders.next();

    Logger.log(
      "RECOVERED EXISTING QR FOLDER"
    );

  } else {

    folder = parentFolder.createFolder(folderName);
    created = true;

  }


  // ---- 7. SIMPAN FOLDER ID KE QR_SLOTS ----

  qrSheet.getRange(
    qrRow,
    folderCol + 1
  ).setValue(folder.getId());

  qrSheet.getRange(
    qrRow,
    updatedCol + 1
  ).setValue(new Date().toISOString());


  // ---- 8. PULANGKAN KEPUTUSAN ----

  return {
    status: "SUCCESS",
    created: created,
    folder_id: folder.getId(),
    folder_name: folder.getName()
  };

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.15
   QUOTA MANAGEMENT - CREATE QUOTA CYCLE

   TUJUAN:
   - Mengesahkan QR Slot yang dipilih.
   - Membaca kuota maksimum QR Slot.
   - Menyediakan rekod kitaran kuota pertama.
   - Menjalankan DRY RUN sahaja.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - Tidak menulis ke Google Sheets.
   - Tidak mengubah kuota sebenar.
   - Tidak dihubungkan kepada Web App awam.
============================================ */

function createQuotaCycle_(qrId) {

  // ---- 1. SAHKAN QR ID ----

  if (!qrId || typeof qrId !== "string") {
    throw new Error("QR ID tidak sah.");
  }


  // ---- 2. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId = PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error("SPREADSHEET_ID tidak dijumpai.");
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(spreadsheetId);

  const qrSheet = ss.getSheetByName("QR_SLOTS");
  const cycleSheet = ss.getSheetByName("QUOTA_CYCLES");

  if (!qrSheet || !cycleSheet) {
    throw new Error("Tab database tidak dijumpai.");
  }


  // ---- 3. CARI QR SLOT ----

  const qrData = qrSheet.getDataRange().getValues();
  const qrHeaders = qrData[0];

  const qrIdIndex = qrHeaders.indexOf("qr_id");
  const eventIdIndex = qrHeaders.indexOf("event_id");
  const maxUploadsIndex = qrHeaders.indexOf("max_uploads");
  const deletionIndex = qrHeaders.indexOf("deletion_status");
  const currentCycleIndex = qrHeaders.indexOf(
    "current_cycle_id"
  );

  if ([qrIdIndex, eventIdIndex, maxUploadsIndex,
       deletionIndex, currentCycleIndex].includes(-1)) {
    throw new Error("Header QR_SLOTS tidak lengkap.");
  }

  const qrRecord = qrData.slice(1).find(
    row => String(row[qrIdIndex]) === qrId
  );

  if (!qrRecord) {
    throw new Error("QR Slot tidak dijumpai.");
  }

  if (String(qrRecord[deletionIndex]) !== "ACTIVE") {
    throw new Error("QR Slot telah dinyahaktifkan.");
  }


  // ---- 4. SEMAK KITARAN SEDIA ADA ----

  const currentCycleId = String(
    qrRecord[currentCycleIndex] || ""
  ).trim();

  if (currentCycleId) {
    throw new Error(
      "QR Slot sudah mempunyai current_cycle_id."
    );
  }

  // Semak juga QUOTA_CYCLES supaya tidak
  // menyediakan kitaran pertama yang berganda.

  const cycleData = cycleSheet.getDataRange().getValues();
  const cycleHeaders = cycleData[0];

  const cycleQrIndex = cycleHeaders.indexOf("qr_id");

  if (cycleQrIndex === -1) {
    throw new Error("Header QUOTA_CYCLES tidak lengkap.");
  }

  const existingCycle = cycleData.slice(1).some(
    row => String(row[cycleQrIndex]) === qrId
  );

  if (existingCycle) {
    throw new Error(
      "QR Slot sudah mempunyai rekod kitaran kuota."
    );
  }


  // ---- 5. SAHKAN KUOTA MAKSIMUM ----

  const maxUploads = Number(
    qrRecord[maxUploadsIndex]
  );

  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(maxUploads) ||
      maxUploads < 1) {
    throw new Error("Kuota maksimum tidak sah.");
  }


  // ---- 6. SEDIAKAN REKOD CYCLE 1 ----

  const cycleId = Utilities.getUuid();
  const now = new Date().toISOString();

  const record = {

    cycle_id: cycleId,
    event_id: String(qrRecord[eventIdIndex]),
    qr_id: qrId,

    cycle_number: 1,
    max_uploads: maxUploads,
    cycle_status: "ACTIVE",

    started_at: now,
    ended_at: "",

    created_at: now,
    created_by: "MANUAL_TEST",

    closed_by: "",
    reset_reason: "",

    successful_uploads: 0

  };


  // ---- 7. PULANGKAN DRY RUN ----

  return {
    status: "SUCCESS",
    mode: "DRY_RUN",
    saved: false,
    cycle: record
  };

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.16
   SAVE FIRST QUOTA CYCLE

   TUJUAN:
   - Cari QR Slot Meja 01.
   - Sediakan Cycle 1.
   - Simpan rekod ke QUOTA_CYCLES.
   - Hubungkan current_cycle_id ke QR_SLOTS.
   - Sahkan kedua-dua rekod sepadan.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - Ujian manual sahaja.
   - Tidak dihubungkan kepada Web App awam.
   - Menggunakan LockService.
============================================ */

function testSaveFirstQuotaCycle_() {

  // ---- 1. KUNCI PROSES ----

  // Mengelakkan dua proses ujian berjalan
  // serentak dan mencipta Cycle 1 berganda.

  const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();

  lock.waitLock(30000);

  try {

    // ---- 2. BUKA DATABASE ----

    const spreadsheetId = PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

    if (!spreadsheetId) {
      throw new Error("SPREADSHEET_ID tidak dijumpai.");
    }

    const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(spreadsheetId);

    const qrSheet = ss.getSheetByName("QR_SLOTS");
    const cycleSheet = ss.getSheetByName("QUOTA_CYCLES");

    if (!qrSheet || !cycleSheet) {
      throw new Error("Tab database tidak dijumpai.");
    }


    // ---- 3. CARI ACARA UJIAN ----

    const events = getEvents_();

    const testEvent = events.events.find(
      event => event.event_name ===
        "QR Polaroid Test Event"
    );

    if (!testEvent) {
      throw new Error("Acara ujian tidak dijumpai.");
    }


    // ---- 4. CARI QR SLOT MEJA 01 ----

    const qrData = qrSheet.getDataRange().getValues();
    const qrHeaders = qrData[0];

    const idIndex = qrHeaders.indexOf("qr_id");
    const eventIndex = qrHeaders.indexOf("event_id");
    const labelIndex = qrHeaders.indexOf("qr_label");
    const currentIndex = qrHeaders.indexOf(
      "current_cycle_id"
    );
    const updatedIndex = qrHeaders.indexOf("updated_at");

    if ([idIndex, eventIndex, labelIndex,
         currentIndex, updatedIndex].includes(-1)) {
      throw new Error("Header QR_SLOTS tidak lengkap.");
    }

    let qrRow = -1;

    for (let i = 1; i < qrData.length; i++) {

      if (
        String(qrData[i][eventIndex]) === testEvent.event_id &&
        String(qrData[i][labelIndex]) === "Meja 01"
      ) {
        qrRow = i + 1;
        break;
      }

    }

    if (qrRow === -1) {
      throw new Error("QR Slot Meja 01 tidak dijumpai.");
    }

    const qrId = String(qrData[qrRow - 1][idIndex]);


    // ---- 5. SEMAK KITARAN SEDIA ADA ----

    const existingCycleId = String(
      qrData[qrRow - 1][currentIndex] || ""
    ).trim();

    if (existingCycleId) {

      Logger.log(
        "TEST SKIPPED: current_cycle_id sudah terisi."
      );

      return;

    }

    const cycleData = cycleSheet.getDataRange().getValues();
    const cycleHeaders = cycleData[0];

    const cycleQrIndex = cycleHeaders.indexOf("qr_id");
    const cycleIdIndex = cycleHeaders.indexOf("cycle_id");
    const cycleNumberIndex = cycleHeaders.indexOf(
      "cycle_number"
    );

    if ([cycleQrIndex, cycleIdIndex,
         cycleNumberIndex].includes(-1)) {
      throw new Error("Header QUOTA_CYCLES tidak lengkap.");
    }

    // ---- 6. PEMULIHAN REKOD SEDIA ADA ----

    // Jika Cycle 1 pernah disimpan tetapi
    // current_cycle_id gagal dikemas kini,
    // gunakan semula Cycle 1 tersebut.

    const existingCycle = cycleData.slice(1).find(
      row =>
        String(row[cycleQrIndex]) === qrId &&
        Number(row[cycleNumberIndex]) === 1
    );

    let cycleId;

    if (existingCycle) {

      cycleId = String(existingCycle[cycleIdIndex]);

      Logger.log("RECOVERED EXISTING CYCLE 1");

    } else {

      // ---- 7. SEDIAKAN CYCLE 1 ----

      const result = createQuotaCycle_(qrId);

      if (
        result.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
        result.saved !== false
      ) {
        throw new Error("Quota Cycle preparation failed.");
      }

      const record = result.cycle;

      cycleId = record.cycle_id;

      // Susun nilai mengikut header sebenar.
      const row = cycleHeaders.map(
        header => record[header] ?? ""
      );

      // ---- 8. SIMPAN KE QUOTA_CYCLES ----

      cycleSheet.appendRow(row);

      SpreadsheetApp.flush();

    }


    // ---- 9. HUBUNGKAN KE QR_SLOTS ----

    qrSheet.getRange(
      qrRow,
      currentIndex + 1
    ).setValue(cycleId);

    qrSheet.getRange(
      qrRow,
      updatedIndex + 1
    ).setValue(new Date().toISOString());

    SpreadsheetApp.flush();


    // ---- 10. SAHKAN HUBUNGAN ----

    const savedCycleId = String(
      qrSheet.getRange(
        qrRow,
        currentIndex + 1
      ).getValue()
    );

    const savedCycles = cycleSheet
      .getDataRange()
      .getValues();

    const savedCycle = savedCycles.slice(1).find(
      row =>
        String(row[cycleIdIndex]) === savedCycleId &&
        String(row[cycleQrIndex]) === qrId
    );

    if (!savedCycle) {
      throw new Error(
        "Pengesahan hubungan Cycle gagal."
      );
    }


    // ---- 11. PAPARKAN KEPUTUSAN ----

    Logger.log("QUOTA CYCLE SAVE VERIFIED");

    Logger.log("QR LABEL: Meja 01");

    Logger.log("CYCLE NUMBER: 1");

    Logger.log("CYCLE ID: " + cycleId);

    Logger.log(
      "MAX UPLOADS: " +
      savedCycle[cycleHeaders.indexOf("max_uploads")]
    );

    Logger.log(
      "SUCCESSFUL UPLOADS: " +
      savedCycle[
        cycleHeaders.indexOf("successful_uploads")
      ]
    );

    Logger.log("QR SLOT LINK VERIFIED");


  } finally {

    // ---- 12. LEPASKAN KUNCI ----

    lock.releaseLock();

  }

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.17
   QUOTA MANAGEMENT - READ QR SLOT QUOTA

   TUJUAN:
   - Cari QR Slot berdasarkan QR ID.
   - Baca current_cycle_id.
   - Cari rekod dalam QUOTA_CYCLES.
   - Kira baki kuota.
   - Paparkan status kuota.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - READ ONLY.
   - Tidak mengubah Google Sheets.
   - Tidak dihubungkan ke Web App awam.
============================================ */

function getQrSlotQuota_(qrId) {

  // ---- 1. SAHKAN QR ID ----

  if (typeof qrId !== "string" || !qrId.trim()) {
    throw new Error("QR ID tidak sah.");
  }

  qrId = qrId.trim();


  // ---- 2. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId = PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error("SPREADSHEET_ID tidak dijumpai.");
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(spreadsheetId);

  const qrSheet = ss.getSheetByName("QR_SLOTS");
  const cycleSheet = ss.getSheetByName("QUOTA_CYCLES");

  if (!qrSheet || !cycleSheet) {
    throw new Error("Tab database tidak dijumpai.");
  }


  // ---- 3. BACA QR_SLOTS ----

  const qrData = qrSheet.getDataRange().getValues();
  const qrHeaders = qrData[0];

  const qrIdIndex = qrHeaders.indexOf("qr_id");
  const labelIndex = qrHeaders.indexOf("qr_label");
  const statusIndex = qrHeaders.indexOf("qr_status");
  const currentIndex = qrHeaders.indexOf(
    "current_cycle_id"
  );
  const deletionIndex = qrHeaders.indexOf(
    "deletion_status"
  );

  if ([qrIdIndex, labelIndex, statusIndex,
       currentIndex, deletionIndex].includes(-1)) {
    throw new Error("Header QR_SLOTS tidak lengkap.");
  }

  const qrRecord = qrData.slice(1).find(
    row => String(row[qrIdIndex]) === qrId
  );

  if (!qrRecord) {
    throw new Error("QR Slot tidak dijumpai.");
  }

  const qrLabel = String(qrRecord[labelIndex]);
  const qrStatus = String(qrRecord[statusIndex]);

  const deletionStatus = String(
    qrRecord[deletionIndex]
  );

  if (deletionStatus !== "ACTIVE") {
    throw new Error("QR Slot tidak aktif atau telah dipadam.");
  }

  const currentCycleId = String(
    qrRecord[currentIndex] || ""
  ).trim();

  if (!currentCycleId) {
    throw new Error(
      "QR Slot belum mempunyai kitaran kuota."
    );
  }


  // ---- 4. BACA QUOTA_CYCLES ----

  const cycleData = cycleSheet.getDataRange().getValues();
  const cycleHeaders = cycleData[0];

  const cycleIdIndex = cycleHeaders.indexOf("cycle_id");
  const cycleQrIndex = cycleHeaders.indexOf("qr_id");
  const numberIndex = cycleHeaders.indexOf("cycle_number");
  const maxIndex = cycleHeaders.indexOf("max_uploads");
  const usedIndex = cycleHeaders.indexOf(
    "successful_uploads"
  );
  const cycleStatusIndex = cycleHeaders.indexOf(
    "cycle_status"
  );

  if ([cycleIdIndex, cycleQrIndex, numberIndex,
       maxIndex, usedIndex, cycleStatusIndex]
      .includes(-1)) {
    throw new Error("Header QUOTA_CYCLES tidak lengkap.");
  }

  const cycleRecord = cycleData.slice(1).find(
    row =>
      String(row[cycleIdIndex]) === currentCycleId &&
      String(row[cycleQrIndex]) === qrId
  );

  if (!cycleRecord) {
    throw new Error(
      "Kitaran kuota aktif tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }


  // ---- 5. KIRA BAKI KUOTA ----

  const maxUploads = Number(cycleRecord[maxIndex]);
  const successfulUploads = Number(cycleRecord[usedIndex]);

  if (
    !Number.isSafeInteger(maxUploads) ||
    maxUploads < 1 ||
    !Number.isSafeInteger(successfulUploads) ||
    successfulUploads < 0
  ) {
    throw new Error("Nilai kuota dalam database tidak sah.");
  }

  const remainingUploads = Math.max(
    0,
    maxUploads - successfulUploads
  );

  const cycleStatus = String(
    cycleRecord[cycleStatusIndex]
  );

  // Status ini hanya gambaran keadaan kuota.
  // Ia belum memberikan kebenaran upload sebenar.
  let quotaStatus = "AVAILABLE";

  if (cycleStatus !== "ACTIVE") {
    quotaStatus = "CYCLE_INACTIVE";
  } else if (qrStatus !== "ACTIVE") {
    quotaStatus = "QR_INACTIVE";
  } else if (remainingUploads === 0) {
    quotaStatus = "FULL";
  }


  // ---- 6. PULANGKAN KEPUTUSAN ----

  return {

    status: "SUCCESS",

    qr_id: qrId,
    qr_label: qrLabel,
    qr_status: qrStatus,

    cycle_id: currentCycleId,
    cycle_number: Number(cycleRecord[numberIndex]),
    cycle_status: cycleStatus,

    max_uploads: maxUploads,
    successful_uploads: successfulUploads,
    remaining_uploads: remainingUploads,

    quota_status: quotaStatus

  };

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.18
   QR SLOT MANAGEMENT - ACTIVATE QR SLOT

   TUJUAN:
   - Cari QR Slot berdasarkan QR ID.
   - Semak status semasa QR Slot.
   - Sahkan folder Google Drive wujud.
   - Sahkan kitaran kuota aktif.
   - Simulasikan perubahan DRAFT ke ACTIVE.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - DRY RUN sahaja.
   - Tidak mengubah Google Sheets.
   - Tidak dihubungkan kepada Web App awam.
============================================ */

function activateQrSlot_(qrId) {

  // ---- 1. SAHKAN QR ID ----

  if (typeof qrId !== "string" || !qrId.trim()) {
    throw new Error("QR ID tidak sah.");
  }

  qrId = qrId.trim();


  // ---- 2. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId = PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error("SPREADSHEET_ID tidak dijumpai.");
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(spreadsheetId);
  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName("QR_SLOTS");

  if (!sheet) {
    throw new Error("Tab QR_SLOTS tidak dijumpai.");
  }


  // ---- 3. CARI QR SLOT ----

  const data = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
  const headers = data[0];

  const idIndex = headers.indexOf("qr_id");
  const labelIndex = headers.indexOf("qr_label");
  const statusIndex = headers.indexOf("qr_status");
  const folderIndex = headers.indexOf("drive_folder_id");
  const deletionIndex = headers.indexOf(
    "deletion_status"
  );

  if ([idIndex, labelIndex, statusIndex,
       folderIndex, deletionIndex].includes(-1)) {
    throw new Error("Header QR_SLOTS tidak lengkap.");
  }

  const record = data.slice(1).find(
    row => String(row[idIndex]) === qrId
  );

  if (!record) {
    throw new Error("QR Slot tidak dijumpai.");
  }

  const qrLabel = String(record[labelIndex]);
  const currentStatus = String(record[statusIndex]);


  // ---- 4. SAHKAN STATUS QR SLOT ----

  if (String(record[deletionIndex]) !== "ACTIVE") {
    throw new Error(
      "QR Slot telah dipadam atau tidak aktif."
    );
  }

  if (currentStatus !== "DRAFT") {
    throw new Error(
      "Hanya QR Slot berstatus DRAFT boleh diaktifkan."
    );
  }


  // ---- 5. SAHKAN FOLDER GOOGLE DRIVE ----

  const folderId = String(
    record[folderIndex] || ""
  ).trim();

  if (!folderId) {
    throw new Error(
      "Folder QR Slot belum diwujudkan."
    );
  }

  // Pastikan folder masih boleh diakses.
  DriveApp.getFolderById(folderId);


  // ---- 6. SAHKAN KITARAN KUOTA ----

  const quota = getQrSlotQuota_(qrId);

  if (quota.cycle_status !== "ACTIVE") {
    throw new Error(
      "Kitaran kuota tidak aktif."
    );
  }

  if (quota.remaining_uploads <= 0) {
    throw new Error(
      "Tiada baki kuota untuk QR Slot."
    );
  }


  // ---- 7. PULANGKAN DRY RUN ----

  return {

    status: "SUCCESS",
    mode: "DRY_RUN",
    saved: false,

    qr_id: qrId,
    qr_label: qrLabel,

    previous_status: currentStatus,
    proposed_status: "ACTIVE",

    cycle_number: quota.cycle_number,
    remaining_uploads: quota.remaining_uploads,

    ready_to_activate: true

  };

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.19
   QR SLOT MANAGEMENT - LIVE ACTIVATION

   TUJUAN:
   - Cari QR Slot Meja 01.
   - Sahkan kelayakan pengaktifan.
   - Tukar qr_status kepada ACTIVE.
   - Kemas kini updated_at dan updated_by.
   - Baca semula status untuk pengesahan.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - Ujian manual sahaja.
   - Tidak dihubungkan kepada Web App awam.
   - Menggunakan LockService.
============================================ */

function testActivateQrSlotLive_() {

  // ---- 1. KUNCI PROSES ----

  const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();

  lock.waitLock(30000);

  try {

    // ---- 2. BUKA DATABASE ----

    const spreadsheetId = PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

    if (!spreadsheetId) {
      throw new Error("SPREADSHEET_ID tidak dijumpai.");
    }

    const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(spreadsheetId);
    const sheet = ss.getSheetByName("QR_SLOTS");

    if (!sheet) {
      throw new Error("Tab QR_SLOTS tidak dijumpai.");
    }


    // ---- 3. BACA DATA QR SLOT ----

    const data = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
    const headers = data[0];

    const idIndex = headers.indexOf("qr_id");
    const labelIndex = headers.indexOf("qr_label");
    const statusIndex = headers.indexOf("qr_status");
    const updatedIndex = headers.indexOf("updated_at");
    const updatedByIndex = headers.indexOf("updated_by");

    if ([idIndex, labelIndex, statusIndex,
         updatedIndex, updatedByIndex].includes(-1)) {
      throw new Error("Header QR_SLOTS tidak lengkap.");
    }


    // ---- 4. CARI MEJA 01 ----

    // Pastikan QR Slot milik acara ujian yang betul.

    const events = getEvents_();

    const testEvent = events.events.find(
      event => event.event_name ===
        "QR Polaroid Test Event"
    );

    if (!testEvent) {
      throw new Error("Acara ujian tidak dijumpai.");
    }

    const eventIndex = headers.indexOf("event_id");

    if (eventIndex === -1) {
      throw new Error("Header event_id tidak dijumpai.");
    }

    let qrRow = -1;

    for (let i = 1; i < data.length; i++) {

      if (
        String(data[i][eventIndex]) === testEvent.event_id &&
        String(data[i][labelIndex]) === "Meja 01"
      ) {
        qrRow = i + 1;
        break;
      }

    }

    if (qrRow === -1) {
      throw new Error("QR Slot Meja 01 tidak dijumpai.");
    }

    const qrId = String(data[qrRow - 1][idIndex]);
    const currentStatus = String(
      data[qrRow - 1][statusIndex]
    );


    // ---- 5. ELAKKAN PENGAKTIFAN BERULANG ----

    if (currentStatus === "ACTIVE") {

      Logger.log(
        "TEST SKIPPED: QR Slot sudah ACTIVE."
      );

      return;

    }


    // ---- 6. SAHKAN KELAYAKAN ----

    // Menggunakan fungsi DRY RUN Langkah 3.18.
    // Fungsi ini menyemak folder dan kuota.

    const validation = activateQrSlot_(qrId);

    if (
      validation.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
      validation.ready_to_activate !== true
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "QR Slot tidak memenuhi syarat pengaktifan."
      );
    }


    // ---- 7. AKTIFKAN QR SLOT ----

    sheet.getRange(
      qrRow,
      statusIndex + 1
    ).setValue("ACTIVE");

    sheet.getRange(
      qrRow,
      updatedIndex + 1
    ).setValue(new Date().toISOString());

    sheet.getRange(
      qrRow,
      updatedByIndex + 1
    ).setValue("MANUAL_TEST");

    SpreadsheetApp.flush();


    // ---- 8. SAHKAN STATUS BAHARU ----

    const savedStatus = String(
      sheet.getRange(
        qrRow,
        statusIndex + 1
      ).getValue()
    );

    if (savedStatus !== "ACTIVE") {
      throw new Error(
        "Status QR Slot gagal dikemas kini."
      );
    }


    // ---- 9. SAHKAN BAKI KUOTA ----

    const quota = getQrSlotQuota_(qrId);

    if (quota.quota_status !== "AVAILABLE") {
      throw new Error(
        "Status kuota tidak seperti dijangka: " +
        quota.quota_status
      );
    }


    // ---- 10. PAPARKAN KEPUTUSAN ----

    Logger.log("QR SLOT ACTIVATION VERIFIED");

    Logger.log("QR LABEL: Meja 01");

    Logger.log("PREVIOUS STATUS: DRAFT");

    Logger.log("CURRENT STATUS: " + savedStatus);

    Logger.log(
      "REMAINING UPLOADS: " +
      quota.remaining_uploads
    );

    Logger.log(
      "QUOTA STATUS: " +
      quota.quota_status
    );


  } finally {

    // ---- 11. LEPASKAN KUNCI ----

    lock.releaseLock();

  }

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.20
   QR TOKEN MANAGEMENT - VALIDATE QR TOKEN

   TUJUAN:
   - Semak format token QR.
   - Cari token dalam QR_SLOTS.
   - Pastikan QR Slot aktif.
   - Pastikan kitaran kuota aktif.
   - Pastikan baki kuota mencukupi.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - READ ONLY.
   - Tidak mengubah database.
   - Tidak memaparkan token dalam log.
   - Belum dihubungkan ke Web App awam.
============================================ */

function validateQrToken_(qrToken) {

  // ---- 1. SAHKAN FORMAT TOKEN ----

  if (typeof qrToken !== "string") {
    return {
      status: "INVALID",
      code: "INVALID_TOKEN"
    };
  }

  const token = qrToken.trim();

  // Token dijana sebagai 64 aksara heksadesimal.
  const tokenPattern = /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/i;

  if (!tokenPattern.test(token)) {
    return {
      status: "INVALID",
      code: "INVALID_TOKEN"
    };
  }


  // ---- 2. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId = PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error("SPREADSHEET_ID tidak dijumpai.");
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(spreadsheetId);
  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName("QR_SLOTS");

  if (!sheet) {
    throw new Error("Tab QR_SLOTS tidak dijumpai.");
  }


  // ---- 3. CARI TOKEN QR ----

  const data = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
  const headers = data[0];

  const tokenIndex = headers.indexOf("qr_token");
  const qrIdIndex = headers.indexOf("qr_id");
  const labelIndex = headers.indexOf("qr_label");
  const statusIndex = headers.indexOf("qr_status");
  const deletionIndex = headers.indexOf(
    "deletion_status"
  );

  if ([tokenIndex, qrIdIndex, labelIndex,
       statusIndex, deletionIndex].includes(-1)) {
    throw new Error("Header QR_SLOTS tidak lengkap.");
  }

  const matchingSlots = data.slice(1).filter(
    row => String(row[tokenIndex]) === token
  );

  if (matchingSlots.length !== 1) {
    return {
      status: "INVALID",
      code: "INVALID_TOKEN"
    };
  }

  const slot = matchingSlots[0];


  // ---- 4. SAHKAN STATUS QR SLOT ----

  const qrStatus = String(slot[statusIndex]);
  const deletionStatus = String(slot[deletionIndex]);

  if (
    qrStatus !== "ACTIVE" ||
    deletionStatus !== "ACTIVE"
  ) {
    return {
      status: "INVALID",
      code: "QR_INACTIVE"
    };
  }


  // ---- 5. SAHKAN STATUS KUOTA ----

  const qrId = String(slot[qrIdIndex]);

  const quota = getQrSlotQuota_(qrId);

  if (quota.quota_status !== "AVAILABLE") {
    return {
      status: "INVALID",
      code: "QUOTA_UNAVAILABLE"
    };
  }


  // ---- 6. PULANGKAN KEPUTUSAN ----

  return {

    status: "VALID",
    code: "TOKEN_ACCEPTED",

    qr_id: qrId,
    qr_label: String(slot[labelIndex]),

    cycle_number: quota.cycle_number,
    max_uploads: quota.max_uploads,
    remaining_uploads: quota.remaining_uploads

  };

}


/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.20
   MANUAL TEST - VALIDATE QR TOKEN

   Token dibaca terus daripada database.
   Token tidak dipaparkan dalam log.
============================================ */

function testValidateQrToken_() {

  // ---- 1. BUKA QR_SLOTS ----

  const spreadsheetId = PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(spreadsheetId);
  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName("QR_SLOTS");

  const data = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
  const headers = data[0];

  const tokenIndex = headers.indexOf("qr_token");
  const labelIndex = headers.indexOf("qr_label");

  if (tokenIndex === -1 || labelIndex === -1) {
    throw new Error("Header QR_SLOTS tidak lengkap.");
  }


  // ---- 2. CARI MEJA 01 ----

  const slot = data.slice(1).find(
    row => String(row[labelIndex]) === "Meja 01"
  );

  if (!slot) {
    throw new Error("QR Slot Meja 01 tidak dijumpai.");
  }


  // ---- 3. SAHKAN TOKEN SEBENAR ----

  const realToken = String(slot[tokenIndex]);

  const validResult = validateQrToken_(realToken);

  Logger.log(
    "VALID TOKEN TEST: " +
    JSON.stringify(validResult, null, 2)
  );


  // ---- 4. UJI TOKEN PALSU ----

  const fakeToken = "0".repeat(64);

  const invalidResult = validateQrToken_(fakeToken);

  Logger.log(
    "INVALID TOKEN TEST: " +
    JSON.stringify(invalidResult, null, 2)
  );

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.21
   EVENT MANAGEMENT - CHECK AVAILABILITY

   TUJUAN:
   - Cari acara berdasarkan event_id.
   - Semak event_status.
   - Semak deletion_status.
   - Semak schedule_enabled.
   - Semak tarikh dan masa acara.
   - Tentukan sama ada acara tersedia.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - READ ONLY.
   - Tidak mengubah database.
   - Tidak dihubungkan ke Web App awam.

   NOTA:
   - Masa menggunakan zon waktu spreadsheet.
   - Tarikh dan masa dibandingkan secara
     berasingan mengikut waktu tempatan acara.
============================================ */

function getEventAvailability_(eventId) {

  // ---- 1. SAHKAN EVENT ID ----

  if (typeof eventId !== "string" || !eventId.trim()) {
    throw new Error("Event ID tidak sah.");
  }

  eventId = eventId.trim();


  // ---- 2. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId = PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error("SPREADSHEET_ID tidak dijumpai.");
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(spreadsheetId);
  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName("EVENTS");

  if (!sheet) {
    throw new Error("Tab EVENTS tidak dijumpai.");
  }

  const timeZone = ss.getSpreadsheetTimeZone();


  // ---- 3. BACA REKOD ACARA ----

  const data = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
  const headers = data[0];

  const requiredHeaders = [
    "event_id",
    "event_name",
    "start_date",
    "end_date",
    "start_time",
    "end_time",
    "schedule_enabled",
    "event_status",
    "deletion_status"
  ];

  const missingHeaders = requiredHeaders.filter(
    header => !headers.includes(header)
  );

  if (missingHeaders.length > 0) {
    throw new Error(
      "Header EVENTS tidak lengkap: " +
      missingHeaders.join(", ")
    );
  }

  const index = name => headers.indexOf(name);

  const matches = data.slice(1).filter(
    row => String(row[index("event_id")]) === eventId
  );

  if (matches.length !== 1) {
    throw new Error(
      "Event ID tidak dijumpai atau mempunyai rekod berganda."
    );
  }

  const event = matches[0];

  const eventName = String(event[index("event_name")]);
  const eventStatus = String(event[index("event_status")]);
  const deletionStatus = String(
    event[index("deletion_status")]
  );


  // ---- 4. SEMAK STATUS ACARA ----

  // Acara yang dipadam atau belum ACTIVE
  // tidak boleh menerima upload.

  if (deletionStatus !== "ACTIVE") {
    return {
      status: "SUCCESS",
      event_id: eventId,
      event_name: eventName,
      available: false,
      availability_code: "EVENT_DELETED"
    };
  }

  if (eventStatus !== "ACTIVE") {
    return {
      status: "SUCCESS",
      event_id: eventId,
      event_name: eventName,
      available: false,
      availability_code: "EVENT_INACTIVE"
    };
  }


  // ---- 5. SEMAK TETAPAN JADUAL ----

  const scheduleValue = event[index("schedule_enabled")];

  const scheduleText = String(scheduleValue)
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase();

  let scheduleEnabled;

  if (
    scheduleValue === true ||
    scheduleText === "true"
  ) {
    scheduleEnabled = true;

  } else if (
    scheduleValue === false ||
    scheduleText === "false"
  ) {
    scheduleEnabled = false;

  } else {
    throw new Error(
      "Nilai schedule_enabled tidak sah."
    );
  }

  // Jika jadual dimatikan, acara ACTIVE
  // dianggap tersedia tanpa had masa jadual.

  if (!scheduleEnabled) {
    return {
      status: "SUCCESS",
      event_id: eventId,
      event_name: eventName,
      available: true,
      availability_code: "EVENT_AVAILABLE",
      schedule_enabled: false
    };
  }


  // ---- 6. FORMAT TARIKH DAN MASA ----

  // Fungsi bantuan untuk menukar tarikh
  // Google Sheets kepada format YYYY-MM-DD.

  function formatDate(value) {

    if (value instanceof Date && !isNaN(value)) {
      return Utilities.formatDate(
        value,
        timeZone,
        "yyyy-MM-dd"
      );
    }

    const text = String(value).trim();

    if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(text)) {
      throw new Error("Format tarikh acara tidak sah.");
    }

    return text;
  }

  // Fungsi bantuan untuk masa HH:mm.
  // Google Sheets mungkin menyimpan masa
  // sebagai Date atau teks.

  function formatTime(value) {

    if (value instanceof Date && !isNaN(value)) {
      return Utilities.formatDate(
        value,
        timeZone,
        "HH:mm"
      );
    }

    const text = String(value).trim();

    if (!/^([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d$/.test(text)) {
      throw new Error("Format masa acara tidak sah.");
    }

    return text;
  }

  const startDate = formatDate(
    event[index("start_date")]
  );

  const endDate = formatDate(
    event[index("end_date")]
  );

  const startTime = formatTime(
    event[index("start_time")]
  );

  const endTime = formatTime(
    event[index("end_time")]
  );


  // ---- 7. SAHKAN JULAT JADUAL ----

  // Untuk versi ini, masa mula dan tamat
  // ialah masa harian dalam zon waktu acara.
  // Acara merentas tengah malam belum disokong.

  if (
    startDate > endDate ||
    startTime >= endTime
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Julat tarikh atau masa acara tidak sah."
    );
  }


  // ---- 8. DAPATKAN MASA SEKARANG ----

  const now = new Date();

  const today = Utilities.formatDate(
    now,
    timeZone,
    "yyyy-MM-dd"
  );

  const currentTime = Utilities.formatDate(
    now,
    timeZone,
    "HH:mm"
  );


  // ---- 9. TENTUKAN KETERSEDIAAN ----

  let availabilityCode = "EVENT_AVAILABLE";
  let available = true;

  if (today < startDate) {

    availabilityCode = "EVENT_NOT_STARTED";
    available = false;

  } else if (today > endDate) {

    availabilityCode = "EVENT_ENDED";
    available = false;

  } else if (currentTime < startTime) {

    availabilityCode = "EVENT_NOT_STARTED";
    available = false;

  } else if (currentTime >= endTime) {

    availabilityCode = "EVENT_ENDED";
    available = false;

  }


  // ---- 10. PULANGKAN KEPUTUSAN ----

  return {
    status: "SUCCESS",

    event_id: eventId,
    event_name: eventName,
    event_status: eventStatus,

    available: available,
    availability_code: availabilityCode,

    schedule_enabled: true,

    start_date: startDate,
    end_date: endDate,
    start_time: startTime,
    end_time: endTime,

    checked_date: today,
    checked_time: currentTime,
    time_zone: timeZone
  };

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.22
   EVENT MANAGEMENT - ACTIVATE EVENT DRY RUN

   TUJUAN:
   - Cari acara berdasarkan event_id.
   - Pastikan acara belum dipadam.
   - Pastikan status semasa DRAFT.
   - Sahkan folder Google Drive acara.
   - Sahkan tetapan jadual acara.
   - Simulasikan pengaktifan acara.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - DRY RUN sahaja.
   - Tidak mengubah database.
   - Tidak dihubungkan ke Web App awam.
============================================ */

function activateEvent_(eventId) {

  // ---- 1. SAHKAN EVENT ID ----

  if (typeof eventId !== "string" || !eventId.trim()) {
    throw new Error("Event ID tidak sah.");
  }

  eventId = eventId.trim();


  // ---- 2. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId = PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error("SPREADSHEET_ID tidak dijumpai.");
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(spreadsheetId);
  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName("EVENTS");

  if (!sheet) {
    throw new Error("Tab EVENTS tidak dijumpai.");
  }


  // ---- 3. BACA REKOD ACARA ----

  const data = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
  const headers = data[0];

  const requiredHeaders = [
    "event_id",
    "event_name",
    "event_status",
    "deletion_status",
    "drive_folder_id",
    "schedule_enabled",
    "start_date",
    "end_date",
    "start_time",
    "end_time"
  ];

  const missingHeaders = requiredHeaders.filter(
    header => !headers.includes(header)
  );

  if (missingHeaders.length > 0) {
    throw new Error(
      "Header EVENTS tidak lengkap: " +
      missingHeaders.join(", ")
    );
  }

  const index = name => headers.indexOf(name);

  const matches = data.slice(1).filter(
    row => String(row[index("event_id")]) === eventId
  );

  if (matches.length !== 1) {
    throw new Error(
      "Event ID tidak dijumpai atau mempunyai rekod berganda."
    );
  }

  const event = matches[0];

  const eventName = String(event[index("event_name")]);
  const currentStatus = String(event[index("event_status")]);
  const deletionStatus = String(
    event[index("deletion_status")]
  );


  // ---- 4. SAHKAN STATUS ACARA ----

  if (deletionStatus !== "ACTIVE") {
    throw new Error(
      "Acara telah dipadam atau tidak aktif."
    );
  }

  if (currentStatus !== "DRAFT") {
    throw new Error(
      "Hanya acara berstatus DRAFT boleh diaktifkan."
    );
  }


  // ---- 5. SAHKAN FOLDER GOOGLE DRIVE ----

  const folderId = String(
    event[index("drive_folder_id")] || ""
  ).trim();

  if (!folderId) {
    throw new Error(
      "Folder Google Drive acara belum diwujudkan."
    );
  }

  // Sahkan folder boleh diakses.
  DriveApp.getFolderById(folderId);


  // ---- 6. SAHKAN TETAPAN JADUAL ----

  const scheduleValue = event[index("schedule_enabled")];

  const scheduleText = String(scheduleValue)
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase();

  let scheduleEnabled;

  if (
    scheduleValue === true ||
    scheduleText === "true"
  ) {
    scheduleEnabled = true;

  } else if (
    scheduleValue === false ||
    scheduleText === "false"
  ) {
    scheduleEnabled = false;

  } else {
    throw new Error(
      "Nilai schedule_enabled tidak sah."
    );
  }


  // ---- 7. SEMAK FORMAT TARIKH DAN MASA ----

  if (scheduleEnabled) {

    const timeZone = ss.getSpreadsheetTimeZone();

    function formatDate(value) {

      if (value instanceof Date && !isNaN(value)) {
        return Utilities.formatDate(
          value,
          timeZone,
          "yyyy-MM-dd"
        );
      }

      const text = String(value).trim();

      if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(text)) {
        throw new Error("Format tarikh tidak sah.");
      }

      return text;
    }

    function formatTime(value) {

      if (value instanceof Date && !isNaN(value)) {
        return Utilities.formatDate(
          value,
          timeZone,
          "HH:mm"
        );
      }

      const text = String(value).trim();

      if (!/^([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d$/.test(text)) {
        throw new Error("Format masa tidak sah.");
      }

      return text;
    }

    const startDate = formatDate(
      event[index("start_date")]
    );

    const endDate = formatDate(
      event[index("end_date")]
    );

    const startTime = formatTime(
      event[index("start_time")]
    );

    const endTime = formatTime(
      event[index("end_time")]
    );

    if (
      startDate > endDate ||
      startTime >= endTime
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "Julat tarikh atau masa acara tidak sah."
      );
    }

  }


  // ---- 8. PULANGKAN KEPUTUSAN DRY RUN ----

  return {

    status: "SUCCESS",
    mode: "DRY_RUN",
    saved: false,

    event_id: eventId,
    event_name: eventName,

    previous_status: currentStatus,
    proposed_status: "ACTIVE",

    folder_verified: true,
    schedule_enabled: scheduleEnabled,

    ready_to_activate: true

  };

}

  // ---- 1. CARI ACARA UJIAN ----
