  let missingFieldRejected = false;

  try {

    buildUploadReservationRow_({

      ...testData,

      cycle_id: ""

    });

  } catch (error) {

    missingFieldRejected =
      error.message ===
      "MISSING_RESERVATION_FIELD: cycle_id";

  }


  // ---- 17. SEMAK DATABASE SELEPAS UJIAN ----

  const uploadsAfter =
    sheet.getDataRange().getValues();

  const snapshotAfter =
    JSON.stringify(uploadsAfter);

  const databaseUnchanged =
    snapshotBefore === snapshotAfter;


  // ---- 18. SEDIAKAN RUMUSAN SELAMAT ----

  const summary = {

    headers_verified:
      headersValid,

    column_count:
      result.column_count,

    all_22_fields_verified:
      allFieldsValid,

    proposed_upload_status:
      result.record.upload_status,

    deletion_status:
      result.record.deletion_status,

    retry_count:
      result.record.retry_count,

    missing_field_rejected:
      missingFieldRejected,

    database_unchanged:
      databaseUnchanged,

    saved:
      result.saved,

    quota_reserved:
      result.quota_reserved

  };

  Logger.log(
    "UPLOAD RESERVATION ROW TEST:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
  );


  // ---- 19. SAHKAN KEPUTUSAN AKHIR ----

  const passed =

    headersValid === true &&

    result.status === "SUCCESS" &&
    result.code ===
      "RESERVATION_ROW_BUILT" &&

    result.column_count === 22 &&

    allFieldsValid === true &&

    result.record.upload_status ===
      "RESERVED" &&

    result.record.deletion_status ===
      "ACTIVE" &&

    result.record.retry_count === 0 &&

    missingFieldRejected === true &&

    databaseUnchanged === true &&

    result.saved === false &&
    result.quota_reserved === false;

  if (!passed) {
    throw new Error(
      "UPLOAD RESERVATION ROW TEST FAILED"
    );
  }

  Logger.log(
    "UPLOAD RESERVATION ROW TEST PASSED"
  );

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.39
   LOCKED RESERVATION PREPARATION

   TUJUAN:
   - Gabungkan pengesahan upload.
   - Gunakan ScriptLock.
   - Semak kuota dan idempotency.
   - Jana lease untuk permintaan layak.
   - Bina rekod RESERVED 22 medan.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - DRY RUN / READ ONLY.
   - Tidak menulis ke Google Sheets.
   - Tidak menyimpan gambar.
   - Tidak menempah kuota.
   - Tidak dihubungkan ke Web App awam.

   PENTING:
   Jangan panggil fungsi ini daripada
   doGet() atau doPost().

   Fungsi ini tidak membenarkan LIVE.
============================================ */


// ---- 1. FUNGSI PENYEDIAAN TERKUNCI ----

function prepareLockedUploadReservation_(
  uploadData
) {

  // ---- 2. DAPATKAN LOCK ----

  return withUploadReservationLock_(
    function() {

      // ---- 3. SAHKAN METADATA ----

      const fileResult = validateUploadFile_(
        uploadData
      );

      if (fileResult.status !== "VALID") {

        return {
          status: "REJECTED",
          code: fileResult.code,
          mode: "LOCKED_DRY_RUN",
          saved: false,
          quota_reserved: false
        };

      }


      // ---- 4. SEMAK IDEMPOTENCY ----

      const keyResult = checkUploadIdempotency_(
        uploadData.idempotency_key
      );

      if (
        keyResult.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
        keyResult.code !== "NEW_REQUEST" ||
        keyResult.can_reserve !== true
      ) {

        return {
          status: "REJECTED",
          code: keyResult.code,
          mode: "LOCKED_DRY_RUN",
          saved: false,
          quota_reserved: false
        };

      }


      // ---- 5. SEMAK KELAYAKAN QR DAN ACARA ----

      const eligibility = checkUploadEligibility_(
        uploadData.qr_token
      );

      if (
        eligibility.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
        eligibility.eligible !== true
      ) {

        return {
          status: "REJECTED",
          code:
            eligibility.eligibility_code ||
            "UPLOAD_NOT_ELIGIBLE",

          mode: "LOCKED_DRY_RUN",
          saved: false,
          quota_reserved: false
        };

      }


      // ---- 6. SEMAK KUOTA EFEKTIF ----

      const quota = getEffectiveUploadQuota_(
        eligibility.qr_id
      );

      if (
        quota.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
        quota.quota_status !== "AVAILABLE" ||
        quota.remaining_reservable_uploads <= 0
      ) {

        return {
          status: "REJECTED",
          code: "EFFECTIVE_QUOTA_FULL",
          mode: "LOCKED_DRY_RUN",
          saved: false,
          quota_reserved: false
        };

      }


      // ---- 7. SAHKAN HUBUNGAN QR DAN CYCLE ----

      if (
        quota.qr_id !== eligibility.qr_id ||
        !quota.cycle_id
      ) {
        return {
          status: "REJECTED",
          code: "INVALID_QR_CYCLE_RELATION",
          mode: "LOCKED_DRY_RUN",
          saved: false,
          quota_reserved: false
        };
      }


      // ---- 8. JANA LEASE ----

      const lease = createUploadLease_();

      // ---- 9. SEDIAKAN DATA REKOD ----

      const now = new Date().toISOString();

      const recordData = {

        upload_id:
          Utilities.getUuid(),

        idempotency_key:
          uploadData.idempotency_key,

        event_id:
          eligibility.event_id,

        qr_id:
          eligibility.qr_id,

        cycle_id:
          quota.cycle_id,

        lease_token:
          lease.lease_token,

        lease_expires_at:
          lease.lease_expires_at,

        original_filename:
          uploadData.original_filename,

        file_mime_type:
          uploadData.file_mime_type,

        file_size_bytes:
          uploadData.file_size_bytes,

        created_at:
          now

      };


      // ---- 10. BINA REKOD 22 MEDAN ----

      const prepared = buildUploadReservationRow_(
        recordData
      );


      // ---- 11. PULANGKAN RUMUSAN SELAMAT ----

      // Jangan pulangkan lease token
      // atau idempotency key.

      return {

        status: "SUCCESS",
        code: "LOCKED_RESERVATION_READY",

        mode: "LOCKED_DRY_RUN",

        saved: false,
        quota_reserved: false,

        lock_acquired: true,

        record_prepared: true,

        column_count:
          prepared.column_count,

        proposed_upload_status:
          prepared.record.upload_status,

        qr_label:
          eligibility.qr_label,

        event_name:
          eligibility.event_name,

        cycle_number:
          quota.cycle_number,

        remaining_reservable_uploads:
          quota.remaining_reservable_uploads

      };

    }
  );

}


/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.39
   MANUAL TEST - LOCKED PREPARATION

   Ujian 1:
   Permintaan sebenar ditolak kerana
   acara belum bermula.

   Ujian 2:
   Rekod 22 medan boleh dibina
   daripada data simulasi.

   Ujian 3:
   UPLOADS tidak berubah.
============================================ */

function testPrepareLockedUploadReservation_() {

  // ---- 12. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId = PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
    spreadsheetId
  );

  const qrSheet = ss.getSheetByName(
    "QR_SLOTS"
  );

  const uploadSheet = ss.getSheetByName(
    "UPLOADS"
  );

  if (!qrSheet || !uploadSheet) {
    throw new Error(
      "Tab QR_SLOTS atau UPLOADS tiada."
    );
  }


  // ---- 13. SIMPAN KEADAAN UPLOADS ----

  const before = JSON.stringify(
    uploadSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 14. CARI ACARA UJIAN ----

  const events = getEvents_().events.filter(
    event =>
      event.event_name ===
      "QR Polaroid Test Event"
  );

  if (events.length !== 1) {
    throw new Error(
      "Acara ujian tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }


  // ---- 15. CARI TOKEN MEJA 01 ----

  const data = qrSheet
    .getDataRange()
    .getValues();

  const headers = data[0];

  const tokenIndex =
    headers.indexOf("qr_token");

  const labelIndex =
    headers.indexOf("qr_label");

  const eventIndex =
    headers.indexOf("event_id");

  if (
    tokenIndex === -1 ||
    labelIndex === -1 ||
    eventIndex === -1
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Header QR_SLOTS tidak lengkap."
    );
  }

  const matches = data.slice(1).filter(
    row =>
      String(row[labelIndex]) === "Meja 01" &&
      String(row[eventIndex]) ===
        events[0].event_id
  );

  if (matches.length !== 1) {
    throw new Error(
      "QR Slot Meja 01 tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }

  const qrToken = String(
    matches[0][tokenIndex]
  );


  // ---- 16. METADATA UJIAN SEBENAR ----

  const uploadData = {

    qr_token: qrToken,

    original_filename:
      "polaroid_test.jpg",

    file_mime_type:
      "image/jpeg",

    file_size_bytes:
      2500000,

    idempotency_key:
      Utilities.getUuid()

  };


  // ---- 17. UJIAN 1: JADUAL SEBENAR ----

  const result1 = prepareLockedUploadReservation_(
    uploadData
  );

  Logger.log(
    "TEST 1 - REAL EVENT VALIDATION:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify(result1, null, 2)
  );


  // ---- 18. UJIAN 2: PEMBENTUKAN REKOD ----

  // Data simulasi digunakan kerana
  // acara sebenar belum bermula.

  const lease = createUploadLease_();

  const simulatedRecord = buildUploadReservationRow_({

    upload_id:
      Utilities.getUuid(),

    idempotency_key:
      Utilities.getUuid(),

    event_id:
      "SIM_EVENT_001",

    qr_id:
      "SIM_QR_001",

    cycle_id:
      "SIM_CYCLE_001",

    lease_token:
      lease.lease_token,

    lease_expires_at:
      lease.lease_expires_at,

    original_filename:
      "polaroid_test.jpg",

    file_mime_type:
      "image/jpeg",

    file_size_bytes:
      2500000,

    created_at:
      new Date().toISOString()

  });

  const simulationPassed =
    simulatedRecord.status === "SUCCESS" &&
    simulatedRecord.column_count === 22 &&
    simulatedRecord.record.upload_status ===
      "RESERVED" &&
    simulatedRecord.saved === false;


  Logger.log(
    "TEST 2 - SIMULATED RECORD:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify({

      record_prepared:
        simulationPassed,

      column_count:
        simulatedRecord.column_count,

      proposed_upload_status:
        simulatedRecord.record.upload_status,

      saved:
        simulatedRecord.saved

    }, null, 2)
  );


  // ---- 19. SEMAK DATABASE ----

  const after = JSON.stringify(
    uploadSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const databaseUnchanged =
    before === after;


  // ---- 20. SAHKAN KEPUTUSAN ----

  const passed =

    result1.status === "REJECTED" &&
    result1.code === "EVENT_NOT_STARTED" &&
    result1.saved === false &&
    result1.quota_reserved === false &&

    simulationPassed === true &&

    databaseUnchanged === true;

  if (!passed) {
    throw new Error(
      "LOCKED RESERVATION PREPARATION TEST FAILED"
    );
  }

  Logger.log(
    "LOCKED RESERVATION PREPARATION TEST PASSED"
  );

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.40
   UPLOAD LEASE RECORD CONSISTENCY TEST

   TUJUAN:
   - Sahkan format lease token.
   - Sahkan tempoh sah lease.
   - Sahkan pemetaan lease ke UPLOADS.
   - Uji lease aktif dan tamat tempoh.
   - Pastikan database tidak berubah.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - DRY RUN / READ ONLY.
   - Tidak menulis ke Google Sheets.
   - Tidak menyimpan gambar.
   - Tidak menempah kuota.
   - Tidak dihubungkan ke Web App awam.

   PENTING:
   Jangan log lease token sebenar.
   Jangan panggil fungsi ujian ini
   daripada doGet() atau doPost().
============================================ */


function testUploadLeaseRecordConsistency_() {

  // ---- 1. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId = PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error(
      "SPREADSHEET_ID tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
    spreadsheetId
  );

  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(
    "UPLOADS"
  );

  if (!sheet) {
    throw new Error(
      "Tab UPLOADS tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }


  // ---- 2. SIMPAN KEADAAN ASAL DATABASE ----

  const snapshotBefore = JSON.stringify(
    sheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 3. JANA LEASE BAHARU ----

  const lease = createUploadLease_();


  // ---- 4. SAHKAN FORMAT LEASE TOKEN ----

  // Token dijangka mengandungi
  // 64 aksara hexadecimal.

  const tokenFormatValid =
    typeof lease.lease_token === "string" &&
    /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/i.test(
      lease.lease_token
    );


  // ---- 5. SAHKAN MASA LEASE ----

  const createdMs = Date.parse(
    lease.lease_created_at
  );

  const expiresMs = Date.parse(
    lease.lease_expires_at
  );

  const timestampsValid =
    Number.isFinite(createdMs) &&
    Number.isFinite(expiresMs) &&
    expiresMs > createdMs;


  // ---- 6. SAHKAN TEMPOH 300 SAAT ----

  const expectedDurationMs =
    UPLOAD_LEASE_DURATION_SECONDS * 1000;

  const actualDurationMs =
    expiresMs - createdMs;

  const durationValid =
    actualDurationMs === expectedDurationMs;


  // ---- 7. BINA REKOD RESERVED ----

  const recordResult =
    buildUploadReservationRow_({

      upload_id:
        Utilities.getUuid(),

      idempotency_key:
        Utilities.getUuid(),

      event_id:
        "SIM_EVENT_001",

      qr_id:
        "SIM_QR_001",

      cycle_id:
        "SIM_CYCLE_001",

      lease_token:
        lease.lease_token,

      lease_expires_at:
        lease.lease_expires_at,

      original_filename:
        "polaroid_test.jpg",

      file_mime_type:
        "image/jpeg",

      file_size_bytes:
        2500000,

      created_at:
        lease.lease_created_at

    });


  // ---- 8. SAHKAN PEMETAAN LEASE ----

  // Kolum G = index 6
  // Kolum H = index 7

  const recordMappingValid =
    recordResult.status === "SUCCESS" &&
    recordResult.column_count === 22 &&
    recordResult.row[5] === "RESERVED" &&
    recordResult.row[6] ===
      lease.lease_token &&
    recordResult.row[7] ===
      lease.lease_expires_at &&
    recordResult.row[13] ===
      lease.lease_created_at &&
    recordResult.row[16] ===
      lease.lease_created_at;


  // ---- 9. UJI LEASE MASIH AKTIF ----

  // Gunakan masa 1 saat selepas
  // lease dicipta.

  const activeTime = new Date(
    createdMs + 1000
  ).toISOString();

  const activeResult = checkUploadLease_(
    lease.lease_expires_at,
    activeTime
  );

  const activeValid =
    activeResult.code === "LEASE_ACTIVE";


  // ---- 10. UJI LEASE SUDAH TAMAT ----

  // Gunakan masa 1 saat selepas
  // tempoh lease tamat.

  const expiredTime = new Date(
    expiresMs + 1000
  ).toISOString();

  const expiredResult = checkUploadLease_(
    lease.lease_expires_at,
    expiredTime
  );

  const expiredValid =
    expiredResult.code === "LEASE_EXPIRED";


  // ---- 11. SEMAK DATABASE SELEPAS UJIAN ----

  const snapshotAfter = JSON.stringify(
    sheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const databaseUnchanged =
    snapshotBefore === snapshotAfter;


  // ---- 12. PAPARKAN RUMUSAN SELAMAT ----

  const summary = {

    token_format_valid:
      tokenFormatValid,

    timestamps_valid:
      timestampsValid,

    lease_duration_seconds:
      actualDurationMs / 1000,

    duration_valid:
      durationValid,

    record_columns:
      recordResult.column_count,

    record_mapping_valid:
      recordMappingValid,

    active_lease_detected:
      activeValid,

    expired_lease_detected:
      expiredValid,

    database_unchanged:
      databaseUnchanged,

    saved: false,

    quota_reserved: false

  };

  Logger.log(
    "UPLOAD LEASE RECORD CONSISTENCY:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
  );


  // ---- 13. SAHKAN KEPUTUSAN AKHIR ----

  const passed =

    tokenFormatValid === true &&
    timestampsValid === true &&
    durationValid === true &&
    recordMappingValid === true &&
    activeValid === true &&
    expiredValid === true &&
    databaseUnchanged === true;

  if (!passed) {
    throw new Error(
      "UPLOAD LEASE RECORD CONSISTENCY TEST FAILED"
    );
  }

  Logger.log(
    "UPLOAD LEASE RECORD CONSISTENCY TEST PASSED"
  );

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.41
   UPLOAD LEASE OWNERSHIP VERIFICATION

   TUJUAN:
   - Sahkan pemilikan lease.
   - Padankan upload_id.
   - Padankan lease_token.
   - Semak upload_status.
   - Semak masa tamat lease.
   - Tolak rekod yang telah dipadam.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - READ ONLY.
   - Tidak membaca rekod sebenar UPLOADS.
   - Tidak menulis ke Google Sheets.
   - Tidak menyimpan gambar.
   - Tidak mengubah kuota.
   - Tidak dihubungkan ke Web App awam.

   PENTING:
   Fungsi ini menerima rekod daripada
   pemanggil untuk tujuan pengujian.

   Ia BELUM merupakan pengesahan
   pemilikan berdasarkan database.

   Dalam operasi LIVE, rekod mesti
   dibaca daripada database oleh server,
   bukan dibekalkan oleh peserta.
============================================ */


// ---- 1. FUNGSI PENGESAHAN PEMILIKAN ----

function verifyUploadLeaseOwnership_(
  uploadId,
  leaseToken,
  uploadRecord,
  nowOverride
) {

  // ---- 2. SEMAK INPUT ASAS ----

  if (
    typeof uploadId !== "string" ||
    !uploadId.trim() ||
    typeof leaseToken !== "string" ||
    !leaseToken.trim()
  ) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "INVALID_LEASE_CREDENTIALS",
      verified: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 3. SEMAK REKOD ----

  if (
    !uploadRecord ||
    typeof uploadRecord !== "object" ||
    Array.isArray(uploadRecord)
  ) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "INVALID_UPLOAD_RECORD",
      verified: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 4. SAHKAN UPLOAD ID ----

  if (
    uploadRecord.upload_id !== uploadId
  ) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "UPLOAD_ID_MISMATCH",
      verified: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 5. SAHKAN LEASE TOKEN ----

  // Jangan log token ini.

  if (
    uploadRecord.lease_token !== leaseToken
  ) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "LEASE_TOKEN_MISMATCH",
      verified: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 6. SEMAK STATUS REKOD ----

  // Hanya RESERVED dibenarkan
  // dalam fasa pengesahan ini.

  if (
    uploadRecord.upload_status !==
    "RESERVED"
  ) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "INVALID_UPLOAD_STATUS",
      verified: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 7. SEMAK STATUS PEMADAMAN ----

  if (
    uploadRecord.deletion_status !==
    "ACTIVE"
  ) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "UPLOAD_RECORD_DELETED",
      verified: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 8. SEMAK LEASE MASIH AKTIF ----

  const leaseResult = checkUploadLease_(
    uploadRecord.lease_expires_at,
    nowOverride
  );

  if (
    leaseResult.code !== "LEASE_ACTIVE"
  ) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "LEASE_NOT_ACTIVE",
      verified: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 9. KEPUTUSAN BERJAYA ----

  return {
    status: "SUCCESS",
    code: "LEASE_OWNER_VERIFIED",
    verified: true,
    upload_status: "RESERVED"
  };

}

   LANGKAH 3.41
   MANUAL TEST - LEASE OWNERSHIP

   Ujian:
   1. Lease sah.

   3. Upload ID salah.

   7. Database tidak berubah.

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(

  );

  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(
    "UPLOADS"
  );

  if (!sheet) {
    throw new Error(
      "Tab UPLOADS tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }


  // ---- 11. SIMPAN KEADAAN ASAL ----

  const before = JSON.stringify(
    sheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 12. JANA LEASE SIMULASI ----

  const lease = createUploadLease_();

  const uploadId =
    Utilities.getUuid();


  // ---- 13. BINA REKOD SIMULASI ----

  const prepared = buildUploadReservationRow_({

      Utilities.getUuid(),

      "SIM_QR_001",

      "SIM_CYCLE_001",

    lease_token:

    file_mime_type:
      "image/jpeg",

    file_size_bytes:
      2500000,

    created_at:
      lease.lease_created_at

  });

  const record = prepared.record;


  // ---- 14. MASA UJIAN ----

  // Gunakan masa 1 saat selepas
  // lease dicipta.

  const activeTime = new Date(

  ).toISOString();


  // ---- 15. UJIAN 1: LEASE SAH ----

  const validResult =

  ).toISOString();

  const expiredResult =

      uploadId,
      lease.lease_token,

    );


  // ---- 20. UJIAN 6: REKOD DIPADAM ----

  const deletedRecord = {
    ...record,
    deletion_status: "DELETED"
  };

  const deletedResult =
    verifyUploadLeaseOwnership_(
      uploadId,
      lease.lease_token,
      deletedRecord,
      activeTime
    );


  // ---- 21. SEMAK DATABASE ----

  const after = JSON.stringify(
    sheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const databaseUnchanged =
    before === after;


  // ---- 22. RUMUSAN KEPUTUSAN ----

  const summary = {

    valid_lease_verified:
      validResult.code ===
      "LEASE_OWNER_VERIFIED",

    wrong_token_rejected:
      wrongTokenResult.code ===
      "LEASE_TOKEN_MISMATCH",

    wrong_upload_id_rejected:
      wrongIdResult.code ===
      "UPLOAD_ID_MISMATCH",

    completed_status_rejected:
      completedResult.code ===
      "INVALID_UPLOAD_STATUS",

    expired_lease_rejected:
      expiredResult.code ===
      "LEASE_NOT_ACTIVE",

    deleted_record_rejected:
      deletedResult.code ===
      "UPLOAD_RECORD_DELETED",

    database_unchanged:
      databaseUnchanged

  };

  Logger.log(
    "UPLOAD LEASE OWNERSHIP TEST:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
  );


  // ---- 23. SAHKAN KEPUTUSAN AKHIR ----

  const passed =
    Object.values(summary).every(
      value => value === true
    );

  if (!passed) {
    throw new Error(
      "UPLOAD LEASE OWNERSHIP TEST FAILED"
    );
  }

  Logger.log(
    "UPLOAD LEASE OWNERSHIP TEST PASSED"
  );

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.42
   FIND UPLOAD RECORD BY ID

   TUJUAN:
   - Cari rekod daripada tab UPLOADS.
   - Gunakan upload_id sebagai kunci.
   - Pulangkan tepat satu rekod.
   - Kesan upload_id berganda.
   - Tolak ID yang tidak sah.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - READ ONLY.
   - Tidak menulis ke Google Sheets.
   - Tidak menyimpan gambar.
   - Tidak mengubah kuota.
   - Tidak dihubungkan ke Web App awam.

   PENTING:
   Fungsi ini memulangkan rekod dalaman
   yang mungkin mengandungi lease_token.

   Jangan pulangkan hasil fungsi ini
   secara terus kepada peserta.

   Jangan tambah fungsi ini kepada
   doGet() atau doPost().
============================================ */


// ---- 1. FUNGSI CARIAN UPLOAD ----

function findUploadRecordById_(uploadId) {

  // ---- 2. SAHKAN FORMAT ID ----

  // Upload ID menggunakan UUID.
  // Semakan ini menerima UUID standard.

  const uuidPattern =
    /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;

  if (
    typeof uploadId !== "string" ||
    !uuidPattern.test(uploadId)
  ) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "INVALID_UPLOAD_ID",
      found: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 3. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId = PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error(
      "SPREADSHEET_ID tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
    spreadsheetId
  );

  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(
    "UPLOADS"
  );

  if (!sheet) {
    throw new Error(
      "Tab UPLOADS tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }


  // ---- 4. BACA HEADER DAN DATA ----

  const values = sheet
    .getDataRange()
    .getValues();

  const headers = values[0].map(
    value => String(value).trim()
  );


  // ---- 5. SAHKAN STRUKTUR DATABASE ----

  const headersValid =
    UPLOAD_RESERVATION_HEADERS.length === 22 &&
    headers.length >= 22 &&
    UPLOAD_RESERVATION_HEADERS.every(
      (header, index) =>
        headers[index] === header
    );

  if (!headersValid) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "UPLOADS_HEADER_MISMATCH",
      found: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 6. CARI UPLOAD ID ----

  const matches = [];

  for (
    let rowIndex = 1;
    rowIndex < values.length;
    rowIndex++
  ) {

    const row = values[rowIndex];

    const storedId = String(
      row[0] || ""
    );

    if (storedId === uploadId) {

      matches.push({
        row_number: rowIndex + 1,
        values: row
      });

    }

  }


  // ---- 7. TIADA REKOD ----

  if (matches.length === 0) {

    return {
      status: "SUCCESS",
      code: "UPLOAD_NOT_FOUND",
      found: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 8. REKOD BERGANDA ----

  if (matches.length > 1) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "DUPLICATE_UPLOAD_ID",
      found: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 9. TUKAR ROW KEPADA OBJECT ----

  const match = matches[0];

  const record = {};

  UPLOAD_RESERVATION_HEADERS.forEach(
    (header, index) => {

      record[header] =
        match.values[index];

    }
  );


  // ---- 10. PULANGKAN REKOD DALAMAN ----

  return {
    status: "SUCCESS",
    code: "UPLOAD_FOUND",
    found: true,

    row_number:
      match.row_number,

    record: record
  };

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.43
   VERIFY STORED UPLOAD LEASE

   TUJUAN:
   - Cari rekod upload dalam database.
   - Sahkan pemilikan lease.
   - Tolak rekod yang tidak wujud.
   - Tolak upload ID yang tidak sah.
   - Pastikan database tidak berubah.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - READ ONLY.
   - Tidak menulis ke Google Sheets.
   - Tidak menyimpan gambar.
   - Tidak mengubah status upload.
   - Tidak mengubah kuota.
   - Tidak dihubungkan ke Web App awam.

   PENTING:
   Fungsi ini tidak menerima rekod
   upload daripada peserta.

   Rekod diperoleh terus daripada
   fungsi findUploadRecordById_().

   Jangan tambahkan fungsi ini kepada
   doGet() atau doPost().
============================================ */


// ---- 1. FUNGSI PENGESAHAN DATABASE ----

function verifyStoredUploadLease_(
  uploadId,
  leaseToken
) {

  // ---- 2. SAHKAN INPUT TOKEN ----

  // Lease token dijangka mengandungi
  // 64 aksara hexadecimal.

  const tokenPattern =
    /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/i;

  if (
    typeof leaseToken !== "string" ||
    !tokenPattern.test(leaseToken)
  ) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "INVALID_LEASE_TOKEN",
      verified: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 3. CARI REKOD DALAM DATABASE ----

  const lookup = findUploadRecordById_(
    uploadId
  );


  // ---- 4. TANGANI REKOD TIDAK DITEMUI ----

  if (
    lookup.status === "SUCCESS" &&
    lookup.code === "UPLOAD_NOT_FOUND"
  ) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "UPLOAD_NOT_FOUND",
      verified: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 5. TANGANI KEGAGALAN CARIAN ----

  if (
    lookup.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
    lookup.found !== true
  ) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code:
        lookup.code ||
        "UPLOAD_LOOKUP_FAILED",

      verified: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 6. SAHKAN PEMILIKAN LEASE ----

  // Gunakan fungsi Langkah 3.41.
  // Rekod datang daripada database.

  const ownership =
    verifyUploadLeaseOwnership_(
      uploadId,
      leaseToken,
      lookup.record
    );


  // ---- 7. TANGANI LEASE TIDAK SAH ----

  if (
    ownership.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
    ownership.verified !== true
  ) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code:
        ownership.code ||
        "LEASE_OWNERSHIP_FAILED",

      verified: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 8. PULANGKAN KEPUTUSAN SELAMAT ----

  // Jangan pulangkan rekod penuh
  // kerana mengandungi lease token.

  return {
    status: "SUCCESS",
    code: "STORED_LEASE_VERIFIED",

    verified: true,

    upload_status:
      lookup.record.upload_status,

    row_number:
      lookup.row_number
  };

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.44
   LOCKED STORED LEASE VERIFICATION

   TUJUAN:
   - Gunakan ScriptLock.
   - Cari rekod upload sebenar.
   - Sahkan pemilikan lease.
   - Semak status dan tempoh lease.
   - Pastikan database tidak berubah.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - LOCKED READ ONLY.
   - Tiada penulisan Google Sheets.
   - Tiada penyimpanan gambar.
   - Tiada perubahan kuota.
   - Tiada perubahan status upload.
   - Tidak dihubungkan ke Web App awam.

   PENTING:
   Jangan tambah fungsi ini kepada
   doGet() atau doPost().

   Jangan gunakan hasil pengesahan
   sebagai kebenaran untuk menulis
   selepas lock dilepaskan.

   Operasi LIVE kelak perlu membuat
   pengesahan dan penulisan dalam
   ScriptLock yang sama.
============================================ */


// ---- 1. FUNGSI PENGESAHAN TERKUNCI ----

function verifyStoredUploadLeaseWithLock_(
  uploadId,
  leaseToken
) {

  // ---- 2. DAPATKAN SCRIPTLOCK ----

  // Fungsi Langkah 3.33 menguruskan:
  // - Pengambilan lock.
  // - Pengendalian lock sibuk.
  // - Pelepasan lock dalam finally.

  return withUploadReservationLock_(
    function() {

      // ---- 3. SAHKAN LEASE DATABASE ----

      // Fungsi Langkah 3.43 akan:
      // - Cari upload_id dalam UPLOADS.
      // - Sahkan lease_token.
      // - Semak status RESERVED.
      // - Semak lease belum tamat.

      const verification =
        verifyStoredUploadLease_(
          uploadId,
          leaseToken
        );


      // ---- 4. TANGANI PENGESAHAN GAGAL ----

      if (
        verification.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
        verification.verified !== true
      ) {

        return {
          status: "REJECTED",

          code:
            verification.code ||
            "LEASE_VERIFICATION_FAILED",

          mode: "LOCKED_READ_ONLY",

          lock_acquired: true,
          verified: false,

          saved: false,
          status_changed: false,
          quota_changed: false
        };

      }


      // ---- 5. PENGESAHAN BERJAYA ----

      // Jangan pulangkan lease token
      // atau rekod database penuh.

      return {
        status: "SUCCESS",

        code: "LOCKED_LEASE_VERIFIED",

        mode: "LOCKED_READ_ONLY",

        lock_acquired: true,
        verified: true,

        upload_status:
          verification.upload_status,

        saved: false,
        status_changed: false,
        quota_changed: false
      };

    }
  );

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.45
   UPLOAD STATUS TRANSITION RULES

   TUJUAN:
   - Menilai perubahan status upload.
   - RESERVED -> PROCESSING sahaja.
   - Mengesahkan pemilikan lease.
   - Menolak status yang tidak sah.
   - Menolak lease tamat tempoh.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - DRY RUN / SIMULATION ONLY.
   - Tidak membaca rekod LIVE.
   - Tidak menulis Google Sheets.
   - Tidak menyimpan gambar.
   - Tidak mengubah kuota.
   - Tidak dihubungkan ke Web App awam.

   PENTING:
   Fungsi ini menerima rekod daripada
   pemanggil untuk simulasi.

   Ia BUKAN kebenaran LIVE untuk
   menukar status upload.

   Dalam operasi LIVE nanti,
   rekod mesti dibaca semula daripada
   database di dalam ScriptLock.
============================================ */


// ---- 1. FUNGSI PENILAIAN STATUS ----

function evaluateUploadProcessingTransition_(
  uploadId,
  leaseToken,
  uploadRecord,
  nowOverride
) {

  // ---- 2. SAHKAN PEMILIKAN LEASE ----

  // Gunakan fungsi Langkah 3.41.
  // Fungsi ini sudah menyemak:
  // - Upload ID
  // - Lease token
  // - Status RESERVED
  // - Deletion status ACTIVE
  // - Tempoh lease

  const ownership =
    verifyUploadLeaseOwnership_(
      uploadId,
      leaseToken,
      uploadRecord,
      nowOverride
    );


  // ---- 3. TOLAK JIKA TIDAK SAH ----

  if (
    ownership.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
    ownership.verified !== true
  ) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",

      code:
        ownership.code ||
        "UPLOAD_TRANSITION_REJECTED",

      mode: "DRY_RUN",

      transition_allowed: false,

      status_changed: false,
      saved: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 4. SEDIAKAN KEPUTUSAN PERUBAHAN ----

  // Perubahan hanya dicadangkan.
  // Rekod asal tidak diubah.

  return {
    status: "SUCCESS",

    code: "PROCESSING_TRANSITION_ALLOWED",

    mode: "DRY_RUN",

    transition_allowed: true,

    current_status: "RESERVED",

    proposed_status: "PROCESSING",

    status_changed: false,
    saved: false
  };

}


/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.45
   MANUAL TEST - STATUS TRANSITION

   Ujian:
   1. RESERVED + lease sah.
   2. Token salah.
   3. Lease tamat tempoh.
   4. Status COMPLETED.
   5. Status PROCESSING.
   6. Rekod dipadam.
   7. Rekod asal tidak berubah.
   8. Database tidak berubah.
============================================ */


function testUploadProcessingTransition_() {

  // ---- 5. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId = PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error(
      "SPREADSHEET_ID tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
    spreadsheetId
  );

  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(
    "UPLOADS"
  );

  if (!sheet) {
    throw new Error(
      "Tab UPLOADS tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }


  // ---- 6. SIMPAN KEADAAN ASAL DATABASE ----

  const databaseBefore = JSON.stringify(
    sheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 7. JANA LEASE SIMULASI ----

  const lease = createUploadLease_();

  const uploadId =
    Utilities.getUuid();


  // ---- 8. BINA REKOD SIMULASI ----

  const prepared = buildUploadReservationRow_({

    upload_id:
      uploadId,

    idempotency_key:
      Utilities.getUuid(),

    event_id:
      "SIM_EVENT_001",

    qr_id:
      "SIM_QR_001",

    cycle_id:
      "SIM_CYCLE_001",

    lease_token:
      lease.lease_token,

    lease_expires_at:
      lease.lease_expires_at,

    original_filename:
      "polaroid_test.jpg",

    file_mime_type:
      "image/jpeg",

    file_size_bytes:
      2500000,

    created_at:
      lease.lease_created_at

  });

  const record = prepared.record;

  const recordBefore = JSON.stringify(
    record
  );


  // ---- 9. MASA LEASE AKTIF ----

  const activeTime = new Date(
    Date.parse(lease.lease_created_at) +
    1000
  ).toISOString();


  // ---- 10. UJIAN 1: STATUS SAH ----

  const validResult =
    evaluateUploadProcessingTransition_(
      uploadId,
      lease.lease_token,
      record,
      activeTime
    );


  // ---- 11. UJIAN 2: TOKEN SALAH ----

  const wrongTokenResult =
    evaluateUploadProcessingTransition_(
      uploadId,
      "WRONG_LEASE_TOKEN",
      record,
      activeTime
    );


  // ---- 12. UJIAN 3: LEASE TAMAT ----

  const expiredTime = new Date(
    Date.parse(lease.lease_expires_at) +
    1000
  ).toISOString();

  const expiredResult =
    evaluateUploadProcessingTransition_(
      uploadId,
      lease.lease_token,
      record,
      expiredTime
    );


  // ---- 13. UJIAN 4: COMPLETED ----

  const completedRecord = {
    ...record,
    upload_status: "COMPLETED"
  };

  const completedResult =
    evaluateUploadProcessingTransition_(
      uploadId,
      lease.lease_token,
      completedRecord,
      activeTime
    );


  // ---- 14. UJIAN 5: PROCESSING ----

  const processingRecord = {
    ...record,
    upload_status: "PROCESSING"
  };

  const processingResult =
    evaluateUploadProcessingTransition_(
      uploadId,
      lease.lease_token,
      processingRecord,
      activeTime
    );


  // ---- 15. UJIAN 6: REKOD DIPADAM ----

  const deletedRecord = {
    ...record,
    deletion_status: "DELETED"
  };

  const deletedResult =
    evaluateUploadProcessingTransition_(
      uploadId,
      lease.lease_token,
      deletedRecord,
      activeTime
    );


  // ---- 16. SEMAK REKOD ASAL ----

  const recordAfter = JSON.stringify(
    record
  );

  const recordUnchanged =
    recordBefore === recordAfter;


  // ---- 17. SEMAK DATABASE ----

  const databaseAfter = JSON.stringify(
    sheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const databaseUnchanged =
    databaseBefore === databaseAfter;


  // ---- 18. RUMUSAN KEPUTUSAN ----

  const summary = {

    valid_transition_allowed:
      validResult.code ===
      "PROCESSING_TRANSITION_ALLOWED" &&
      validResult.transition_allowed === true &&
      validResult.proposed_status ===
        "PROCESSING",

    wrong_token_rejected:
      wrongTokenResult.code ===
      "LEASE_TOKEN_MISMATCH",

    expired_lease_rejected:
      expiredResult.code ===
      "LEASE_NOT_ACTIVE",

    completed_status_rejected:
      completedResult.code ===
      "INVALID_UPLOAD_STATUS",

    processing_status_rejected:
      processingResult.code ===
      "INVALID_UPLOAD_STATUS",

    deleted_record_rejected:
      deletedResult.code ===
      "UPLOAD_RECORD_DELETED",

    original_record_unchanged:
      recordUnchanged,

    database_unchanged:
      databaseUnchanged

  };

  Logger.log(
    "UPLOAD PROCESSING TRANSITION TEST:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
  );


  // ---- 19. SAHKAN KEPUTUSAN AKHIR ----

  const passed =
    Object.values(summary).every(
      value => value === true
    );

  if (!passed) {
    throw new Error(
      "UPLOAD PROCESSING TRANSITION TEST FAILED"
    );
  }

  Logger.log(
    "UPLOAD PROCESSING TRANSITION TEST PASSED"
  );

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.46
   PREPARE UPLOAD PROCESSING RECORD

   TUJUAN:
   - Sediakan rekod PROCESSING.
   - Kemas kini upload_status.
   - Tetapkan started_at.
   - Kemas kini updated_at.
   - Kekalkan 19 medan lain.
   - Jangan ubah rekod asal.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - DRY RUN ONLY.
   - Tidak membaca rekod LIVE.
   - Tidak menulis Google Sheets.
   - Tidak menyimpan gambar.
   - Tidak mengubah kuota.
   - Tidak dihubungkan ke Web App awam.

   PENTING:
   Fungsi ini menerima rekod simulasi.

   Ia belum boleh digunakan untuk
   mengubah status upload LIVE.
============================================ */


// ---- 1. FUNGSI PENYEDIAAN REKOD ----

function prepareUploadProcessingRecord_(
  uploadId,
  leaseToken,
  uploadRecord,
  nowOverride
) {

  // ---- 2. SAHKAN MASA UJIAN ----

  // Jika nowOverride tidak diberikan,
  // gunakan masa semasa server.

  let processingTime;

  if (
    nowOverride === undefined ||
    nowOverride === null
  ) {

    processingTime =
      new Date().toISOString();

  } else {

    if (
      typeof nowOverride !== "string" ||
      !Number.isFinite(
        Date.parse(nowOverride)
      )
    ) {

      return {
        status: "REJECTED",
        code: "INVALID_PROCESSING_TIME",
        mode: "DRY_RUN",
        prepared: false,
        saved: false
      };

    }

    processingTime = new Date(
      nowOverride
    ).toISOString();

  }


  // ---- 3. SAHKAN PERUBAHAN STATUS ----

  // Gunakan fungsi Langkah 3.45.

  const decision =
    evaluateUploadProcessingTransition_(
      uploadId,
      leaseToken,
      uploadRecord,
      processingTime
    );


  // ---- 4. TOLAK JIKA TIDAK LAYAK ----

  if (
    decision.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
    decision.transition_allowed !== true
  ) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",

      code:
        decision.code ||
        "PROCESSING_NOT_ALLOWED",

      mode: "DRY_RUN",

      prepared: false,
      saved: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 5. SAHKAN STRUKTUR REKOD ----

  // Pastikan semua 22 medan wujud.

  const headersValid =
    UPLOAD_RESERVATION_HEADERS.length === 22 &&
    UPLOAD_RESERVATION_HEADERS.every(
      header =>
        Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
          uploadRecord,
          header
        )
    );

  if (!headersValid) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "INCOMPLETE_UPLOAD_RECORD",
      mode: "DRY_RUN",
      prepared: false,
      saved: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 6. BINA SALINAN REKOD ----

  // Spread operator menghasilkan
  // salinan object baharu.
  //
  // Rekod asal tidak diubah.

  const processingRecord = {
    ...uploadRecord,

    upload_status: "PROCESSING",

    started_at: processingTime,

    updated_at: processingTime
  };


  // ---- 7. SUSUN SEMULA 22 MEDAN ----

  // Susunan ini mengikut header
  // sebenar dalam tab UPLOADS.

  const processingRow =
    UPLOAD_RESERVATION_HEADERS.map(
      header => processingRecord[header]
    );


  // ---- 8. PULANGKAN HASIL DRY RUN ----

  // PENTING:
  // processingRecord dan processingRow
  // mengandungi lease token.
  //
  // Jangan dedahkan kepada peserta
  // atau paparkan dalam Logger.

  return {
    status: "SUCCESS",

    code: "PROCESSING_RECORD_PREPARED",

    mode: "DRY_RUN",

    prepared: true,
    saved: false,

    status_changed: false,

    column_count:
      processingRow.length,

    proposed_status:
      "PROCESSING",

    processingRecord:
      processingRecord,

    processingRow:
      processingRow
  };

}

   LANGKAH 3.46
   MANUAL TEST - PROCESSING RECORD

   Ujian:
   1. Rekod PROCESSING berjaya dibina.
   2. upload_status berubah.

   7. Lease tamat ditolak.
   8. Masa tidak sah ditolak.
   9. Database tidak berubah.

function testPrepareUploadProcessingRecord_() {

  // ---- 9. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId = PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error(
      "SPREADSHEET_ID tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
    spreadsheetId
  );

  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(
    "UPLOADS"
  );

  if (!sheet) {
    throw new Error(
      "Tab UPLOADS tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }


  // ---- 10. SIMPAN KEADAAN ASAL DATABASE ----

  const databaseBefore = JSON.stringify(
    sheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 11. JANA LEASE SIMULASI ----

  const lease = createUploadLease_();

  const uploadId =
    Utilities.getUuid();


  // ---- 12. BINA REKOD RESERVED ----

  const built = buildUploadReservationRow_({

    upload_id:
      uploadId,

    idempotency_key:
      Utilities.getUuid(),

    event_id:
      "SIM_EVENT_001",

    qr_id:
      "SIM_QR_001",

    cycle_id:
      "SIM_CYCLE_001",

    lease_token:
      lease.lease_token,

    lease_expires_at:
      lease.lease_expires_at,

    original_filename:
      "polaroid_test.jpg",

    file_mime_type:
      "image/jpeg",

    file_size_bytes:
      2500000,

    created_at:
      lease.lease_created_at

  });

  if (built.status !== "SUCCESS") {
    throw new Error(
      "Gagal membina rekod simulasi."
    );
  }

  const originalRecord =
    built.record;

  const originalBefore = JSON.stringify(
    originalRecord
  );


  // ---- 13. TETAPKAN MASA PEMPROSESAN ----

  // Satu saat selepas lease dicipta.

  const processingTime = new Date(
    Date.parse(lease.lease_created_at) +
    1000
  ).toISOString();


  // ---- 14. UJIAN REKOD SAH ----

  const result =
    prepareUploadProcessingRecord_(
      uploadId,
      lease.lease_token,
      originalRecord,
      processingTime
    );


  // ---- 15. SAHKAN TIGA MEDAN ----

  const threeFieldsUpdated =
    result.status === "SUCCESS" &&
    result.prepared === true &&
    result.processingRecord.upload_status ===
      "PROCESSING" &&
    result.processingRecord.started_at ===
      processingTime &&
    result.processingRecord.updated_at ===
      processingTime;


  // ---- 16. SAHKAN 19 MEDAN LAIN ----

  const changedFields = [
    "upload_status",
    "started_at",
    "updated_at"
  ];

  const otherFieldsPreserved =
    UPLOAD_RESERVATION_HEADERS
      .filter(
        header =>
          !changedFields.includes(header)
      )
      .every(
        header =>
          result.processingRecord[header] ===
          originalRecord[header]
      );


  // ---- 17. SAHKAN SUSUNAN 22 MEDAN ----

  const rowValid =
    result.column_count === 22 &&
    result.processingRow.length === 22 &&
    result.processingRow[5] ===
      "PROCESSING" &&
    result.processingRow[14] ===
      processingTime &&
    result.processingRow[16] ===
      processingTime;


  // ---- 18. SEMAK REKOD ASAL ----

  const originalAfter = JSON.stringify(
    originalRecord
  );

  const originalUnchanged =
    originalBefore === originalAfter;


  // ---- 19. UJIAN LEASE TAMAT ----

  const expiredTime = new Date(
    Date.parse(lease.lease_expires_at) +
    1000
  ).toISOString();

  const expiredResult =
    prepareUploadProcessingRecord_(
      uploadId,
      lease.lease_token,
      originalRecord,
      expiredTime
    );


  // ---- 20. UJIAN MASA TIDAK SAH ----

  const invalidTimeResult =
    prepareUploadProcessingRecord_(
      uploadId,
      lease.lease_token,
      originalRecord,
      "INVALID_TIME"
    );


  // ---- 21. SEMAK DATABASE ----

  const databaseAfter = JSON.stringify(
    sheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const databaseUnchanged =
    databaseBefore === databaseAfter;


  // ---- 22. RUMUSAN SELAMAT ----

  const summary = {

    processing_record_prepared:
      result.code ===
      "PROCESSING_RECORD_PREPARED",

    three_fields_updated:
      threeFieldsUpdated,

    other_19_fields_preserved:
      otherFieldsPreserved,

    row_22_columns_valid:
      rowValid,

    original_record_unchanged:
      originalUnchanged,

    expired_lease_rejected:
      expiredResult.code ===
      "LEASE_NOT_ACTIVE",

    invalid_time_rejected:
      invalidTimeResult.code ===
      "INVALID_PROCESSING_TIME",

    database_unchanged:
      databaseUnchanged

  };

  Logger.log(
    "PROCESSING RECORD PREPARATION TEST:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
  );


  // ---- 23. SAHKAN KEPUTUSAN ----

  const passed =
    Object.values(summary).every(
      value => value === true
    );

  if (!passed) {
    throw new Error(
      "PROCESSING RECORD PREPARATION TEST FAILED"
    );
  }

  Logger.log(
    "PROCESSING RECORD PREPARATION TEST PASSED"
  );

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.47
   LOCKED UPLOAD PROCESSING PREPARATION

   TUJUAN:
   - Dapatkan ScriptLock.
   - Cari rekod sebenar daripada UPLOADS.
   - Sahkan pemilikan lease.
   - Sediakan rekod PROCESSING.
   - Kekalkan database tanpa perubahan.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - LOCKED DRY RUN ONLY.
   - Tidak menulis Google Sheets.
   - Tidak menyimpan gambar.
   - Tidak mengubah kuota.
   - Tidak mengubah status LIVE.
   - Tidak dihubungkan ke Web App awam.

   PENTING:
   Jangan tambah fungsi ini kepada
   doGet() atau doPost().

   Jangan panggil fungsi lain yang
   mendapatkan ScriptLock baharu
   dari dalam callback ini.

   Gunakan helper dalaman yang
   tidak mengambil lock sendiri.
============================================ */


// ---- 1. FUNGSI PENYEDIAAN TERKUNCI ----

function prepareLockedUploadProcessing_(
  uploadId,
  leaseToken
) {

  // ---- 2. GUNAKAN SCRIPTLOCK ----

  // Helper Langkah 3.33 akan
  // mendapatkan dan melepaskan lock.

  return withUploadReservationLock_(
    function() {

      // ---- 3. CARI REKOD DATABASE ----

      const lookup =
        findUploadRecordById_(uploadId);


      // ---- 4. TANGANI REKOD TIDAK WUJUD ----

      if (
        lookup.status === "SUCCESS" &&
        lookup.code === "UPLOAD_NOT_FOUND"
      ) {

        return {
          status: "REJECTED",
          code: "UPLOAD_NOT_FOUND",

          mode: "LOCKED_DRY_RUN",

          lock_acquired: true,
          prepared: false,
          saved: false,
          status_changed: false
        };

      }


      // ---- 5. TANGANI KEGAGALAN CARIAN ----

      if (
        lookup.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
        lookup.found !== true
      ) {

        return {
          status: "REJECTED",

          code:
            lookup.code ||
            "UPLOAD_LOOKUP_FAILED",

          mode: "LOCKED_DRY_RUN",

          lock_acquired: true,
          prepared: false,
          saved: false,
          status_changed: false
        };

      }


      // ---- 6. SEDIAKAN REKOD PROCESSING ----

      // Fungsi Langkah 3.46 akan
      // mengesahkan pemilikan lease
      // melalui Langkah 3.45 dan 3.41.
      //
      // Ia juga akan menyediakan:
      // - upload_status = PROCESSING
      // - started_at
      // - updated_at
      //
      // Semua dalam memori sahaja.

      const preparation =
        prepareUploadProcessingRecord_(
          uploadId,
          leaseToken,
          lookup.record
        );


      // ---- 7. TANGANI PENYEDIAAN GAGAL ----

      if (
        preparation.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
        preparation.prepared !== true
      ) {

        return {
          status: "REJECTED",

          code:
            preparation.code ||
            "PROCESSING_PREPARATION_FAILED",

          mode: "LOCKED_DRY_RUN",

          lock_acquired: true,
          prepared: false,
          saved: false,
          status_changed: false
        };

      }


      // ---- 8. PULANGKAN RUMUSAN SELAMAT ----

      // Jangan pulangkan:
      // - lease_token
      // - processingRecord
      // - processingRow
      //
      // Ketiga-tiganya tidak diperlukan
      // untuk keputusan DRY RUN ini.

      return {
        status: "SUCCESS",

        code: "LOCKED_PROCESSING_READY",

        mode: "LOCKED_DRY_RUN",

        lock_acquired: true,
        prepared: true,

        proposed_status: "PROCESSING",

        column_count:
          preparation.column_count,

        saved: false,
        status_changed: false,
        quota_changed: false
      };

    }
  );

}
