/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.48
   UPLOAD PROCESSING SHEET MAPPING TEST

   TUJUAN:
   - Baca header sebenar UPLOADS.
   - Sahkan susunan 22 lajur.
   - Bina rekod RESERVED simulasi.
   - Sediakan rekod PROCESSING.
   - Semak hanya F, O dan Q berubah.
   - Pastikan database tidak berubah.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - READ ONLY / DRY RUN.
   - Tiada appendRow().
   - Tiada setValue().
   - Tiada setValues().
   - Tiada penyimpanan gambar.
   - Tiada perubahan kuota.
   - Tidak dihubungkan ke Web App.

   PENTING:
   Jangan paparkan processingRow
   atau lease_token dalam Logger.
============================================ */


function testUploadProcessingSheetMapping_() {

  // ---- 1. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId = PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error(
      "SPREADSHEET_ID tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
    spreadsheetId
  );

  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(
    "UPLOADS"
  );

  if (!sheet) {
    throw new Error(
      "Tab UPLOADS tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }


  // ---- 2. SIMPAN KEADAAN DATABASE ----

  const databaseBefore = JSON.stringify(
    sheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 3. BACA HEADER SEBENAR ----

  const actualHeaders = sheet
    .getRange(1, 1, 1, 22)
    .getValues()[0]
    .map(
      value => String(value).trim()
    );


  // ---- 4. SAHKAN SUSUNAN HEADER ----

  const headersValid =
    UPLOAD_RESERVATION_HEADERS.length === 22 &&
    UPLOAD_RESERVATION_HEADERS.every(
      (header, index) =>
        actualHeaders[index] === header
    );

  if (!headersValid) {
    throw new Error(
      "UPLOADS HEADER MAPPING MISMATCH"
    );
  }


  // ---- 5. JANA LEASE SIMULASI ----

  const lease = createUploadLease_();

  const uploadId = Utilities.getUuid();


  // ---- 6. BINA REKOD RESERVED ----

  const built = buildUploadReservationRow_({

    upload_id:
      uploadId,

    idempotency_key:
      Utilities.getUuid(),

    event_id:
      "SIM_EVENT_001",

    qr_id:
      "SIM_QR_001",

    cycle_id:
      "SIM_CYCLE_001",

    lease_token:
      lease.lease_token,

    lease_expires_at:
      lease.lease_expires_at,

    original_filename:
      "polaroid_test.jpg",

    file_mime_type:
      "image/jpeg",

    file_size_bytes:
      2500000,

    created_at:
      lease.lease_created_at

  });

  if (
    built.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
    built.column_count !== 22
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "RESERVED RECORD BUILD FAILED"
    );
  }


  // ---- 7. SIMPAN REKOD ASAL ----

  const originalRecord = built.record;

  const originalBefore = JSON.stringify(
    originalRecord
  );

  const reservedRow = actualHeaders.map(
    header => originalRecord[header]
  );


  // ---- 8. TETAPKAN MASA SIMULASI ----

  const processingTime = new Date(
    Date.parse(lease.lease_created_at) +
    1000
  ).toISOString();


  // ---- 9. SEDIAKAN REKOD PROCESSING ----

  const result = prepareUploadProcessingRecord_(
    uploadId,
    lease.lease_token,
    originalRecord,
    processingTime
  );

  if (
    result.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
    result.prepared !== true
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "PROCESSING PREPARATION FAILED"
    );
  }


  // ---- 10. SEMAK MAPPING F/O/Q ----

  const processingRow =
    result.processingRow;

  const statusMapped =
    processingRow[5] === "PROCESSING";

  const startedAtMapped =
    processingRow[14] === processingTime;

  const updatedAtMapped =
    processingRow[16] === processingTime;


  // ---- 11. SEMAK 19 MEDAN LAIN ----

  // Index bermula daripada 0:
  // F = 5
  // O = 14
  // Q = 16

  const allowedChanges = [5, 14, 16];

  const otherFieldsPreserved =
    reservedRow.every(
      (value, index) => {

        if (allowedChanges.includes(index)) {
          return true;
        }

        return value === processingRow[index];

      }
    );


  // ---- 12. SEMAK JUMLAH LAJUR ----

  const columnCountValid =
    reservedRow.length === 22 &&
    processingRow.length === 22;


  // ---- 13. SEMAK REKOD ASAL ----

  const originalUnchanged =
    originalBefore === JSON.stringify(
      originalRecord
    );


  // ---- 14. SEMAK DATABASE ----

  const databaseAfter = JSON.stringify(
    sheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const databaseUnchanged =
    databaseBefore === databaseAfter;


  // ---- 15. RUMUSAN KEPUTUSAN ----

  const summary = {

    actual_headers_valid:
      headersValid,

    reserved_row_22_columns:
      reservedRow.length === 22,

    processing_row_22_columns:
      columnCountValid,

    status_column_F_correct:
      statusMapped,

    started_at_column_O_correct:
      startedAtMapped,

    updated_at_column_Q_correct:
      updatedAtMapped,

    other_19_fields_preserved:
      otherFieldsPreserved,

    original_record_unchanged:
      originalUnchanged,

    database_unchanged:
      databaseUnchanged

  };


  // ---- 16. PAPARKAN RUMUSAN SELAMAT ----

  Logger.log(
    "UPLOAD PROCESSING SHEET MAPPING TEST:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
  );


  // ---- 17. SAHKAN SEMUA UJIAN ----

  const passed =
    Object.values(summary).every(
      value => value === true
    );

  if (!passed) {
    throw new Error(
      "UPLOAD PROCESSING SHEET MAPPING TEST FAILED"
    );
  }

  Logger.log(
    "UPLOAD PROCESSING SHEET MAPPING TEST PASSED"
  );

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.49
   DUPLICATE PROCESSING PREVENTION TEST

   TUJUAN:
   - Simulasi permintaan pertama.
   - Simulasi permintaan kedua.
   - Pastikan hanya RESERVED diterima.
   - Pastikan PROCESSING ditolak.
   - Pastikan COMPLETED ditolak.
   - Pastikan database tidak berubah.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - DRY RUN ONLY.
   - Tiada penulisan Google Sheets.
   - Tiada penyimpanan gambar.
   - Tiada perubahan kuota.
   - Tidak dihubungkan ke Web App.

   PENTING:
   Ujian ini mensimulasikan permintaan
   secara berturutan dalam memori.

   Ia BUKAN ujian dua proses serentak.

   Perlindungan LIVE kelak memerlukan
   ScriptLock dan semakan status
   terkini sebelum setiap penulisan.
============================================ */


function testDuplicateProcessingPrevention_() {

  // ---- 1. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId = PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error(
      "SPREADSHEET_ID tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
    spreadsheetId
  );

  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(
    "UPLOADS"
  );

  if (!sheet) {
    throw new Error(
      "Tab UPLOADS tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }


  // ---- 2. SIMPAN KEADAAN DATABASE ----

  const databaseBefore = JSON.stringify(
    sheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 3. JANA LEASE SIMULASI ----

  const lease = createUploadLease_();

  const uploadId = Utilities.getUuid();


  // ---- 4. BINA REKOD RESERVED ----

  const built = buildUploadReservationRow_({

    upload_id:
      uploadId,

    idempotency_key:
      Utilities.getUuid(),

    event_id:
      "SIM_EVENT_001",

    qr_id:
      "SIM_QR_001",

    cycle_id:
      "SIM_CYCLE_001",

    lease_token:
      lease.lease_token,

    lease_expires_at:
      lease.lease_expires_at,

    original_filename:
      "polaroid_test.jpg",

    file_mime_type:
      "image/jpeg",

    file_size_bytes:
      2500000,

    created_at:
      lease.lease_created_at

  });

  if (
    built.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
    !built.record
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "SIMULATED RESERVATION BUILD FAILED"
    );
  }


  // ---- 5. SIMPAN REKOD ASAL ----

  const reservedRecord = built.record;

  const originalBefore = JSON.stringify(
    reservedRecord
  );


  // ---- 6. TETAPKAN MASA UJIAN ----

  const firstTime = new Date(
    Date.parse(lease.lease_created_at) +
    1000
  ).toISOString();

  const secondTime = new Date(
    Date.parse(lease.lease_created_at) +
    2000
  ).toISOString();


  // ---- 7. PERMINTAAN A ----

  // Rekod masih RESERVED.
  // Perubahan sepatutnya dibenarkan.

  const requestA =
    prepareUploadProcessingRecord_(
      uploadId,
      lease.lease_token,
      reservedRecord,
      firstTime
    );


  // ---- 8. SEMAK PERMINTAAN A ----

  const firstAccepted =
    requestA.status === "SUCCESS" &&
    requestA.code ===
      "PROCESSING_RECORD_PREPARED" &&
    requestA.prepared === true &&
    requestA.processingRecord.upload_status ===
      "PROCESSING";


  // ---- 9. PERMINTAAN B ----

  // Gunakan rekod PROCESSING
  // yang dihasilkan oleh A.
  //
  // Ini mensimulasikan keadaan
  // selepas status telah berubah.

  const requestB =
    prepareUploadProcessingRecord_(
      uploadId,
      lease.lease_token,
      requestA.processingRecord,
      secondTime
    );


  // ---- 10. SEMAK PERMINTAAN B ----

  const secondRejected =
    requestB.status === "REJECTED" &&
    requestB.code ===
      "INVALID_UPLOAD_STATUS" &&
    requestB.prepared === false;


  // ---- 11. UJIAN STATUS COMPLETED ----

  const completedRecord = {
    ...requestA.processingRecord,
    upload_status: "COMPLETED"
  };

  const requestC =
    prepareUploadProcessingRecord_(
      uploadId,
      lease.lease_token,
      completedRecord,
      secondTime
    );

  const completedRejected =
    requestC.status === "REJECTED" &&
    requestC.code ===
      "INVALID_UPLOAD_STATUS";


  // ---- 12. SEMAK REKOD RESERVED ASAL ----

  const originalUnchanged =
    originalBefore === JSON.stringify(
      reservedRecord
    );


  // ---- 13. SEMAK DATABASE ----

  const databaseAfter = JSON.stringify(
    sheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const databaseUnchanged =
    databaseBefore === databaseAfter;


  // ---- 14. RUMUSAN KEPUTUSAN ----

  const summary = {

    first_request_accepted:
      firstAccepted,

    second_request_rejected:
      secondRejected,

    completed_request_rejected:
      completedRejected,

    original_reserved_record_unchanged:
      originalUnchanged,

    database_unchanged:
      databaseUnchanged

  };


  // ---- 15. PAPARKAN LOG SELAMAT ----

  Logger.log(
    "DUPLICATE PROCESSING PREVENTION TEST:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
  );


  // ---- 16. SAHKAN KEPUTUSAN ----

  const passed =
    Object.values(summary).every(
      value => value === true
    );

  if (!passed) {
    throw new Error(
      "DUPLICATE PROCESSING PREVENTION TEST FAILED"
    );
  }

  Logger.log(
    "DUPLICATE PROCESSING PREVENTION TEST PASSED"
  );

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.50
   UPLOAD PROCESSING LEASE BOUNDARY TEST

   TUJUAN:
   - Uji lease sebelum tamat.
   - Uji lease pada masa tamat tepat.
   - Uji lease selepas tamat.
   - Uji tarikh tamat tidak sah.
   - Pastikan database tidak berubah.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - DRY RUN ONLY.
   - Tiada penulisan Google Sheets.
   - Tiada penyimpanan gambar.
   - Tiada perubahan status LIVE.
   - Tiada perubahan kuota.
   - Tidak dihubungkan ke Web App.

   PENTING:
   Lease tamat apabila masa semasa
   mencapai atau melebihi
   lease_expires_at.

   Peraturan:
   now < lease_expires_at = AKTIF
   now >= lease_expires_at = TAMAT
============================================ */


function testUploadProcessingLeaseBoundary_() {

  // ---- 1. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId = PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error(
      "SPREADSHEET_ID tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
    spreadsheetId
  );

  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(
    "UPLOADS"
  );

  if (!sheet) {
    throw new Error(
      "Tab UPLOADS tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }


  // ---- 2. SIMPAN KEADAAN DATABASE ----

  const databaseBefore = JSON.stringify(
    sheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 3. JANA LEASE SIMULASI ----

  const lease = createUploadLease_();

  const uploadId = Utilities.getUuid();


  // ---- 4. BINA REKOD RESERVED ----

  const built = buildUploadReservationRow_({

    upload_id:
      uploadId,

    idempotency_key:
      Utilities.getUuid(),

    event_id:
      "SIM_EVENT_001",

    qr_id:
      "SIM_QR_001",

    cycle_id:
      "SIM_CYCLE_001",

    lease_token:
      lease.lease_token,

    lease_expires_at:
      lease.lease_expires_at,

    original_filename:
      "polaroid_test.jpg",

    file_mime_type:
      "image/jpeg",

    file_size_bytes:
      2500000,

    created_at:
      lease.lease_created_at

  });

  if (
    built.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
    !built.record
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "SIMULATED RESERVATION BUILD FAILED"
    );
  }

  const record = built.record;

  const recordBefore = JSON.stringify(
    record
  );


  // ---- 5. TETAPKAN MASA RUJUKAN ----

  const expiryMs = Date.parse(
    lease.lease_expires_at
  );

  if (!Number.isFinite(expiryMs)) {
    throw new Error(
      "INVALID GENERATED LEASE EXPIRY"
    );
  }


  // ---- 6. UJIAN 299 SAAT ----

  // Satu saat sebelum lease tamat.

  const beforeExpiry = new Date(
    expiryMs - 1000
  ).toISOString();

  const beforeResult =
    prepareUploadProcessingRecord_(
      uploadId,
      lease.lease_token,
      record,
      beforeExpiry
    );


  // ---- 7. UJIAN 300 SAAT TEPAT ----

  const exactExpiry = new Date(
    expiryMs
  ).toISOString();

  const exactResult =
    prepareUploadProcessingRecord_(
      uploadId,
      lease.lease_token,
      record,
      exactExpiry
    );


  // ---- 8. UJIAN 301 SAAT ----

  const afterExpiry = new Date(
    expiryMs + 1000
  ).toISOString();

  const afterResult =
    prepareUploadProcessingRecord_(
      uploadId,
      lease.lease_token,
      record,
      afterExpiry
    );


  // ---- 9. UJIAN TARIKH TAMAT ROSAK ----

  const invalidExpiryRecord = {
    ...record,
    lease_expires_at: "INVALID_DATE"
  };

  const invalidExpiryResult =
    prepareUploadProcessingRecord_(
      uploadId,
      lease.lease_token,
      invalidExpiryRecord,
      beforeExpiry
    );


  // ---- 10. SEMAK REKOD ASAL ----

  const recordUnchanged =
    recordBefore === JSON.stringify(
      record
    );


  // ---- 11. SEMAK DATABASE ----

  const databaseAfter = JSON.stringify(
    sheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const databaseUnchanged =
    databaseBefore === databaseAfter;


  // ---- 12. RUMUSAN KEPUTUSAN ----

  const summary = {

    before_expiry_allowed:
      beforeResult.status === "SUCCESS" &&
      beforeResult.code ===
        "PROCESSING_RECORD_PREPARED",

    exact_expiry_rejected:
      exactResult.status === "REJECTED" &&
      exactResult.code ===
        "LEASE_NOT_ACTIVE",

    after_expiry_rejected:
      afterResult.status === "REJECTED" &&
      afterResult.code ===
        "LEASE_NOT_ACTIVE",

    invalid_expiry_rejected:
      invalidExpiryResult.status ===
        "REJECTED" &&
      invalidExpiryResult.code ===
        "LEASE_NOT_ACTIVE",

    original_record_unchanged:
      recordUnchanged,

    database_unchanged:
      databaseUnchanged

  };


  // ---- 13. PAPARKAN LOG SELAMAT ----

  Logger.log(
    "UPLOAD PROCESSING LEASE BOUNDARY TEST:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
  );


  // ---- 14. SAHKAN KEPUTUSAN ----

  const passed =
    Object.values(summary).every(
      value => value === true
    );

  if (!passed) {
    throw new Error(
      "UPLOAD PROCESSING LEASE BOUNDARY TEST FAILED"
    );
  }

  Logger.log(
    "UPLOAD PROCESSING LEASE BOUNDARY TEST PASSED"
  );

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.51
   PROCESSING RECORD INTEGRITY VALIDATION

   TUJUAN:
   - Bandingkan rekod asal dan cadangan.
   - Benarkan perubahan F, O dan Q.
   - Pastikan 19 medan lain kekal.
   - Tolak perubahan medan tidak sah.
   - Pastikan database tidak berubah.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - READ ONLY / DRY RUN.
   - Tiada penulisan Google Sheets.
   - Tiada penyimpanan gambar.
   - Tiada perubahan kuota.
   - Tidak dihubungkan ke Web App.

   PENTING:
   Fungsi ini memeriksa struktur dan
   integriti perubahan rekod.

   Ia bukan kebenaran LIVE untuk
   mengubah Google Sheets.
============================================ */


// ---- 1. FUNGSI PENGESAHAN INTEGRITI ----

function validateProcessingRecordIntegrity_(
  originalRecord,
  proposedRecord
) {

  // ---- 2. SAHKAN KEDUA-DUA REKOD ----

  if (
    !originalRecord ||
    typeof originalRecord !== "object" ||
    Array.isArray(originalRecord) ||
    !proposedRecord ||
    typeof proposedRecord !== "object" ||
    Array.isArray(proposedRecord)
  ) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "INVALID_RECORD_OBJECT",
      valid: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 3. SAHKAN 22 MEDAN ----

  const headers = UPLOAD_RESERVATION_HEADERS;

  const structureValid =
    headers.length === 22 &&
    headers.every(
      header =>
        Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
          originalRecord,
          header
        ) &&
        Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
          proposedRecord,
          header
        )
    );

  if (!structureValid) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "INCOMPLETE_UPLOAD_RECORD",
      valid: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 4. SAHKAN STATUS ASAL ----

  if (
    originalRecord.upload_status !==
    "RESERVED"
  ) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "INVALID_ORIGINAL_STATUS",
      valid: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 5. SAHKAN STATUS CADANGAN ----

  if (
    proposedRecord.upload_status !==
    "PROCESSING"
  ) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "INVALID_PROPOSED_STATUS",
      valid: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 6. SAHKAN TIMESTAMP ----

  const startedAt =
    proposedRecord.started_at;

  const updatedAt =
    proposedRecord.updated_at;

  const timestampsValid =
    typeof startedAt === "string" &&
    typeof updatedAt === "string" &&
    Number.isFinite(Date.parse(startedAt)) &&
    Number.isFinite(Date.parse(updatedAt)) &&
    startedAt === updatedAt;

  if (!timestampsValid) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "INVALID_PROCESSING_TIMESTAMPS",
      valid: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 7. TETAPKAN MEDAN DIBENARKAN ----

  const allowedChanges = [
    "upload_status",
    "started_at",
    "updated_at"
  ];


  // ---- 8. SEMAK 19 MEDAN LAIN ----

  const otherFieldsPreserved =
    headers
      .filter(
        header =>
          !allowedChanges.includes(header)
      )
      .every(
        header =>
          originalRecord[header] ===
          proposedRecord[header]
      );

  if (!otherFieldsPreserved) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "UNAUTHORIZED_FIELD_CHANGE",
      valid: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 9. KEPUTUSAN BERJAYA ----

  return {
    status: "SUCCESS",

    code: "PROCESSING_RECORD_INTEGRITY_VALID",

    valid: true,

    allowed_field_changes: 3,
    preserved_fields: 19
  };

}


/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.51
   MANUAL TEST - RECORD INTEGRITY

   Ujian:
   1. Rekod PROCESSING sah.
   2. Perubahan lease_token ditolak.
   3. Perubahan qr_id ditolak.
   4. Status cadangan salah ditolak.
   5. Timestamp tidak sah ditolak.
   6. Rekod asal tidak berubah.
   7. Database tidak berubah.
============================================ */


function testProcessingRecordIntegrity_() {

  // ---- 10. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId = PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error(
      "SPREADSHEET_ID tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
    spreadsheetId
  );

  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(
    "UPLOADS"
  );

  if (!sheet) {
    throw new Error(
      "Tab UPLOADS tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }


  // ---- 11. SIMPAN KEADAAN DATABASE ----

  const databaseBefore = JSON.stringify(
    sheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 12. JANA LEASE SIMULASI ----

  const lease = createUploadLease_();

  const uploadId = Utilities.getUuid();


  // ---- 13. BINA REKOD RESERVED ----

  const built = buildUploadReservationRow_({

    upload_id:
      uploadId,

    idempotency_key:
      Utilities.getUuid(),

    event_id:
      "SIM_EVENT_001",

    qr_id:
      "SIM_QR_001",

    cycle_id:
      "SIM_CYCLE_001",

    lease_token:
      lease.lease_token,

    lease_expires_at:
      lease.lease_expires_at,

    original_filename:
      "polaroid_test.jpg",

    file_mime_type:
      "image/jpeg",

    file_size_bytes:
      2500000,

    created_at:
      lease.lease_created_at

  });

  if (
    built.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
    !built.record
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "SIMULATED RECORD BUILD FAILED"
    );
  }

  const originalRecord = built.record;

  const originalBefore = JSON.stringify(
    originalRecord
  );


  // ---- 14. SEDIAKAN REKOD PROCESSING ----

  const processingTime = new Date(
    Date.parse(lease.lease_created_at) +
    1000
  ).toISOString();

  const prepared =
    prepareUploadProcessingRecord_(
      uploadId,
      lease.lease_token,
      originalRecord,
      processingTime
    );

  if (
    prepared.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
    prepared.prepared !== true
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "PROCESSING RECORD PREPARATION FAILED"
    );
  }

  const proposedRecord =
    prepared.processingRecord;


  // ---- 15. UJIAN REKOD SAH ----

  const validResult =
    validateProcessingRecordIntegrity_(
      originalRecord,
      proposedRecord
    );


  // ---- 16. UJIAN LEASE TOKEN DIUBAH ----

  const changedTokenRecord = {
    ...proposedRecord,
    lease_token: "MODIFIED_TOKEN"
  };

  const tokenResult =
    validateProcessingRecordIntegrity_(
      originalRecord,
      changedTokenRecord
    );


  // ---- 17. UJIAN QR ID DIUBAH ----

  const changedQrRecord = {
    ...proposedRecord,
    qr_id: "DIFFERENT_QR_ID"
  };

  const qrResult =
    validateProcessingRecordIntegrity_(
      originalRecord,
      changedQrRecord
    );


  // ---- 18. UJIAN STATUS SALAH ----

  const wrongStatusRecord = {
    ...proposedRecord,
    upload_status: "COMPLETED"
  };

  const statusResult =
    validateProcessingRecordIntegrity_(
      originalRecord,
      wrongStatusRecord
    );


  // ---- 19. UJIAN TIMESTAMP SALAH ----

  const invalidTimeRecord = {
    ...proposedRecord,
    started_at: "INVALID_DATE"
  };

  const timeResult =
    validateProcessingRecordIntegrity_(
      originalRecord,
      invalidTimeRecord
    );


  // ---- 20. SEMAK REKOD ASAL ----

  const originalUnchanged =
    originalBefore === JSON.stringify(
      originalRecord
    );


  // ---- 21. SEMAK DATABASE ----

  const databaseAfter = JSON.stringify(
    sheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const databaseUnchanged =
    databaseBefore === databaseAfter;


  // ---- 22. RUMUSAN KEPUTUSAN ----

  const summary = {

    valid_record_accepted:
      validResult.code ===
        "PROCESSING_RECORD_INTEGRITY_VALID" &&
      validResult.valid === true,

    changed_lease_token_rejected:
      tokenResult.code ===
        "UNAUTHORIZED_FIELD_CHANGE",

    changed_qr_id_rejected:
      qrResult.code ===
        "UNAUTHORIZED_FIELD_CHANGE",

    wrong_status_rejected:
      statusResult.code ===
        "INVALID_PROPOSED_STATUS",

    invalid_timestamp_rejected:
      timeResult.code ===
        "INVALID_PROCESSING_TIMESTAMPS",

    original_record_unchanged:
      originalUnchanged,

    database_unchanged:
      databaseUnchanged

  };


  // ---- 23. PAPARKAN LOG SELAMAT ----

  Logger.log(
    "PROCESSING RECORD INTEGRITY TEST:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
  );


  // ---- 24. SAHKAN KEPUTUSAN ----

  const passed =
    Object.values(summary).every(
      value => value === true
    );

  if (!passed) {
    throw new Error(
      "PROCESSING RECORD INTEGRITY TEST FAILED"
    );
  }

  Logger.log(
    "PROCESSING RECORD INTEGRITY TEST PASSED"
  );

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.52
   LOCKED PROCESSING WITH INTEGRITY

   TUJUAN:
   - Dapatkan ScriptLock.
   - Cari rekod sebenar UPLOADS.
   - Sahkan lease masih aktif.
   - Sediakan status PROCESSING.
   - Sahkan integriti 22 medan.
   - Jangan ubah database.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - LOCKED DRY RUN ONLY.
   - Tiada penulisan Google Sheets.
   - Tiada penyimpanan gambar.
   - Tiada perubahan kuota.
   - Tidak dihubungkan ke Web App.

   PENTING:
   Jangan panggil fungsi yang
   mendapatkan ScriptLock baharu
   dari dalam callback ini.

   Jangan paparkan lease_token
   atau rekod penuh dalam Logger.
============================================ */


// ---- 1. FUNGSI UTAMA TERKUNCI ----

function prepareLockedUploadProcessingWithIntegrity_(
  uploadId,
  leaseToken
) {

  // ---- 2. DAPATKAN SCRIPTLOCK ----

  return withUploadReservationLock_(
    function() {

      // ---- 3. CARI REKOD SEBENAR ----

      const lookup =
        findUploadRecordById_(uploadId);


      // ---- 4. SEMAK KEPUTUSAN CARIAN ----

      if (
        lookup.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
        lookup.found !== true
      ) {

        return {
          status: "REJECTED",

          code:
            lookup.code ||
            "UPLOAD_LOOKUP_FAILED",

          mode: "LOCKED_DRY_RUN",

          lock_acquired: true,

          prepared: false,
          integrity_verified: false,

          saved: false,
          status_changed: false
        };

      }


      // ---- 5. SEDIAKAN REKOD PROCESSING ----

      // Fungsi ini turut mengesahkan:
      // - upload_id
      // - lease_token
      // - status RESERVED
      // - deletion_status ACTIVE
      // - lease belum tamat

      const prepared =
        prepareUploadProcessingRecord_(
          uploadId,
          leaseToken,
          lookup.record
        );


      // ---- 6. SEMAK PENYEDIAAN ----

      if (
        prepared.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
        prepared.prepared !== true
      ) {

        return {
          status: "REJECTED",

          code:
            prepared.code ||
            "PROCESSING_PREPARATION_FAILED",

          mode: "LOCKED_DRY_RUN",

          lock_acquired: true,

          prepared: false,
          integrity_verified: false,

          saved: false,
          status_changed: false
        };

      }


      // ---- 7. SAHKAN INTEGRITI REKOD ----

      const integrity =
        validateProcessingRecordIntegrity_(
          lookup.record,
          prepared.processingRecord
        );


      // ---- 8. TOLAK JIKA INTEGRITI GAGAL ----

      if (
        integrity.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
        integrity.valid !== true
      ) {

        return {
          status: "REJECTED",

          code:
            integrity.code ||
            "PROCESSING_INTEGRITY_FAILED",

          mode: "LOCKED_DRY_RUN",

          lock_acquired: true,

          prepared: false,
          integrity_verified: false,

          saved: false,
          status_changed: false
        };

      }


      // ---- 9. PULANGKAN RUMUSAN SELAMAT ----

      // Jangan pulangkan rekod penuh
      // atau lease token kepada pengguna.

      return {
        status: "SUCCESS",

        code:
          "LOCKED_PROCESSING_INTEGRITY_READY",

        mode: "LOCKED_DRY_RUN",

        lock_acquired: true,

        prepared: true,
        integrity_verified: true,

        proposed_status: "PROCESSING",

        column_count:
          prepared.column_count,

        preserved_fields:
          integrity.preserved_fields,

        saved: false,
        status_changed: false,
        quota_changed: false
      };

    }
  );

}


/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.52
   MANUAL TEST - LOCKED INTEGRITY

   Ujian:
   1. Rekod tidak wujud ditolak.
   2. Upload ID tidak sah ditolak.
   3. Rekod simulasi disediakan.
   4. Integriti simulasi disahkan.
   5. Rekod rosak ditolak.
   6. Database tidak berubah.

   Nota:
   Laluan berjaya terhadap rekod
   tersimpan belum diuji kerana
   UPLOADS masih kosong.
============================================ */


function testLockedProcessingIntegrity_() {

  // ---- 10. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId = PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error(
      "SPREADSHEET_ID tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
    spreadsheetId
  );

  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(
    "UPLOADS"
  );

  if (!sheet) {
    throw new Error(
      "Tab UPLOADS tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }


  // ---- 11. SIMPAN KEADAAN DATABASE ----

  const databaseBefore = JSON.stringify(
    sheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 12. JANA LEASE SIMULASI ----

  const lease = createUploadLease_();

  const uploadId = Utilities.getUuid();


  // ---- 13. UJIAN CARIAN SEBENAR ----

  const missingResult =
    prepareLockedUploadProcessingWithIntegrity_(
      uploadId,
      lease.lease_token
    );

  const invalidIdResult =
    prepareLockedUploadProcessingWithIntegrity_(
      "INVALID_UPLOAD_ID",
      lease.lease_token
    );


  // ---- 14. BINA REKOD SIMULASI ----

  const built = buildUploadReservationRow_({

    upload_id:
      uploadId,

    idempotency_key:
      Utilities.getUuid(),

    event_id:
      "SIM_EVENT_001",

    qr_id:
      "SIM_QR_001",

    cycle_id:
      "SIM_CYCLE_001",

    lease_token:
      lease.lease_token,

    lease_expires_at:
      lease.lease_expires_at,

    original_filename:
      "polaroid_test.jpg",

    file_mime_type:
      "image/jpeg",

    file_size_bytes:
      2500000,

    created_at:
      lease.lease_created_at

  });

  if (
    built.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
    !built.record
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "SIMULATED RECORD BUILD FAILED"
    );
  }


  // ---- 15. SEDIAKAN REKOD SIMULASI ----

  const processingTime = new Date(
    Date.parse(lease.lease_created_at) +
    1000
  ).toISOString();

  const prepared =
    prepareUploadProcessingRecord_(
      uploadId,
      lease.lease_token,
      built.record,
      processingTime
    );

  if (
    prepared.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
    prepared.prepared !== true
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "SIMULATED PROCESSING PREPARATION FAILED"
    );
  }


  // ---- 16. SAHKAN INTEGRITI SIMULASI ----

  const integrity =
    validateProcessingRecordIntegrity_(
      built.record,
      prepared.processingRecord
    );


  // ---- 17. UJIAN REKOD ROSAK ----

  const corruptedRecord = {
    ...prepared.processingRecord,
    cycle_id: "MODIFIED_CYCLE_ID"
  };

  const corruptedIntegrity =
    validateProcessingRecordIntegrity_(
      built.record,
      corruptedRecord
    );


  // ---- 18. SEMAK DATABASE ----

  const databaseAfter = JSON.stringify(
    sheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const databaseUnchanged =
    databaseBefore === databaseAfter;


  // ---- 19. RUMUSAN KEPUTUSAN ----

  const summary = {

    missing_upload_rejected:
      missingResult.status === "REJECTED" &&
      missingResult.code ===
        "UPLOAD_NOT_FOUND" &&
      missingResult.lock_acquired === true,

    invalid_upload_id_rejected:
      invalidIdResult.status === "REJECTED" &&
      invalidIdResult.code ===
        "INVALID_UPLOAD_ID" &&
      invalidIdResult.lock_acquired === true,

    simulated_processing_prepared:
      prepared.status === "SUCCESS" &&
      prepared.code ===
        "PROCESSING_RECORD_PREPARED",

    simulated_integrity_verified:
      integrity.status === "SUCCESS" &&
      integrity.code ===
        "PROCESSING_RECORD_INTEGRITY_VALID" &&
      integrity.valid === true,

    corrupted_record_rejected:
      corruptedIntegrity.status ===
        "REJECTED" &&
      corruptedIntegrity.code ===
        "UNAUTHORIZED_FIELD_CHANGE",

    database_unchanged:
      databaseUnchanged

  };


  // ---- 20. PAPARKAN LOG SELAMAT ----

  Logger.log(
    "LOCKED PROCESSING INTEGRITY TEST:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
  );


  // ---- 21. SAHKAN SEMUA UJIAN ----

  const passed =
    Object.values(summary).every(
      value => value === true
    );

  if (!passed) {
    throw new Error(
      "LOCKED PROCESSING INTEGRITY TEST FAILED"
    );
  }

  Logger.log(
    "LOCKED PROCESSING INTEGRITY TEST PASSED"
  );

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.53
   STORED PROCESSING INTEGRITY PATH TEST

   TUJUAN:
   - Simpan satu rekod ujian sementara.
   - Baca rekod melalui fungsi sebenar.
   - Uji laluan berjaya ScriptLock.
   - Sahkan integriti pemprosesan.
   - Padam rekod ujian selepas selesai.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - MANUAL TEST ONLY.
   - Bukan fungsi awam.
   - Tidak memuat naik gambar.
   - Tidak mengubah kuota.
   - Tidak mengaktifkan LIVE upload.

   PERHATIAN:
   Ujian ini MENULIS sementara ke
   tab UPLOADS.

   Jalankan hanya apabila UPLOADS
   mempunyai header sahaja.

   Pembersihan menggunakan finally.
   Jika pembersihan gagal, semak
   tab UPLOADS secara manual.

   Jangan panggil fungsi ini daripada
   doGet() atau doPost().
============================================ */


function testStoredProcessingIntegrityPath_() {

  // ---- 1. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId = PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error(
      "SPREADSHEET_ID tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
    spreadsheetId
  );

  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(
    "UPLOADS"
  );

  if (!sheet) {
    throw new Error(
      "Tab UPLOADS tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }


  // ---- 2. SAHKAN DATABASE KOSONG ----

  if (sheet.getLastRow() !== 1) {
    throw new Error(
      "TEST STOPPED: UPLOADS IS NOT EMPTY"
    );
  }


  // ---- 3. SAHKAN HEADER ----

  const actualHeaders = sheet
    .getRange(1, 1, 1, 22)
    .getValues()[0];

  const headersValid =
    UPLOAD_RESERVATION_HEADERS.length === 22 &&
    UPLOAD_RESERVATION_HEADERS.every(
      (header, index) =>
        actualHeaders[index] === header
    );

  if (!headersValid) {
    throw new Error(
      "UPLOADS HEADER MISMATCH"
    );
  }


  // ---- 4. SIMPAN KEADAAN ASAL ----

  const databaseBefore = JSON.stringify(
    sheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 5. JANA REKOD UJIAN ----

  const lease = createUploadLease_();

  const uploadId = Utilities.getUuid();

  const built = buildUploadReservationRow_({

    upload_id:
      uploadId,

    idempotency_key:
      Utilities.getUuid(),

    event_id:
      "SIM_EVENT_001",

    qr_id:
      "SIM_QR_001",

    cycle_id:
      "SIM_CYCLE_001",

    lease_token:
      lease.lease_token,

    lease_expires_at:
      lease.lease_expires_at,

    original_filename:
      "temporary_test.jpg",

    file_mime_type:
      "image/jpeg",

    file_size_bytes:
      2500000,

    created_at:
      lease.lease_created_at

  });

  if (
    built.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
    built.column_count !== 22
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "TEST RECORD BUILD FAILED"
    );
  }


  // ---- 6. TETAPKAN PEMBERSIHAN ----

  let temporaryRowCreated = false;

  let cleanupCompleted = false;

  let testPassed = false;

  let testError = null;


  // ---- 7. MULAKAN UJIAN TERKAWAL ----

  try {

    // ---- 8. SIMPAN REKOD SEMENTARA ----

    // Rekod ini hanya digunakan
    // untuk ujian dalaman.

    sheet.getRange(
      2,
      1,
      1,
      22
    ).setValues([
      built.row
    ]);

    temporaryRowCreated = true;

    SpreadsheetApp.flush();


    // ---- 9. SAHKAN REKOD TERSIMPAN ----

    const lookup =
      findUploadRecordById_(uploadId);

    const storedRecordFound =
      lookup.status === "SUCCESS" &&
      lookup.code === "UPLOAD_FOUND" &&
      lookup.found === true &&
      lookup.row_number === 2;


    // ---- 10. JALANKAN ALIRAN TERKUNCI ----

    const result =
      prepareLockedUploadProcessingWithIntegrity_(
        uploadId,
        lease.lease_token
      );


    // ---- 11. SAHKAN KEPUTUSAN ----

    const lockedPathPassed =
      result.status === "SUCCESS" &&
      result.code ===
        "LOCKED_PROCESSING_INTEGRITY_READY" &&
      result.lock_acquired === true &&
      result.prepared === true &&
      result.integrity_verified === true &&
      result.column_count === 22 &&
      result.preserved_fields === 19 &&
      result.saved === false &&
      result.status_changed === false;


    // ---- 12. SAHKAN STATUS DATABASE ----

    // Fungsi terkunci masih DRY RUN.
    // Oleh itu status tersimpan mesti
    // kekal RESERVED.

    const storedStatus =
      sheet.getRange(2, 6).getValue();

    const statusUnchanged =
      storedStatus === "RESERVED";


    // ---- 13. KEPUTUSAN UJIAN ----

    testPassed =
      storedRecordFound &&
      lockedPathPassed &&
      statusUnchanged;


    // Jangan log rekod penuh
    // kerana mengandungi lease_token.

    Logger.log(
      "STORED PROCESSING INTEGRITY TEST:"
    );

    Logger.log(
      JSON.stringify({

        stored_record_found:
          storedRecordFound,

        locked_success_path_passed:
          lockedPathPassed,

        stored_status_unchanged:
          statusUnchanged

      }, null, 2)
    );


    if (!testPassed) {
      throw new Error(
        "STORED PROCESSING INTEGRITY PATH FAILED"
      );
    }

  } catch (error) {

    testError = error;

  } finally {

    // ---- 14. PEMBERSIHAN REKOD UJIAN ----

    // Jangan padam rekod lain.
    // Semak upload_id pada baris 2
    // sebelum melakukan pembersihan.

    if (temporaryRowCreated) {

      const currentUploadId =
        sheet.getRange(2, 1).getValue();

      if (currentUploadId === uploadId) {

        sheet.deleteRow(2);

        SpreadsheetApp.flush();

        cleanupCompleted = true;

      } else {

        Logger.log(
          "WARNING: TEST ROW ID MISMATCH"
        );

      }

    }

  }


  // ---- 15. SAHKAN PEMBERSIHAN ----

  const databaseAfter = JSON.stringify(
    sheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const databaseRestored =
    databaseBefore === databaseAfter;


  const summary = {

    test_passed:
      testPassed,

    cleanup_completed:
      cleanupCompleted,

    database_restored:
      databaseRestored

  };


  Logger.log(
    "STORED PROCESSING CLEANUP:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
  );


  // ---- 16. TANGANI RALAT UJIAN ----

  if (testError) {
    throw testError;
  }


  // ---- 17. SAHKAN KEPUTUSAN AKHIR ----

  if (
    !testPassed ||
    !cleanupCompleted ||
    !databaseRestored
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "STORED PROCESSING TEST OR CLEANUP FAILED"
    );
  }


  Logger.log(
    "STORED PROCESSING INTEGRITY PATH TEST PASSED"
  );

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.54
   START UPLOAD PROCESSING
   WITH LIVE SAFETY GUARD

   TUJUAN:
   - Sediakan fungsi utama pemprosesan.
   - Gunakan ScriptLock sedia ada.
   - Benarkan DRY RUN sahaja.
   - Tolak semua permintaan LIVE.
   - Pastikan database tidak berubah.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - LIVE PROCESSING DISABLED.
   - Tiada penulisan Google Sheets.
   - Tiada penyimpanan gambar.
   - Tiada perubahan kuota.
   - Tidak dihubungkan ke Web App.

   PENTING:
   Jangan tambah fungsi ini kepada
   doGet() atau doPost().

   Jangan ubah syarat dryRun
   sehingga fungsi LIVE sebenar
   dibina dan diuji secara berasingan.
============================================ */


// ---- 1. FUNGSI UTAMA ----

function startUploadProcessing_(
  uploadId,
  leaseToken,
  dryRun = true
) {

  // ---- 2. SEKAT OPERASI LIVE ----

  // Hanya boolean true dibenarkan.
  //
  // false, null, undefined yang
  // dihantar secara eksplisit,
  // dan nilai lain akan ditolak.
  //
  // Parameter yang tidak dihantar
  // menggunakan default true.

  if (dryRun !== true) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",

      code: "LIVE_PROCESSING_DISABLED",

      mode: "SAFETY_GUARD",

      processing_started: false,

      saved: false,
      status_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 3. SAHKAN UPLOAD ID ----

  // Upload ID mesti UUIDv4.

  const uuidRegex =
    /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;

  if (
    typeof uploadId !== "string" ||
    !uuidRegex.test(uploadId)
  ) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",

      code: "INVALID_UPLOAD_ID",

      mode: "DRY_RUN",

      processing_started: false,

      saved: false,
      status_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 4. SAHKAN LEASE TOKEN ----

  // Lease token ialah 64 aksara hex.

  const leaseRegex =
    /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/i;

  if (
    typeof leaseToken !== "string" ||
    !leaseRegex.test(leaseToken)
  ) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",

      code: "INVALID_LEASE_TOKEN",

      mode: "DRY_RUN",

      processing_started: false,

      saved: false,
      status_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 5. JALANKAN ALIRAN TERKUNCI ----

  // Fungsi Langkah 3.52 akan:
  //
  // - Dapatkan ScriptLock.
  // - Cari rekod sebenar.
  // - Sahkan lease.
  // - Sediakan rekod PROCESSING.
  // - Sahkan integriti 22 medan.
  //
  // Tiada penulisan dilakukan.

  const result =
    prepareLockedUploadProcessingWithIntegrity_(
      uploadId,
      leaseToken
    );


  // ---- 6. TANGANI KEGAGALAN ----

  if (
    result.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
    result.prepared !== true ||
    result.integrity_verified !== true
  ) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",

      code:
        result.code ||
        "PROCESSING_PREPARATION_FAILED",

      mode: "DRY_RUN",

      processing_started: false,

      saved: false,
      status_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 7. PULANGKAN KEPUTUSAN DRY RUN ----

  // Jangan pulangkan lease_token
  // atau rekod penuh kepada peserta.

  return {
    status: "SUCCESS",

    code: "PROCESSING_DRY_RUN_READY",

    mode: "DRY_RUN",

    processing_started: false,

    prepared: true,
    integrity_verified: true,

    proposed_status: "PROCESSING",

    column_count: result.column_count,

    saved: false,
    status_changed: false,
    quota_changed: false
  };

}


/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.54
   MANUAL TEST - START PROCESSING

   Ujian:
   1. LIVE ditolak.
   2. Upload ID tidak sah ditolak.
   3. Lease token tidak sah ditolak.
   4. Rekod tidak wujud ditolak.
   5. Database tidak berubah.

   Nota:
   Laluan DRY RUN berjaya terhadap
   rekod tersimpan telah diuji
   pada Langkah 3.53 melalui
   fungsi penyediaan terkunci.

   Fungsi startUploadProcessing_()
   sendiri belum diuji pada laluan
   berjaya dengan rekod tersimpan.
============================================ */


function testStartUploadProcessing_() {

  // ---- 8. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId = PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error(
      "SPREADSHEET_ID tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
    spreadsheetId
  );

  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(
    "UPLOADS"
  );

  if (!sheet) {
    throw new Error(
      "Tab UPLOADS tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }


  // ---- 9. SIMPAN KEADAAN DATABASE ----

  const databaseBefore = JSON.stringify(
    sheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 10. JANA DATA UJIAN ----

  const uploadId = Utilities.getUuid();

  const lease = createUploadLease_();


  // ---- 11. UJIAN LIVE DISABLED ----

  const liveResult =
    startUploadProcessing_(
      uploadId,
      lease.lease_token,
      false
    );


  // ---- 12. UJIAN UPLOAD ID SALAH ----

  const invalidIdResult =
    startUploadProcessing_(
      "INVALID_UPLOAD_ID",
      lease.lease_token,
      true
    );


  // ---- 13. UJIAN LEASE TOKEN SALAH ----

  const invalidTokenResult =
    startUploadProcessing_(
      uploadId,
      "INVALID_TOKEN",
      true
    );


  // ---- 14. UJIAN REKOD TIDAK WUJUD ----

  const missingResult =
    startUploadProcessing_(
      uploadId,
      lease.lease_token,
      true
    );


  // ---- 15. SEMAK DATABASE ----

  const databaseAfter = JSON.stringify(
    sheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const databaseUnchanged =
    databaseBefore === databaseAfter;


  // ---- 16. RUMUSAN KEPUTUSAN ----

  const summary = {

    live_processing_disabled:
      liveResult.status === "REJECTED" &&
      liveResult.code ===
        "LIVE_PROCESSING_DISABLED" &&
      liveResult.processing_started === false,

    invalid_upload_id_rejected:
      invalidIdResult.status === "REJECTED" &&
      invalidIdResult.code ===
        "INVALID_UPLOAD_ID",

    invalid_lease_token_rejected:
      invalidTokenResult.status === "REJECTED" &&
      invalidTokenResult.code ===
        "INVALID_LEASE_TOKEN",

    missing_upload_rejected:
      missingResult.status === "REJECTED" &&
      missingResult.code ===
        "UPLOAD_NOT_FOUND",

    database_unchanged:
      databaseUnchanged

  };


  // ---- 17. PAPARKAN LOG SELAMAT ----

  Logger.log(
    "START UPLOAD PROCESSING TEST:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
  );


  // ---- 18. SAHKAN SEMUA UJIAN ----

  const passed =
    Object.values(summary).every(
      value => value === true
    );

  if (!passed) {
    throw new Error(
      "START UPLOAD PROCESSING TEST FAILED"
    );
  }

  Logger.log(
    "START UPLOAD PROCESSING TEST PASSED"
  );

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.55
   START PROCESSING STORED SUCCESS TEST

   TUJUAN:
   - Cipta satu rekod RESERVED sementara.
   - Uji startUploadProcessing_().
   - Sahkan keputusan DRY RUN berjaya.
   - Sahkan status tersimpan tidak berubah.
   - Padam rekod ujian selepas selesai.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - MANUAL TEST ONLY.

   - Tiada upload gambar.

   - Tidak dihubungkan ke Web App.

   PERHATIAN:

   sementara ke tab UPLOADS.

   Jalankan hanya apabila UPLOADS

   jalankan ujian semula sebelum

    spreadsheetId
  );

  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(
    "UPLOADS"
  );

  if (!sheet) {
    throw new Error(
      "Tab UPLOADS tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }


  // ---- 2. SAHKAN DATABASE KOSONG ----

  if (sheet.getLastRow() !== 1) {
    throw new Error(
      "TEST STOPPED: UPLOADS IS NOT EMPTY"
    );
  }


  // ---- 3. SAHKAN HEADER ----

  const actualHeaders = sheet
    .getRange(1, 1, 1, 22)
    .getValues()[0];

  const headersValid =
    UPLOAD_RESERVATION_HEADERS.length === 22 &&
    UPLOAD_RESERVATION_HEADERS.every(
      (header, index) =>
        actualHeaders[index] === header
    );

  if (!headersValid) {
    throw new Error(
      "UPLOADS HEADER MISMATCH"
    );
  }


  // ---- 4. SIMPAN KEADAAN ASAL ----

  const databaseBefore = JSON.stringify(
    sheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 5. JANA LEASE DAN UPLOAD ID ----

  const lease = createUploadLease_();

  const uploadId = Utilities.getUuid();


  // ---- 6. BINA REKOD RESERVED ----

  const built = buildUploadReservationRow_({

    upload_id:
      uploadId,

    idempotency_key:
      Utilities.getUuid(),

    event_id:
      "SIM_EVENT_001",

    qr_id:
      "SIM_QR_001",

    cycle_id:
      "SIM_CYCLE_001",

    lease_token:
      lease.lease_token,

    lease_expires_at:
      lease.lease_expires_at,

    original_filename:
      "temporary_success_test.jpg",

    file_mime_type:
      "image/jpeg",

    file_size_bytes:
      2500000,

    created_at:
      lease.lease_created_at

  });

  if (
    built.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
    built.column_count !== 22
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "TEST RECORD BUILD FAILED"
    );
  }


  // ---- 7. TETAPKAN STATUS UJIAN ----

  let temporaryRowCreated = false;

  let cleanupCompleted = false;

  let testPassed = false;

  let testError = null;


  // ---- 8. MULAKAN UJIAN ----

  try {

    // ---- 9. SIMPAN REKOD SEMENTARA ----

    sheet.getRange(
      2,
      1,
      1,
      22
    ).setValues([
      built.row
    ]);

    temporaryRowCreated = true;

    SpreadsheetApp.flush();


    // ---- 10. PANGGIL FUNGSI UTAMA ----

    const result = startUploadProcessing_(
      uploadId,
      lease.lease_token,
      true
    );


    // ---- 11. SAHKAN KEPUTUSAN ----

    const successResult =
      result.status === "SUCCESS" &&
      result.code ===
        "PROCESSING_DRY_RUN_READY" &&
      result.mode === "DRY_RUN" &&
      result.prepared === true &&
      result.integrity_verified === true &&
      result.proposed_status ===
        "PROCESSING" &&
      result.column_count === 22;


    // ---- 12. SAHKAN TIADA LIVE WRITE ----

    const noLiveWrite =
      result.processing_started === false &&
      result.saved === false &&
      result.status_changed === false &&
      result.quota_changed === false;


    // ---- 13. SAHKAN STATUS TERSIMPAN ----

    const storedStatus =
      sheet.getRange(2, 6).getValue();

    const statusUnchanged =
      storedStatus === "RESERVED";


    // ---- 14. SAHKAN LIVE MASIH DISEKAT ----

    const liveResult = startUploadProcessing_(
      uploadId,
      lease.lease_token,
      false
    );

    const liveStillDisabled =
      liveResult.status === "REJECTED" &&
      liveResult.code ===
        "LIVE_PROCESSING_DISABLED";


    // ---- 15. RUMUSAN UJIAN ----

    testPassed =
      successResult &&
      noLiveWrite &&
      statusUnchanged &&
      liveStillDisabled;


    Logger.log(
      "START PROCESSING STORED SUCCESS TEST:"
    );

    Logger.log(
      JSON.stringify({

        dry_run_success:
          successResult,

        no_live_write:
          noLiveWrite,

        stored_status_unchanged:
          statusUnchanged,

        live_still_disabled:
          liveStillDisabled

      }, null, 2)
    );


    if (!testPassed) {
      throw new Error(
        "START PROCESSING STORED SUCCESS TEST FAILED"
      );
    }

  } catch (error) {

    testError = error;

  } finally {

    // ---- 16. PEMBERSIHAN REKOD UJIAN ----

    if (temporaryRowCreated) {

      const currentUploadId =
        sheet.getRange(2, 1).getValue();

      if (currentUploadId === uploadId) {

        sheet.deleteRow(2);

        SpreadsheetApp.flush();

        cleanupCompleted = true;

      } else {

        Logger.log(
          "WARNING: TEST ROW ID MISMATCH"
        );

      }

    }

  }


  // ---- 17. SEMAK DATABASE DIPULIHKAN ----

  const databaseAfter = JSON.stringify(
    sheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const databaseRestored =
    databaseBefore === databaseAfter;


  // ---- 18. RUMUSAN PEMBERSIHAN ----

  const cleanupSummary = {

    test_passed:
      testPassed,

    cleanup_completed:
      cleanupCompleted,

    database_restored:
      databaseRestored

  };


  Logger.log(
    "START PROCESSING TEST CLEANUP:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify(
      cleanupSummary,
      null,
      2
    )
  );


  // ---- 19. TANGANI RALAT ----

  if (testError) {
    throw testError;
  }


  // ---- 20. SAHKAN KEPUTUSAN AKHIR ----

  if (
    !testPassed ||
    !cleanupCompleted ||
    !databaseRestored
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "START PROCESSING STORED TEST OR CLEANUP FAILED"
    );
  }


  Logger.log(
    "START PROCESSING STORED SUCCESS TEST PASSED"
  );

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.56
   PROCESSING WRITE PLAN - DRY RUN

   TUJUAN:
   - Bina pelan penulisan tiga lajur.
   - Gunakan rekod PROCESSING yang
     telah disediakan dan disahkan.
   - Pastikan lajur F, O dan Q betul.
   - Pastikan tiada penulisan sebenar.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - DRY RUN ONLY.
   - Tiada setValue() / setValues().
   - Tiada perubahan kuota.
   - Tiada upload gambar.
   - LIVE masih DISABLED.

   PENTING:
   Pelan ini bukan kebenaran untuk
   menulis ke Google Sheets.

   Untuk LIVE nanti, carian rekod,
   pengesahan lease, pengesahan
   integriti dan penulisan mesti
   dilakukan dalam ScriptLock
   yang sama.
============================================ */


// ---- 1. FUNGSI BINA PELAN PENULISAN ----

function buildProcessingWritePlan_(
  originalRecord,
  proposedRecord
) {

  // ---- 2. SAHKAN INTEGRITI ----

  const integrity =
    validateProcessingRecordIntegrity_(
      originalRecord,
      proposedRecord
    );

  if (
    integrity.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
    integrity.valid !== true
  ) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",

      code:
        integrity.code ||
        "PROCESSING_INTEGRITY_FAILED",

      mode: "DRY_RUN",

      plan_ready: false,

      saved: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 3. SAHKAN STRUKTUR HEADER ----

  const expectedHeaders = [
    "upload_status",
    "started_at",
    "updated_at"
  ];

  const expectedColumns = [
    6,
    15,
    17
  ];

  const mappingValid =
    UPLOAD_RESERVATION_HEADERS.length === 22 &&
    expectedHeaders.every(
      (header, index) =>
        UPLOAD_RESERVATION_HEADERS[
          expectedColumns[index] - 1
        ] === header
    );

  if (!mappingValid) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",

      code: "PROCESSING_COLUMN_MAPPING_MISMATCH",

      mode: "DRY_RUN",

      plan_ready: false,

      saved: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 4. BINA PELAN TIGA LAJUR ----

  const writePlan = [

    {
      column: 6,
      header: "upload_status",
      value: proposedRecord.upload_status
    },

    {
      column: 15,
      header: "started_at",
      value: proposedRecord.started_at
    },

    {
      column: 17,
      header: "updated_at",
      value: proposedRecord.updated_at
    }

  ];


  // ---- 5. PULANGKAN PELAN DRY RUN ----

  return {
    status: "SUCCESS",

    code: "PROCESSING_WRITE_PLAN_READY",

    mode: "DRY_RUN",

    plan_ready: true,

    write_count: 3,

    preserved_fields:
      integrity.preserved_fields,

    write_plan: writePlan,

    saved: false,
    status_changed: false,
    quota_changed: false
  };

}


/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.56
   MANUAL TEST - WRITE PLAN

   Ujian:
   1. Pelan sah berjaya dibina.
   2. Lajur F, O dan Q betul.
   3. Nilai PROCESSING betul.
   4. Timestamp dipetakan tepat.
   5. Perubahan medan lain ditolak.
   6. Database tidak berubah.
============================================ */


function testBuildProcessingWritePlan_() {

  // ---- 6. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId = PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error(
      "SPREADSHEET_ID tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
    spreadsheetId
  );

  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(
    "UPLOADS"
  );

  if (!sheet) {
    throw new Error(
      "Tab UPLOADS tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }


  // ---- 7. SIMPAN KEADAAN DATABASE ----

  const databaseBefore = JSON.stringify(
    sheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 8. JANA REKOD SIMULASI ----

  const lease = createUploadLease_();

  const uploadId = Utilities.getUuid();

  const built = buildUploadReservationRow_({

    upload_id:
      uploadId,

    idempotency_key:
      Utilities.getUuid(),

    event_id:
      "SIM_EVENT_001",

    qr_id:
      "SIM_QR_001",

    cycle_id:
      "SIM_CYCLE_001",

    lease_token:
      lease.lease_token,

    lease_expires_at:
      lease.lease_expires_at,

    original_filename:
      "write_plan_test.jpg",

    file_mime_type:
      "image/jpeg",

    file_size_bytes:
      2500000,

    created_at:
      lease.lease_created_at

  });

  if (
    built.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
    !built.record
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "SIMULATED RECORD BUILD FAILED"
    );
  }


  // ---- 9. SEDIAKAN REKOD PROCESSING ----

  const processingTime = new Date(
    Date.parse(lease.lease_created_at) +
    1000
  ).toISOString();

  const prepared =
    prepareUploadProcessingRecord_(
      uploadId,
      lease.lease_token,
      built.record,
      processingTime
    );

  if (
    prepared.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
    prepared.prepared !== true
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "PROCESSING PREPARATION FAILED"
    );
  }


  // ---- 10. BINA PELAN PENULISAN ----

  const plan = buildProcessingWritePlan_(
    built.record,
    prepared.processingRecord
  );


  // ---- 11. SAHKAN LAJUR ----

  const columnsCorrect =
    plan.status === "SUCCESS" &&
    plan.code ===
      "PROCESSING_WRITE_PLAN_READY" &&
    plan.write_count === 3 &&
    plan.write_plan.length === 3 &&
    plan.write_plan[0].column === 6 &&
    plan.write_plan[1].column === 15 &&
    plan.write_plan[2].column === 17;


  // ---- 12. SAHKAN NILAI ----

  const valuesCorrect =
    plan.write_plan[0].value ===
      "PROCESSING" &&
    plan.write_plan[1].value ===
      processingTime &&
    plan.write_plan[2].value ===
      processingTime;


  // ---- 13. SAHKAN TIADA LIVE WRITE ----

  const noLiveWrite =
    plan.saved === false &&
    plan.status_changed === false &&
    plan.quota_changed === false;


  // ---- 14. UJI PERUBAHAN TIDAK SAH ----

  const corruptedRecord = {
    ...prepared.processingRecord,
    qr_id: "MODIFIED_QR_ID"
  };

  const corruptedPlan =
    buildProcessingWritePlan_(
      built.record,
      corruptedRecord
    );

  const corruptedRejected =
    corruptedPlan.status === "REJECTED" &&
    corruptedPlan.code ===
      "UNAUTHORIZED_FIELD_CHANGE";


  // ---- 15. SEMAK DATABASE ----

  const databaseAfter = JSON.stringify(
    sheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const databaseUnchanged =
    databaseBefore === databaseAfter;


  // ---- 16. RUMUSAN UJIAN ----

  const summary = {

    write_plan_ready:
      plan.status === "SUCCESS" &&
      plan.plan_ready === true,

    columns_correct:
      columnsCorrect,

    values_correct:
      valuesCorrect,

    no_live_write:
      noLiveWrite,

    unauthorized_change_rejected:
      corruptedRejected,

    database_unchanged:
      databaseUnchanged

  };


  // ---- 17. PAPARKAN LOG SELAMAT ----

  Logger.log(
    "PROCESSING WRITE PLAN TEST:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
  );


  // ---- 18. SAHKAN KEPUTUSAN ----

  const passed =
    Object.values(summary).every(
      value => value === true
    );

  if (!passed) {
    throw new Error(
      "PROCESSING WRITE PLAN TEST FAILED"
    );
  }

  Logger.log(
    "PROCESSING WRITE PLAN TEST PASSED"
  );

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.57
   LOCKED PROCESSING WRITE PLAN

   TUJUAN:
   - Cari rekod sebenar dalam UPLOADS.
   - Dapatkan nombor baris sasaran.
   - Sahkan lease dan status RESERVED.
   - Sediakan rekod PROCESSING.
   - Sahkan integriti 22 medan.
   - Bina pelan penulisan F, O dan Q.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - LOCKED DRY RUN ONLY.
   - Tiada setValue() / setValues().
   - Tiada perubahan kuota.
   - Tiada upload gambar.
   - LIVE masih DISABLED.
   - Tidak dihubungkan ke Web App.

   PENTING:
   Jangan panggil fungsi lain yang
   mendapatkan ScriptLock baharu
   dari dalam callback ini.

   Nombor baris yang dipulangkan
   bukan kebenaran untuk menulis
   selepas lock dilepaskan.
============================================ */


// ---- 1. FUNGSI UTAMA TERKUNCI ----

function prepareLockedProcessingWritePlan_(
  uploadId,
  leaseToken
) {

  // ---- 2. DAPATKAN SCRIPTLOCK ----

  return withUploadReservationLock_(
    function() {

      // ---- 3. CARI REKOD SEBENAR ----

      const lookup =
        findUploadRecordById_(uploadId);


      // ---- 4. SEMAK KEPUTUSAN CARIAN ----

      if (
        lookup.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
        lookup.found !== true
      ) {

        return {
          status: "REJECTED",

          code:
            lookup.code ||
            "UPLOAD_LOOKUP_FAILED",

          mode: "LOCKED_DRY_RUN",

          lock_acquired: true,

          plan_ready: false,

          saved: false,
          status_changed: false,
          quota_changed: false
        };

      }


      // ---- 5. SAHKAN NOMBOR BARIS ----

      const rowNumber =
        lookup.row_number;

      if (
        !Number.isInteger(rowNumber) ||
        rowNumber < 2
      ) {

        return {
          status: "REJECTED",

          code: "INVALID_UPLOAD_ROW_NUMBER",

          mode: "LOCKED_DRY_RUN",

          lock_acquired: true,

          plan_ready: false,

          saved: false,
          status_changed: false,
          quota_changed: false
        };

      }


      // ---- 6. SEDIAKAN REKOD PROCESSING ----

      // Fungsi ini akan mengesahkan:
      // - upload_id
      // - lease_token
      // - status RESERVED
      // - deletion_status ACTIVE
      // - lease masih aktif

      const prepared =
        prepareUploadProcessingRecord_(
          uploadId,
          leaseToken,
          lookup.record
        );


      // ---- 7. SEMAK PENYEDIAAN ----

      if (
        prepared.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
        prepared.prepared !== true
      ) {

        return {
          status: "REJECTED",

          code:
            prepared.code ||
            "PROCESSING_PREPARATION_FAILED",

          mode: "LOCKED_DRY_RUN",

          lock_acquired: true,

          plan_ready: false,

          saved: false,
          status_changed: false,
          quota_changed: false
        };

      }


      // ---- 8. BINA PELAN PENULISAN ----

      // buildProcessingWritePlan_()
      // turut memeriksa integriti
      // semua 22 medan.

      const plan = buildProcessingWritePlan_(
        lookup.record,
        prepared.processingRecord
      );


      // ---- 9. SEMAK PELAN ----

      if (
        plan.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
        plan.plan_ready !== true ||
        plan.write_count !== 3
      ) {

        return {
          status: "REJECTED",

          code:
            plan.code ||
            "PROCESSING_WRITE_PLAN_FAILED",

          mode: "LOCKED_DRY_RUN",

          lock_acquired: true,

          plan_ready: false,

          saved: false,
          status_changed: false,
          quota_changed: false
        };

      }


      // ---- 10. SAHKAN PEMETAAN LAJUR ----

      const expectedColumns = [
        6,
        15,
        17
      ];

      const columnsValid =
        plan.write_plan.length === 3 &&
        plan.write_plan.every(
          (item, index) =>
            item.column ===
            expectedColumns[index]
        );

      if (!columnsValid) {

        return {
          status: "REJECTED",

          code: "INVALID_PROCESSING_WRITE_COLUMNS",

          mode: "LOCKED_DRY_RUN",

          lock_acquired: true,

          plan_ready: false,

          saved: false,
          status_changed: false,
          quota_changed: false
        };

      }


      // ---- 11. PULANGKAN RUMUSAN SELAMAT ----

      // Jangan pulangkan lease_token
      // atau keseluruhan rekod.

      // Nombor baris dipulangkan
      // untuk tujuan diagnostik
      // dalaman sahaja.

      return {
        status: "SUCCESS",

        code:
          "LOCKED_PROCESSING_WRITE_PLAN_READY",

        mode: "LOCKED_DRY_RUN",

        lock_acquired: true,

        plan_ready: true,

        row_number: rowNumber,

        write_count: 3,

        target_columns: [
          6,
          15,
          17
        ],

        proposed_status: "PROCESSING",

        preserved_fields:
          plan.preserved_fields,

        saved: false,
        status_changed: false,
        quota_changed: false
      };

    }
  );

}

  if (!passed) {

  Logger.log(

  );

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.58
   LOCKED WRITE PLAN STORED SUCCESS TEST

   TUJUAN:
   - Cipta rekod RESERVED sementara.
   - Uji pelan penulisan terkunci.
   - Sahkan baris dan lajur sasaran.
   - Sahkan tiada status berubah.
   - Padam rekod ujian selepas selesai.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - MANUAL TEST ONLY.
   - LIVE PROCESSING DISABLED.
   - Tiada upload gambar.
   - Tiada perubahan kuota.
   - Tidak dihubungkan ke Web App.

   PERHATIAN:
   Ujian ini MENULIS sementara
   ke tab UPLOADS.

   Jalankan hanya apabila UPLOADS
   mempunyai header sahaja.

   Jangan jalankan serentak dengan
   operasi lain.

   Pembersihan menggunakan finally.
   Semak database secara manual
   selepas ujian selesai.
============================================ */


function testLockedProcessingWritePlanStoredSuccess_() {

  // ---- 1. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId = PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error(
      "SPREADSHEET_ID tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
    spreadsheetId
  );

  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(
    "UPLOADS"
  );

  if (!sheet) {
    throw new Error(
      "Tab UPLOADS tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }


  // ---- 2. SAHKAN DATABASE KOSONG ----

  if (sheet.getLastRow() !== 1) {
    throw new Error(
      "TEST STOPPED: UPLOADS IS NOT EMPTY"
    );
  }


  // ---- 3. SAHKAN HEADER ----

  const actualHeaders = sheet
    .getRange(1, 1, 1, 22)
    .getValues()[0];

  const headersValid =
    UPLOAD_RESERVATION_HEADERS.length === 22 &&
    UPLOAD_RESERVATION_HEADERS.every(
      (header, index) =>
        actualHeaders[index] === header
    );

  if (!headersValid) {
    throw new Error(
      "UPLOADS HEADER MISMATCH"
    );
  }


  // ---- 4. SIMPAN KEADAAN ASAL ----

  const databaseBefore = JSON.stringify(
    sheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 5. JANA DATA UJIAN ----

  const lease = createUploadLease_();

  const uploadId = Utilities.getUuid();


  // ---- 6. BINA REKOD RESERVED ----

  const built = buildUploadReservationRow_({

    upload_id:
      uploadId,

    idempotency_key:
      Utilities.getUuid(),

    event_id:
      "SIM_EVENT_001",

    qr_id:
      "SIM_QR_001",

    cycle_id:
      "SIM_CYCLE_001",

    lease_token:
      lease.lease_token,

    lease_expires_at:
      lease.lease_expires_at,

    original_filename:
      "locked_write_plan_test.jpg",

    file_mime_type:
      "image/jpeg",

    file_size_bytes:
      2500000,

    created_at:
      lease.lease_created_at

  });

  if (
    built.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
    built.column_count !== 22
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "TEST RECORD BUILD FAILED"
    );
  }


  // ---- 7. STATUS UJIAN ----

  let temporaryRowCreated = false;

  let cleanupCompleted = false;

  let testPassed = false;

  let testError = null;


  // ---- 8. MULAKAN UJIAN ----

  try {

    // ---- 9. DAPATKAN LOCK UNTUK INSERT ----

    const insertResult =
      withUploadReservationLock_(
        function() {

          if (sheet.getLastRow() !== 1) {

            return {
              status: "REJECTED",
              code: "UPLOADS_NOT_EMPTY"
            };

          }

          sheet.getRange(
            2,
            1,
            1,
            22
          ).setValues([
            built.row
          ]);

          temporaryRowCreated = true;

          SpreadsheetApp.flush();

          return {
            status: "SUCCESS",
            code: "TEST_ROW_INSERTED"
          };

        }
      );

    if (
      insertResult.status !== "SUCCESS"
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "TEST ROW INSERT FAILED"
      );
    }


    // ---- 10. JALANKAN FUNGSI TERKUNCI ----

    // Jangan panggil fungsi ini
    // di dalam lock insert tadi.
    // Ia mendapatkan lock sendiri.

    const result =
      prepareLockedProcessingWritePlan_(
        uploadId,
        lease.lease_token
      );


    // ---- 11. SAHKAN KEPUTUSAN ----

    const planReady =
      result.status === "SUCCESS" &&
      result.code ===
        "LOCKED_PROCESSING_WRITE_PLAN_READY" &&
      result.mode === "LOCKED_DRY_RUN" &&
      result.lock_acquired === true &&
      result.plan_ready === true;


    // ---- 12. SAHKAN BARIS SASARAN ----

    const rowCorrect =
      result.row_number === 2;


    // ---- 13. SAHKAN LAJUR SASARAN ----

    const columnsCorrect =
      result.write_count === 3 &&
      Array.isArray(
        result.target_columns
      ) &&
      JSON.stringify(
        result.target_columns
      ) === JSON.stringify([
        6,
        15,
        17
      ]);


    // ---- 14. SAHKAN INTEGRITI ----

    const integrityCorrect =
      result.preserved_fields === 19 &&
      result.proposed_status ===
        "PROCESSING";


    // ---- 15. SAHKAN TIADA LIVE WRITE ----

    const noLiveWrite =
      result.saved === false &&
      result.status_changed === false &&
      result.quota_changed === false;


    // ---- 16. SEMAK STATUS TERSIMPAN ----

    const storedStatus =
      sheet.getRange(2, 6).getValue();

    const statusUnchanged =
      storedStatus === "RESERVED";


    // ---- 17. RUMUSAN UJIAN ----

    testPassed =
      planReady &&
      rowCorrect &&
      columnsCorrect &&
      integrityCorrect &&
      noLiveWrite &&
      statusUnchanged;


    Logger.log(
      "LOCKED WRITE PLAN STORED SUCCESS TEST:"
    );

    Logger.log(
      JSON.stringify({

        plan_ready:
          planReady,

        row_correct:
          rowCorrect,

        columns_correct:
          columnsCorrect,

        integrity_correct:
          integrityCorrect,

        no_live_write:
          noLiveWrite,

        stored_status_unchanged:
          statusUnchanged

      }, null, 2)
    );


    if (!testPassed) {
      throw new Error(
        "LOCKED WRITE PLAN STORED SUCCESS TEST FAILED"
      );
    }

  } catch (error) {

    testError = error;

  } finally {

    // ---- 18. PEMBERSIHAN DENGAN LOCK ----

    if (temporaryRowCreated) {

      try {

        const cleanupResult =
          withUploadReservationLock_(
            function() {

              const currentUploadId =
                sheet.getRange(
                  2,
                  1
                ).getValue();

              if (
                currentUploadId !== uploadId
              ) {

                return {
                  status: "REJECTED",
                  code: "TEST_ROW_ID_MISMATCH"
                };

              }

              sheet.deleteRow(2);

              SpreadsheetApp.flush();

              return {
                status: "SUCCESS",
                code: "TEST_ROW_REMOVED"
              };

            }
          );

        cleanupCompleted =
          cleanupResult.status ===
          "SUCCESS";

      } catch (cleanupError) {

        Logger.log(
          "WARNING: TEST CLEANUP FAILED"
        );

      }

    }

  }


  // ---- 19. SAHKAN DATABASE DIPULIHKAN ----

  const databaseAfter = JSON.stringify(
    sheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const databaseRestored =
    databaseBefore === databaseAfter;


  // ---- 20. RUMUSAN PEMBERSIHAN ----

  const summary = {

    test_passed:
      testPassed,

    cleanup_completed:
      cleanupCompleted,

    database_restored:
      databaseRestored

  };


  Logger.log(
    "LOCKED WRITE PLAN CLEANUP:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
  );


  // ---- 21. TANGANI RALAT ----

  if (testError) {
    throw testError;
  }


  // ---- 22. SAHKAN KEPUTUSAN AKHIR ----

  if (
    !testPassed ||
    !cleanupCompleted ||
    !databaseRestored
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "LOCKED WRITE PLAN TEST OR CLEANUP FAILED"
    );
  }


  Logger.log(
    "LOCKED WRITE PLAN STORED SUCCESS TEST PASSED"
  );

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.59
   PREPARE PROCESSING STATUS WRITE

   TUJUAN:
   - Sediakan perubahan status upload.
   - Gunakan satu ScriptLock sahaja.
   - Sahkan rekod RESERVED sebenar.
   - Sahkan lease masih aktif.
   - Sahkan integriti 22 medan.
   - Bina pelan penulisan F, O, Q.
   - Sahkan identiti baris sasaran.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - DRY RUN ONLY.
   - Tiada penulisan database.
   - Tiada perubahan kuota.
   - Tiada upload gambar.
   - LIVE masih DISABLED.

   PENTING:
   Fungsi ini tidak boleh digunakan
   sebagai kebenaran menulis selepas
   ScriptLock dilepaskan.

   Dalam operasi LIVE nanti, semua
   pengesahan dan penulisan mesti
   berlaku dalam lock yang sama.

   Jangan hubungkan fungsi ini
   kepada doGet() atau doPost().
============================================ */


// ---- 1. FUNGSI UTAMA ----

function prepareProcessingStatusWrite_(
  uploadId,
  leaseToken
) {

  // ---- 2. DAPATKAN SCRIPTLOCK ----

  return withUploadReservationLock_(
    function() {

      // ---- 3. CARI REKOD SEBENAR ----

      const lookup =
        findUploadRecordById_(uploadId);


      // ---- 4. SEMAK REKOD ----

      if (
        lookup.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
        lookup.found !== true
      ) {

        return {
          status: "REJECTED",

          code:
            lookup.code ||
            "UPLOAD_LOOKUP_FAILED",

          mode: "LOCKED_DRY_RUN",

          prepared: false,

          saved: false,
          status_changed: false,
          quota_changed: false
        };

      }


      // ---- 5. SAHKAN NOMBOR BARIS ----

      const rowNumber =
        lookup.row_number;

      if (
        !Number.isInteger(rowNumber) ||
        rowNumber < 2
      ) {

        return {
          status: "REJECTED",

          code: "INVALID_UPLOAD_ROW_NUMBER",

          mode: "LOCKED_DRY_RUN",

          prepared: false,

          saved: false,
          status_changed: false,
          quota_changed: false
        };

      }


      // ---- 6. SEDIAKAN REKOD PROCESSING ----

      // Fungsi sedia ada menyemak:
      //
      // - upload_id
      // - lease_token
      // - status RESERVED
      // - deletion_status ACTIVE
      // - lease belum tamat

      const prepared =
        prepareUploadProcessingRecord_(
          uploadId,
          leaseToken,
          lookup.record
        );


      // ---- 7. SEMAK PENYEDIAAN ----

      if (
        prepared.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
        prepared.prepared !== true
      ) {

        return {
          status: "REJECTED",

          code:
            prepared.code ||
            "PROCESSING_PREPARATION_FAILED",

          mode: "LOCKED_DRY_RUN",

          prepared: false,

          saved: false,
          status_changed: false,
          quota_changed: false
        };

      }


      // ---- 8. SAHKAN INTEGRITI ----

      const integrity =
        validateProcessingRecordIntegrity_(
          lookup.record,
          prepared.processingRecord
        );

      if (
        integrity.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
        integrity.valid !== true
      ) {

        return {
          status: "REJECTED",

          code:
            integrity.code ||
            "PROCESSING_INTEGRITY_FAILED",

          mode: "LOCKED_DRY_RUN",

          prepared: false,

          saved: false,
          status_changed: false,
          quota_changed: false
        };

      }


      // ---- 9. BINA PELAN PENULISAN ----

      const plan =
        buildProcessingWritePlan_(
          lookup.record,
          prepared.processingRecord
        );


      // ---- 10. SAHKAN PELAN ----

      if (
        plan.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
        plan.plan_ready !== true ||
        plan.write_count !== 3
      ) {

        return {
          status: "REJECTED",

          code:
            plan.code ||
            "PROCESSING_WRITE_PLAN_FAILED",

          mode: "LOCKED_DRY_RUN",

          prepared: false,

          saved: false,
          status_changed: false,
          quota_changed: false
        };

      }


      // ---- 11. SAHKAN LAJUR ----

      const expectedColumns = [
        6,
        15,
        17
      ];

      const columnsValid =
        Array.isArray(plan.write_plan) &&
        plan.write_plan.length === 3 &&
        plan.write_plan.every(
          (item, index) =>
            item.column ===
            expectedColumns[index]
        );

      if (!columnsValid) {

        return {
          status: "REJECTED",

          code: "INVALID_PROCESSING_WRITE_COLUMNS",

          mode: "LOCKED_DRY_RUN",

          prepared: false,

          saved: false,
          status_changed: false,
          quota_changed: false
        };

      }


      // ---- 12. SAHKAN IDENTITI REKOD ----

      // Baca semula upload_id pada
      // baris yang dikenal pasti.

      // Ini pemeriksaan tambahan
      // sebelum operasi penulisan.

      const spreadsheetId =
        PropertiesService
          .getScriptProperties()
          .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

      if (!spreadsheetId) {
        throw new Error(
          "SPREADSHEET_ID tidak dijumpai."
        );
      }

      const ss =
        SpreadsheetApp.openById(
          spreadsheetId
        );

      const sheet =
        ss.getSheetByName("UPLOADS");

      if (!sheet) {
        throw new Error(
          "Tab UPLOADS tidak dijumpai."
        );
      }

      const storedUploadId =
        sheet.getRange(
          rowNumber,
          1
        ).getValue();


      // ---- 13. BANDINKAN UPLOAD ID ----

      if (storedUploadId !== uploadId) {

        return {
          status: "REJECTED",

          code: "UPLOAD_ROW_ID_MISMATCH",

          mode: "LOCKED_DRY_RUN",

          prepared: false,

          saved: false,
          status_changed: false,
          quota_changed: false
        };

      }


      // ---- 14. PULANGKAN RUMUSAN SELAMAT ----

      // Jangan pulangkan lease_token,
      // rekod penuh atau nilai sensitif.

      return {
        status: "SUCCESS",

        code:
          "PROCESSING_STATUS_WRITE_PREPARED",

        mode: "LOCKED_DRY_RUN",

        lock_acquired: true,

        prepared: true,

        row_number: rowNumber,

        write_count: 3,

        target_columns: [
          6,
          15,
          17
        ],

        proposed_status: "PROCESSING",

        integrity_verified: true,

        preserved_fields: 19,

        saved: false,
        status_changed: false,
        quota_changed: false
      };

    }
  );

}


/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.59
   MANUAL TEST

   Ujian:
   1. Rekod tidak wujud ditolak.
   2. Upload ID tidak sah ditolak.
   3. Database tidak berubah.

   Laluan berjaya dengan rekod
   tersimpan akan diuji secara
   berasingan selepas ini.
============================================ */


function testPrepareProcessingStatusWrite_() {

  // ---- 15. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error(
      "SPREADSHEET_ID tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }

  const ss =
    SpreadsheetApp.openById(
      spreadsheetId
    );

  const sheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("UPLOADS");

  if (!sheet) {
    throw new Error(
      "Tab UPLOADS tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }


  // ---- 16. SIMPAN KEADAAN DATABASE ----

  const databaseBefore =
    JSON.stringify(
      sheet.getDataRange().getValues()
    );


  // ---- 17. JANA DATA UJIAN ----

  const uploadId =
    Utilities.getUuid();

  const lease =
    createUploadLease_();


  // ---- 18. UJIAN REKOD TIDAK WUJUD ----

  const missingResult =
    prepareProcessingStatusWrite_(
      uploadId,
      lease.lease_token
    );


  // ---- 19. UJIAN ID TIDAK SAH ----

  const invalidIdResult =
    prepareProcessingStatusWrite_(
      "INVALID_UPLOAD_ID",
      lease.lease_token
    );


  // ---- 20. SEMAK DATABASE ----

  const databaseAfter =
    JSON.stringify(
      sheet.getDataRange().getValues()
    );

  const databaseUnchanged =
    databaseBefore === databaseAfter;


  // ---- 21. RUMUSAN UJIAN ----

  const summary = {

    missing_upload_rejected:
      missingResult.status === "REJECTED" &&
      missingResult.code ===
        "UPLOAD_NOT_FOUND",

    invalid_upload_id_rejected:
      invalidIdResult.status === "REJECTED" &&
      invalidIdResult.code ===
        "INVALID_UPLOAD_ID",

    database_unchanged:
      databaseUnchanged

  };


  // ---- 22. PAPARKAN LOG SELAMAT ----

  Logger.log(
    "PROCESSING STATUS WRITE PREPARATION TEST:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify(
      summary,
      null,
      2
    )
  );


  // ---- 23. SAHKAN SEMUA UJIAN ----

  const passed =
