    Object.values(summary).every(
      value => value === true
    );

  if (!passed) {
    throw new Error(
      "PROCESSING STATUS WRITE PREPARATION TEST FAILED"
    );
  }

  Logger.log(
    "PROCESSING STATUS WRITE PREPARATION TEST PASSED"
  );

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.60
   STORED PROCESSING WRITE PREPARATION TEST

   TUJUAN:
   - Cipta satu rekod RESERVED sementara.
   - Uji prepareProcessingStatusWrite_().
   - Sahkan baris sasaran ialah baris 2.
   - Sahkan lajur F, O dan Q.
   - Sahkan status kekal RESERVED.
   - Sahkan tiada perubahan kuota.
   - Padam rekod ujian.
   - Pastikan database dipulihkan.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - UJIAN MANUAL SAHAJA.
   - LIVE PROCESSING MASIH DISABLED.
   - Tiada gambar dimuat naik.
   - Tiada perubahan status sebenar.
   - Tidak dihubungkan ke doPost/doGet.

   PENTING:
   Jalankan hanya apabila tab UPLOADS
   mempunyai header sahaja.

   Jika ujian terhenti secara paksa,
   pembersihan mungkin tidak berlaku.
   Semak UPLOADS selepas ujian.
============================================ */


function testPrepareProcessingStatusWriteStoredSuccess_() {

  // ---- 1. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error(
      "SPREADSHEET_ID tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
    spreadsheetId
  );

  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(
    "UPLOADS"
  );

  const quotaSheet = ss.getSheetByName(
    "QUOTA_CYCLES"
  );

  if (!sheet || !quotaSheet) {
    throw new Error(
      "UPLOADS atau QUOTA_CYCLES tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }


  // ---- 2. SAHKAN UPLOADS KOSONG ----

  if (sheet.getLastRow() !== 1) {
    throw new Error(
      "TEST STOPPED: UPLOADS IS NOT EMPTY"
    );
  }


  // ---- 3. SAHKAN HEADER 22 LAJUR ----

  const actualHeaders = sheet
    .getRange(1, 1, 1, 22)
    .getValues()[0];

  const headersValid =
    UPLOAD_RESERVATION_HEADERS.length === 22 &&
    UPLOAD_RESERVATION_HEADERS.every(
      (header, index) =>
        actualHeaders[index] === header
    );

  if (!headersValid) {
    throw new Error(
      "UPLOADS HEADER MISMATCH"
    );
  }


  // ---- 4. SIMPAN KEADAAN ASAL ----

  const uploadsBefore = JSON.stringify(
    sheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const quotaBefore = JSON.stringify(
    quotaSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 5. JANA IDENTITI DAN LEASE ----

  const uploadId = Utilities.getUuid();

  const lease = createUploadLease_();


  // ---- 6. BINA REKOD RESERVED ----

  const built = buildUploadReservationRow_({

    upload_id: uploadId,

    idempotency_key:
      Utilities.getUuid(),

    event_id:
      "SIM_EVENT_001",

    qr_id:
      "SIM_QR_001",

    cycle_id:
      "SIM_CYCLE_001",

    lease_token:
      lease.lease_token,

    lease_expires_at:
      lease.lease_expires_at,

    original_filename:
      "processing_status_test.jpg",

    file_mime_type:
      "image/jpeg",

    file_size_bytes:
      2500000,

    created_at:
      lease.lease_created_at

  });

  if (
    built.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
    built.column_count !== 22 ||
    !Array.isArray(built.row) ||
    built.row.length !== 22
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "TEST RECORD BUILD FAILED"
    );
  }


  // ---- 7. PEMBOLEH UBAH UJIAN ----

  let temporaryRowCreated = false;

  let cleanupCompleted = false;

  let testPassed = false;

  let testError = null;


  // ---- 8. MULAKAN UJIAN ----

  try {

    // ---- 9. MASUKKAN REKOD DENGAN LOCK ----

    const insertResult =
      withUploadReservationLock_(
        function() {

          if (sheet.getLastRow() !== 1) {
            return {
              status: "REJECTED",
              code: "UPLOADS_NOT_EMPTY"
            };
          }

          // Tulis rekod ujian sahaja.

          sheet.getRange(
            2, 1, 1, 22
          ).setValues([
            built.row
          ]);

          // Tandakan sebelum flush supaya
          // finally boleh cuba membersihkan.

          temporaryRowCreated = true;

          SpreadsheetApp.flush();

          return {
            status: "SUCCESS",
            code: "TEST_ROW_INSERTED"
          };

        }
      );

    if (
      insertResult.status !== "SUCCESS"
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "TEST ROW INSERT FAILED"
      );
    }


    // ---- 10. PANGGIL FUNGSI LANGKAH 3.59 ----

    // PENTING:
    // Panggil di luar lock insert.
    //
    // Fungsi ini mendapatkan
    // ScriptLock sendiri.

    const result =
      prepareProcessingStatusWrite_(
        uploadId,
        lease.lease_token
      );


    // ---- 11. SAHKAN KEJAYAAN ----

    const preparationSuccessful =
      result.status === "SUCCESS" &&
      result.code ===
        "PROCESSING_STATUS_WRITE_PREPARED" &&
      result.mode === "LOCKED_DRY_RUN" &&
      result.lock_acquired === true &&
      result.prepared === true;


    // ---- 12. SAHKAN BARIS ----

    const rowCorrect =
      result.row_number === 2;


    // ---- 13. SAHKAN LAJUR ----

    const columnsCorrect =
      result.write_count === 3 &&
      Array.isArray(
        result.target_columns
      ) &&
      JSON.stringify(
        result.target_columns
      ) === JSON.stringify([
        6, 15, 17
      ]);


    // ---- 14. SAHKAN INTEGRITI ----

    const integrityCorrect =
      result.integrity_verified === true &&
      result.preserved_fields === 19 &&
      result.proposed_status ===
        "PROCESSING";


    // ---- 15. SAHKAN TIADA LIVE WRITE ----

    const noLiveWrite =
      result.saved === false &&
      result.status_changed === false &&
      result.quota_changed === false;


    // ---- 16. SEMAK STATUS TERSIMPAN ----

    const storedStatus = sheet
      .getRange(2, 6)
      .getValue();

    const statusUnchanged =
      storedStatus === "RESERVED";


    // ---- 17. SEMAK TIMESTAMP TERSIMPAN ----

    // O = started_at
    // Q = updated_at
    //
    // Rekod RESERVED asal:
    // started_at kosong.
    // updated_at sama dengan created_at.

    const startedAt = sheet
      .getRange(2, 15)
      .getValue();

    const updatedAt = sheet
      .getRange(2, 17)
      .getValue();

    const timestampsUnchanged =
      startedAt === "" &&
      updatedAt ===
        built.record.updated_at;


    // ---- 18. SEMAK KUOTA ----

    const quotaDuring = JSON.stringify(
      quotaSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
    );

    const quotaUnchanged =
      quotaBefore === quotaDuring;


    // ---- 19. BINA RUMUSAN ----

    const summary = {

      preparation_successful:
        preparationSuccessful,

      row_correct:
        rowCorrect,

      columns_correct:
        columnsCorrect,

      integrity_correct:
        integrityCorrect,

      no_live_write:
        noLiveWrite,

      stored_status_unchanged:
        statusUnchanged,

      timestamps_unchanged:
        timestampsUnchanged,

      quota_unchanged:
        quotaUnchanged

    };


    // ---- 20. PAPARKAN LOG SELAMAT ----

    Logger.log(
      "PROCESSING STATUS STORED SUCCESS TEST:"
    );

    Logger.log(
      JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
    );


    // ---- 21. SAHKAN SEMUA UJIAN ----

    testPassed =
      Object.values(summary).every(
        value => value === true
      );

    if (!testPassed) {
      throw new Error(
        "PROCESSING STATUS STORED SUCCESS TEST FAILED"
      );
    }

  } catch (error) {

    testError = error;

  } finally {

    // ---- 22. BERSIHKAN REKOD UJIAN ----

    if (temporaryRowCreated) {

      try {

        const cleanupResult =
          withUploadReservationLock_(
            function() {

              // Jangan padam jika ID berbeza.

              const storedUploadId =
                sheet.getRange(
                  2, 1
                ).getValue();

              if (
                storedUploadId !== uploadId
              ) {
                return {
                  status: "REJECTED",
                  code: "TEST_ROW_ID_MISMATCH"
                };
              }

              sheet.deleteRow(2);

              SpreadsheetApp.flush();

              return {
                status: "SUCCESS",
                code: "TEST_ROW_REMOVED"
              };

            }
          );

        cleanupCompleted =
          cleanupResult.status ===
          "SUCCESS";

      } catch (cleanupError) {

        Logger.log(
          "WARNING: TEST CLEANUP FAILED"
        );

      }

    }

  }


  // ---- 23. SAHKAN DATABASE DIPULIHKAN ----

  const uploadsAfter = JSON.stringify(
    sheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const quotaAfter = JSON.stringify(
    quotaSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const uploadsRestored =
    uploadsBefore === uploadsAfter;

  const quotaRestored =
    quotaBefore === quotaAfter;


  // ---- 24. LOG PEMBERSIHAN ----

  Logger.log(
    "PROCESSING STATUS TEST CLEANUP:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify({

      test_passed:
        testPassed,

      cleanup_completed:
        cleanupCompleted,

      uploads_restored:
        uploadsRestored,

      quota_restored:
        quotaRestored

    }, null, 2)
  );


  // ---- 25. TANGANI RALAT ----

  if (testError) {
    throw testError;
  }


  // ---- 26. KEPUTUSAN AKHIR ----

  if (
    !testPassed ||
    !cleanupCompleted ||
    !uploadsRestored ||
    !quotaRestored
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "PROCESSING STATUS TEST OR CLEANUP FAILED"
    );
  }

  Logger.log(
    "PROCESSING STATUS STORED SUCCESS TEST PASSED"
  );

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.61
   ACTUAL PROCESSING STATUS WRITE TEST

   TUJUAN:
   - Uji penulisan sebenar ke UPLOADS.
   - Gunakan rekod RESERVED sementara.
   - Sahkan lease dan integriti.
   - Tukar RESERVED kepada PROCESSING.
   - Sahkan hanya F, O, Q berubah.
   - Padam rekod ujian.
   - Pulihkan database.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - PRIVATE MANUAL TEST ONLY.
   - Bukan fungsi upload awam.
   - LIVE masih DISABLED.
   - Tiada upload gambar.
   - Tiada perubahan kuota.
   - Satu ScriptLock untuk keseluruhan
     operasi ujian.

   PENTING:
   Jangan hubungkan fungsi ini
   kepada doGet() atau doPost().

   Jalankan hanya apabila UPLOADS
   mempunyai header sahaja.
============================================ */


function testProcessingStatusActualWrite_() {

  // ---- 1. DAPATKAN DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error(
      "SPREADSHEET_ID tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
    spreadsheetId
  );

  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(
    "UPLOADS"
  );

  const quotaSheet = ss.getSheetByName(
    "QUOTA_CYCLES"
  );

  if (!sheet || !quotaSheet) {
    throw new Error(
      "UPLOADS atau QUOTA_CYCLES tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }


  // ---- 2. DAPATKAN SATU SCRIPTLOCK ----

  const result = withUploadReservationLock_(
    function() {

      // ---- 3. SAHKAN UPLOADS KOSONG ----

      if (sheet.getLastRow() !== 1) {
        return {
          status: "REJECTED",
          code: "UPLOADS_NOT_EMPTY"
        };
      }


      // ---- 4. SAHKAN HEADER ----

      const headers = sheet
        .getRange(1, 1, 1, 22)
        .getValues()[0];

      const headersValid =
        UPLOAD_RESERVATION_HEADERS.length === 22 &&
        UPLOAD_RESERVATION_HEADERS.every(
          (header, index) =>
            headers[index] === header
        );

      if (!headersValid) {
        return {
          status: "REJECTED",
          code: "UPLOADS_HEADER_MISMATCH"
        };
      }


      // ---- 5. SIMPAN KEADAAN ASAL ----

      const uploadsBefore = JSON.stringify(
        sheet.getDataRange().getValues()
      );

      const quotaBefore = JSON.stringify(
        quotaSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
      );


      // ---- 6. JANA REKOD SIMULASI ----

      const uploadId = Utilities.getUuid();

      const lease = createUploadLease_();

      const built = buildUploadReservationRow_({

        upload_id:
          uploadId,

        idempotency_key:
          Utilities.getUuid(),

        event_id:
          "SIM_EVENT_001",

        qr_id:
          "SIM_QR_001",

        cycle_id:
          "SIM_CYCLE_001",

        lease_token:
          lease.lease_token,

        lease_expires_at:
          lease.lease_expires_at,

        original_filename:
          "actual_write_test.jpg",

        file_mime_type:
          "image/jpeg",

        file_size_bytes:
          2500000,

        created_at:
          lease.lease_created_at

      });

      if (
        built.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
        built.column_count !== 22
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          "TEST RECORD BUILD FAILED"
        );
      }


      // ---- 7. STATUS PEMBERSIHAN ----

      let temporaryRowCreated = false;

      let cleanupCompleted = false;

      let testPassed = false;

      let testError = null;


      // ---- 8. MULAKAN UJIAN ----

      try {

        // ---- 9. TULIS REKOD RESERVED ----

        sheet.getRange(
          2, 1, 1, 22
        ).setValues([
          built.row
        ]);

        temporaryRowCreated = true;

        SpreadsheetApp.flush();


        // ---- 10. CARI REKOD TERSIMPAN ----

        // Fungsi ini tidak mendapatkan
        // lock baharu.

        const lookup =
          findUploadRecordById_(uploadId);

        if (
          lookup.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
          lookup.found !== true ||
          lookup.row_number !== 2
        ) {
          throw new Error(
            "STORED UPLOAD LOOKUP FAILED"
          );
        }


        // ---- 11. SEDIAKAN PROCESSING ----

        const prepared =
          prepareUploadProcessingRecord_(
            uploadId,
            lease.lease_token,
            lookup.record
          );

        if (
          prepared.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
          prepared.prepared !== true
        ) {
          throw new Error(
            "PROCESSING PREPARATION FAILED"
          );
        }


        // ---- 12. SAHKAN INTEGRITI ----

        const integrity =
          validateProcessingRecordIntegrity_(
            lookup.record,
            prepared.processingRecord
          );

        if (
          integrity.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
          integrity.valid !== true
        ) {
          throw new Error(
            "PROCESSING INTEGRITY FAILED"
          );
        }


        // ---- 13. BINA PELAN PENULISAN ----

        const plan =
          buildProcessingWritePlan_(
            lookup.record,
            prepared.processingRecord
          );

        if (
          plan.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
          plan.plan_ready !== true ||
          plan.write_count !== 3
        ) {
          throw new Error(
            "PROCESSING WRITE PLAN FAILED"
          );
        }


        // ---- 14. SAHKAN LAJUR ----

        const expectedColumns = [
          6, 15, 17
        ];

        const columnsValid =
          plan.write_plan.length === 3 &&
          plan.write_plan.every(
            (item, index) =>
              item.column ===
              expectedColumns[index]
          );

        if (!columnsValid) {
          throw new Error(
            "PROCESSING COLUMN MAPPING FAILED"
          );
        }


        // ---- 15. SAHKAN REKOD SASARAN ----

        const storedId = sheet
          .getRange(2, 1)
          .getValue();

        if (storedId !== uploadId) {
          throw new Error(
            "UPLOAD ROW ID MISMATCH"
          );
        }


        // ---- 16. TULIS STATUS SEBENAR ----

        // Tulis keseluruhan 22 lajur
        // menggunakan rekod yang telah
        // disahkan integritinya.

        // Ini satu operasi setValues().
        // Hanya F, O, Q mempunyai
        // nilai baharu.

        sheet.getRange(
          2, 1, 1, 22
        ).setValues([
          prepared.processingRow
        ]);

        SpreadsheetApp.flush();


        // ---- 17. BACA SEMULA REKOD ----

        const storedRow = sheet
          .getRange(2, 1, 1, 22)
          .getValues()[0];


        // ---- 18. SAHKAN 22 MEDAN ----

        const allFieldsCorrect =
          storedRow.every(
            (value, index) =>
              value ===
              prepared.processingRow[index]
          );


        // ---- 19. SAHKAN STATUS ----

        const statusCorrect =
          storedRow[5] === "PROCESSING";


        // ---- 20. SAHKAN TIMESTAMP ----

        const timestampsCorrect =
          storedRow[14] ===
            prepared.processingRecord.started_at &&
          storedRow[16] ===
            prepared.processingRecord.updated_at;


        // ---- 21. SAHKAN 19 MEDAN LAIN ----

        const changedIndexes = [
          5, 14, 16
        ];

        const preservedCorrect =
          storedRow.every(
            (value, index) =>
              changedIndexes.includes(index) ||
              value === built.row[index]
          );


        // ---- 22. SAHKAN KUOTA ----

        const quotaDuring = JSON.stringify(
          quotaSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
        );

        const quotaUnchanged =
          quotaBefore === quotaDuring;


        // ---- 23. RUMUSAN UJIAN ----

        const summary = {

          stored_record_found: true,

          processing_prepared: true,

          integrity_verified: true,

          columns_correct:
            columnsValid,

          all_fields_correct:
            allFieldsCorrect,

          status_processing:
            statusCorrect,

          timestamps_correct:
            timestampsCorrect,

          preserved_fields_correct:
            preservedCorrect,

          quota_unchanged:
            quotaUnchanged

        };


        Logger.log(
          "ACTUAL PROCESSING WRITE TEST:"
        );

        Logger.log(
          JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
        );


        testPassed =
          Object.values(summary).every(
            value => value === true
          );

        if (!testPassed) {
          throw new Error(
            "ACTUAL PROCESSING WRITE TEST FAILED"
          );
        }

      } catch (error) {

        testError = error;

      } finally {

        // ---- 24. PADAM REKOD SEMENTARA ----

        if (temporaryRowCreated) {

          try {

            const currentId = sheet
              .getRange(2, 1)
              .getValue();

            if (currentId === uploadId) {

              sheet.deleteRow(2);

              SpreadsheetApp.flush();

              cleanupCompleted = true;

            } else {

              Logger.log(
                "WARNING: TEST ROW ID MISMATCH"
              );

            }

          } catch (cleanupError) {

            Logger.log(
              "WARNING: TEST CLEANUP FAILED"
            );

          }

        }

      }


      // ---- 25. SAHKAN DATABASE DIPULIHKAN ----

      const uploadsAfter = JSON.stringify(
        sheet.getDataRange().getValues()
      );

      const quotaAfter = JSON.stringify(
        quotaSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
      );

      const uploadsRestored =
        uploadsBefore === uploadsAfter;

      const quotaRestored =
        quotaBefore === quotaAfter;


      // ---- 26. LOG PEMBERSIHAN ----

      Logger.log(
        "ACTUAL PROCESSING WRITE CLEANUP:"
      );

      Logger.log(
        JSON.stringify({

          test_passed:
            testPassed,

          cleanup_completed:
            cleanupCompleted,

          uploads_restored:
            uploadsRestored,

          quota_restored:
            quotaRestored

        }, null, 2)
      );


      // ---- 27. TANGANI RALAT ----

      if (testError) {
        throw testError;
      }


      // ---- 28. SAHKAN KEPUTUSAN AKHIR ----

      if (
        !testPassed ||
        !cleanupCompleted ||
        !uploadsRestored ||
        !quotaRestored
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          "ACTUAL PROCESSING WRITE OR CLEANUP FAILED"
        );
      }


      // ---- 29. KEPUTUSAN BERJAYA ----

      return {
        status: "SUCCESS",
        code:
          "ACTUAL_PROCESSING_WRITE_TEST_PASSED"
      };

    }
  );


  // ---- 30. PAPARKAN KEPUTUSAN AKHIR ----

  if (
    result.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
    result.code !==
      "ACTUAL_PROCESSING_WRITE_TEST_PASSED"
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "ACTUAL PROCESSING WRITE TEST NOT PASSED"
    );
  }

  Logger.log(
    "ACTUAL PROCESSING WRITE TEST PASSED"
  );

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.62
   COMMIT UPLOAD PROCESSING - SAFE GATE

   TUJUAN:
   - Sediakan fungsi commit backend.
   - DRY RUN sebagai mod lalai.
   - LIVE masih dinyahaktifkan.
   - Semak rekod, lease dan integriti.
   - Jangan ubah database.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - PRIVATE BACKEND ONLY.
   - Tiada laluan public doPost/doGet.
   - Tiada upload gambar.
   - Tiada perubahan kuota.
   - Tiada penulisan LIVE.

   PENTING:
   Fungsi ini belum membenarkan
   perubahan status sebenar.

   Jangan ubah syarat keselamatan
   dryRun !== true sehingga kita
   melaksanakan kawalan LIVE
   yang lengkap.
============================================ */


// ---- 1. FUNGSI COMMIT TERKAWAL ----

function commitUploadProcessing_(
  uploadId,
  leaseToken,
  dryRun = true
) {

  // ---- 2. SEKAT SEMUA PERMINTAAN LIVE ----

  // Hanya nilai boolean true
  // diterima untuk DRY RUN.

  // false, null, 0 dan nilai
  // selain true akan ditolak.

  if (dryRun !== true) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",

      code: "LIVE_PROCESSING_COMMIT_DISABLED",

      mode: "SAFETY_GUARD",

      committed: false,

      saved: false,
      status_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 3. SAHKAN UPLOAD ID ----

  const uuidRegex =
    /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;

  if (
    typeof uploadId !== "string" ||
    !uuidRegex.test(uploadId)
  ) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",

      code: "INVALID_UPLOAD_ID",

      mode: "DRY_RUN",

      committed: false,

      saved: false,
      status_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 4. SAHKAN LEASE TOKEN ----

  const leaseRegex =
    /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/i;

  if (
    typeof leaseToken !== "string" ||
    !leaseRegex.test(leaseToken)
  ) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",

      code: "INVALID_LEASE_TOKEN",

      mode: "DRY_RUN",

      committed: false,

      saved: false,
      status_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 5. SEDIAKAN OPERASI TERKUNCI ----

  // Fungsi Langkah 3.59:
  // - mendapatkan ScriptLock
  // - mencari rekod sebenar
  // - mengesahkan lease
  // - menyemak integriti
  // - membina pelan F, O, Q
  // - menyemak baris sasaran

  const preparation =
    prepareProcessingStatusWrite_(
      uploadId,
      leaseToken
    );


  // ---- 6. SEMAK KEPUTUSAN ----

  if (
    preparation.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
    preparation.prepared !== true ||
    preparation.integrity_verified !== true
  ) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",

      code:
        preparation.code ||
        "PROCESSING_COMMIT_PREPARATION_FAILED",

      mode: "DRY_RUN",

      committed: false,

      saved: false,
      status_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 7. PULANGKAN DRY RUN BERJAYA ----

  // Jangan pulangkan lease_token,
  // keseluruhan rekod atau data
  // sensitif.

  return {
    status: "SUCCESS",

    code: "PROCESSING_COMMIT_DRY_RUN_READY",

    mode: "DRY_RUN",

    committed: false,

    prepared: true,

    integrity_verified: true,

    proposed_status: "PROCESSING",

    write_count: 3,

    preserved_fields: 19,

    saved: false,
    status_changed: false,
    quota_changed: false
  };

}


/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.62
   MANUAL TEST - COMMIT SAFE GATE

   Ujian:
   1. LIVE ditolak.
   2. Upload ID tidak sah ditolak.
   3. Lease token tidak sah ditolak.
   4. Rekod tidak wujud ditolak.
   5. Database tidak berubah.

   Ujian ini tidak menulis
   rekod sementara.
============================================ */


function testCommitUploadProcessing_() {

  // ---- 8. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error(
      "SPREADSHEET_ID tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
    spreadsheetId
  );

  const uploadsSheet = ss.getSheetByName(
    "UPLOADS"
  );

  const quotaSheet = ss.getSheetByName(
    "QUOTA_CYCLES"
  );

  if (!uploadsSheet || !quotaSheet) {
    throw new Error(
      "UPLOADS atau QUOTA_CYCLES tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }


  // ---- 9. SIMPAN KEADAAN DATABASE ----

  const uploadsBefore = JSON.stringify(
    uploadsSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const quotaBefore = JSON.stringify(
    quotaSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 10. JANA DATA UJIAN ----

  const uploadId = Utilities.getUuid();

  const lease = createUploadLease_();


  // ---- 11. UJI LIVE DISABLED ----

  const liveResult =
    commitUploadProcessing_(
      uploadId,
      lease.lease_token,
      false
    );


  // ---- 12. UJI UPLOAD ID TIDAK SAH ----

  const invalidIdResult =
    commitUploadProcessing_(
      "INVALID_UPLOAD_ID",
      lease.lease_token,
      true
    );


  // ---- 13. UJI LEASE TIDAK SAH ----

  const invalidLeaseResult =
    commitUploadProcessing_(
      uploadId,
      "INVALID_LEASE",
      true
    );


  // ---- 14. UJI REKOD TIDAK WUJUD ----

  const missingResult =
    commitUploadProcessing_(
      uploadId,
      lease.lease_token,
      true
    );


  // ---- 15. SEMAK DATABASE ----

  const uploadsAfter = JSON.stringify(
    uploadsSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const quotaAfter = JSON.stringify(
    quotaSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 16. RUMUSAN UJIAN ----

  const summary = {

    live_disabled:
      liveResult.status === "REJECTED" &&
      liveResult.code ===
        "LIVE_PROCESSING_COMMIT_DISABLED" &&
      liveResult.committed === false,

    invalid_upload_id_rejected:
      invalidIdResult.status === "REJECTED" &&
      invalidIdResult.code ===
        "INVALID_UPLOAD_ID",

    invalid_lease_rejected:
      invalidLeaseResult.status === "REJECTED" &&
      invalidLeaseResult.code ===
        "INVALID_LEASE_TOKEN",

    missing_upload_rejected:
      missingResult.status === "REJECTED" &&
      missingResult.code ===
        "UPLOAD_NOT_FOUND",

    uploads_unchanged:
      uploadsBefore === uploadsAfter,

    quota_unchanged:
      quotaBefore === quotaAfter

  };


  // ---- 17. PAPARKAN LOG SELAMAT ----

  Logger.log(
    "PROCESSING COMMIT SAFE GATE TEST:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
  );


  // ---- 18. SAHKAN SEMUA UJIAN ----

  const passed =
    Object.values(summary).every(
      value => value === true
    );

  if (!passed) {
    throw new Error(
      "PROCESSING COMMIT SAFE GATE TEST FAILED"
    );
  }

  Logger.log(
    "PROCESSING COMMIT SAFE GATE TEST PASSED"
  );

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.63
   COMMIT PROCESSING STORED DRY RUN TEST

   TUJUAN:
   - Cipta rekod RESERVED sementara.
   - Uji commitUploadProcessing_().
   - Sahkan DRY RUN berjaya.
   - Pastikan LIVE tetap disekat.
   - Pastikan status tidak berubah.
   - Pastikan kuota tidak berubah.
   - Bersihkan rekod sementara.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - MANUAL TEST ONLY.
   - LIVE PROCESSING DISABLED.
   - Tiada upload gambar.
   - Tidak dihubungkan ke Web App.

   PENTING:
   Ujian ini menulis sementara
   ke tab UPLOADS.

   Jalankan hanya apabila tab
   UPLOADS mempunyai header sahaja.
============================================ */


function testCommitUploadProcessingStoredSuccess_() {

  // ---- 1. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error(
      "SPREADSHEET_ID tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
    spreadsheetId
  );

  const uploadsSheet = ss.getSheetByName(
    "UPLOADS"
  );

  const quotaSheet = ss.getSheetByName(
    "QUOTA_CYCLES"
  );

  if (!uploadsSheet || !quotaSheet) {
    throw new Error(
      "UPLOADS atau QUOTA_CYCLES tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }


  // ---- 2. SAHKAN UPLOADS KOSONG ----

  if (uploadsSheet.getLastRow() !== 1) {
    throw new Error(
      "TEST STOPPED: UPLOADS IS NOT EMPTY"
    );
  }


  // ---- 3. SAHKAN HEADER ----

  const headers = uploadsSheet
    .getRange(1, 1, 1, 22)
    .getValues()[0];

  const headersValid =
    UPLOAD_RESERVATION_HEADERS.length === 22 &&
    UPLOAD_RESERVATION_HEADERS.every(
      (header, index) =>
        headers[index] === header
    );

  if (!headersValid) {
    throw new Error(
      "UPLOADS HEADER MISMATCH"
    );
  }


  // ---- 4. SIMPAN KEADAAN ASAL ----

  const uploadsBefore = JSON.stringify(
    uploadsSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const quotaBefore = JSON.stringify(
    quotaSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 5. JANA IDENTITI UJIAN ----

  const uploadId = Utilities.getUuid();

  const lease = createUploadLease_();


  // ---- 6. BINA REKOD RESERVED ----

  const built = buildUploadReservationRow_({

    upload_id:
      uploadId,

    idempotency_key:
      Utilities.getUuid(),

    event_id:
      "SIM_EVENT_001",

    qr_id:
      "SIM_QR_001",

    cycle_id:
      "SIM_CYCLE_001",

    lease_token:
      lease.lease_token,

    lease_expires_at:
      lease.lease_expires_at,

    original_filename:
      "commit_dry_run_test.jpg",

    file_mime_type:
      "image/jpeg",

    file_size_bytes:
      2500000,

    created_at:
      lease.lease_created_at

  });

  if (
    built.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
    built.column_count !== 22
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "TEST RECORD BUILD FAILED"
    );
  }


  // ---- 7. STATUS UJIAN ----

  let temporaryRowCreated = false;

  let cleanupCompleted = false;

  let testPassed = false;

  let testError = null;


  // ---- 8. MULAKAN UJIAN ----

  try {

    // ---- 9. MASUKKAN REKOD SEMENTARA ----

    const insertResult =
      withUploadReservationLock_(
        function() {

          if (
            uploadsSheet.getLastRow() !== 1
          ) {
            return {
              status: "REJECTED",
              code: "UPLOADS_NOT_EMPTY"
            };
          }

          uploadsSheet.getRange(
            2, 1, 1, 22
          ).setValues([
            built.row
          ]);

          temporaryRowCreated = true;

          SpreadsheetApp.flush();

          return {
            status: "SUCCESS",
            code: "TEST_ROW_INSERTED"
          };

        }
      );

    if (
      insertResult.status !== "SUCCESS"
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "TEST ROW INSERT FAILED"
      );
    }


    // ---- 10. UJI DRY RUN BERJAYA ----

    // Fungsi ini mendapatkan
    // ScriptLock sendiri.
    //
    // Jangan panggil di dalam
    // lock insert tadi.

    const dryRunResult =
      commitUploadProcessing_(
        uploadId,
        lease.lease_token,
        true
      );


    // ---- 11. UJI LIVE MASIH DISEKAT ----

    const liveResult =
      commitUploadProcessing_(
        uploadId,
        lease.lease_token,
        false
      );


    // ---- 12. SAHKAN DRY RUN ----

    const dryRunSuccessful =
      dryRunResult.status === "SUCCESS" &&
      dryRunResult.code ===
        "PROCESSING_COMMIT_DRY_RUN_READY" &&
      dryRunResult.mode === "DRY_RUN" &&
      dryRunResult.committed === false &&
      dryRunResult.prepared === true &&
      dryRunResult.integrity_verified === true;


    // ---- 13. SAHKAN LIVE DISABLED ----

    const liveDisabled =
      liveResult.status === "REJECTED" &&
      liveResult.code ===
        "LIVE_PROCESSING_COMMIT_DISABLED" &&
      liveResult.committed === false;


    // ---- 14. SAHKAN PELAN ----

    const planCorrect =
      dryRunResult.proposed_status ===
        "PROCESSING" &&
      dryRunResult.write_count === 3 &&
      dryRunResult.preserved_fields === 19;


    // ---- 15. SAHKAN TIADA PENULISAN ----

    const noLiveWrite =
      dryRunResult.saved === false &&
      dryRunResult.status_changed === false &&
      dryRunResult.quota_changed === false;


    // ---- 16. SEMAK STATUS TERSIMPAN ----

    const storedStatus =
      uploadsSheet.getRange(
        2, 6
      ).getValue();

    const statusUnchanged =
      storedStatus === "RESERVED";


    // ---- 17. SEMAK TIMESTAMP ----

    const startedAt =
      uploadsSheet.getRange(
        2, 15
      ).getValue();

    const updatedAt =
      uploadsSheet.getRange(
        2, 17
      ).getValue();

    const timestampsUnchanged =
      startedAt === "" &&
      updatedAt ===
        built.record.updated_at;


    // ---- 18. SEMAK KUOTA ----

    const quotaDuring = JSON.stringify(
      quotaSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
    );

    const quotaUnchanged =
      quotaBefore === quotaDuring;


    // ---- 19. RUMUSAN UJIAN ----

    const summary = {

      dry_run_successful:
        dryRunSuccessful,

      live_disabled:
        liveDisabled,

      plan_correct:
        planCorrect,

      no_live_write:
        noLiveWrite,

      stored_status_unchanged:
        statusUnchanged,

      timestamps_unchanged:
        timestampsUnchanged,

      quota_unchanged:
        quotaUnchanged

    };


    // ---- 20. PAPARKAN LOG ----

    Logger.log(
      "PROCESSING COMMIT STORED DRY RUN TEST:"
    );

    Logger.log(
      JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
    );


    // ---- 21. SAHKAN UJIAN ----

    testPassed =
      Object.values(summary).every(
        value => value === true
      );

    if (!testPassed) {
      throw new Error(
        "PROCESSING COMMIT STORED DRY RUN TEST FAILED"
      );
    }

  } catch (error) {

    testError = error;

  } finally {

    // ---- 22. BERSIHKAN REKOD UJIAN ----

    if (temporaryRowCreated) {

      try {

        const cleanupResult =
          withUploadReservationLock_(
            function() {

              const currentId =
                uploadsSheet.getRange(
                  2, 1
                ).getValue();

              if (currentId !== uploadId) {
                return {
                  status: "REJECTED",
                  code: "TEST_ROW_ID_MISMATCH"
                };
              }

              uploadsSheet.deleteRow(2);

              SpreadsheetApp.flush();

              return {
                status: "SUCCESS",
                code: "TEST_ROW_REMOVED"
              };

            }
          );

        cleanupCompleted =
          cleanupResult.status ===
          "SUCCESS";

      } catch (cleanupError) {

        Logger.log(
          "WARNING: TEST CLEANUP FAILED"
        );

      }

    }

  }


  // ---- 23. SAHKAN DATABASE DIPULIHKAN ----

  const uploadsAfter = JSON.stringify(
    uploadsSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const quotaAfter = JSON.stringify(
    quotaSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const uploadsRestored =
    uploadsBefore === uploadsAfter;

  const quotaRestored =
    quotaBefore === quotaAfter;


  // ---- 24. LOG PEMBERSIHAN ----

  Logger.log(
    "PROCESSING COMMIT TEST CLEANUP:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify({

      test_passed:
        testPassed,

      cleanup_completed:
        cleanupCompleted,

      uploads_restored:
        uploadsRestored,

      quota_restored:
        quotaRestored

    }, null, 2)
  );


  // ---- 25. TANGANI RALAT ----

  if (testError) {
    throw testError;
  }


  // ---- 26. SAHKAN KEPUTUSAN AKHIR ----

  if (
    !testPassed ||
    !cleanupCompleted ||
    !uploadsRestored ||
    !quotaRestored
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "PROCESSING COMMIT TEST OR CLEANUP FAILED"
    );
  }


  Logger.log(
    "PROCESSING COMMIT STORED DRY RUN TEST PASSED"
  );

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.64
   INTERNAL PROCESSING COMMIT

   TUJUAN:
   - Sediakan fungsi penulisan sebenar.
   - Hadkan kepada ujian dalaman.
   - Gunakan satu ScriptLock.
   - Sahkan lease dan status RESERVED.
   - Sahkan integriti 22 medan.
   - Tulis status PROCESSING.
   - Baca semula dan sahkan hasil.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - BUKAN PUBLIC API.
   - Jangan panggil melalui doGet/doPost.
   - Jangan masukkan token dalam log.
   - Tiada perubahan kuota.
   - Tiada upload gambar.

   PENTING:
   Internal authorization di sini
   ialah safety gate sahaja,
   bukan authentication sebenar.
============================================ */


// ---- 1. FUNGSI LIVE DALAMAN ----

function commitUploadProcessingInternal_(
  uploadId,
  leaseToken,
  internalAuthorization
) {

  // ---- 2. KAWALAN AKSES UJIAN ----

  // Nilai ini hanya membenarkan
  // fungsi dipanggil secara sengaja.
  //
  // Ia BUKAN password atau
  // authentication pengguna.

  if (
    internalAuthorization !==
    "INTERNAL_TEST_ONLY"
  ) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",

      code: "INTERNAL_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED",

      committed: false,

      saved: false,
      status_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 3. SAHKAN UPLOAD ID ----

  const uuidRegex =
    /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;

  if (
    typeof uploadId !== "string" ||
    !uuidRegex.test(uploadId)
  ) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",

      code: "INVALID_UPLOAD_ID",

      committed: false,

      saved: false,
      status_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 4. SAHKAN LEASE TOKEN ----

  const leaseRegex =
    /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/i;

  if (
    typeof leaseToken !== "string" ||
    !leaseRegex.test(leaseToken)
  ) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",

      code: "INVALID_LEASE_TOKEN",

      committed: false,

      saved: false,
      status_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 5. MULAKAN SATU SCRIPTLOCK ----

  return withUploadReservationLock_(
    function() {

      // ---- 6. CARI REKOD SEBENAR ----

      const lookup =
        findUploadRecordById_(uploadId);

      if (
        lookup.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
        lookup.found !== true
      ) {

        return {
          status: "REJECTED",

          code:
            lookup.code ||
            "UPLOAD_LOOKUP_FAILED",

          committed: false,

          saved: false,
          status_changed: false,
          quota_changed: false
        };

      }


      // ---- 7. SAHKAN NOMBOR BARIS ----

      const rowNumber =
        lookup.row_number;

      if (
        !Number.isInteger(rowNumber) ||
        rowNumber < 2
      ) {

        return {
          status: "REJECTED",

          code: "INVALID_UPLOAD_ROW_NUMBER",

          committed: false,

          saved: false,
          status_changed: false,
          quota_changed: false
        };

      }


      // ---- 8. SEDIAKAN REKOD PROCESSING ----

      const prepared =
        prepareUploadProcessingRecord_(
          uploadId,
          leaseToken,
          lookup.record
        );

      if (
        prepared.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
        prepared.prepared !== true
      ) {

        return {
          status: "REJECTED",

          code:
            prepared.code ||
            "PROCESSING_PREPARATION_FAILED",

          committed: false,

          saved: false,
          status_changed: false,
          quota_changed: false
        };

      }


      // ---- 9. SAHKAN INTEGRITI ----

      const integrity =
        validateProcessingRecordIntegrity_(
          lookup.record,
          prepared.processingRecord
        );

      if (
        integrity.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
        integrity.valid !== true
      ) {

        return {
          status: "REJECTED",

          code:
            integrity.code ||
            "PROCESSING_INTEGRITY_FAILED",

          committed: false,

          saved: false,
          status_changed: false,
          quota_changed: false
        };

      }


      // ---- 10. BINA PELAN PENULISAN ----

      const plan =
        buildProcessingWritePlan_(
          lookup.record,
          prepared.processingRecord
        );

      if (
        plan.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
        plan.plan_ready !== true ||
        plan.write_count !== 3
      ) {

        return {
          status: "REJECTED",

          code:
            plan.code ||
            "PROCESSING_WRITE_PLAN_FAILED",

          committed: false,

          saved: false,
          status_changed: false,
          quota_changed: false
        };

      }


      // ---- 11. SAHKAN LAJUR ----

      const expectedColumns = [
        6, 15, 17
      ];

      const columnsValid =
        plan.write_plan.length === 3 &&
        plan.write_plan.every(
          (item, index) =>
            item.column ===
            expectedColumns[index]
        );

      if (!columnsValid) {

        return {
          status: "REJECTED",

          code: "INVALID_PROCESSING_COLUMNS",

          committed: false,

          saved: false,
          status_changed: false,
          quota_changed: false
        };

      }


      // ---- 12. BUKA TAB UPLOADS ----

      const spreadsheetId =
        PropertiesService
          .getScriptProperties()
          .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

      if (!spreadsheetId) {
        throw new Error(
          "SPREADSHEET_ID tidak dijumpai."
        );
      }

      const ss =
        SpreadsheetApp.openById(
          spreadsheetId
        );

      const sheet =
        ss.getSheetByName("UPLOADS");

      if (!sheet) {
        throw new Error(
          "Tab UPLOADS tidak dijumpai."
        );
      }


      // ---- 13. SAHKAN IDENTITI BARIS ----

      const currentId =
        sheet.getRange(
          rowNumber,
          1
        ).getValue();

      if (currentId !== uploadId) {

        return {
          status: "REJECTED",

          code: "UPLOAD_ROW_ID_MISMATCH",

          committed: false,

          saved: false,
          status_changed: false,
          quota_changed: false
        };

      }


      // ---- 14. SAHKAN STATUS TERKINI ----

      const currentStatus =
        sheet.getRange(
          rowNumber,
          6
        ).getValue();

      if (currentStatus !== "RESERVED") {

        return {
          status: "REJECTED",

          code: "UPLOAD_NO_LONGER_RESERVED",

          committed: false,

          saved: false,
          status_changed: false,
          quota_changed: false
        };

      }


      // ---- 15. TULIS REKOD PROCESSING ----

      // Satu operasi setValues()
      // untuk keseluruhan 22 medan.
      //
      // Hanya F, O dan Q mempunyai
      // nilai berbeza.

      sheet.getRange(
        rowNumber,
        1,
        1,
        22
      ).setValues([
        prepared.processingRow
      ]);

      SpreadsheetApp.flush();


      // ---- 16. BACA SEMULA REKOD ----

      const storedRow =
        sheet.getRange(
          rowNumber,
          1,
          1,
          22
        ).getValues()[0];


      // ---- 17. SAHKAN HASIL PENULISAN ----

      const writeVerified =
        storedRow.every(
          (value, index) =>
            value ===
            prepared.processingRow[index]
        );


      // ---- 18. TANGANI HASIL TIDAK SEPADAN ----

      if (!writeVerified) {

        return {
          status: "REJECTED",

          code: "PROCESSING_WRITE_VERIFICATION_FAILED",

          committed: false,

          // Penulisan telah dicuba.
          // Jangan mendakwa database
          // pasti tidak berubah.

          saved: "UNKNOWN",

          status_changed: "UNKNOWN",

          quota_changed: false
        };

      }


      // ---- 19. KEPUTUSAN BERJAYA ----

      return {
        status: "SUCCESS",

        code: "INTERNAL_PROCESSING_COMMITTED",

        mode: "INTERNAL_LIVE",

        committed: true,

        saved: true,

        status_changed: true,

        quota_changed: false,

        upload_status: "PROCESSING",

        write_verified: true,

        column_count: 22
      };

    }
  );

}


/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.64
   MANUAL TEST - INTERNAL SAFETY

   Ujian:
   1. Tanpa authorization ditolak.
   2. Authorization salah ditolak.
   3. Upload ID tidak sah ditolak.
   4. Lease token tidak sah ditolak.
   5. Rekod tidak wujud ditolak.
   6. Database tidak berubah.

   Ujian ini TIDAK mencipta
   rekod sementara.
============================================ */


function testInternalProcessingCommitSafety_() {

  // ---- 20. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error(
      "SPREADSHEET_ID tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
    spreadsheetId
  );

  const uploadsSheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("UPLOADS");

  const quotaSheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("QUOTA_CYCLES");

  if (!uploadsSheet || !quotaSheet) {
    throw new Error(
      "UPLOADS atau QUOTA_CYCLES tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }


  // ---- 21. SIMPAN KEADAAN ASAL ----

  const uploadsBefore = JSON.stringify(
    uploadsSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const quotaBefore = JSON.stringify(
    quotaSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 22. JANA DATA UJIAN ----

  const uploadId =
    Utilities.getUuid();

  const lease =
    createUploadLease_();


  // ---- 23. UJI TANPA AUTHORIZATION ----

  const noAuth =
    commitUploadProcessingInternal_(
      uploadId,
      lease.lease_token
    );


  // ---- 24. UJI AUTHORIZATION SALAH ----

  const wrongAuth =
    commitUploadProcessingInternal_(
      uploadId,
      lease.lease_token,
      "WRONG_AUTHORIZATION"
    );


  // ---- 25. UJI UPLOAD ID TIDAK SAH ----

  const invalidId =
    commitUploadProcessingInternal_(
      "INVALID_UPLOAD_ID",
      lease.lease_token,
      "INTERNAL_TEST_ONLY"
    );


  // ---- 26. UJI LEASE TIDAK SAH ----

  const invalidLease =
    commitUploadProcessingInternal_(
      uploadId,
      "INVALID_LEASE",
      "INTERNAL_TEST_ONLY"
    );


  // ---- 27. UJI REKOD TIDAK WUJUD ----

  const missingUpload =
    commitUploadProcessingInternal_(
      uploadId,
      lease.lease_token,
      "INTERNAL_TEST_ONLY"
    );


  // ---- 28. SEMAK DATABASE ----

  const uploadsAfter = JSON.stringify(
    uploadsSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const quotaAfter = JSON.stringify(
    quotaSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 29. RUMUSAN UJIAN ----

  const summary = {

    missing_authorization_rejected:
      noAuth.status === "REJECTED" &&
      noAuth.code ===
        "INTERNAL_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED",

    wrong_authorization_rejected:
      wrongAuth.status === "REJECTED" &&
      wrongAuth.code ===
        "INTERNAL_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED",

    invalid_upload_id_rejected:
      invalidId.status === "REJECTED" &&
      invalidId.code ===
        "INVALID_UPLOAD_ID",

    invalid_lease_rejected:
      invalidLease.status === "REJECTED" &&
      invalidLease.code ===
        "INVALID_LEASE_TOKEN",

    missing_upload_rejected:
      missingUpload.status === "REJECTED" &&
      missingUpload.code ===
        "UPLOAD_NOT_FOUND",

    uploads_unchanged:
      uploadsBefore === uploadsAfter,

    quota_unchanged:
      quotaBefore === quotaAfter

  };


  // ---- 30. PAPARKAN LOG SELAMAT ----

  Logger.log(
    "INTERNAL PROCESSING COMMIT SAFETY TEST:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
  );


  // ---- 31. SAHKAN SEMUA UJIAN ----

  const passed =
    Object.values(summary).every(
      value => value === true
    );

  if (!passed) {
    throw new Error(
      "INTERNAL PROCESSING COMMIT SAFETY TEST FAILED"
    );
  }

  Logger.log(
    "INTERNAL PROCESSING COMMIT SAFETY TEST PASSED"
  );

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.65
   INTERNAL PROCESSING COMMIT
   STORED SUCCESS TEST

   TUJUAN:
   - Cipta rekod RESERVED sementara.
   - Panggil commitUploadProcessingInternal_().
   - Sahkan status menjadi PROCESSING.
   - Sahkan hanya F, O, Q berubah.
   - Sahkan 19 medan lain kekal.
   - Sahkan permintaan kedua ditolak.
   - Sahkan kuota tidak berubah.
   - Padam rekod ujian.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - MANUAL TEST ONLY.
   - PUBLIC LIVE MASIH DISABLED.
   - Tiada upload gambar.
   - Jangan sambungkan ke doPost/doGet.

   PENTING:
   Ujian ini benar-benar menulis
   ke tab UPLOADS.

   Jalankan hanya apabila UPLOADS
   mempunyai header sahaja.
============================================ */


function testInternalProcessingCommitStoredSuccess_() {

  // ---- 1. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error(
      "SPREADSHEET_ID tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
    spreadsheetId
  );

  const uploadsSheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("UPLOADS");

  const quotaSheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("QUOTA_CYCLES");

  if (!uploadsSheet || !quotaSheet) {
    throw new Error(
      "UPLOADS atau QUOTA_CYCLES tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }


  // ---- 2. SAHKAN UPLOADS KOSONG ----

  if (uploadsSheet.getLastRow() !== 1) {
    throw new Error(
      "TEST STOPPED: UPLOADS IS NOT EMPTY"
    );
  }


  // ---- 3. SAHKAN HEADER ----

  const headers = uploadsSheet
    .getRange(1, 1, 1, 22)
    .getValues()[0];

  const headersValid =
    UPLOAD_RESERVATION_HEADERS.length === 22 &&
    UPLOAD_RESERVATION_HEADERS.every(
      (header, index) =>
        headers[index] === header
    );

  if (!headersValid) {
    throw new Error(
      "UPLOADS HEADER MISMATCH"
    );
  }


  // ---- 4. SIMPAN KEADAAN ASAL ----

  const uploadsBefore = JSON.stringify(
    uploadsSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const quotaBefore = JSON.stringify(
    quotaSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 5. JANA IDENTITI UJIAN ----

  const uploadId =
    Utilities.getUuid();

  const lease =
    createUploadLease_();


  // ---- 6. BINA REKOD RESERVED ----

  const built =
    buildUploadReservationRow_({

      upload_id:
        uploadId,

      idempotency_key:
        Utilities.getUuid(),

      event_id:
        "SIM_EVENT_001",

      qr_id:
        "SIM_QR_001",

      cycle_id:
        "SIM_CYCLE_001",

      lease_token:
        lease.lease_token,

      lease_expires_at:
        lease.lease_expires_at,

      original_filename:
        "internal_commit_test.jpg",

      file_mime_type:
        "image/jpeg",

      file_size_bytes:
        2500000,

      created_at:
        lease.lease_created_at

    });

  if (
    built.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
    built.column_count !== 22 ||
    !Array.isArray(built.row) ||
    built.row.length !== 22
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "TEST RECORD BUILD FAILED"
    );
  }


  // ---- 7. STATUS UJIAN ----

  let temporaryRowCreated = false;

  let cleanupCompleted = false;

  let testPassed = false;

  let testError = null;


  // ---- 8. MULAKAN UJIAN ----

  try {

    // ---- 9. TULIS REKOD SEMENTARA ----

    const insertResult =
      withUploadReservationLock_(
        function() {

          if (
            uploadsSheet.getLastRow() !== 1
          ) {
            return {
              status: "REJECTED",
              code: "UPLOADS_NOT_EMPTY"
            };
          }

          uploadsSheet.getRange(
            2, 1, 1, 22
          ).setValues([
            built.row
          ]);

          temporaryRowCreated = true;

          SpreadsheetApp.flush();

          return {
            status: "SUCCESS",
            code: "TEST_ROW_INSERTED"
          };

        }
      );

    if (
      insertResult.status !== "SUCCESS"
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "TEST ROW INSERT FAILED"
      );
    }


    // ---- 10. JALANKAN LIVE DALAMAN ----

    // Fungsi ini mendapatkan
    // ScriptLock sendiri.
    //
    // Jangan panggil di dalam
    // lock insert tadi.

    const commitResult =
      commitUploadProcessingInternal_(
        uploadId,
        lease.lease_token,
        "INTERNAL_TEST_ONLY"
      );


    // ---- 11. SAHKAN KEJAYAAN ----

    const commitSuccessful =
      commitResult.status === "SUCCESS" &&
      commitResult.code ===
        "INTERNAL_PROCESSING_COMMITTED" &&
      commitResult.committed === true &&
      commitResult.saved === true &&
      commitResult.status_changed === true &&
      commitResult.quota_changed === false &&
      commitResult.write_verified === true;


    // ---- 12. BACA REKOD SELEPAS COMMIT ----

    const storedRow =
      uploadsSheet.getRange(
        2, 1, 1, 22
      ).getValues()[0];


    // ---- 13. SAHKAN STATUS ----

    const statusCorrect =
      storedRow[5] === "PROCESSING";


    // ---- 14. SAHKAN TIMESTAMP ----

    const timestampsCorrect =
      typeof storedRow[14] === "string" &&
      typeof storedRow[16] === "string" &&
      storedRow[14].length > 0 &&
      storedRow[14] === storedRow[16];


    // ---- 15. SAHKAN 19 MEDAN LAIN ----

    const changedIndexes = [
      5, 14, 16
    ];

    const preservedCorrect =
      storedRow.every(
        (value, index) =>
          changedIndexes.includes(index) ||
          value === built.row[index]
      );


    // ---- 16. CUBA PROSES SEKALI LAGI ----

    const duplicateResult =
      commitUploadProcessingInternal_(
        uploadId,
        lease.lease_token,
        "INTERNAL_TEST_ONLY"
      );


    // ---- 17. SAHKAN DUPLICATE DITOLAK ----

    const duplicateRejected =
      duplicateResult.status === "REJECTED" &&
      duplicateResult.code ===
        "INVALID_UPLOAD_STATUS" &&
      duplicateResult.committed === false;


    // ---- 18. SEMAK REKOD KEKAL ----

    const afterDuplicate =
      uploadsSheet.getRange(
        2, 1, 1, 22
      ).getValues()[0];

    const duplicateDidNotChangeRecord =
      JSON.stringify(storedRow) ===
      JSON.stringify(afterDuplicate);


    // ---- 19. SEMAK KUOTA ----

    const quotaDuring = JSON.stringify(
      quotaSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
    );

    const quotaUnchanged =
      quotaBefore === quotaDuring;


    // ---- 20. RUMUSAN UJIAN ----

    const summary = {

      commit_successful:
        commitSuccessful,

      status_processing:
        statusCorrect,

      timestamps_correct:
        timestampsCorrect,

      preserved_fields_correct:
        preservedCorrect,

      duplicate_rejected:
        duplicateRejected,

      duplicate_no_change:
        duplicateDidNotChangeRecord,

      quota_unchanged:
        quotaUnchanged

    };


    // ---- 21. PAPARKAN LOG ----

    Logger.log(
      "INTERNAL PROCESSING COMMIT STORED TEST:"
    );

    Logger.log(
      JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
    );


    // ---- 22. SAHKAN SEMUA UJIAN ----

    testPassed =
      Object.values(summary).every(
        value => value === true
      );

    if (!testPassed) {
      throw new Error(
        "INTERNAL PROCESSING COMMIT STORED TEST FAILED"
      );
    }

  } catch (error) {

    testError = error;

  } finally {

    // ---- 23. BERSIHKAN REKOD UJIAN ----

    if (temporaryRowCreated) {

      try {

        const cleanupResult =
          withUploadReservationLock_(
            function() {

              const currentId =
                uploadsSheet.getRange(
                  2, 1
                ).getValue();

              if (currentId !== uploadId) {
                return {
                  status: "REJECTED",
                  code: "TEST_ROW_ID_MISMATCH"
                };
              }

              uploadsSheet.deleteRow(2);

              SpreadsheetApp.flush();

              return {
                status: "SUCCESS",
                code: "TEST_ROW_REMOVED"
              };

            }
          );

        cleanupCompleted =
          cleanupResult.status ===
          "SUCCESS";

      } catch (cleanupError) {

        Logger.log(
          "WARNING: TEST CLEANUP FAILED"
        );

      }

    }

  }


  // ---- 24. SAHKAN DATABASE DIPULIHKAN ----

  const uploadsAfter = JSON.stringify(
    uploadsSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const quotaAfter = JSON.stringify(
    quotaSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const uploadsRestored =
    uploadsBefore === uploadsAfter;

  const quotaRestored =
    quotaBefore === quotaAfter;


  // ---- 25. LOG PEMBERSIHAN ----

  Logger.log(
    "INTERNAL PROCESSING COMMIT CLEANUP:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify({

      test_passed:
        testPassed,

      cleanup_completed:
        cleanupCompleted,

      uploads_restored:
        uploadsRestored,

      quota_restored:
        quotaRestored

    }, null, 2)
  );


  // ---- 26. TANGANI RALAT ----

  if (testError) {
    throw testError;
  }


  // ---- 27. SAHKAN KEPUTUSAN AKHIR ----

  if (
    !testPassed ||
    !cleanupCompleted ||
    !uploadsRestored ||
    !quotaRestored
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "INTERNAL PROCESSING COMMIT OR CLEANUP FAILED"
    );
  }


  Logger.log(
    "INTERNAL PROCESSING COMMIT STORED SUCCESS TEST PASSED"
  );

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.66
   INTERNAL PROCESSING EXPIRED LEASE TEST

   TUJUAN:
   - Cipta rekod RESERVED sementara.
   - Tetapkan lease tamat 60 saat lalu.
   - Cuba jalankan LIVE dalaman.
   - Pastikan permintaan ditolak.
   - Pastikan status kekal RESERVED.
   - Pastikan 22 medan tidak berubah.
   - Pastikan kuota tidak berubah.
   - Padam rekod sementara.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - MANUAL TEST ONLY.
   - PUBLIC LIVE MASIH DISABLED.
   - Tiada upload gambar.
   - Tidak mengubah doGet/doPost.

   PENTING:
   Jalankan hanya apabila UPLOADS
   mempunyai header sahaja.

   Jika pembersihan gagal,
   jangan ulang ujian dahulu.
============================================ */


function testInternalProcessingExpiredLease_() {

  // ---- 1. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error(
      "SPREADSHEET_ID tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
    spreadsheetId
  );

  const uploadsSheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("UPLOADS");

  const quotaSheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("QUOTA_CYCLES");

  if (!uploadsSheet || !quotaSheet) {
    throw new Error(
      "UPLOADS atau QUOTA_CYCLES tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }


  // ---- 2. SAHKAN UPLOADS KOSONG ----

  if (uploadsSheet.getLastRow() !== 1) {
    throw new Error(
      "TEST STOPPED: UPLOADS IS NOT EMPTY"
    );
  }


  // ---- 3. SAHKAN HEADER ----

  const headers = uploadsSheet
    .getRange(1, 1, 1, 22)
    .getValues()[0];

  const headersValid =
    UPLOAD_RESERVATION_HEADERS.length === 22 &&
    UPLOAD_RESERVATION_HEADERS.every(
      (header, index) =>
        headers[index] === header
    );

  if (!headersValid) {
    throw new Error(
      "UPLOADS HEADER MISMATCH"
    );
  }


  // ---- 4. SIMPAN KEADAAN ASAL ----

  const uploadsBefore = JSON.stringify(
    uploadsSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const quotaBefore = JSON.stringify(
    quotaSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 5. JANA IDENTITI UJIAN ----

  const uploadId =
    Utilities.getUuid();

  const lease =
    createUploadLease_();


  // ---- 6. TETAPKAN LEASE TAMAT TEMPOH ----

  // Masa tamat ditetapkan
  // 60 saat sebelum masa sekarang.

  const expiredAt =
    new Date(
      Date.now() - 60000
    ).toISOString();


  // ---- 7. BINA REKOD RESERVED ----

  const built =
    buildUploadReservationRow_({

      upload_id:
        uploadId,

      idempotency_key:
        Utilities.getUuid(),

      event_id:
        "SIM_EVENT_001",

      qr_id:
        "SIM_QR_001",

      cycle_id:
        "SIM_CYCLE_001",

      lease_token:
        lease.lease_token,

      lease_expires_at:
        expiredAt,

      original_filename:
        "expired_lease_test.jpg",

      file_mime_type:
        "image/jpeg",

      file_size_bytes:
        2500000,

      created_at:
        lease.lease_created_at

    });

  if (
    built.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
    built.column_count !== 22 ||
    !Array.isArray(built.row) ||
    built.row.length !== 22
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "TEST RECORD BUILD FAILED"
    );
  }


  // ---- 8. STATUS UJIAN ----

  let temporaryRowCreated = false;

  let cleanupCompleted = false;

  let testPassed = false;

  let testError = null;


  // ---- 9. MULAKAN UJIAN ----

  try {

    // ---- 10. TULIS REKOD SEMENTARA ----

    const insertResult =
      withUploadReservationLock_(
        function() {

          if (
            uploadsSheet.getLastRow() !== 1
          ) {
            return {
              status: "REJECTED",
              code: "UPLOADS_NOT_EMPTY"
            };
          }

          uploadsSheet.getRange(
            2, 1, 1, 22
          ).setValues([
            built.row
          ]);

          temporaryRowCreated = true;

          SpreadsheetApp.flush();

          return {
            status: "SUCCESS",
            code: "TEST_ROW_INSERTED"
          };

        }
      );

    if (
      insertResult.status !== "SUCCESS"
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "TEST ROW INSERT FAILED"
      );
    }


    // ---- 11. BACA REKOD SEBELUM COMMIT ----

    const storedBefore =
      uploadsSheet.getRange(
        2, 1, 1, 22
      ).getValues()[0];


    // ---- 12. CUBA LIVE DALAMAN ----

    const commitResult =
      commitUploadProcessingInternal_(
        uploadId,
        lease.lease_token,
        "INTERNAL_TEST_ONLY"
      );


    // ---- 13. SAHKAN PENOLAKAN ----

    const expiredLeaseRejected =
      commitResult.status === "REJECTED" &&
      commitResult.code ===
        "LEASE_NOT_ACTIVE" &&
      commitResult.committed === false &&
      commitResult.saved === false &&
      commitResult.status_changed === false;


    // ---- 14. BACA REKOD SELEPAS COMMIT ----

    const storedAfter =
      uploadsSheet.getRange(
        2, 1, 1, 22
      ).getValues()[0];


    // ---- 15. SAHKAN STATUS ----

    const statusUnchanged =
      storedAfter[5] === "RESERVED";


    // ---- 16. SAHKAN 22 MEDAN ----

    const allFieldsUnchanged =
      JSON.stringify(storedBefore) ===
      JSON.stringify(storedAfter);


    // ---- 17. SAHKAN TIMESTAMP ----

    const timestampsUnchanged =
      storedAfter[14] === "" &&
      storedAfter[16] ===
        built.record.updated_at;


    // ---- 18. SAHKAN KUOTA ----

    const quotaDuring = JSON.stringify(
      quotaSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
    );

    const quotaUnchanged =
      quotaBefore === quotaDuring;


    // ---- 19. RUMUSAN UJIAN ----

    const summary = {

      expired_lease_rejected:
        expiredLeaseRejected,

      status_unchanged:
        statusUnchanged,

      all_fields_unchanged:
        allFieldsUnchanged,

      timestamps_unchanged:
        timestampsUnchanged,

      quota_unchanged:
        quotaUnchanged

    };


    // ---- 20. PAPARKAN LOG SELAMAT ----

    Logger.log(
      "INTERNAL PROCESSING EXPIRED LEASE TEST:"
    );

    Logger.log(
      JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
    );


    // ---- 21. SAHKAN SEMUA UJIAN ----

    testPassed =
      Object.values(summary).every(
        value => value === true
      );

    if (!testPassed) {
      throw new Error(
        "INTERNAL PROCESSING EXPIRED LEASE TEST FAILED"
      );
    }

  } catch (error) {

    testError = error;

  } finally {

    // ---- 22. BERSIHKAN REKOD SEMENTARA ----

    if (temporaryRowCreated) {

      try {

        const cleanupResult =
          withUploadReservationLock_(
            function() {

              const currentId =
                uploadsSheet.getRange(
                  2, 1
                ).getValue();

              if (currentId !== uploadId) {
                return {
                  status: "REJECTED",
                  code: "TEST_ROW_ID_MISMATCH"
                };
              }

              uploadsSheet.deleteRow(2);

              SpreadsheetApp.flush();

              return {
                status: "SUCCESS",
                code: "TEST_ROW_REMOVED"
              };

            }
          );

        cleanupCompleted =
          cleanupResult.status ===
          "SUCCESS";

      } catch (cleanupError) {

        Logger.log(
          "WARNING: TEST CLEANUP FAILED"
        );

      }

    }

  }


  // ---- 23. SAHKAN DATABASE DIPULIHKAN ----

  const uploadsAfter = JSON.stringify(
    uploadsSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const quotaAfter = JSON.stringify(
    quotaSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const uploadsRestored =
    uploadsBefore === uploadsAfter;

  const quotaRestored =
    quotaBefore === quotaAfter;


  // ---- 24. LOG PEMBERSIHAN ----

  Logger.log(
    "EXPIRED LEASE TEST CLEANUP:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify({

      test_passed:
        testPassed,

      cleanup_completed:
        cleanupCompleted,

      uploads_restored:
        uploadsRestored,

      quota_restored:
        quotaRestored

    }, null, 2)
  );


  // ---- 25. TANGANI RALAT ----

  if (testError) {
    throw testError;
  }


  // ---- 26. SAHKAN KEPUTUSAN AKHIR ----

  if (
    !testPassed ||
    !cleanupCompleted ||
    !uploadsRestored ||
    !quotaRestored
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "EXPIRED LEASE TEST OR CLEANUP FAILED"
    );
  }


  Logger.log(
    "INTERNAL PROCESSING EXPIRED LEASE TEST PASSED"
  );

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.67
   STALE UPLOAD DETECTION

   TUJUAN:
   - Kesan RESERVED yang lease tamat.
   - Kesan PROCESSING yang lease tamat.
   - Abaikan COMPLETED dan status lain.
   - Abaikan rekod yang telah dipadam.
   - Jangan ubah Google Sheets.
   - Jangan dedahkan lease token.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - READ ONLY.
   - PRIVATE BACKEND ONLY.
   - Tiada penulisan ke database.
   - Tiada perubahan kuota.
   - Tiada pemadaman fail.
   - Jangan sambung ke doGet/doPost.

   NOTA:
   STALE bukan bermaksud FAILED.
   Ia hanya memerlukan semakan lanjut.
============================================ */


// ---- 1. FUNGSI PENGESANAN STALE ----

function detectStaleUploadRecords_(
  uploadRecords,
  nowOverride
) {

  // ---- 2. SAHKAN INPUT ----

  if (!Array.isArray(uploadRecords)) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "INVALID_UPLOAD_RECORDS",
      stale_count: 0,
      stale_records: []
    };

  }


  // ---- 3. TENTUKAN MASA SEMAKAN ----

  const now = nowOverride === undefined
    ? new Date()
    : new Date(nowOverride);

  if (!Number.isFinite(now.getTime())) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "INVALID_CHECK_TIME",
      stale_count: 0,
      stale_records: []
    };

  }


  // ---- 4. SEDIAKAN SENARAI ----

  const staleRecords = [];

  let activeCount = 0;
  let completedCount = 0;
  let skippedCount = 0;


  // ---- 5. SEMAK SETIAP REKOD ----

  uploadRecords.forEach(function(record) {

    // ---- 6. ABAIKAN REKOD TIDAK SAH ----

    if (
      !record ||
      typeof record !== "object" ||
      Array.isArray(record)
    ) {
      skippedCount++;
      return;
    }


    // ---- 7. ABAIKAN REKOD DIPADAM ----

    if (record.deletion_status !== "ACTIVE") {
      skippedCount++;
      return;
    }


    // ---- 8. SEMAK STATUS ----

    const uploadStatus =
      record.upload_status;

    if (uploadStatus === "COMPLETED") {
      completedCount++;
      return;
    }

    if (
      uploadStatus !== "RESERVED" &&
      uploadStatus !== "PROCESSING"
    ) {
      skippedCount++;
      return;
    }


    // ---- 9. SEMAK LEASE ----

    const expiry = new Date(
      record.lease_expires_at
    );

    // Lease tidak sah perlu disemak,
    // bukan dianggap selamat.

    const expiryValid =
      Number.isFinite(expiry.getTime());

    const isExpired =
      !expiryValid ||
      now.getTime() >= expiry.getTime();


    // ---- 10. REKOD MASIH AKTIF ----

    if (!isExpired) {
      activeCount++;
      return;
    }


    // ---- 11. TENTUKAN SEBAB ----

    const reason = expiryValid
      ? "LEASE_EXPIRED"
      : "INVALID_LEASE_EXPIRY";


    // ---- 12. MASUKKAN KE SENARAI STALE ----

    // Jangan masukkan lease_token,
    // idempotency_key atau data sensitif.

    staleRecords.push({

      upload_id:
        record.upload_id,

      upload_status:
        uploadStatus,

      event_id:
        record.event_id,

      qr_id:
        record.qr_id,

      cycle_id:
        record.cycle_id,

      reason:
        reason,

      lease_expires_at:
        record.lease_expires_at

    });

  });


  // ---- 13. PULANGKAN KEPUTUSAN ----

  return {
    status: "SUCCESS",

    code: "STALE_UPLOAD_SCAN_COMPLETED",

    mode: "READ_ONLY",

    checked_at: now.toISOString(),

    scanned_count:
      uploadRecords.length,

    stale_count:
      staleRecords.length,

    active_count:
      activeCount,

    completed_count:
      completedCount,

    skipped_count:
      skippedCount,

    stale_records:
      staleRecords,

    records_changed: false,

    quota_changed: false
  };

}


/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.67
   READ REAL UPLOADS DATABASE

   Fungsi ini:
   - Membaca UPLOADS.
   - Menukar setiap baris kepada objek.
   - Memanggil pengesanan stale.
   - Tidak mengubah database.

   Jangan dedahkan fungsi ini
   kepada peserta.
============================================ */


function scanStoredStaleUploads_() {

  // ---- 14. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error(
      "SPREADSHEET_ID tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
    spreadsheetId
  );

  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(
    "UPLOADS"
  );

  if (!sheet) {
    throw new Error(
      "Tab UPLOADS tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }


  // ---- 15. SAHKAN HEADER ----

  const headers = sheet
    .getRange(1, 1, 1, 22)
    .getValues()[0];

  const headersValid =
    UPLOAD_RESERVATION_HEADERS.length === 22 &&
    UPLOAD_RESERVATION_HEADERS.every(
      (header, index) =>
        headers[index] === header
    );

  if (!headersValid) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "UPLOADS_HEADER_MISMATCH",
      stale_count: 0,
      stale_records: []
    };

  }


  // ---- 16. SEMAK JUMLAH BARIS ----

  const lastRow = sheet.getLastRow();

  if (lastRow < 2) {

    return detectStaleUploadRecords_([]);
  }


  // ---- 17. BACA DATA ----

  const rows = sheet
    .getRange(
      2, 1, lastRow - 1, 22
    )
    .getValues();


  // ---- 18. TUKAR KEPADA OBJEK ----

  const records = rows.map(
    function(row) {

      const record = {};

      headers.forEach(
        function(header, index) {
          record[header] = row[index];
        }
      );

      return record;

    }
  );


  // ---- 19. JALANKAN PENGESANAN ----

  return detectStaleUploadRecords_(
    records
  );

}


/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.67
   MANUAL TEST - STALE DETECTION

   Ujian simulasi:
   - RESERVED expired.
   - PROCESSING expired.
   - RESERVED active.
   - PROCESSING active.
   - COMPLETED expired.
   - Deleted record.
   - Invalid lease expiry.
   - Database unchanged.

   Tiada rekod sementara ditulis.
============================================ */


function testDetectStaleUploadRecords_() {

  // ---- 20. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error(
      "SPREADSHEET_ID tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
    spreadsheetId
  );

  const uploadsSheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("UPLOADS");

  const quotaSheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("QUOTA_CYCLES");

  if (!uploadsSheet || !quotaSheet) {
    throw new Error(
      "UPLOADS atau QUOTA_CYCLES tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }


  // ---- 21. SIMPAN KEADAAN ASAL ----

  const uploadsBefore = JSON.stringify(
    uploadsSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const quotaBefore = JSON.stringify(
    quotaSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 22. MASA UJIAN TETAP ----

  const now =
    "2027-01-15T10:00:00.000Z";

  const expired =
    "2027-01-15T09:00:00.000Z";

  const active =
    "2027-01-15T11:00:00.000Z";


  // ---- 23. BINA DATA SIMULASI ----

  const records = [

    {
      upload_id: "SIM_001",
      upload_status: "RESERVED",
      deletion_status: "ACTIVE",
      lease_expires_at: expired
    },

    {
      upload_id: "SIM_002",
      upload_status: "PROCESSING",
      deletion_status: "ACTIVE",
      lease_expires_at: expired
    },

    {
      upload_id: "SIM_003",
      upload_status: "RESERVED",
      deletion_status: "ACTIVE",
      lease_expires_at: active
    },

    {
      upload_id: "SIM_004",
      upload_status: "PROCESSING",
      deletion_status: "ACTIVE",
      lease_expires_at: active
    },

    {
      upload_id: "SIM_005",
      upload_status: "COMPLETED",
      deletion_status: "ACTIVE",
      lease_expires_at: expired
    },

    {
      upload_id: "SIM_006",
      upload_status: "RESERVED",
      deletion_status: "DELETED",
      lease_expires_at: expired
    },

    {
      upload_id: "SIM_007",
      upload_status: "RESERVED",
      deletion_status: "ACTIVE",
      lease_expires_at: "INVALID_DATE"
    }

  ];


  // ---- 24. SIMPAN DATA SIMULASI ----

  const simulationBefore =
    JSON.stringify(records);


  // ---- 25. JALANKAN PENGESANAN ----

  const result =
    detectStaleUploadRecords_(
      records,
      now
    );


  // ---- 26. SAHKAN KEPUTUSAN ----

  const scanSuccessful =
    result.status === "SUCCESS" &&
    result.code ===
      "STALE_UPLOAD_SCAN_COMPLETED";


  // ---- 27. SAHKAN JUMLAH ----

  const countsCorrect =
    result.scanned_count === 7 &&
    result.stale_count === 3 &&
    result.active_count === 2 &&
    result.completed_count === 1 &&
    result.skipped_count === 1;


  // ---- 28. SAHKAN IDENTITI STALE ----

  const staleIds =
    result.stale_records.map(
      item => item.upload_id
    );

  const staleIdsCorrect =
    JSON.stringify(staleIds) ===
    JSON.stringify([
      "SIM_001",
      "SIM_002",
      "SIM_007"
    ]);


  // ---- 29. SAHKAN SEBAB ----

  const reasonsCorrect =
    result.stale_records[0].reason ===
      "LEASE_EXPIRED" &&
    result.stale_records[1].reason ===
      "LEASE_EXPIRED" &&
    result.stale_records[2].reason ===
      "INVALID_LEASE_EXPIRY";


  // ---- 30. SAHKAN TIADA TOKEN ----

  const noSensitiveToken =
    result.stale_records.every(
      item =>
        !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
          item,
          "lease_token"
        ) &&
        !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
          item,
          "idempotency_key"
        )
    );


  // ---- 31. SAHKAN SIMULASI TIDAK BERUBAH ----

  const simulationUnchanged =
    simulationBefore ===
    JSON.stringify(records);


  // ---- 32. SEMAK DATABASE ----

  const uploadsAfter = JSON.stringify(
    uploadsSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const quotaAfter = JSON.stringify(
    quotaSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 33. RUMUSAN UJIAN ----

  const summary = {

    scan_successful:
      scanSuccessful,

    counts_correct:
      countsCorrect,

    stale_ids_correct:
      staleIdsCorrect,

    reasons_correct:
      reasonsCorrect,

    no_sensitive_token:
      noSensitiveToken,

    simulation_unchanged:
      simulationUnchanged,

    uploads_unchanged:
      uploadsBefore === uploadsAfter,

    quota_unchanged:
      quotaBefore === quotaAfter

  };


  // ---- 34. PAPARKAN LOG SELAMAT ----

  Logger.log(
    "STALE UPLOAD DETECTION TEST:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
  );


  // ---- 35. SAHKAN SEMUA UJIAN ----

  const passed =
    Object.values(summary).every(
      value => value === true
    );

  if (!passed) {
    throw new Error(
      "STALE UPLOAD DETECTION TEST FAILED"
    );
  }

  Logger.log(
    "STALE UPLOAD DETECTION TEST PASSED"
  );

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.68

   TUJUAN:

   - 2 rekod mempunyai lease tamat.

   KESELAMATAN:

    original_filename:
