      "image/jpeg",

    file_size_bytes:
      1400000,

    created_at:
      leaseC.lease_created_at

  });


  // ---- 11. SAHKAN REKOD BERJAYA DIBINA ----

  const builds = [
    builtA,
    builtB,
    builtC
  ];

  const buildsValid =
    builds.every(
      item =>
        item.status === "SUCCESS" &&
        item.column_count === 22 &&
        Array.isArray(item.row) &&
        item.row.length === 22
    );

  if (!buildsValid) {
    throw new Error(
      "TEST RECORD BUILD FAILED"
    );
  }


  // ---- 12. SEDIAKAN BARIS UJIAN ----

  // Salin array supaya rekod asal
  // tidak diubah secara langsung.

  const rowA = builtA.row.slice();
  const rowB = builtB.row.slice();
  const rowC = builtC.row.slice();


  // ---- 13. TETAPKAN STATUS ----

  // F = upload_status

  rowA[5] = "RESERVED";

  rowB[5] = "PROCESSING";

  rowC[5] = "COMPLETED";


  // ---- 14. SEDIAKAN STATUS UJIAN ----

  let temporaryRowsCreated = false;

  let cleanupCompleted = false;

  let testPassed = false;

  let testError = null;


  // ---- 15. MULAKAN UJIAN ----

  try {

    // ---- 16. MASUKKAN 3 REKOD ----

    const insertResult =
      withUploadReservationLock_(
        function() {

          if (
            uploadsSheet.getLastRow() !== 1
          ) {
            return {
              status: "REJECTED",
              code: "UPLOADS_NOT_EMPTY"
            };
          }

          uploadsSheet.getRange(
            2, 1, 3, 22
          ).setValues([
            rowA,
            rowB,
            rowC
          ]);

          temporaryRowsCreated = true;

          SpreadsheetApp.flush();

          return {
            status: "SUCCESS",
            code: "TEST_ROWS_INSERTED"
          };

        }
      );

    if (
      insertResult.status !== "SUCCESS"
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "TEST ROW INSERT FAILED"
      );
    }


    // ---- 17. SIMPAN REKOD SEBELUM SCAN ----

    const storedBefore = JSON.stringify(
      uploadsSheet.getRange(
        2, 1, 3, 22
      ).getValues()
    );


    // ---- 18. JALANKAN SCAN SEBENAR ----

    const scanResult =
      scanStoredStaleUploads_();


    // ---- 19. SAHKAN KEJAYAAN ----

    const scanSuccessful =
      scanResult.status === "SUCCESS" &&
      scanResult.code ===
        "STALE_UPLOAD_SCAN_COMPLETED";


    // ---- 20. SAHKAN JUMLAH ----

    const countsCorrect =
      scanResult.scanned_count === 3 &&
      scanResult.stale_count === 2 &&
      scanResult.completed_count === 1 &&
      scanResult.active_count === 0 &&
      scanResult.skipped_count === 0;


    // ---- 21. SAHKAN IDENTITI STALE ----

    const staleIds =
      scanResult.stale_records.map(
        item => item.upload_id
      );

    const staleIdsCorrect =
      JSON.stringify(staleIds) ===
      JSON.stringify([
        uploadIdA,
        uploadIdB
      ]);


    // ---- 22. SAHKAN STATUS ----

    const statusesCorrect =
      scanResult.stale_records[0]
        .upload_status === "RESERVED" &&
      scanResult.stale_records[1]
        .upload_status === "PROCESSING";


    // ---- 23. SAHKAN SEBAB ----

    const reasonsCorrect =
      scanResult.stale_records.every(
        item =>
          item.reason ===
          "LEASE_EXPIRED"
      );


    // ---- 24. SAHKAN TIADA TOKEN ----

    const noSensitiveToken =
      scanResult.stale_records.every(
        item =>
          !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
            item,
            "lease_token"
          ) &&
          !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
            item,
            "idempotency_key"
          )
      );


    // ---- 25. SEMAK REKOD SELEPAS SCAN ----

    const storedAfter = JSON.stringify(
      uploadsSheet.getRange(
        2, 1, 3, 22
      ).getValues()
    );

    const scanReadOnly =
      storedBefore === storedAfter;


    // ---- 26. SEMAK KUOTA ----

    const quotaDuring = JSON.stringify(
      quotaSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
    );

    const quotaUnchanged =
      quotaBefore === quotaDuring;


    // ---- 27. RUMUSAN UJIAN ----

    const summary = {

      scan_successful:
        scanSuccessful,

      counts_correct:
        countsCorrect,

      stale_ids_correct:
        staleIdsCorrect,

      statuses_correct:
        statusesCorrect,

      reasons_correct:
        reasonsCorrect,

      no_sensitive_token:
        noSensitiveToken,

      scan_read_only:
        scanReadOnly,

      quota_unchanged:
        quotaUnchanged

    };


    // ---- 28. PAPARKAN LOG ----

    Logger.log(
      "STORED STALE UPLOAD SCAN TEST:"
    );

    Logger.log(
      JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
    );


    // ---- 29. SAHKAN UJIAN ----

    testPassed =
      Object.values(summary).every(
        value => value === true
      );

    if (!testPassed) {
      throw new Error(
        "STORED STALE UPLOAD SCAN TEST FAILED"
      );
    }

  } catch (error) {

    testError = error;

  } finally {

    // ---- 30. BERSIHKAN 3 REKOD ----

    if (temporaryRowsCreated) {

      try {

        const cleanupResult =
          withUploadReservationLock_(
            function() {

              const storedIds =
                uploadsSheet.getRange(
                  2, 1, 3, 1
                ).getValues().map(
                  row => row[0]
                );

              const idsMatch =
                JSON.stringify(storedIds) ===
                JSON.stringify([
                  uploadIdA,
                  uploadIdB,
                  uploadIdC
                ]);

              if (!idsMatch) {
                return {
                  status: "REJECTED",
                  code: "TEST_ROW_IDS_MISMATCH"
                };
              }

              uploadsSheet.deleteRows(
                2, 3
              );

              SpreadsheetApp.flush();

              return {
                status: "SUCCESS",
                code: "TEST_ROWS_REMOVED"
              };

            }
          );

        cleanupCompleted =
          cleanupResult.status ===
          "SUCCESS";

      } catch (cleanupError) {

        Logger.log(
          "WARNING: TEST CLEANUP FAILED"
        );

      }

    }

  }


  // ---- 31. SAHKAN DATABASE DIPULIHKAN ----

  const uploadsAfter = JSON.stringify(
    uploadsSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const quotaAfter = JSON.stringify(
    quotaSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const uploadsRestored =
    uploadsBefore === uploadsAfter;

  const quotaRestored =
    quotaBefore === quotaAfter;


  // ---- 32. LOG PEMBERSIHAN ----

  Logger.log(
    "STORED STALE SCAN CLEANUP:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify({

      test_passed:
        testPassed,

      cleanup_completed:
        cleanupCompleted,

      uploads_restored:
        uploadsRestored,

      quota_restored:
        quotaRestored

    }, null, 2)
  );


  // ---- 33. TANGANI RALAT ----

  if (testError) {
    throw testError;
  }


  // ---- 34. SAHKAN KEPUTUSAN AKHIR ----

  if (
    !testPassed ||
    !cleanupCompleted ||
    !uploadsRestored ||
    !quotaRestored
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "STORED STALE SCAN OR CLEANUP FAILED"
    );
  }


  Logger.log(
    "STORED STALE UPLOAD SCAN TEST PASSED"
  );

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.69
   STALE UPLOAD RECOVERY ASSESSMENT

   TUJUAN:
   - Nilai status RESERVED / PROCESSING.
   - Semak sama ada lease telah tamat.
   - Semak kewujudan drive_file_id.
   - Tentukan tindakan semakan lanjut.
   - Jangan terus tandakan FAILED.
   - Jangan ubah Google Sheets.
   - Jangan ubah Google Drive.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - PURE FUNCTION.
   - READ ONLY.
   - DRY RUN.
   - Tiada perubahan kuota.
   - Tiada pemadaman fail.
   - Jangan dedahkan kepada doGet/doPost.

   NOTA:
   Assessment bukan recovery sebenar.
============================================ */


// ---- 1. FUNGSI PENILAIAN ----

function assessStaleUploadRecovery_(
  uploadRecord,
  nowOverride
) {

  // ---- 2. SAHKAN REKOD ----

  if (
    !uploadRecord ||
    typeof uploadRecord !== "object" ||
    Array.isArray(uploadRecord)
  ) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "INVALID_UPLOAD_RECORD",
      recovery_allowed: false,
      records_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 3. TENTUKAN MASA SEMAKAN ----

  const now = nowOverride === undefined
    ? new Date()
    : new Date(nowOverride);

  if (!Number.isFinite(now.getTime())) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "INVALID_CHECK_TIME",
      recovery_allowed: false,
      records_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 4. SEMAK DELETION STATUS ----

  if (
    uploadRecord.deletion_status !== "ACTIVE"
  ) {

    return {
      status: "SUCCESS",
      code: "RECOVERY_NOT_APPLICABLE",
      assessment: "RECORD_NOT_ACTIVE",
      recovery_allowed: false,
      records_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 5. SEMAK UPLOAD STATUS ----

  const uploadStatus =
    uploadRecord.upload_status;

  if (
    uploadStatus !== "RESERVED" &&
    uploadStatus !== "PROCESSING"
  ) {

    return {
      status: "SUCCESS",
      code: "RECOVERY_NOT_APPLICABLE",
      assessment: "STATUS_NOT_RECOVERABLE",
      recovery_allowed: false,
      records_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 6. SEMAK LEASE EXPIRY ----

  const expiry = new Date(
    uploadRecord.lease_expires_at
  );

  const expiryValid =
    Number.isFinite(expiry.getTime());


  // ---- 7. LEASE TIDAK SAH ----

  if (!expiryValid) {

    return {
      status: "SUCCESS",

      code: "RECOVERY_REVIEW_REQUIRED",

      assessment: "INVALID_LEASE_EXPIRY",

      recommended_action:
        "MANUAL_REVIEW",

      recovery_allowed: false,

      records_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 8. LEASE MASIH AKTIF ----

  if (
    now.getTime() < expiry.getTime()
  ) {

    return {
      status: "SUCCESS",

      code: "RECOVERY_NOT_REQUIRED",

      assessment: "LEASE_STILL_ACTIVE",

      recommended_action:
        "NO_ACTION",

      recovery_allowed: false,

      records_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 9. SEMAK METADATA DRIVE ----

  const hasDriveFileId =
    typeof uploadRecord.drive_file_id ===
      "string" &&
    uploadRecord.drive_file_id.trim() !== "";


  // ---- 10. RESERVED TANPA ID FAIL ----

  if (
    uploadStatus === "RESERVED" &&
    !hasDriveFileId
  ) {

    return {
      status: "SUCCESS",

      code: "RECOVERY_REVIEW_REQUIRED",

      assessment:
        "STALE_RESERVED_NO_FILE_ID",

      recommended_action:
        "CHECK_FOR_UNRECORDED_DRIVE_FILE",

      recovery_allowed: false,

      records_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 11. RESERVED DENGAN ID FAIL ----

  if (
    uploadStatus === "RESERVED" &&
    hasDriveFileId
  ) {

    return {
      status: "SUCCESS",

      code: "RECOVERY_REVIEW_REQUIRED",

      assessment:
        "STALE_RESERVED_WITH_FILE_ID",

      recommended_action:
        "VERIFY_DRIVE_FILE_AND_HISTORY",

      recovery_allowed: false,

      records_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 12. PROCESSING TANPA ID FAIL ----

  if (
    uploadStatus === "PROCESSING" &&
    !hasDriveFileId
  ) {

    return {
      status: "SUCCESS",

      code: "RECOVERY_REVIEW_REQUIRED",

      assessment:
        "STALE_PROCESSING_NO_FILE_ID",

      recommended_action:
        "CHECK_FOR_UNRECORDED_DRIVE_FILE",

      recovery_allowed: false,

      records_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 13. PROCESSING DENGAN ID FAIL ----

  return {
    status: "SUCCESS",

    code: "RECOVERY_REVIEW_REQUIRED",

    assessment:
      "STALE_PROCESSING_WITH_FILE_ID",

    recommended_action:
      "VERIFY_DRIVE_FILE_AND_HISTORY",

    recovery_allowed: false,

    records_changed: false,
    quota_changed: false
  };

}


/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.69
   MANUAL TEST - RECOVERY ASSESSMENT

   Ujian:
   - RESERVED expired tanpa file ID.
   - PROCESSING expired tanpa file ID.
   - PROCESSING expired dengan file ID.
   - RESERVED expired dengan file ID.
   - Lease masih aktif.
   - Lease tidak sah.
   - COMPLETED dikecualikan.
   - Rekod dipadam dikecualikan.
   - Input tidak sah ditolak.
   - Database tidak berubah.
============================================ */


function testAssessStaleUploadRecovery_() {

  // ---- 14. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error(
      "SPREADSHEET_ID tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
    spreadsheetId
  );

  const uploadsSheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("UPLOADS");

  const quotaSheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("QUOTA_CYCLES");

  if (!uploadsSheet || !quotaSheet) {
    throw new Error(
      "UPLOADS atau QUOTA_CYCLES tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }


  // ---- 15. SIMPAN KEADAAN ASAL ----

  const uploadsBefore = JSON.stringify(
    uploadsSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const quotaBefore = JSON.stringify(
    quotaSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 16. MASA SIMULASI ----

  const now =
    "2027-01-15T10:00:00.000Z";

  const expired =
    "2027-01-15T09:00:00.000Z";

  const active =
    "2027-01-15T11:00:00.000Z";


  // ---- 17. BINA REKOD ASAS ----

  const baseRecord = {

    upload_id: "SIM_UPLOAD_001",

    upload_status: "RESERVED",

    deletion_status: "ACTIVE",

    lease_expires_at: expired,

    drive_file_id: ""

  };


  // ---- 18. UJI RESERVED TANPA FILE ID ----

  const reservedNoFile =
    assessStaleUploadRecovery_(
      { ...baseRecord },
      now
    );


  // ---- 19. UJI PROCESSING TANPA FILE ID ----

  const processingNoFile =
    assessStaleUploadRecovery_(
      {
        ...baseRecord,
        upload_status: "PROCESSING"
      },
      now
    );


  // ---- 20. UJI PROCESSING DENGAN FILE ID ----

  const processingWithFile =
    assessStaleUploadRecovery_(
      {
        ...baseRecord,
        upload_status: "PROCESSING",
        drive_file_id: "SIM_DRIVE_FILE_001"
      },
      now
    );


  // ---- 21. UJI RESERVED DENGAN FILE ID ----

  const reservedWithFile =
    assessStaleUploadRecovery_(
      {
        ...baseRecord,
        drive_file_id: "SIM_DRIVE_FILE_002"
      },
      now
    );


  // ---- 22. UJI LEASE MASIH AKTIF ----

  const activeLease =
    assessStaleUploadRecovery_(
      {
        ...baseRecord,
        lease_expires_at: active
      },
      now
    );


  // ---- 23. UJI LEASE TIDAK SAH ----

  const invalidLease =
    assessStaleUploadRecovery_(
      {
        ...baseRecord,
        lease_expires_at: "INVALID_DATE"
      },
      now
    );


  // ---- 24. UJI COMPLETED ----

  const completed =
    assessStaleUploadRecovery_(
      {
        ...baseRecord,
        upload_status: "COMPLETED"
      },
      now
    );


  // ---- 25. UJI REKOD DIPADAM ----

  const deleted =
    assessStaleUploadRecovery_(
      {
        ...baseRecord,
        deletion_status: "DELETED"
      },
      now
    );


  // ---- 26. UJI INPUT TIDAK SAH ----

  const invalidInput =
    assessStaleUploadRecovery_(
      null,
      now
    );


  // ---- 27. RUMUSAN UJIAN ----

  const summary = {

    reserved_no_file_correct:
      reservedNoFile.assessment ===
        "STALE_RESERVED_NO_FILE_ID",

    processing_no_file_correct:
      processingNoFile.assessment ===
        "STALE_PROCESSING_NO_FILE_ID",

    processing_with_file_correct:
      processingWithFile.assessment ===
        "STALE_PROCESSING_WITH_FILE_ID",

    reserved_with_file_correct:
      reservedWithFile.assessment ===
        "STALE_RESERVED_WITH_FILE_ID",

    active_lease_correct:
      activeLease.code ===
        "RECOVERY_NOT_REQUIRED",

    invalid_lease_correct:
      invalidLease.assessment ===
        "INVALID_LEASE_EXPIRY",

    completed_excluded:
      completed.code ===
        "RECOVERY_NOT_APPLICABLE",

    deleted_excluded:
      deleted.code ===
        "RECOVERY_NOT_APPLICABLE",

    invalid_input_rejected:
      invalidInput.status ===
        "REJECTED",

    recovery_never_allowed:
      [
        reservedNoFile,
        processingNoFile,
        processingWithFile,
        reservedWithFile,
        activeLease,
        invalidLease,
        completed,
        deleted,
        invalidInput
      ].every(
        result =>
          result.recovery_allowed === false &&
          result.records_changed === false &&
          result.quota_changed === false
      )

  };


  // ---- 28. SEMAK DATABASE ----

  const uploadsAfter = JSON.stringify(
    uploadsSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const quotaAfter = JSON.stringify(
    quotaSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  summary.uploads_unchanged =
    uploadsBefore === uploadsAfter;

  summary.quota_unchanged =
    quotaBefore === quotaAfter;


  // ---- 29. PAPARKAN LOG SELAMAT ----

  Logger.log(
    "STALE UPLOAD RECOVERY ASSESSMENT TEST:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
  );


  // ---- 30. SAHKAN SEMUA UJIAN ----

  const passed =
    Object.values(summary).every(
      value => value === true
    );

  if (!passed) {
    throw new Error(
      "STALE UPLOAD RECOVERY ASSESSMENT TEST FAILED"
    );
  }

  Logger.log(
    "STALE UPLOAD RECOVERY ASSESSMENT TEST PASSED"
  );

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.70
   STORED STALE RECOVERY ASSESSMENT

   TUJUAN:
   - Baca rekod sebenar daripada UPLOADS.
   - Kesan rekod stale.
   - Cari rekod asal berdasarkan upload_id.
   - Nilai status dan metadata Drive.
   - Hasilkan laporan semakan.
   - Jangan ubah Google Sheets.
   - Jangan ubah Google Drive.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - READ ONLY.
   - PRIVATE BACKEND ONLY.
   - Tiada perubahan kuota.
   - Tiada pemadaman rekod.
   - Tiada pemulihan automatik.
   - Jangan sambung ke doGet/doPost.

   PENTING:
   STALE bukan bermaksud FAILED.
============================================ */


// ---- 1. FUNGSI PENILAIAN REKOD SEBENAR ----

function assessStoredStaleUploadRecovery_() {

  // ---- 2. JALANKAN STALE SCAN ----

  const scan =
    scanStoredStaleUploads_();

  if (scan.status !== "SUCCESS") {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",

      code:
        scan.code ||
        "STALE_SCAN_FAILED",

      mode: "READ_ONLY",

      assessed_count: 0,

      assessments: [],

      records_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 3. SEDIAKAN SENARAI ----

  const assessments = [];

  let assessmentErrors = 0;


  // ---- 4. SEMAK SETIAP REKOD STALE ----

  for (
    const staleRecord of scan.stale_records
  ) {

    // ---- 5. SAHKAN UPLOAD ID ----

    const uploadId =
      staleRecord.upload_id;

    if (
      typeof uploadId !== "string" ||
      uploadId.trim() === ""
    ) {

      assessmentErrors++;

      assessments.push({
        status: "REJECTED",
        code: "INVALID_STALE_UPLOAD_ID"
      });

      continue;
    }


    // ---- 6. CARI REKOD ASAL ----

    const lookup =
      findUploadRecordById_(uploadId);

    if (
      lookup.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
      lookup.found !== true
    ) {

      assessmentErrors++;

      assessments.push({

        upload_id: uploadId,

        status: "REJECTED",

        code:
          lookup.code ||
          "UPLOAD_LOOKUP_FAILED"

      });

      continue;
    }


    // ---- 7. JALANKAN RECOVERY ASSESSMENT ----

    const assessment =
      assessStaleUploadRecovery_(
        lookup.record
      );


    // ---- 8. SEMAK KEPUTUSAN ----

    if (
      assessment.status !== "SUCCESS"
    ) {
      assessmentErrors++;
    }


    // ---- 9. SIMPAN RUMUSAN SELAMAT ----

    // Jangan pulangkan:
    // - lease_token
    // - idempotency_key
    // - drive_file_id
    // - full upload record

    assessments.push({

      upload_id: uploadId,

      upload_status:
        lookup.record.upload_status,

      status:
        assessment.status,

      code:
        assessment.code,

      assessment:
        assessment.assessment || "",

      recommended_action:
        assessment.recommended_action || "",

      recovery_allowed:
        assessment.recovery_allowed === true

    });

  }


  // ---- 10. PULANGKAN LAPORAN ----

  return {

    status: "SUCCESS",

    code: "STORED_RECOVERY_ASSESSMENT_COMPLETED",

    mode: "READ_ONLY",

    scanned_count:
      scan.scanned_count,

    stale_count:
      scan.stale_count,

    assessed_count:
      assessments.length,

    assessment_errors:
      assessmentErrors,

    assessments:
      assessments,

    records_changed: false,

    quota_changed: false

  };

}


/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.70
   MANUAL TEST - STORED ASSESSMENT

   Ujian:
   - Fungsi membaca UPLOADS.
   - Scan dan assessment berjaya.
   - Bilangan assessment konsisten.
   - Tiada recovery dibenarkan.
   - Tiada data sensitif dipulangkan.
   - Database tidak berubah.

   Ujian ini tidak menambah
   rekod sementara.
============================================ */


function testAssessStoredStaleUploadRecovery_() {

  // ---- 11. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error(
      "SPREADSHEET_ID tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
    spreadsheetId
  );

  const uploadsSheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("UPLOADS");

  const quotaSheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("QUOTA_CYCLES");

  if (!uploadsSheet || !quotaSheet) {
    throw new Error(
      "UPLOADS atau QUOTA_CYCLES tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }


  // ---- 12. SIMPAN KEADAAN ASAL ----

  const uploadsBefore = JSON.stringify(
    uploadsSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const quotaBefore = JSON.stringify(
    quotaSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 13. JALANKAN FUNGSI ----

  const result =
    assessStoredStaleUploadRecovery_();


  // ---- 14. SAHKAN KEJAYAAN ----

  const assessmentSuccessful =
    result.status === "SUCCESS" &&
    result.code ===
      "STORED_RECOVERY_ASSESSMENT_COMPLETED" &&
    result.mode === "READ_ONLY";


  // ---- 15. SAHKAN BILANGAN ----

  const countsConsistent =
    result.assessed_count ===
      result.assessments.length &&
    result.assessed_count ===
      result.stale_count;


  // ---- 16. SAHKAN TIADA RECOVERY ----

  const noRecoveryAllowed =
    result.assessments.every(
      item =>
        item.recovery_allowed === false
    );


  // ---- 17. SAHKAN TIADA TOKEN ----

  const noSensitiveFields =
    result.assessments.every(
      item =>
        !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
          item,
          "lease_token"
        ) &&
        !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
          item,
          "idempotency_key"
        ) &&
        !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
          item,
          "drive_file_id"
        )
    );


  // ---- 18. SEMAK DATABASE ----

  const uploadsAfter = JSON.stringify(
    uploadsSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const quotaAfter = JSON.stringify(
    quotaSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 19. RUMUSAN UJIAN ----

  const summary = {

    assessment_successful:
      assessmentSuccessful,

    counts_consistent:
      countsConsistent,

    no_recovery_allowed:
      noRecoveryAllowed,

    no_sensitive_fields:
      noSensitiveFields,

    uploads_unchanged:
      uploadsBefore === uploadsAfter,

    quota_unchanged:
      quotaBefore === quotaAfter

  };


  // ---- 20. PAPARKAN LOG SELAMAT ----

  Logger.log(
    "STORED RECOVERY ASSESSMENT TEST:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
  );


  // ---- 21. SAHKAN SEMUA UJIAN ----

  const passed =
    Object.values(summary).every(
      value => value === true
    );

  if (!passed) {
    throw new Error(
      "STORED RECOVERY ASSESSMENT TEST FAILED"
    );
  }

  Logger.log(
    "STORED RECOVERY ASSESSMENT TEST PASSED"
  );

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.71

   WITH REAL SHEET RECORDS

   TUJUAN:
   - Cipta 3 rekod sementara.
   - RESERVED expired tanpa Drive ID.
   - PROCESSING expired dengan Drive ID.
   - COMPLETED expired dikecualikan.
   - Uji assessment sebenar.
   - Sahkan tiada recovery dibenarkan.
   - Sahkan scan tidak mengubah rekod.
   - Padam rekod sementara.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - MANUAL TEST ONLY.
   - PUBLIC LIVE DISABLED.
   - Tiada upload gambar.
   - Tiada operasi Google Drive.
   - Tiada perubahan kuota.

   PENTING:
   Jalankan hanya apabila UPLOADS
   mempunyai header sahaja.

   Jika cleanup gagal,
   jangan ulang ujian dahulu.
============================================ */


function testStoredRecoveryAssessmentWithRecords_() {

  // ---- 1. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error(
      "SPREADSHEET_ID tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
    spreadsheetId
  );

  const uploadsSheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("UPLOADS");

  const quotaSheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("QUOTA_CYCLES");

  if (!uploadsSheet || !quotaSheet) {
    throw new Error(
      "UPLOADS atau QUOTA_CYCLES tidak dijumpai."
    );
  }


  // ---- 2. SAHKAN UPLOADS KOSONG ----

  if (uploadsSheet.getLastRow() !== 1) {
    throw new Error(
      "TEST STOPPED: UPLOADS IS NOT EMPTY"
    );
  }


  // ---- 3. SAHKAN HEADER ----

  const headers = uploadsSheet
    .getRange(1, 1, 1, 22)
    .getValues()[0];

  const headersValid =
    UPLOAD_RESERVATION_HEADERS.length === 22 &&
    UPLOAD_RESERVATION_HEADERS.every(
      (header, index) =>
        headers[index] === header
    );

  if (!headersValid) {
    throw new Error(
      "UPLOADS HEADER MISMATCH"
    );
  }


  // ---- 4. SIMPAN KEADAAN ASAL ----

  const uploadsBefore = JSON.stringify(
    uploadsSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const quotaBefore = JSON.stringify(
    quotaSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 5. JANA IDENTITI ----

  const uploadIdA = Utilities.getUuid();
  const uploadIdB = Utilities.getUuid();
  const uploadIdC = Utilities.getUuid();


  // ---- 6. JANA LEASE ----

  const leaseA = createUploadLease_();
  const leaseB = createUploadLease_();
  const leaseC = createUploadLease_();


  // ---- 7. TETAPKAN LEASE EXPIRED ----

  const expiredAt =
    new Date(
      Date.now() - 60000
    ).toISOString();


  // ---- 8. BINA REKOD A ----

  const builtA = buildUploadReservationRow_({

    upload_id: uploadIdA,

    idempotency_key:
      Utilities.getUuid(),

    event_id: "SIM_EVENT_001",

    qr_id: "SIM_QR_001",

    cycle_id: "SIM_CYCLE_001",

    lease_token:
      leaseA.lease_token,

    lease_expires_at:
      expiredAt,

    original_filename:
      "recovery_reserved_test.jpg",

    file_mime_type:
      "image/jpeg",

    file_size_bytes:
      1000000,

    created_at:
      leaseA.lease_created_at

  });


  // ---- 9. BINA REKOD B ----

  const builtB = buildUploadReservationRow_({

    upload_id: uploadIdB,

    idempotency_key:
      Utilities.getUuid(),

    event_id: "SIM_EVENT_001",

    qr_id: "SIM_QR_001",

    cycle_id: "SIM_CYCLE_001",

    lease_token:
      leaseB.lease_token,

    lease_expires_at:
      expiredAt,

    original_filename:
      "recovery_processing_test.jpg",

    file_mime_type:
      "image/jpeg",

    file_size_bytes:
      1200000,

    created_at:
      leaseB.lease_created_at

  });


  // ---- 10. BINA REKOD C ----

  const builtC = buildUploadReservationRow_({

    upload_id: uploadIdC,

    idempotency_key:
      Utilities.getUuid(),

    event_id: "SIM_EVENT_001",

    qr_id: "SIM_QR_001",

    cycle_id: "SIM_CYCLE_001",

    lease_token:
      leaseC.lease_token,

    lease_expires_at:
      expiredAt,

    original_filename:
      "recovery_completed_test.jpg",

    file_mime_type:
      "image/jpeg",

    file_size_bytes:
      1400000,

    created_at:
      leaseC.lease_created_at

  });


  // ---- 11. SAHKAN REKOD DIBINA ----

  const buildsValid =
    [builtA, builtB, builtC].every(
      item =>
        item.status === "SUCCESS" &&
        item.column_count === 22 &&
        Array.isArray(item.row) &&
        item.row.length === 22
    );

  if (!buildsValid) {
    throw new Error(
      "TEST RECORD BUILD FAILED"
    );
  }


  // ---- 12. SALIN BARIS ----

  const rowA = builtA.row.slice();
  const rowB = builtB.row.slice();
  const rowC = builtC.row.slice();


  // ---- 13. TETAPKAN STATUS ----

  // F = upload_status

  rowA[5] = "RESERVED";
  rowB[5] = "PROCESSING";
  rowC[5] = "COMPLETED";


  // ---- 14. TETAPKAN DRIVE FILE ID ----

  // L = drive_file_id
  //
  // Ini hanya teks simulasi.
  // Tiada fail Drive sebenar digunakan.

  rowB[11] = "SIM_DRIVE_FILE_001";


  // ---- 15. STATUS UJIAN ----

  let temporaryRowsCreated = false;

  let cleanupCompleted = false;

  let testPassed = false;

  let testError = null;


  // ---- 16. MULAKAN UJIAN ----

  try {

    // ---- 17. MASUKKAN REKOD ----

    const insertResult =
      withUploadReservationLock_(
        function() {

          if (
            uploadsSheet.getLastRow() !== 1
          ) {
            return {
              status: "REJECTED",
              code: "UPLOADS_NOT_EMPTY"
            };
          }

          uploadsSheet.getRange(
            2, 1, 3, 22
          ).setValues([
            rowA,
            rowB,
            rowC
          ]);

          temporaryRowsCreated = true;

          SpreadsheetApp.flush();

          return {
            status: "SUCCESS",
            code: "TEST_ROWS_INSERTED"
          };

        }
      );

    if (
      insertResult.status !== "SUCCESS"
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "TEST ROW INSERT FAILED"
      );
    }


    // ---- 18. SIMPAN DATA SEBELUM ASSESSMENT ----

    const storedBefore = JSON.stringify(
      uploadsSheet.getRange(
        2, 1, 3, 22
      ).getValues()
    );


    // ---- 19. JALANKAN ASSESSMENT ----

    const result =
      assessStoredStaleUploadRecovery_();


    // ---- 20. SAHKAN KEJAYAAN ----

    const assessmentSuccessful =
      result.status === "SUCCESS" &&
      result.code ===
        "STORED_RECOVERY_ASSESSMENT_COMPLETED" &&
      result.mode === "READ_ONLY";


    // ---- 21. SAHKAN BILANGAN ----

    const countsCorrect =
      result.scanned_count === 3 &&
      result.stale_count === 2 &&
      result.assessed_count === 2 &&
      result.assessment_errors === 0;


    // ---- 22. SAHKAN IDENTITI ----

    const assessedIds =
      result.assessments.map(
        item => item.upload_id
      );

    const idsCorrect =
      JSON.stringify(assessedIds) ===
      JSON.stringify([
        uploadIdA,
        uploadIdB
      ]);


    // ---- 23. SAHKAN ASSESSMENT ----

    const assessmentsCorrect =
      result.assessments[0].assessment ===
        "STALE_RESERVED_NO_FILE_ID" &&
      result.assessments[1].assessment ===
        "STALE_PROCESSING_WITH_FILE_ID";


    // ---- 24. SAHKAN CADANGAN ----

    const actionsCorrect =
      result.assessments[0]
        .recommended_action ===
        "CHECK_FOR_UNRECORDED_DRIVE_FILE" &&
      result.assessments[1]
        .recommended_action ===
        "VERIFY_DRIVE_FILE_AND_HISTORY";


    // ---- 25. SAHKAN TIADA RECOVERY ----

    const noRecoveryAllowed =
      result.assessments.every(
        item =>
          item.recovery_allowed === false
      );


    // ---- 26. SAHKAN TIADA MEDAN SENSITIF ----

    const noSensitiveFields =
      result.assessments.every(
        item =>
          !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
            item,
            "lease_token"
          ) &&
          !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
            item,
            "idempotency_key"
          ) &&
          !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
            item,
            "drive_file_id"
          )
      );


    // ---- 27. SAHKAN READ ONLY ----

    const storedAfter = JSON.stringify(
      uploadsSheet.getRange(
        2, 1, 3, 22
      ).getValues()
    );

    const assessmentReadOnly =
      storedBefore === storedAfter;


    // ---- 28. SAHKAN KUOTA ----

    const quotaDuring = JSON.stringify(
      quotaSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
    );

    const quotaUnchanged =
      quotaBefore === quotaDuring;


    // ---- 29. RUMUSAN UJIAN ----

    const summary = {

      assessment_successful:
        assessmentSuccessful,

      counts_correct:
        countsCorrect,

      ids_correct:
        idsCorrect,

      assessments_correct:
        assessmentsCorrect,

      actions_correct:
        actionsCorrect,

      no_recovery_allowed:
        noRecoveryAllowed,

      no_sensitive_fields:
        noSensitiveFields,

      assessment_read_only:
        assessmentReadOnly,

      quota_unchanged:
        quotaUnchanged

    };


    // ---- 30. PAPARKAN LOG ----

    Logger.log(
      "STORED RECOVERY ASSESSMENT WITH RECORDS TEST:"
    );

    Logger.log(
      JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
    );


    // ---- 31. SAHKAN UJIAN ----

    testPassed =
      Object.values(summary).every(
        value => value === true
      );

    if (!testPassed) {
      throw new Error(
        "STORED RECOVERY ASSESSMENT WITH RECORDS TEST FAILED"
      );
    }

  } catch (error) {

    testError = error;

  } finally {

    // ---- 32. BERSIHKAN REKOD ----

    if (temporaryRowsCreated) {

      try {

        const cleanupResult =
          withUploadReservationLock_(
            function() {

              const storedIds =
                uploadsSheet.getRange(
                  2, 1, 3, 1
                ).getValues().map(
                  row => row[0]
                );

              const idsMatch =
                JSON.stringify(storedIds) ===
                JSON.stringify([
                  uploadIdA,
                  uploadIdB,
                  uploadIdC
                ]);

              if (!idsMatch) {
                return {
                  status: "REJECTED",
                  code: "TEST_ROW_IDS_MISMATCH"
                };
              }

              uploadsSheet.deleteRows(
                2, 3
              );

              SpreadsheetApp.flush();

              return {
                status: "SUCCESS",
                code: "TEST_ROWS_REMOVED"
              };

            }
          );

        cleanupCompleted =
          cleanupResult.status ===
          "SUCCESS";

      } catch (cleanupError) {

        Logger.log(
          "WARNING: TEST CLEANUP FAILED"
        );

      }

    }

  }


  // ---- 33. SAHKAN DATABASE DIPULIHKAN ----

  const uploadsAfter = JSON.stringify(
    uploadsSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const quotaAfter = JSON.stringify(
    quotaSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const uploadsRestored =
    uploadsBefore === uploadsAfter;

  const quotaRestored =
    quotaBefore === quotaAfter;


  // ---- 34. LOG PEMBERSIHAN ----

  Logger.log(

  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify({

      test_passed:
        testPassed,

      cleanup_completed:

      uploads_restored:

      quota_restored:
        quotaRestored

    }, null, 2)

  // ---- 35. TANGANI RALAT ----

  if (testError) {

  }


  // ---- 36. SAHKAN KEPUTUSAN AKHIR ----

  if (
    !testPassed ||
    !cleanupCompleted ||
    !uploadsRestored ||
    !quotaRestored
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "STORED RECOVERY ASSESSMENT OR CLEANUP FAILED"
    );
  }


  Logger.log(
    "STORED RECOVERY ASSESSMENT WITH RECORDS TEST PASSED"
  );

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.72
   GOOGLE DRIVE FILE VERIFICATION

   TUJUAN:
   - Semak kewujudan fail Drive.
   - Semak sama ada fail boleh diakses.
   - Semak lokasi dalam folder sistem.
   - Jangan ubah fail atau folder.
   - Jangan dedahkan ID fail sebenar.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - READ ONLY.
   - PRIVATE BACKEND ONLY.
   - Tiada createFile().
   - Tiada setTrashed().
   - Tiada moveTo().
   - Tiada perubahan database.
   - Jangan sambung ke doGet/doPost.

   NOTA:
   FILE_NOT_ACCESSIBLE tidak semestinya
   bermaksud fail telah dipadam.
============================================ */


// ---- 1. FUNGSI PEMERIKSAAN FAIL ----

function verifyDriveFileReadOnly_(
  driveFileId
) {

  // ---- 2. SAHKAN INPUT ----

  if (
    typeof driveFileId !== "string" ||
    driveFileId.trim() === ""
  ) {

    return {
      status: "SUCCESS",
      code: "NO_FILE_ID",
      verified: false,
      file_accessible: false,
      inside_system: false,
      records_changed: false,
      drive_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 3. DAPATKAN ROOT FOLDER ID ----

  const rootFolderId =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(
        "ROOT_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID"
      );

  if (!rootFolderId) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "ROOT_FOLDER_NOT_CONFIGURED",
      verified: false,
      file_accessible: false,
      inside_system: false,
      records_changed: false,
      drive_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 4. SEMAK ROOT FOLDER ----

  let rootFolder;

  try {

    rootFolder =
      DriveApp.getFolderById(
        rootFolderId
      );

    // Paksa semakan akses.
    rootFolder.getName();

  } catch (error) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "ROOT_FOLDER_NOT_ACCESSIBLE",
      verified: false,
      file_accessible: false,
      inside_system: false,
      records_changed: false,
      drive_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 5. CUBA AKSES FAIL ----

  let file;

  try {

    file = DriveApp.getFileById(
      driveFileId.trim()
    );

    // Paksa semakan akses.
    file.getName();

  } catch (error) {

    return {
      status: "SUCCESS",
      code: "FILE_NOT_ACCESSIBLE",
      verified: false,
      file_accessible: false,
      inside_system: false,
      records_changed: false,
      drive_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 6. SEMAK STATUS TRASH ----

  try {

    if (file.isTrashed()) {

      return {
        status: "SUCCESS",
        code: "FILE_TRASHED",
        verified: false,
        file_accessible: true,
        inside_system: false,
        records_changed: false,
        drive_changed: false
      };

    }

  } catch (error) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "DRIVE_CHECK_ERROR",
      verified: false,
      file_accessible: true,
      inside_system: false,
      records_changed: false,
      drive_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 7. SEMAK RANTAIAN FOLDER ----

  // Fail mungkin berada dalam:
  //
  // ROOT
  //   EVENT
  //     QR SLOT
  //       PHOTO
  //
  // Jadi kita perlu memeriksa
  // folder induk secara berperingkat.


  let insideSystem = false;

  const visitedFolderIds = {};

  const foldersToCheck = [];


  // ---- 8. DAPATKAN FOLDER INDUK FAIL ----

  try {

    const parents = file.getParents();

    while (parents.hasNext()) {

      foldersToCheck.push(
        parents.next()
      );

    }

  } catch (error) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "DRIVE_CHECK_ERROR",
      verified: false,
      file_accessible: true,
      inside_system: false,
      records_changed: false,
      drive_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 9. SEMAK FOLDER SATU PERSATU ----

  try {

    while (foldersToCheck.length > 0) {

      const folder =
        foldersToCheck.shift();

      const folderId =
        folder.getId();

      // Elakkan folder sama
      // diperiksa berulang kali.

      if (visitedFolderIds[folderId]) {
        continue;
      }

      visitedFolderIds[folderId] = true;


      // ---- 10. JUMPA ROOT SISTEM ----

      if (folderId === rootFolderId) {

        insideSystem = true;
        break;

      }


      // ---- 11. SEMAK FOLDER INDUK ----

      const parents =
        folder.getParents();

      while (parents.hasNext()) {

        foldersToCheck.push(
          parents.next()
        );

      }

    }

  } catch (error) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "DRIVE_CHECK_ERROR",
      verified: false,
      file_accessible: true,
      inside_system: false,
      records_changed: false,
      drive_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 12. FAIL DI LUAR SISTEM ----

  if (!insideSystem) {

    return {
      status: "SUCCESS",
      code: "FILE_OUTSIDE_SYSTEM",
      verified: false,
      file_accessible: true,
      inside_system: false,
      records_changed: false,
      drive_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 13. FAIL DISAHKAN ----

  return {
    status: "SUCCESS",
    code: "FILE_VERIFIED",
    verified: true,
    file_accessible: true,
    inside_system: true,
    records_changed: false,
    drive_changed: false
  };

}


/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.72
   MANUAL TEST - DRIVE VERIFICATION

   Ujian:
   - ID kosong.
   - ID fail simulasi.
   - Folder sistem boleh diakses.
   - Tiada perubahan Sheets.
   - Tiada perubahan Drive.
   - Tiada ID sensitif dipaparkan.

   Tiada fail dicipta atau dipadam.
============================================ */


function testVerifyDriveFileReadOnly_() {

  // ---- 14. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  const rootFolderId =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(
        "ROOT_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID"
      );

  if (!spreadsheetId || !rootFolderId) {
    throw new Error(
      "SCRIPT PROPERTIES NOT CONFIGURED"
    );
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
    spreadsheetId
  );

  const uploadsSheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("UPLOADS");

  const quotaSheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("QUOTA_CYCLES");

  if (!uploadsSheet || !quotaSheet) {
    throw new Error(
      "REQUIRED SHEETS NOT FOUND"
    );
  }


  // ---- 15. SIMPAN KEADAAN SHEETS ----

  const uploadsBefore = JSON.stringify(
    uploadsSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const quotaBefore = JSON.stringify(
    quotaSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 16. UJI ID KOSONG ----

  const emptyResult =
    verifyDriveFileReadOnly_("");


  // ---- 17. UJI ID SIMULASI ----

  // Ini bukan ID fail sebenar.

  const fakeResult =
    verifyDriveFileReadOnly_(
      "SIMULATED_NON_EXISTENT_FILE_ID_12345"
    );


  // ---- 18. SEMAK ROOT FOLDER ----

  let rootAccessible = false;

  try {

    const root =
      DriveApp.getFolderById(
        rootFolderId
      );

    root.getName();

    rootAccessible = true;

  } catch (error) {

    rootAccessible = false;

  }


  // ---- 19. SAHKAN HASIL ----

  const emptyIdCorrect =
    emptyResult.status === "SUCCESS" &&
    emptyResult.code === "NO_FILE_ID" &&
    emptyResult.verified === false;


  const fakeIdCorrect =
    fakeResult.status === "SUCCESS" &&
    fakeResult.code ===
      "FILE_NOT_ACCESSIBLE" &&
    fakeResult.verified === false;


  // ---- 20. SAHKAN TIADA DATA SENSITIF ----

  const noSensitiveFields =
    [emptyResult, fakeResult].every(
      item =>
        !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
          item,
          "drive_file_id"
        ) &&
        !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
          item,
          "root_folder_id"
        ) &&
        !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
          item,
          "file_name"
        ) &&
        !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
          item,
          "file_url"
        )
    );


  // ---- 21. SAHKAN TIADA PERUBAHAN ----

  const readOnlyFlagsCorrect =
    [emptyResult, fakeResult].every(
      item =>
        item.records_changed === false &&
        item.drive_changed === false
    );


  // ---- 22. SEMAK SHEETS ----

  const uploadsAfter = JSON.stringify(
    uploadsSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const quotaAfter = JSON.stringify(
    quotaSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 23. RUMUSAN UJIAN ----

  const summary = {

    empty_id_correct:
      emptyIdCorrect,

    fake_id_correct:
      fakeIdCorrect,

    root_accessible:
      rootAccessible,

    no_sensitive_fields:
      noSensitiveFields,

    read_only_flags_correct:
      readOnlyFlagsCorrect,

    uploads_unchanged:
      uploadsBefore === uploadsAfter,

    quota_unchanged:
      quotaBefore === quotaAfter

  };


  // ---- 24. PAPARKAN LOG SELAMAT ----

  Logger.log(
    "DRIVE FILE READ ONLY VERIFICATION TEST:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
  );


  // ---- 25. SAHKAN SEMUA UJIAN ----

  const passed =
    Object.values(summary).every(
      value => value === true
    );

  if (!passed) {
    throw new Error(
      "DRIVE FILE READ ONLY VERIFICATION TEST FAILED"
    );
  }

  Logger.log(
    "DRIVE FILE READ ONLY VERIFICATION TEST PASSED"
  );

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.73

   TUJUAN:

   - Uji verifyDriveFileReadOnly_().
   - Sahkan FILE_VERIFIED.
