   - Tiada perubahan UPLOADS.
   - Tiada perubahan kuota.
   - Hanya fail/folder ciptaan ujian
     ini dibenarkan masuk Trash.

   PENTING:
   Jika cleanup gagal,
   jangan ulang ujian dahulu.
============================================ */


function testVerifyDriveFileStoredSuccess_() {

  // ---- 1. BACA SCRIPT PROPERTIES ----

  const properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  const spreadsheetId =
    properties.getProperty(
      "SPREADSHEET_ID"
    );

  const rootFolderId =
    properties.getProperty(
      "ROOT_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID"
    );

  if (!spreadsheetId || !rootFolderId) {
    throw new Error(
      "SCRIPT PROPERTIES NOT CONFIGURED"
    );
  }


  // ---- 2. BUKA GOOGLE SHEETS ----

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
    spreadsheetId
  );

  const uploadsSheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("UPLOADS");

  const quotaSheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("QUOTA_CYCLES");

  if (!uploadsSheet || !quotaSheet) {
    throw new Error(
      "REQUIRED SHEETS NOT FOUND"
    );
  }


  // ---- 3. SIMPAN KEADAAN DATABASE ----

  const uploadsBefore = JSON.stringify(
    uploadsSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const quotaBefore = JSON.stringify(
    quotaSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 4. BUKA FOLDER UTAMA ----

  const rootFolder =
    DriveApp.getFolderById(
      rootFolderId
    );

  // Paksa semakan akses.
  rootFolder.getName();


  // ---- 5. SEDIAKAN PEMBOLEH UBAH ----

  let testFolder = null;
  let testFile = null;

  let folderCreated = false;
  let fileCreated = false;

  let fileCleanupCompleted = false;
  let folderCleanupCompleted = false;

  let testPassed = false;
  let testError = null;


  // ---- 6. MULAKAN UJIAN ----

  try {

    // ---- 7. CIPTA FOLDER UJIAN ----

    const uniqueSuffix =
      Utilities.getUuid().slice(0, 8);

    testFolder =
      rootFolder.createFolder(
        "QR_POLAROID_TEST_373_" +
        uniqueSuffix
      );

    folderCreated = true;


    // ---- 8. CIPTA FAIL TEKS ----

    testFile =
      testFolder.createFile(
        "drive_verification_test.txt",
        "QR Polaroid internal test only.",
        MimeType.PLAIN_TEXT
      );

    fileCreated = true;


    // ---- 9. JALANKAN PENGESAHAN ----

    const result =
      verifyDriveFileReadOnly_(
        testFile.getId()
      );


    // ---- 10. SAHKAN FILE_VERIFIED ----

    const fileVerified =
      result.status === "SUCCESS" &&
      result.code === "FILE_VERIFIED" &&
      result.verified === true;


    // ---- 11. SAHKAN AKSES FAIL ----

    const fileAccessible =
      result.file_accessible === true;


    // ---- 12. SAHKAN LOKASI SISTEM ----

    const insideSystem =
      result.inside_system === true;


    // ---- 13. SAHKAN READ ONLY ----

    const verificationReadOnly =
      result.records_changed === false &&
      result.drive_changed === false;


    // ---- 14. SAHKAN TIADA ID SENSITIF ----

    const noSensitiveFields =
      !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
        result,
        "drive_file_id"
      ) &&
      !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
        result,
        "root_folder_id"
      ) &&
      !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
        result,
        "file_name"
      ) &&
      !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
        result,
        "file_url"
      );


    // ---- 15. SEMAK DATABASE ----

    const uploadsDuring = JSON.stringify(
      uploadsSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
    );

    const quotaDuring = JSON.stringify(
      quotaSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
    );


    // ---- 16. RUMUSAN UJIAN ----

    const summary = {

      folder_created:
        folderCreated,

      file_created:
        fileCreated,

      file_verified:
        fileVerified,

      file_accessible:
        fileAccessible,

      inside_system:
        insideSystem,

      verification_read_only:
        verificationReadOnly,

      no_sensitive_fields:
        noSensitiveFields,

      uploads_unchanged:
        uploadsBefore === uploadsDuring,

      quota_unchanged:
        quotaBefore === quotaDuring

    };


    // ---- 17. PAPARKAN LOG SELAMAT ----

    Logger.log(
      "DRIVE FILE STORED SUCCESS TEST:"
    );

    Logger.log(
      JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
    );


    // ---- 18. SAHKAN UJIAN ----

    testPassed =
      Object.values(summary).every(
        value => value === true
      );

    if (!testPassed) {
      throw new Error(
        "DRIVE FILE STORED SUCCESS TEST FAILED"
      );
    }

  } catch (error) {

    testError = error;

  } finally {

    // ---- 19. BERSIHKAN FAIL UJIAN ----

    // Hanya fail yang dicipta
    // dalam ujian ini boleh dibuang.

    if (fileCreated && testFile) {

      try {

        const fileName =
          testFile.getName();

        const fileParents =
          testFile.getParents();

        let parentMatches = false;

        while (fileParents.hasNext()) {

          if (
            fileParents.next().getId() ===
            testFolder.getId()
          ) {
            parentMatches = true;
          }

        }

        if (
          fileName ===
            "drive_verification_test.txt" &&
          parentMatches
        ) {

          testFile.setTrashed(true);

          fileCleanupCompleted = true;

        }

      } catch (cleanupError) {

        Logger.log(
          "WARNING: TEST FILE CLEANUP FAILED"
        );

      }

    }


    // ---- 20. BERSIHKAN FOLDER UJIAN ----

    if (folderCreated && testFolder) {

      try {

        const folderName =
          testFolder.getName();

        const folderParents =
          testFolder.getParents();

        let rootMatches = false;

        while (folderParents.hasNext()) {

          if (
            folderParents.next().getId() ===
            rootFolderId
          ) {
            rootMatches = true;
          }

        }

        if (
          folderName.indexOf(
            "QR_POLAROID_TEST_373_"
          ) === 0 &&
          rootMatches &&
          fileCleanupCompleted
        ) {

          testFolder.setTrashed(true);

          folderCleanupCompleted = true;

        }

      } catch (cleanupError) {

        Logger.log(
          "WARNING: TEST FOLDER CLEANUP FAILED"
        );

      }

    }

  }


  // ---- 21. SEMAK DATABASE SELEPAS UJIAN ----

  const uploadsAfter = JSON.stringify(
    uploadsSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const quotaAfter = JSON.stringify(
    quotaSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const uploadsRestored =
    uploadsBefore === uploadsAfter;

  const quotaRestored =
    quotaBefore === quotaAfter;


  // ---- 22. SEMAK CLEANUP ----

  const cleanupCompleted =
    fileCleanupCompleted &&
    folderCleanupCompleted;


  // ---- 23. PAPARKAN LOG CLEANUP ----

  Logger.log(
    "DRIVE FILE STORED TEST CLEANUP:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify({

      test_passed:
        testPassed,

      cleanup_completed:
        cleanupCompleted,

      uploads_restored:
        uploadsRestored,

      quota_restored:
        quotaRestored

    }, null, 2)
  );


  // ---- 24. TANGANI RALAT ----

  if (testError) {
    throw testError;
  }


  // ---- 25. SAHKAN KEPUTUSAN AKHIR ----

  if (
    !testPassed ||
    !cleanupCompleted ||
    !uploadsRestored ||
    !quotaRestored
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "DRIVE STORED TEST OR CLEANUP FAILED"
    );
  }


  Logger.log(
    "DRIVE FILE STORED SUCCESS TEST PASSED"
  );

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.74
   QR SLOT DRIVE LOCATION VERIFICATION

   TUJUAN:
   - Semak fail mengikut QR Slot.
   - Baca drive_folder_id daripada QR_SLOTS.
   - Pastikan fail dalam folder yang betul.
   - Tolak fail dari folder QR lain.
   - Jangan ubah Sheets atau Drive.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - READ ONLY.
   - PRIVATE BACKEND ONLY.
   - Tiada createFile().
   - Tiada setTrashed().
   - Tiada perubahan kuota.
   - Jangan sambung ke doGet/doPost.

   NOTA:
   Fungsi ini hanya menyemak lokasi.
   Ia tidak membenarkan recovery.
============================================ */


// ---- 1. FUNGSI PEMERIKSAAN QR SLOT ----

function verifyDriveFileQrSlotLocation_(
  driveFileId,
  qrId
) {

  // ---- 2. SAHKAN INPUT ----

  if (
    typeof driveFileId !== "string" ||
    driveFileId.trim() === "" ||
    typeof qrId !== "string" ||
    qrId.trim() === ""
  ) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "INVALID_VERIFICATION_INPUT",
      verified: false,
      correct_qr_folder: false,
      records_changed: false,
      drive_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 3. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "DATABASE_NOT_CONFIGURED",
      verified: false,
      correct_qr_folder: false,
      records_changed: false,
      drive_changed: false
    };

  }


  let sheet;

  try {

    const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
      spreadsheetId
    );

    sheet = ss.getSheetByName(
      "QR_SLOTS"
    );

    if (!sheet) {
      throw new Error(
        "QR_SLOTS_NOT_FOUND"
      );
    }

  } catch (error) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "DATABASE_READ_ERROR",
      verified: false,
      correct_qr_folder: false,
      records_changed: false,
      drive_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 4. SAHKAN HEADER ----

  const expectedHeaders = [
    "qr_id",
    "event_id",
    "qr_label",
    "qr_token",
    "qr_status",
    "max_uploads",
    "current_cycle_id",
    "drive_folder_id",
    "created_at",
    "updated_at",
    "created_by",
    "updated_by",
    "last_upload_at",
    "regenerated_at",
    "regenerated_by",
    "deleted_at",
    "deleted_by",
    "deletion_status"
  ];

  let values;

  try {

    values = sheet.getDataRange()
      .getValues();

  } catch (error) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "DATABASE_READ_ERROR",
      verified: false,
      correct_qr_folder: false,
      records_changed: false,
      drive_changed: false
    };

  }

  const headersValid =
    values.length > 0 &&
    expectedHeaders.every(
      (header, index) =>
        values[0][index] === header
    );

  if (!headersValid) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "QR_SLOTS_HEADER_MISMATCH",
      verified: false,
      correct_qr_folder: false,
      records_changed: false,
      drive_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 5. CARI QR SLOT ----

  const matches = values
    .slice(1)
    .filter(
      row => row[0] === qrId
    );

  if (matches.length !== 1) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code:
        matches.length === 0
          ? "QR_SLOT_NOT_FOUND"
          : "DUPLICATE_QR_SLOT",
      verified: false,
      correct_qr_folder: false,
      records_changed: false,
      drive_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 6. SEMAK STATUS QR SLOT ----

  const qrRecord = matches[0];

  const deletionStatus =
    qrRecord[17];

  if (deletionStatus !== "ACTIVE") {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "QR_SLOT_DELETED",
      verified: false,
      correct_qr_folder: false,
      records_changed: false,
      drive_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 7. DAPATKAN FOLDER QR ----

  const expectedFolderId =
    qrRecord[7];

  if (
    typeof expectedFolderId !== "string" ||
    expectedFolderId.trim() === ""
  ) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "QR_FOLDER_NOT_CONFIGURED",
      verified: false,
      correct_qr_folder: false,
      records_changed: false,
      drive_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 8. SEMAK FAIL DALAM SISTEM ----

  const systemCheck =
    verifyDriveFileReadOnly_(
      driveFileId
    );

  if (
    systemCheck.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
    systemCheck.verified !== true
  ) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code:
        systemCheck.code ||
        "SYSTEM_FILE_VERIFICATION_FAILED",
      verified: false,
      correct_qr_folder: false,
      records_changed: false,
      drive_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 9. BUKA FAIL DAN FOLDER QR ----

  let file;
  let qrFolder;

  try {

    file = DriveApp.getFileById(
      driveFileId.trim()
    );

    qrFolder = DriveApp.getFolderById(
      expectedFolderId.trim()
    );

    file.getName();
    qrFolder.getName();

    if (qrFolder.isTrashed()) {

      return {
        status: "REJECTED",
        code: "QR_FOLDER_TRASHED",
        verified: false,
        correct_qr_folder: false,
        records_changed: false,
        drive_changed: false
      };

    }

  } catch (error) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "QR_FOLDER_OR_FILE_NOT_ACCESSIBLE",
      verified: false,
      correct_qr_folder: false,
      records_changed: false,
      drive_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 10. SEMAK FOLDER INDUK FAIL ----

  // Untuk sistem ini, gambar
  // disimpan terus dalam folder QR.
  //
  // Jadi kita semak direct parent,
  // bukan sekadar folder utama.

  let correctFolder = false;

  try {

    const parents = file.getParents();

    while (parents.hasNext()) {

      const parent =
        parents.next();

      if (
        parent.getId() ===
        expectedFolderId.trim()
      ) {

        correctFolder = true;
        break;

      }

    }

  } catch (error) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "FILE_PARENT_CHECK_ERROR",
      verified: false,
      correct_qr_folder: false,
      records_changed: false,
      drive_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 11. FAIL DALAM FOLDER SALAH ----

  if (!correctFolder) {

    return {
      status: "SUCCESS",
      code: "WRONG_QR_FOLDER",
      verified: false,
      correct_qr_folder: false,
      records_changed: false,
      drive_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 12. FAIL DALAM FOLDER BETUL ----

  return {
    status: "SUCCESS",
    code: "QR_FOLDER_VERIFIED",
    verified: true,
    correct_qr_folder: true,
    records_changed: false,
    drive_changed: false
  };

}


/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.74
   MANUAL TEST - QR FOLDER LOCATION

   Ujian:
   - Input kosong.
   - QR ID tidak wujud.
   - Tiada perubahan Sheets.
   - Tiada perubahan Drive.
   - Tiada ID sensitif dipulangkan.

   Ujian positif menggunakan fail
   sebenar akan dibuat kemudian.
============================================ */


function testVerifyDriveFileQrSlotLocation_() {

  // ---- 13. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error(
      "SPREADSHEET_ID NOT CONFIGURED"
    );
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
    spreadsheetId
  );

  const qrSheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("QR_SLOTS");

  const uploadsSheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("UPLOADS");

  const quotaSheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("QUOTA_CYCLES");

  if (
    !qrSheet ||
    !uploadsSheet ||
    !quotaSheet
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "REQUIRED SHEETS NOT FOUND"
    );
  }


  // ---- 14. SIMPAN KEADAAN ASAL ----

  const qrBefore = JSON.stringify(
    qrSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const uploadsBefore = JSON.stringify(
    uploadsSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const quotaBefore = JSON.stringify(
    quotaSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 15. UJI INPUT KOSONG ----

  const emptyResult =
    verifyDriveFileQrSlotLocation_(
      "",
      ""
    );


  // ---- 16. UJI QR ID TIDAK WUJUD ----

  const missingQrResult =
    verifyDriveFileQrSlotLocation_(
      "SIMULATED_FILE_ID",
      "SIMULATED_QR_ID_NOT_FOUND"
    );


  // ---- 17. SAHKAN INPUT KOSONG ----

  const emptyInputCorrect =
    emptyResult.status === "REJECTED" &&
    emptyResult.code ===
      "INVALID_VERIFICATION_INPUT";


  // ---- 18. SAHKAN QR TIDAK WUJUD ----

  const missingQrCorrect =
    missingQrResult.status === "REJECTED" &&
    missingQrResult.code ===
      "QR_SLOT_NOT_FOUND";


  // ---- 19. SAHKAN TIADA DATA SENSITIF ----

  const noSensitiveFields =
    [emptyResult, missingQrResult].every(
      item =>
        !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
          item,
          "drive_file_id"
        ) &&
        !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
          item,
          "qr_token"
        ) &&
        !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
          item,
          "drive_folder_id"
        )
    );


  // ---- 20. SAHKAN READ ONLY ----

  const readOnlyFlagsCorrect =
    [emptyResult, missingQrResult].every(
      item =>
        item.records_changed === false &&
        item.drive_changed === false
    );


  // ---- 21. SEMAK DATABASE ----

  const qrAfter = JSON.stringify(
    qrSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const uploadsAfter = JSON.stringify(
    uploadsSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const quotaAfter = JSON.stringify(
    quotaSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 22. RUMUSAN UJIAN ----

  const summary = {

    empty_input_correct:
      emptyInputCorrect,

    missing_qr_correct:
      missingQrCorrect,

    no_sensitive_fields:
      noSensitiveFields,

    read_only_flags_correct:
      readOnlyFlagsCorrect,

    qr_slots_unchanged:
      qrBefore === qrAfter,

    uploads_unchanged:
      uploadsBefore === uploadsAfter,

    quota_unchanged:
      quotaBefore === quotaAfter

  };


  // ---- 23. PAPARKAN LOG SELAMAT ----

  Logger.log(
    "QR SLOT DRIVE LOCATION TEST:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
  );


  // ---- 24. SAHKAN SEMUA UJIAN ----

  const passed =
    Object.values(summary).every(
      value => value === true
    );

  if (!passed) {
    throw new Error(
      "QR SLOT DRIVE LOCATION TEST FAILED"
    );
  }

  Logger.log(
    "QR SLOT DRIVE LOCATION TEST PASSED"
  );

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.75
   QR SLOT REAL DRIVE LOCATION TEST

   TUJUAN:
   - Baca QR Slot Meja 01.
   - Cipta fail sementara dalam Meja 01.
   - Cipta fail sementara dalam folder lain.
   - Uji QR_FOLDER_VERIFIED.
   - Uji WRONG_QR_FOLDER.
   - Pastikan database tidak berubah.
   - Bersihkan bahan ujian sahaja.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - MANUAL TEST ONLY.
   - Jangan dedahkan melalui doGet/doPost.
   - Tidak menggunakan gambar peserta.
   - Tidak mengubah kuota.
   - Tidak mengubah rekod UPLOADS.
   - Folder Meja 01 tidak dipadam.

   PENTING:
   Jika cleanup gagal, jangan ulang
   ujian sebelum membuat semakan.
============================================ */


function testVerifyDriveFileQrSlotStoredSuccess_() {

  // ---- 1. BACA SCRIPT PROPERTIES ----

  const properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  const spreadsheetId =
    properties.getProperty(
      "SPREADSHEET_ID"
    );

  const rootFolderId =
    properties.getProperty(
      "ROOT_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID"
    );

  if (!spreadsheetId || !rootFolderId) {
    throw new Error(
      "SCRIPT PROPERTIES NOT CONFIGURED"
    );
  }


  // ---- 2. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
    spreadsheetId
  );

  const qrSheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("QR_SLOTS");

  const uploadsSheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("UPLOADS");

  const quotaSheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("QUOTA_CYCLES");

  if (!qrSheet || !uploadsSheet || !quotaSheet) {
    throw new Error(
      "REQUIRED SHEETS NOT FOUND"
    );
  }


  // ---- 3. SIMPAN KEADAAN ASAL ----

  const qrBefore = JSON.stringify(
    qrSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const uploadsBefore = JSON.stringify(
    uploadsSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const quotaBefore = JSON.stringify(
    quotaSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 4. CARI MEJA 01 ----

  const qrValues =
    qrSheet.getDataRange().getValues();

  const matches =
    qrValues.slice(1).filter(
      row =>
        row[2] === "Meja 01" &&
        row[17] === "ACTIVE"
    );

  if (matches.length !== 1) {
    throw new Error(
      "MEJA 01 NOT FOUND OR DUPLICATED"
    );
  }

  const qrRecord = matches[0];

  const qrId = qrRecord[0];

  const qrFolderId = qrRecord[7];

  if (!qrId || !qrFolderId) {
    throw new Error(
      "QR SLOT FOLDER NOT CONFIGURED"
    );
  }


  // ---- 5. BUKA FOLDER ----

  const rootFolder =
    DriveApp.getFolderById(
      rootFolderId
    );

  const qrFolder =
    DriveApp.getFolderById(
      qrFolderId
    );

  rootFolder.getName();
  qrFolder.getName();


  // ---- 6. SAHKAN FOLDER QR ----

  // Elakkan ujian pada folder
  // yang tidak berada dalam sistem.

  let qrFolderInsideSystem = false;

  const parentQueue = [];
  const visited = {};

  const initialParents =
    qrFolder.getParents();

  while (initialParents.hasNext()) {
    parentQueue.push(
      initialParents.next()
    );
  }

  while (parentQueue.length > 0) {

    const folder =
      parentQueue.shift();

    const folderId =
      folder.getId();

    if (visited[folderId]) {
      continue;
    }

    visited[folderId] = true;

    if (folderId === rootFolderId) {
      qrFolderInsideSystem = true;
      break;
    }

    const parents =
      folder.getParents();

    while (parents.hasNext()) {
      parentQueue.push(
        parents.next()
      );
    }

  }

  if (!qrFolderInsideSystem) {
    throw new Error(
      "QR FOLDER OUTSIDE SYSTEM"
    );
  }

  if (qrFolder.isTrashed()) {
    throw new Error(
      "QR FOLDER IS TRASHED"
    );
  }


  // ---- 7. SEDIAKAN PEMBOLEH UBAH ----

  let correctFile = null;
  let wrongFile = null;
  let wrongFolder = null;

  let correctFileCreated = false;
  let wrongFileCreated = false;
  let wrongFolderCreated = false;

  let correctFileCleaned = false;
  let wrongFileCleaned = false;
  let wrongFolderCleaned = false;

  let testPassed = false;
  let testError = null;

  const uniqueSuffix =
    Utilities.getUuid().slice(0, 8);

  const wrongFolderName =
    "QR_POLAROID_TEST_375_" +
    uniqueSuffix;

  const correctFileName =
    "test_correct_slot_" +
    uniqueSuffix + ".txt";

  const wrongFileName =
    "test_wrong_slot_" +
    uniqueSuffix + ".txt";


  // ---- 8. MULAKAN UJIAN ----

  try {

    // ---- 9. CIPTA FAIL DALAM MEJA 01 ----

    correctFile =
      qrFolder.createFile(
        correctFileName,
        "QR Polaroid test 3.75 only.",
        MimeType.PLAIN_TEXT
      );

    correctFileCreated = true;


    // ---- 10. CIPTA FOLDER UJIAN LAIN ----

    wrongFolder =
      rootFolder.createFolder(
        wrongFolderName
      );

    wrongFolderCreated = true;


    // ---- 11. CIPTA FAIL DALAM FOLDER LAIN ----

    wrongFile =
      wrongFolder.createFile(
        wrongFileName,
        "QR Polaroid wrong slot test.",
        MimeType.PLAIN_TEXT
      );

    wrongFileCreated = true;


    // ---- 12. UJI FAIL BETUL ----

    const correctResult =
      verifyDriveFileQrSlotLocation_(
        correctFile.getId(),
        qrId
      );


    // ---- 13. UJI FAIL SALAH ----

    const wrongResult =
      verifyDriveFileQrSlotLocation_(
        wrongFile.getId(),
        qrId
      );


    // ---- 14. SAHKAN FAIL BETUL ----

    const correctFolderVerified =
      correctResult.status === "SUCCESS" &&
      correctResult.code ===
        "QR_FOLDER_VERIFIED" &&
      correctResult.verified === true &&
      correctResult.correct_qr_folder === true;


    // ---- 15. SAHKAN FAIL SALAH ----

    const wrongFolderRejected =
      wrongResult.status === "SUCCESS" &&
      wrongResult.code ===
        "WRONG_QR_FOLDER" &&
      wrongResult.verified === false &&
      wrongResult.correct_qr_folder === false;


    // ---- 16. SAHKAN READ ONLY ----

    const verificationReadOnly =
      [correctResult, wrongResult].every(
        result =>
          result.records_changed === false &&
          result.drive_changed === false
      );


    // ---- 17. SAHKAN TIADA DATA SENSITIF ----

    const noSensitiveFields =
      [correctResult, wrongResult].every(
        result =>
          !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
            result,
            "drive_file_id"
          ) &&
          !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
            result,
            "qr_token"
          ) &&
          !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
            result,
            "drive_folder_id"
          )
      );


    // ---- 18. SEMAK DATABASE ----

    const qrDuring = JSON.stringify(
      qrSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
    );

    const uploadsDuring = JSON.stringify(
      uploadsSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
    );

    const quotaDuring = JSON.stringify(
      quotaSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
    );


    // ---- 19. RUMUSAN UJIAN ----

    const summary = {

      correct_file_created:
        correctFileCreated,

      wrong_folder_created:
        wrongFolderCreated,

      wrong_file_created:
        wrongFileCreated,

      correct_folder_verified:
        correctFolderVerified,

      wrong_folder_rejected:
        wrongFolderRejected,

      verification_read_only:
        verificationReadOnly,

      no_sensitive_fields:
        noSensitiveFields,

      qr_slots_unchanged:
        qrBefore === qrDuring,

      uploads_unchanged:
        uploadsBefore === uploadsDuring,

      quota_unchanged:
        quotaBefore === quotaDuring

    };


    // ---- 20. PAPARKAN LOG ----

    Logger.log(
      "QR SLOT REAL DRIVE LOCATION TEST:"
    );

    Logger.log(
      JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
    );


    // ---- 21. SAHKAN UJIAN ----

    testPassed =
      Object.values(summary).every(
        value => value === true
      );

    if (!testPassed) {
      throw new Error(
        "QR SLOT REAL DRIVE LOCATION TEST FAILED"
      );
    }

  } catch (error) {

    testError = error;

  } finally {

    // ---- 22. CLEANUP FAIL MEJA 01 ----

    if (correctFileCreated && correctFile) {

      try {

        const parents =
          correctFile.getParents();

        let parentMatches = false;

        while (parents.hasNext()) {

          if (
            parents.next().getId() ===
            qrFolderId
          ) {
            parentMatches = true;
          }

        }

        if (
          correctFile.getName() ===
            correctFileName &&
          parentMatches
        ) {

          correctFile.setTrashed(true);

          correctFileCleaned = true;

        }

      } catch (cleanupError) {

        Logger.log(
          "WARNING: CORRECT TEST FILE CLEANUP FAILED"
        );

      }

    }


    // ---- 23. CLEANUP FAIL SALAH ----

    if (wrongFileCreated && wrongFile) {

      try {

        const parents =
          wrongFile.getParents();

        let parentMatches = false;

        while (parents.hasNext()) {

          if (
            parents.next().getId() ===
            wrongFolder.getId()
          ) {
            parentMatches = true;
          }

        }

        if (
          wrongFile.getName() ===
            wrongFileName &&
          parentMatches
        ) {

          wrongFile.setTrashed(true);

          wrongFileCleaned = true;

        }

      } catch (cleanupError) {

        Logger.log(
          "WARNING: WRONG TEST FILE CLEANUP FAILED"
        );

      }

    }


    // ---- 24. CLEANUP FOLDER SALAH ----

    if (
      wrongFolderCreated &&
      wrongFolder &&
      wrongFileCleaned
    ) {

      try {

        const parents =
          wrongFolder.getParents();

        let parentMatches = false;

        while (parents.hasNext()) {

          if (
            parents.next().getId() ===
            rootFolderId
          ) {
            parentMatches = true;
          }

        }

        if (
          wrongFolder.getName() ===
            wrongFolderName &&
          parentMatches
        ) {

          wrongFolder.setTrashed(true);

          wrongFolderCleaned = true;

        }

      } catch (cleanupError) {

        Logger.log(
          "WARNING: WRONG TEST FOLDER CLEANUP FAILED"
        );

      }

    }

  }


  // ---- 25. SAHKAN DATABASE DIPULIHKAN ----

  const qrAfter = JSON.stringify(
    qrSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const uploadsAfter = JSON.stringify(
    uploadsSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const quotaAfter = JSON.stringify(
    quotaSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 26. SAHKAN CLEANUP ----

  const cleanupCompleted =
    correctFileCleaned &&
    wrongFileCleaned &&
    wrongFolderCleaned;


  // ---- 27. LOG CLEANUP ----

  Logger.log(
    "QR SLOT REAL DRIVE TEST CLEANUP:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify({

      test_passed:
        testPassed,

      cleanup_completed:
        cleanupCompleted,

      qr_slots_restored:
        qrBefore === qrAfter,

      uploads_restored:
        uploadsBefore === uploadsAfter,

      quota_restored:
        quotaBefore === quotaAfter

    }, null, 2)
  );


  // ---- 28. TANGANI RALAT ----

  if (testError) {
    throw testError;
  }


  // ---- 29. SAHKAN KEPUTUSAN AKHIR ----

  if (
    !testPassed ||
    !cleanupCompleted ||
    qrBefore !== qrAfter ||
    uploadsBefore !== uploadsAfter ||
    quotaBefore !== quotaAfter
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "QR SLOT REAL DRIVE TEST OR CLEANUP FAILED"
    );
  }


  Logger.log(
    "QR SLOT REAL DRIVE LOCATION TEST PASSED"
  );

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.76
   UPLOAD OWNERSHIP CHAIN VERIFICATION

   TUJUAN:
   - Sahkan hubungan UPLOADS.
   - Sahkan QR Slot milik event.
   - Sahkan cycle milik QR Slot.
   - Pastikan event wujud.
   - Jangan ubah database.
   - Jangan ubah Google Drive.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - READ ONLY.
   - PRIVATE BACKEND ONLY.
   - Tiada recovery automatik.
   - Tiada perubahan kuota.
   - Jangan dedahkan kepada doGet/doPost.

   NOTA:
   Pengesahan hubungan rekod
   bukan pengesahan fail gambar.
============================================ */


// ---- 1. FUNGSI PENGESAHAN HUBUNGAN ----

function verifyUploadOwnershipChain_(
  uploadRecord
) {

  // ---- 2. SAHKAN INPUT ----

  if (
    !uploadRecord ||
    typeof uploadRecord !== "object" ||
    Array.isArray(uploadRecord)
  ) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "INVALID_UPLOAD_RECORD",
      verified: false,
      records_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 3. DAPATKAN IDENTITI ----

  const eventId =
    uploadRecord.event_id;

  const qrId =
    uploadRecord.qr_id;

  const cycleId =
    uploadRecord.cycle_id;

  if (
    typeof eventId !== "string" ||
    eventId.trim() === "" ||
    typeof qrId !== "string" ||
    qrId.trim() === "" ||
    typeof cycleId !== "string" ||
    cycleId.trim() === ""
  ) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "INVALID_OWNERSHIP_IDENTIFIERS",
      verified: false,
      records_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 4. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "DATABASE_NOT_CONFIGURED",
      verified: false,
      records_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  let eventsSheet;
  let qrSheet;
  let cyclesSheet;

  try {

    const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
      spreadsheetId
    );

    eventsSheet =
      ss.getSheetByName("EVENTS");

    qrSheet =
      ss.getSheetByName("QR_SLOTS");

    cyclesSheet =
      ss.getSheetByName("QUOTA_CYCLES");

    if (
      !eventsSheet ||
      !qrSheet ||
      !cyclesSheet
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "REQUIRED_SHEETS_NOT_FOUND"
      );
    }

  } catch (error) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "DATABASE_READ_ERROR",
      verified: false,
      records_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 5. BACA REKOD ----

  let events;
  let qrSlots;
  let cycles;

  try {

    events =
      eventsSheet.getDataRange()
        .getValues();

    qrSlots =
      qrSheet.getDataRange()
        .getValues();

    cycles =
      cyclesSheet.getDataRange()
        .getValues();

  } catch (error) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "DATABASE_READ_ERROR",
      verified: false,
      records_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 6. SAHKAN HEADER PENTING ----

  const headersValid =
    events[0][0] === "event_id" &&
    events[0][14] === "deletion_status" &&
    qrSlots[0][0] === "qr_id" &&
    qrSlots[0][1] === "event_id" &&
    qrSlots[0][17] === "deletion_status" &&
    cycles[0][0] === "cycle_id" &&
    cycles[0][1] === "event_id" &&
    cycles[0][2] === "qr_id";

  if (!headersValid) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "OWNERSHIP_HEADER_MISMATCH",
      verified: false,
      records_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 7. CARI EVENT ----

  const eventMatches =
    events.slice(1).filter(
      row => row[0] === eventId
    );

  if (eventMatches.length !== 1) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code:
        eventMatches.length === 0
          ? "EVENT_NOT_FOUND"
          : "DUPLICATE_EVENT",
      verified: false,
      records_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 8. CARI QR SLOT ----

  const qrMatches =
    qrSlots.slice(1).filter(
      row => row[0] === qrId
    );

  if (qrMatches.length !== 1) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code:
        qrMatches.length === 0
          ? "QR_SLOT_NOT_FOUND"
          : "DUPLICATE_QR_SLOT",
      verified: false,
      records_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 9. CARI QUOTA CYCLE ----

  const cycleMatches =
    cycles.slice(1).filter(
      row => row[0] === cycleId
    );

  if (cycleMatches.length !== 1) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code:
        cycleMatches.length === 0
          ? "CYCLE_NOT_FOUND"
          : "DUPLICATE_CYCLE",
      verified: false,
      records_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 10. DAPATKAN REKOD ----

  const eventRecord =
    eventMatches[0];

  const qrRecord =
    qrMatches[0];

  const cycleRecord =
    cycleMatches[0];


  // ---- 11. SAHKAN STATUS AKTIF ----

  if (
    eventRecord[14] !== "ACTIVE" ||
    qrRecord[17] !== "ACTIVE"
  ) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "OWNERSHIP_RECORD_DELETED",
      verified: false,
      records_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 12. SAHKAN QR MILIK EVENT ----

  if (qrRecord[1] !== eventId) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "QR_EVENT_MISMATCH",
      verified: false,
      records_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 13. SAHKAN CYCLE MILIK EVENT ----

  if (cycleRecord[1] !== eventId) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "CYCLE_EVENT_MISMATCH",
      verified: false,
      records_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 14. SAHKAN CYCLE MILIK QR ----

  if (cycleRecord[2] !== qrId) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "CYCLE_QR_MISMATCH",
      verified: false,
      records_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 15. HUBUNGAN DISAHKAN ----

  return {
    status: "SUCCESS",
    code: "UPLOAD_OWNERSHIP_VERIFIED",
    verified: true,
    records_changed: false,
    quota_changed: false
  };

}


/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.76
   MANUAL TEST - OWNERSHIP CHAIN

   Ujian:
   - Input tidak sah.
   - Hubungan sebenar Meja 01.
   - Event ID salah.
   - QR ID salah.
   - Cycle ID salah.
   - Database tidak berubah.

   Tiada rekod ujian disimpan.
============================================ */


function testVerifyUploadOwnershipChain_() {

  // ---- 16. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error(
      "SPREADSHEET_ID NOT CONFIGURED"
    );
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
    spreadsheetId
  );

  const eventsSheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("EVENTS");

  const qrSheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("QR_SLOTS");

  const cyclesSheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("QUOTA_CYCLES");

  const uploadsSheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("UPLOADS");

  if (
    !eventsSheet ||
    !qrSheet ||
    !cyclesSheet ||
    !uploadsSheet
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "REQUIRED SHEETS NOT FOUND"
    );
  }


  // ---- 17. SIMPAN KEADAAN ASAL ----

  const eventsBefore = JSON.stringify(
    eventsSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const qrBefore = JSON.stringify(
    qrSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const cyclesBefore = JSON.stringify(
    cyclesSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const uploadsBefore = JSON.stringify(
    uploadsSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 18. DAPATKAN MEJA 01 ----

  const qrRows =
    qrSheet.getDataRange()
      .getValues()
      .slice(1);

  const qrMatches =
    qrRows.filter(
      row =>
        row[2] === "Meja 01" &&
        row[17] === "ACTIVE"
    );

  if (qrMatches.length !== 1) {
    throw new Error(
      "MEJA 01 NOT FOUND OR DUPLICATED"
    );
  }

  const qrRecord =
    qrMatches[0];

  const qrId =
    qrRecord[0];

  const eventId =
    qrRecord[1];

  const cycleId =
    qrRecord[6];


  // ---- 19. SAHKAN CYCLE ID ----

  if (!cycleId) {
    throw new Error(
      "CURRENT CYCLE NOT CONFIGURED"
    );
  }


  // ---- 20. BINA REKOD SIMULASI ----

  const validRecord = {

    event_id: eventId,

    qr_id: qrId,

    cycle_id: cycleId

  };


  // ---- 21. UJI HUBUNGAN BETUL ----

  const validResult =
    verifyUploadOwnershipChain_(
      validRecord
    );


  // ---- 22. UJI INPUT TIDAK SAH ----

  const invalidResult =
    verifyUploadOwnershipChain_(
      null
    );


  // ---- 23. UJI EVENT SALAH ----

  const wrongEventResult =
    verifyUploadOwnershipChain_({

      ...validRecord,

      event_id:
        "SIM_EVENT_NOT_FOUND"

    });


  // ---- 24. UJI QR SALAH ----

  const wrongQrResult =
    verifyUploadOwnershipChain_({

      ...validRecord,

      qr_id:
        "SIM_QR_NOT_FOUND"

    });


  // ---- 25. UJI CYCLE SALAH ----

  const wrongCycleResult =
    verifyUploadOwnershipChain_({

      ...validRecord,

      cycle_id:
        "SIM_CYCLE_NOT_FOUND"

    });


  // ---- 26. SAHKAN KEPUTUSAN ----

  const validOwnershipVerified =
    validResult.status === "SUCCESS" &&
    validResult.code ===
      "UPLOAD_OWNERSHIP_VERIFIED" &&
    validResult.verified === true;


  const invalidInputRejected =
    invalidResult.status === "REJECTED" &&
    invalidResult.code ===
      "INVALID_UPLOAD_RECORD";


  const wrongEventRejected =
    wrongEventResult.status === "REJECTED" &&
    wrongEventResult.code ===
      "EVENT_NOT_FOUND";


  const wrongQrRejected =
    wrongQrResult.status === "REJECTED" &&
    wrongQrResult.code ===
      "QR_SLOT_NOT_FOUND";


  const wrongCycleRejected =
    wrongCycleResult.status === "REJECTED" &&
    wrongCycleResult.code ===
      "CYCLE_NOT_FOUND";


  // ---- 27. SAHKAN READ ONLY ----

  const results = [
    validResult,
    invalidResult,
    wrongEventResult,
    wrongQrResult,
    wrongCycleResult
  ];

  const readOnlyFlagsCorrect =
    results.every(
      result =>
        result.records_changed === false &&
        result.quota_changed === false
    );


  // ---- 28. SEMAK DATABASE ----

  const eventsAfter = JSON.stringify(
    eventsSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const qrAfter = JSON.stringify(
    qrSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const cyclesAfter = JSON.stringify(
    cyclesSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const uploadsAfter = JSON.stringify(
    uploadsSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 29. RUMUSAN UJIAN ----

  const summary = {

    valid_ownership_verified:
      validOwnershipVerified,

    invalid_input_rejected:
      invalidInputRejected,

    wrong_event_rejected:
      wrongEventRejected,

    wrong_qr_rejected:
      wrongQrRejected,

    wrong_cycle_rejected:
      wrongCycleRejected,

    read_only_flags_correct:
      readOnlyFlagsCorrect,

    events_unchanged:
      eventsBefore === eventsAfter,

    qr_slots_unchanged:
      qrBefore === qrAfter,

    quota_cycles_unchanged:
      cyclesBefore === cyclesAfter,

    uploads_unchanged:
      uploadsBefore === uploadsAfter

  };


  // ---- 30. PAPARKAN LOG SELAMAT ----

  Logger.log(
    "UPLOAD OWNERSHIP CHAIN TEST:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
  );


  // ---- 31. SAHKAN SEMUA UJIAN ----

  const passed =
    Object.values(summary).every(
      value => value === true
    );

  if (!passed) {
    throw new Error(
      "UPLOAD OWNERSHIP CHAIN TEST FAILED"
    );
  }

  Logger.log(
    "UPLOAD OWNERSHIP CHAIN TEST PASSED"
  );

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.77
   CURRENT QUOTA CYCLE VERIFICATION

   TUJUAN:
   - Semak current_cycle_id.
   - Semak cycle_status ACTIVE.
   - Semak hubungan cycle dengan QR.
   - Semak hubungan cycle dengan event.
   - Bezakan cycle semasa dan lama.
   - Jangan ubah Google Sheets.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - READ ONLY.
   - PRIVATE BACKEND ONLY.
   - Tiada perubahan kuota.
   - Tiada recovery automatik.
   - Jangan dedahkan melalui doGet/doPost.

   NOTA:
   Cycle lama mungkin rekod sejarah
   yang sah. Jangan padam automatik.
============================================ */


// ---- 1. FUNGSI PENGESAHAN CYCLE ----

function verifyUploadCurrentCycle_(
  uploadRecord
) {

  // ---- 2. SAHKAN INPUT ----

  if (
    !uploadRecord ||
    typeof uploadRecord !== "object" ||
    Array.isArray(uploadRecord)
  ) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "INVALID_UPLOAD_RECORD",
      verified: false,
      records_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 3. DAPATKAN IDENTITI ----

  const eventId =
    uploadRecord.event_id;

  const qrId =
    uploadRecord.qr_id;

  const cycleId =
    uploadRecord.cycle_id;

  if (
    typeof eventId !== "string" ||
    eventId.trim() === "" ||
    typeof qrId !== "string" ||
    qrId.trim() === "" ||
    typeof cycleId !== "string" ||
    cycleId.trim() === ""
  ) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "INVALID_CYCLE_IDENTIFIERS",
      verified: false,
      records_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 4. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "DATABASE_NOT_CONFIGURED",
      verified: false,
      records_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  let qrSheet;
  let cycleSheet;

  try {

    const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
      spreadsheetId
    );

    qrSheet =
      ss.getSheetByName("QR_SLOTS");

    cycleSheet =
      ss.getSheetByName("QUOTA_CYCLES");

    if (!qrSheet || !cycleSheet) {
      throw new Error(
        "REQUIRED_SHEETS_NOT_FOUND"
      );
    }

  } catch (error) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "DATABASE_READ_ERROR",
      verified: false,
      records_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 5. BACA REKOD ----

  let qrRows;
  let cycleRows;

  try {

    qrRows =
      qrSheet.getDataRange()
        .getValues();

    cycleRows =
      cycleSheet.getDataRange()
        .getValues();

  } catch (error) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "DATABASE_READ_ERROR",
      verified: false,
      records_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 6. SAHKAN HEADER ----

  const headersValid =
    qrRows[0][0] === "qr_id" &&
    qrRows[0][1] === "event_id" &&
    qrRows[0][6] === "current_cycle_id" &&
    qrRows[0][17] === "deletion_status" &&
    cycleRows[0][0] === "cycle_id" &&
    cycleRows[0][1] === "event_id" &&
    cycleRows[0][2] === "qr_id" &&
    cycleRows[0][5] === "cycle_status";

  if (!headersValid) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "CYCLE_HEADER_MISMATCH",
      verified: false,
      records_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 7. CARI QR SLOT ----

  const qrMatches =
    qrRows.slice(1).filter(
      row => row[0] === qrId
    );

  if (qrMatches.length !== 1) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code:
        qrMatches.length === 0
          ? "QR_SLOT_NOT_FOUND"
          : "DUPLICATE_QR_SLOT",
      verified: false,
      records_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 8. CARI CYCLE ----

  const cycleMatches =
    cycleRows.slice(1).filter(
      row => row[0] === cycleId
    );

  if (cycleMatches.length !== 1) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code:
        cycleMatches.length === 0
          ? "CYCLE_NOT_FOUND"
          : "DUPLICATE_CYCLE",
      verified: false,
      records_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 9. DAPATKAN REKOD ----

  const qrRecord =
    qrMatches[0];

  const cycleRecord =
    cycleMatches[0];


  // ---- 10. SEMAK DELETION STATUS ----

  if (qrRecord[17] !== "ACTIVE") {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "QR_SLOT_DELETED",
      verified: false,
      records_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 11. SAHKAN HUBUNGAN EVENT ----

  if (
    qrRecord[1] !== eventId ||
    cycleRecord[1] !== eventId
  ) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "CYCLE_EVENT_MISMATCH",
      verified: false,
      records_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 12. SAHKAN HUBUNGAN QR ----

  if (cycleRecord[2] !== qrId) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "CYCLE_QR_MISMATCH",
      verified: false,
      records_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 13. SAHKAN CURRENT CYCLE ----

  if (qrRecord[6] !== cycleId) {

    return {
      status: "SUCCESS",
      code: "NOT_CURRENT_CYCLE",
      verified: false,
      records_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 14. SAHKAN STATUS ACTIVE ----

  if (cycleRecord[5] !== "ACTIVE") {

    return {
      status: "SUCCESS",
      code: "CYCLE_NOT_ACTIVE",
      verified: false,
      records_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 15. CURRENT CYCLE DISAHKAN ----

  return {
    status: "SUCCESS",
    code: "CURRENT_CYCLE_VERIFIED",
    verified: true,
    records_changed: false,
    quota_changed: false
  };

}


/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.77
   MANUAL TEST - CURRENT CYCLE

   Ujian:
   - Current cycle sebenar Meja 01.
   - Input tidak sah.
   - QR ID tidak wujud.
   - Cycle ID tidak wujud.
   - Database tidak berubah.

   Tiada rekod sementara dicipta.
============================================ */


function testVerifyUploadCurrentCycle_() {

  // ---- 16. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error(
      "SPREADSHEET_ID NOT CONFIGURED"
    );
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
    spreadsheetId
  );

  const qrSheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("QR_SLOTS");

  const cycleSheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("QUOTA_CYCLES");

  const uploadsSheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("UPLOADS");

  if (
    !qrSheet ||
    !cycleSheet ||
    !uploadsSheet
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "REQUIRED SHEETS NOT FOUND"
    );
  }


  // ---- 17. SIMPAN KEADAAN ASAL ----

  const qrBefore = JSON.stringify(
    qrSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const cyclesBefore = JSON.stringify(
    cycleSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const uploadsBefore = JSON.stringify(
    uploadsSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 18. CARI MEJA 01 ----

  const qrMatches =
    qrSheet.getDataRange()
      .getValues()
      .slice(1)
      .filter(
        row =>
          row[2] === "Meja 01" &&
          row[17] === "ACTIVE"
      );

  if (qrMatches.length !== 1) {
    throw new Error(
      "MEJA 01 NOT FOUND OR DUPLICATED"
    );
  }

  const qrRecord =
    qrMatches[0];


  // ---- 19. BINA REKOD SIMULASI ----

  const validRecord = {

    event_id:
      qrRecord[1],

    qr_id:
      qrRecord[0],

    cycle_id:
      qrRecord[6]

  };


  // ---- 20. UJI CURRENT CYCLE ----

  const validResult =
    verifyUploadCurrentCycle_(
      validRecord
    );


  // ---- 21. UJI INPUT TIDAK SAH ----

  const invalidResult =
    verifyUploadCurrentCycle_(
      null
    );


  // ---- 22. UJI QR TIDAK WUJUD ----

  const missingQrResult =
    verifyUploadCurrentCycle_({

      ...validRecord,

      qr_id:
        "SIM_QR_NOT_FOUND"

    });


  // ---- 23. UJI CYCLE TIDAK WUJUD ----

  const missingCycleResult =
    verifyUploadCurrentCycle_({

      ...validRecord,

      cycle_id:
        "SIM_CYCLE_NOT_FOUND"

    });


  // ---- 24. SAHKAN KEPUTUSAN ----

  const validCycleVerified =
    validResult.status === "SUCCESS" &&
    validResult.code ===
      "CURRENT_CYCLE_VERIFIED" &&
    validResult.verified === true;


  const invalidInputRejected =
    invalidResult.status === "REJECTED" &&
    invalidResult.code ===
      "INVALID_UPLOAD_RECORD";


  const missingQrRejected =
    missingQrResult.status === "REJECTED" &&
    missingQrResult.code ===
      "QR_SLOT_NOT_FOUND";


  const missingCycleRejected =
    missingCycleResult.status === "REJECTED" &&
    missingCycleResult.code ===
      "CYCLE_NOT_FOUND";


  // ---- 25. SAHKAN READ ONLY ----

  const results = [
    validResult,
    invalidResult,
    missingQrResult,
    missingCycleResult
  ];

  const readOnlyFlagsCorrect =
    results.every(
      result =>
        result.records_changed === false &&
        result.quota_changed === false
    );


  // ---- 26. SEMAK DATABASE ----

  const qrAfter = JSON.stringify(
    qrSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const cyclesAfter = JSON.stringify(
    cycleSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const uploadsAfter = JSON.stringify(
    uploadsSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 27. RUMUSAN UJIAN ----

  const summary = {

    valid_cycle_verified:
      validCycleVerified,

    invalid_input_rejected:
      invalidInputRejected,

    missing_qr_rejected:
      missingQrRejected,

    missing_cycle_rejected:
      missingCycleRejected,

    read_only_flags_correct:
      readOnlyFlagsCorrect,

    qr_slots_unchanged:
      qrBefore === qrAfter,

    quota_cycles_unchanged:
      cyclesBefore === cyclesAfter,

    uploads_unchanged:
      uploadsBefore === uploadsAfter

  };


  // ---- 28. PAPARKAN LOG SELAMAT ----

  Logger.log(
    "CURRENT QUOTA CYCLE TEST:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
  );


  // ---- 29. SAHKAN SEMUA UJIAN ----

  const passed =
    Object.values(summary).every(
      value => value === true
    );

  if (!passed) {
    throw new Error(
      "CURRENT QUOTA CYCLE TEST FAILED"
    );
  }

  Logger.log(
    "CURRENT QUOTA CYCLE TEST PASSED"
  );

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.78
   CURRENT CYCLE EDGE CASE TEST

   TUJUAN:
   - Uji NOT_CURRENT_CYCLE.
   - Uji CYCLE_NOT_ACTIVE.
   - Jangan ubah Cycle 1 sebenar.
   - Gunakan cycle sementara sahaja.
   - Bersihkan rekod selepas ujian.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - MANUAL TEST ONLY.
   - Tiada perubahan UPLOADS.
   - Tiada perubahan QR_SLOTS.
   - Tiada perubahan kuota sebenar.
   - Jangan dedahkan melalui doGet/doPost.

   PENTING:
   Ujian memerlukan QUOTA_CYCLES
   mempunyai hanya rekod sedia ada
   yang dikenali.

   Jika cleanup gagal:
   JANGAN ulang ujian dahulu.
============================================ */


function testVerifyUploadCurrentCycleEdgeCases_() {

  // ---- 1. BACA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error(
      "SPREADSHEET_ID NOT CONFIGURED"
    );
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
    spreadsheetId
  );

  const qrSheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("QR_SLOTS");

  const cycleSheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("QUOTA_CYCLES");

  const uploadsSheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("UPLOADS");

  if (
    !qrSheet ||
    !cycleSheet ||
    !uploadsSheet
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "REQUIRED SHEETS NOT FOUND"
    );
  }


  // ---- 2. SIMPAN KEADAAN ASAL ----

  const qrBefore = JSON.stringify(
    qrSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const cyclesBefore = JSON.stringify(
    cycleSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const uploadsBefore = JSON.stringify(
    uploadsSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 3. CARI MEJA 01 ----

  const qrMatches =
    qrSheet.getDataRange()
      .getValues()
      .slice(1)
      .filter(
        row =>
          row[2] === "Meja 01" &&
          row[17] === "ACTIVE"
      );

  if (qrMatches.length !== 1) {
    throw new Error(
      "MEJA 01 NOT FOUND OR DUPLICATED"
    );
  }

  const qrRecord =
    qrMatches[0];

  const qrId =
    qrRecord[0];

  const eventId =
    qrRecord[1];

  const currentCycleId =
    qrRecord[6];


  // ---- 4. SAHKAN CURRENT CYCLE ----

  const cycleRows =
    cycleSheet.getDataRange()
      .getValues();

  const currentMatches =
    cycleRows.slice(1).filter(
      row => row[0] === currentCycleId
    );

  if (
    currentMatches.length !== 1 ||
    currentMatches[0][5] !== "ACTIVE"
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "CURRENT CYCLE NOT ACTIVE"
    );
  }


  // ---- 5. SEDIAKAN CYCLE SEMENTARA ----

  const temporaryCycleId =
    Utilities.getUuid();

  const temporaryCycleNumber =
    999999;

  const now =
    new Date().toISOString();


  // ---- 6. BINA REKOD 13 KOLOM ----

  const temporaryCycleRow = [

    temporaryCycleId,  // A cycle_id
    eventId,           // B event_id
    qrId,              // C qr_id
    temporaryCycleNumber, // D cycle_number
    5,                 // E max_uploads
    "ACTIVE",          // F cycle_status
    now,               // G started_at
    "",                // H ended_at
    now,               // I created_at
    "INTERNAL_TEST",   // J created_by
    "",                // K closed_by
    "",                // L reset_reason
    0                  // M successful_uploads

  ];


  // ---- 7. SAHKAN HEADER ----

  const expectedHeaders = [
    "cycle_id",
    "event_id",
    "qr_id",
    "cycle_number",
    "max_uploads",
    "cycle_status",
    "started_at",
    "ended_at",
    "created_at",
    "created_by",
    "closed_by",
    "reset_reason",
    "successful_uploads"
  ];

  const headers =
    cycleRows[0];

  const headersValid =
    headers.length === 13 &&
    expectedHeaders.every(
      (header, index) =>
        headers[index] === header
    );

  if (!headersValid) {
    throw new Error(
      "QUOTA_CYCLES HEADER MISMATCH"
    );
  }


  // ---- 8. PASTIKAN ID BELUM WUJUD ----

  const duplicateId =
    cycleRows.slice(1).some(
      row => row[0] === temporaryCycleId
    );

  if (duplicateId) {
    throw new Error(
      "TEMPORARY CYCLE ID CONFLICT"
    );
  }


  // ---- 9. SEDIAKAN PEMBOLEH UBAH ----

  let temporaryRowNumber = null;
  let temporaryRowCreated = false;
  let temporaryRowCleaned = false;

  let testPassed = false;
  let testError = null;


  // ---- 10. MULAKAN UJIAN ----

  try {

    // ---- 11. TAMBAH CYCLE SEMENTARA ----

    temporaryRowNumber =
      cycleSheet.getLastRow() + 1;

    cycleSheet.getRange(
      temporaryRowNumber,
      1,
      1,
      13
    ).setValues([
      temporaryCycleRow
    ]);

    SpreadsheetApp.flush();

    temporaryRowCreated = true;


    // ---- 12. BINA INPUT UJIAN ----

    const testRecord = {

      event_id: eventId,

      qr_id: qrId,

      cycle_id:
        temporaryCycleId

    };


    // ---- 13. UJI CYCLE BUKAN CURRENT ----

    const oldCycleResult =
      verifyUploadCurrentCycle_(
        testRecord
      );


    // ---- 14. SAHKAN NOT_CURRENT_CYCLE ----

    const oldCycleRejected =
      oldCycleResult.status === "SUCCESS" &&
      oldCycleResult.code ===
        "NOT_CURRENT_CYCLE" &&
      oldCycleResult.verified === false;


    // ---- 15. TUKAR STATUS CYCLE SEMENTARA ----

    cycleSheet.getRange(
      temporaryRowNumber,
      6
    ).setValue("CLOSED");

    SpreadsheetApp.flush();


    // ---- 16. UJI STATUS CLOSED ----

    // Fungsi asal menyemak current cycle
    // sebelum status. Oleh itu, untuk
    // menguji CYCLE_NOT_ACTIVE,
    // kita perlu gunakan cycle yang
    // merupakan current cycle.
    //
    // Kita tidak akan mengubah
    // QR_SLOTS sebenar secara kekal.

    const originalCurrentCycle =
      qrSheet.getRange(
        qrSheet.getDataRange()
          .getValues()
          .findIndex(
            row => row[0] === qrId
          ) + 1,
        7
      ).getValue();


    // ---- 17. CARI BARIS QR ----

    const qrData =
      qrSheet.getDataRange()
        .getValues();

    const qrRowIndex =
      qrData.findIndex(
        (row, index) =>
          index > 0 &&
          row[0] === qrId
      );

    if (qrRowIndex < 1) {
      throw new Error(
        "QR ROW NOT FOUND"
      );
    }

    const qrRowNumber =
      qrRowIndex + 1;


    // ---- 18. UJI CLOSED CURRENT CYCLE ----

    // Perubahan sementara ini hanya
    // melibatkan current_cycle_id.
    // Nilai asal dipulihkan dalam finally.

    try {

      qrSheet.getRange(
        qrRowNumber,
        7
      ).setValue(
        temporaryCycleId
      );

      SpreadsheetApp.flush();

      const closedCycleResult =
        verifyUploadCurrentCycle_(
          testRecord
        );

      var closedCycleRejected =
        closedCycleResult.status === "SUCCESS" &&
        closedCycleResult.code ===
          "CYCLE_NOT_ACTIVE" &&
        closedCycleResult.verified === false;

    } finally {

      // ---- 19. PULIHKAN CURRENT CYCLE ----

      qrSheet.getRange(
        qrRowNumber,
        7
      ).setValue(
        originalCurrentCycle
      );

      SpreadsheetApp.flush();

    }


    // ---- 20. SAHKAN DATABASE ----

    const qrDuring = JSON.stringify(
      qrSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
    );

    const uploadsDuring = JSON.stringify(
      uploadsSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
    );


    // ---- 21. RUMUSAN UJIAN ----

    const summary = {

      temporary_cycle_created:
        temporaryRowCreated,

      old_cycle_rejected:
        oldCycleRejected,

      closed_cycle_rejected:
        closedCycleRejected,

      qr_slots_restored:
        qrBefore === qrDuring,

      uploads_unchanged:
        uploadsBefore === uploadsDuring

    };


    // ---- 22. PAPARKAN LOG ----

    Logger.log(
      "CURRENT CYCLE EDGE CASE TEST:"
    );

    Logger.log(
      JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
    );


    // ---- 23. SAHKAN UJIAN ----

    testPassed =
      Object.values(summary).every(
        value => value === true
      );

    if (!testPassed) {
      throw new Error(
        "CURRENT CYCLE EDGE CASE TEST FAILED"
      );
    }

  } catch (error) {

    testError = error;

  } finally {

    // ---- 24. BERSIHKAN CYCLE SEMENTARA ----

    if (
      temporaryRowCreated &&
      temporaryRowNumber
    ) {

      try {

        const storedId =
          cycleSheet.getRange(
            temporaryRowNumber,
            1
          ).getValue();

        if (
          storedId === temporaryCycleId
        ) {

          cycleSheet.deleteRow(
            temporaryRowNumber
          );

          SpreadsheetApp.flush();

          temporaryRowCleaned = true;

        }

      } catch (cleanupError) {

        Logger.log(
          "WARNING: TEMPORARY CYCLE CLEANUP FAILED"
        );

      }

    }

  }


  // ---- 25. SAHKAN KEADAAN AKHIR ----

  const qrAfter = JSON.stringify(
    qrSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const cyclesAfter = JSON.stringify(
    cycleSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const uploadsAfter = JSON.stringify(
    uploadsSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 26. LOG CLEANUP ----

  Logger.log(
    "CURRENT CYCLE EDGE CASE CLEANUP:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify({

      test_passed:
        testPassed,

      temporary_cycle_cleaned:
        temporaryRowCleaned,

      qr_slots_restored:
        qrBefore === qrAfter,

      quota_cycles_restored:
        cyclesBefore === cyclesAfter,

      uploads_restored:
        uploadsBefore === uploadsAfter

    }, null, 2)
  );


  // ---- 27. TANGANI RALAT ----

  if (testError) {
    throw testError;
  }


  // ---- 28. SAHKAN KEPUTUSAN AKHIR ----

  if (
    !testPassed ||
    !temporaryRowCleaned ||
    qrBefore !== qrAfter ||
    cyclesBefore !== cyclesAfter ||
    uploadsBefore !== uploadsAfter
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "CURRENT CYCLE EDGE CASE OR CLEANUP FAILED"
    );
  }


  Logger.log(
    "CURRENT CYCLE EDGE CASE TEST PASSED"
  );

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.79
   UPLOAD RECOVERY READINESS PRECHECK

   TUJUAN:
   - Gabungkan ownership verification.
   - Gabungkan current cycle verification.
   - Gabungkan Drive folder verification.
   - Hentikan proses jika semakan gagal.
   - Pulangkan keputusan yang selamat.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - READ ONLY.
   - PRIVATE BACKEND ONLY.
   - Tiada recovery sebenar.
   - Tiada perubahan kuota.
   - Tiada perubahan Google Drive.
   - Jangan dedahkan melalui doGet/doPost.

   PENTING:
   PRECHECK_PASSED bukan kebenaran
   untuk mengubah status UPLOADS.
============================================ */


// ---- 1. FUNGSI PENYELARAS ----

function verifyUploadRecoveryReadiness_(
  uploadRecord
) {

  // ---- 2. SAHKAN INPUT ----

  if (
    !uploadRecord ||
    typeof uploadRecord !== "object" ||
    Array.isArray(uploadRecord)
  ) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "INVALID_UPLOAD_RECORD",
      ready: false,
      recovery_allowed: false,
      records_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false,
      drive_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 3. SAHKAN IDENTITI ----

  const requiredFields = [
    "event_id",
    "qr_id",
    "cycle_id",
    "drive_file_id"
  ];

  const fieldsValid =
    requiredFields.every(
      field =>
        typeof uploadRecord[field] ===
          "string" &&
        uploadRecord[field].trim() !== ""
    );

  if (!fieldsValid) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "INCOMPLETE_UPLOAD_IDENTIFIERS",
      ready: false,
      recovery_allowed: false,
      records_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false,
      drive_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 4. SAHKAN OWNERSHIP ----

  const ownershipResult =
    verifyUploadOwnershipChain_(
      uploadRecord
    );

  if (
    ownershipResult.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
    ownershipResult.verified !== true
  ) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "OWNERSHIP_PRECHECK_FAILED",
      reason_code:
        ownershipResult.code ||
        "UNKNOWN_OWNERSHIP_ERROR",
      ready: false,
      recovery_allowed: false,
      records_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false,
      drive_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 5. SAHKAN CURRENT CYCLE ----

  const cycleResult =
    verifyUploadCurrentCycle_(
      uploadRecord
    );

  if (
    cycleResult.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
    cycleResult.verified !== true
  ) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "CURRENT_CYCLE_PRECHECK_FAILED",
      reason_code:
        cycleResult.code ||
        "UNKNOWN_CYCLE_ERROR",
      ready: false,
      recovery_allowed: false,
      records_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false,
      drive_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 6. SAHKAN LOKASI FAIL ----

  const driveResult =
    verifyDriveFileQrSlotLocation_(
      uploadRecord.drive_file_id,
      uploadRecord.qr_id
    );

  if (
    driveResult.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
    driveResult.verified !== true ||
    driveResult.correct_qr_folder !== true
  ) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "DRIVE_LOCATION_PRECHECK_FAILED",
      reason_code:
        driveResult.code ||
        "UNKNOWN_DRIVE_ERROR",
      ready: false,
      recovery_allowed: false,
      records_changed: false,
      quota_changed: false,
      drive_changed: false
    };

  }


  // ---- 7. SEMUA PRECHECK LULUS ----

  return {
    status: "SUCCESS",
    code: "RECOVERY_PRECHECK_PASSED",
    ready: true,
    recovery_allowed: false,
    ownership_verified: true,
    current_cycle_verified: true,
    drive_location_verified: true,
    records_changed: false,
    quota_changed: false,
    drive_changed: false
  };

}


/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 3.79
   MANUAL TEST - PRECHECK

   Ujian:
   - Input null.
   - Rekod tidak lengkap.
   - Event tidak wujud.
   - QR Slot tidak wujud.
   - Cycle tidak wujud.
   - Tiada perubahan database.

   Ujian positif dengan fail sebenar
   akan dibuat pada langkah berikutnya.
============================================ */


function testVerifyUploadRecoveryReadiness_() {

  // ---- 8. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error(
      "SPREADSHEET_ID NOT CONFIGURED"
    );
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
    spreadsheetId
  );

  const eventsSheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("EVENTS");

  const qrSheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("QR_SLOTS");

  const cyclesSheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("QUOTA_CYCLES");

  const uploadsSheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("UPLOADS");

  if (
    !eventsSheet ||
    !qrSheet ||
    !cyclesSheet ||
    !uploadsSheet
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "REQUIRED SHEETS NOT FOUND"
    );
  }


  // ---- 9. SIMPAN KEADAAN ASAL ----

  const eventsBefore = JSON.stringify(
    eventsSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const qrBefore = JSON.stringify(
    qrSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const cyclesBefore = JSON.stringify(
    cyclesSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const uploadsBefore = JSON.stringify(
    uploadsSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 10. DAPATKAN MEJA 01 ----

  const qrMatches =
    qrSheet.getDataRange()
      .getValues()
      .slice(1)
      .filter(
        row =>
          row[2] === "Meja 01" &&
          row[17] === "ACTIVE"
      );

  if (qrMatches.length !== 1) {
    throw new Error(
      "MEJA 01 NOT FOUND OR DUPLICATED"
    );
  }

  const qrRecord =
    qrMatches[0];


  // ---- 11. BINA REKOD SIMULASI ----

  const baseRecord = {

    event_id:
      qrRecord[1],

    qr_id:
      qrRecord[0],

    cycle_id:
      qrRecord[6],

    drive_file_id:
      "SIMULATED_FILE_ID"

  };


  // ---- 12. UJI INPUT NULL ----

  const invalidResult =
    verifyUploadRecoveryReadiness_(
      null
    );


  // ---- 13. UJI REKOD TIDAK LENGKAP ----

  const incompleteResult =
    verifyUploadRecoveryReadiness_({

      event_id:
        baseRecord.event_id,

      qr_id:
        baseRecord.qr_id

    });


  // ---- 14. UJI EVENT TIDAK WUJUD ----

  const wrongEventResult =
    verifyUploadRecoveryReadiness_({

      ...baseRecord,

      event_id:
        "SIM_EVENT_NOT_FOUND"

    });


  // ---- 15. UJI QR TIDAK WUJUD ----

  const wrongQrResult =
    verifyUploadRecoveryReadiness_({

      ...baseRecord,

      qr_id:
        "SIM_QR_NOT_FOUND"

    });


  // ---- 16. UJI CYCLE TIDAK WUJUD ----

  const wrongCycleResult =
    verifyUploadRecoveryReadiness_({

      ...baseRecord,

      cycle_id:
        "SIM_CYCLE_NOT_FOUND"

    });


  // ---- 17. SAHKAN KEPUTUSAN ----

  const invalidInputRejected =
    invalidResult.status === "REJECTED" &&
    invalidResult.code ===
      "INVALID_UPLOAD_RECORD";


  const incompleteRejected =
    incompleteResult.status === "REJECTED" &&
    incompleteResult.code ===
      "INCOMPLETE_UPLOAD_IDENTIFIERS";


  const wrongEventRejected =
    wrongEventResult.status === "REJECTED" &&
    wrongEventResult.code ===
      "OWNERSHIP_PRECHECK_FAILED" &&
    wrongEventResult.reason_code ===
      "EVENT_NOT_FOUND";


  const wrongQrRejected =
    wrongQrResult.status === "REJECTED" &&
    wrongQrResult.code ===
      "OWNERSHIP_PRECHECK_FAILED" &&
    wrongQrResult.reason_code ===
      "QR_SLOT_NOT_FOUND";


  const wrongCycleRejected =
    wrongCycleResult.status === "REJECTED" &&
    wrongCycleResult.code ===
      "OWNERSHIP_PRECHECK_FAILED" &&
    wrongCycleResult.reason_code ===
      "CYCLE_NOT_FOUND";


  // ---- 18. SAHKAN TIADA RECOVERY ----

  const results = [
    invalidResult,
    incompleteResult,
    wrongEventResult,
    wrongQrResult,
    wrongCycleResult
  ];

  const recoveryDisabled =
    results.every(
      result =>
        result.ready === false &&
        result.recovery_allowed === false
    );


  // ---- 19. SAHKAN READ ONLY ----

  const readOnlyFlagsCorrect =
    results.every(
      result =>
        result.records_changed === false &&
        result.quota_changed === false &&
        result.drive_changed === false
    );


  // ---- 20. SAHKAN TIADA DATA SENSITIF ----

  const noSensitiveFields =
    results.every(
      result =>
        !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
          result,
          "drive_file_id"
        ) &&
        !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
          result,
          "qr_token"
        ) &&
        !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
          result,
          "lease_token"
        )
    );


  // ---- 21. SEMAK DATABASE ----

  const eventsAfter = JSON.stringify(
    eventsSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const qrAfter = JSON.stringify(
    qrSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const cyclesAfter = JSON.stringify(
    cyclesSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );

  const uploadsAfter = JSON.stringify(
    uploadsSheet.getDataRange().getValues()
  );


  // ---- 22. RUMUSAN UJIAN ----

  const summary = {

    invalid_input_rejected:
      invalidInputRejected,

    incomplete_record_rejected:
      incompleteRejected,

    wrong_event_rejected:
      wrongEventRejected,

    wrong_qr_rejected:
      wrongQrRejected,

    wrong_cycle_rejected:
      wrongCycleRejected,

    recovery_disabled:
      recoveryDisabled,

    read_only_flags_correct:
      readOnlyFlagsCorrect,

    no_sensitive_fields:
      noSensitiveFields,

    events_unchanged:
      eventsBefore === eventsAfter,

    qr_slots_unchanged:
      qrBefore === qrAfter,

    quota_cycles_unchanged:
      cyclesBefore === cyclesAfter,

    uploads_unchanged:
      uploadsBefore === uploadsAfter

  };


  // ---- 23. PAPARKAN LOG SELAMAT ----

  Logger.log(
    "UPLOAD RECOVERY PRECHECK TEST:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
  );


  // ---- 24. SAHKAN SEMUA UJIAN ----

  const passed =
    Object.values(summary).every(
      value => value === true
    );

  if (!passed) {
    throw new Error(
      "UPLOAD RECOVERY PRECHECK TEST FAILED"
    );
  }

  Logger.log(
    "UPLOAD RECOVERY PRECHECK TEST PASSED"
