  // ---- 8. PEMBOLEH UBAH CLEANUP ----

  let testFile = null;
  let rowsCleaned = false;
  let fileCleaned = false;
  let testPassed = false;
  let testError = null;

  const checks = {};

  // ---- 9. MULAKAN UJIAN ----

  try {

    // ---- 10. CIPTA FAIL SEMENTARA ----

    testFile = folder.createFile(
      fileName,
      "Temporary integration test.",
      MimeType.PLAIN_TEXT
    );

    const fileId = testFile.getId();

    // ---- 11. CIPTA DUA REKOD ----

    uploads.getRange(2, 1, 2, 22)
      .setValues([
        makeRow(uploadA, fileId),
        makeRow(uploadB, "")
      ]);

    SpreadsheetApp.flush();

    // ---- 12. UJI LEASE AKTIF ----

    uploads.getRange(2, 8)
      .setValue(activeExpiry);

    SpreadsheetApp.flush();

    const active =
      assessStoredProcessingDriveRiskWithLock_(
        uploadA
      );

    checks.active_lease_detected =
      active.status === "SUCCESS" &&
      active.code ===
        "PROCESSING_LEASE_ACTIVE" &&
      active.lock_acquired === true;

    // ---- 13. UJI FAIL WUJUD ----

    uploads.getRange(2, 8)
      .setValue(expiredExpiry);

    SpreadsheetApp.flush();

    const exists =
      assessStoredProcessingDriveRiskWithLock_(
        uploadA
      );

    checks.existing_file_detected =
      exists.status === "SUCCESS" &&
      exists.code ===
        "PROCESSING_FILE_EXISTS_REVIEW" &&
      exists.file_verified === true &&
      exists.needs_review === true;

    // ---- 14. UJI FAIL BELUM DIPAUTKAN ----

    uploads.getRange(2, 12)
      .setValue("");

    SpreadsheetApp.flush();

    const unlinked =
      assessStoredProcessingDriveRiskWithLock_(
        uploadA
      );

    checks.unlinked_file_review =
      unlinked.status === "SUCCESS" &&
      unlinked.code ===
        "PROCESSING_FILE_UNLINKED_REVIEW" &&
      unlinked.needs_review === true;

    // ---- 15. UJI RUJUKAN BERGANDA ----

    uploads.getRange(2, 12)
      .setValue(fileId);

    uploads.getRange(3, 12)
      .setValue(fileId);

    SpreadsheetApp.flush();

    const duplicate =
      assessStoredProcessingDriveRiskWithLock_(
        uploadA
      );

    checks.duplicate_reference_blocked =
      duplicate.status === "SUCCESS" &&
      duplicate.code ===
        "PROCESSING_FILE_REFERENCE_UNSAFE_REVIEW" &&
      duplicate.file_verified === false;

    // ---- 16. SEMAK SEMUA HASIL ----

    const results = [
      active,
      exists,
      unlinked,
      duplicate
    ];

    checks.recovery_disabled =
      results.every(r =>
        r.recovery_allowed === false
      );

    checks.quota_release_disabled =
      results.every(r =>
        r.quota_release_allowed === false
      );

    checks.read_only_flags_correct =
      results.every(r =>
        r.records_changed === false &&
        r.quota_changed === false &&
        r.drive_changed === false
      );

    checks.no_sensitive_fields =
      results.every(r =>
        ![
          "upload_id",
          "drive_file_id",
          "lease_token",
          "qr_token",
          "idempotency_key"
        ].some(key =>
          Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
            r, key
          )
        )
      );

    // ---- 17. SEMAK LOCK DILEPASKAN ----

    const lock =
      LockService.getScriptLock();

    const acquired =
      lock.tryLock(1000);

    if (acquired) {
      lock.releaseLock();
    }

    checks.lock_released = acquired;

    // ---- 18. SEMAK TAB LAIN ----

    checks.events_unchanged =
      before.events === snapshot(events);

    checks.qr_slots_unchanged =
      before.qr === snapshot(qrSheet);

    checks.quota_cycles_unchanged =
      before.cycles === snapshot(cycles);

    Logger.log(
      "REAL PROCESSING DRIVE INTEGRATION:"
    );

    Logger.log(
      JSON.stringify(checks, null, 2)
    );

    testPassed =
      Object.values(checks).every(
        value => value === true
      );

    if (!testPassed) {
      throw new Error(
        "REAL PROCESSING DRIVE INTEGRATION FAILED"
      );
    }

  } catch (error) {

    testError = error;

  } finally {

    // ---- 19. CLEANUP REKOD UJIAN ----

    // Padam hanya apabila dua baris
    // benar-benar milik ujian ini.

    try {

      if (uploads.getLastRow() === 3) {

        const ids =
          uploads.getRange(2, 1, 2, 1)
            .getValues()
            .map(row => row[0]);

        if (
          ids[0] === uploadA &&
          ids[1] === uploadB
        ) {

          uploads.deleteRows(2, 2);
          SpreadsheetApp.flush();

          rowsCleaned = true;
        }
      }

    } catch (error) {

      Logger.log(
        "WARNING: UPLOAD CLEANUP FAILED"
      );
    }

    // ---- 20. CLEANUP FAIL UJIAN ----

    if (testFile) {

      try {

        const parents =
          testFile.getParents();

        let correctParent = false;

        while (parents.hasNext()) {
          if (
            parents.next().getId() === folderId
          ) {
            correctParent = true;
          }
        }

        if (
          testFile.getName() === fileName &&
          correctParent
        ) {

          testFile.setTrashed(true);
          fileCleaned = true;
        }

      } catch (error) {

        Logger.log(
          "WARNING: FILE CLEANUP FAILED"
        );
      }
    }
  }

  // ---- 21. SAHKAN CLEANUP ----

  const cleanup = {

    temporary_uploads_cleaned:
      rowsCleaned,

    temporary_file_cleaned:
      fileCleaned,

    uploads_restored:
      before.uploads === snapshot(uploads),

    events_restored:
      before.events === snapshot(events),

    qr_slots_restored:
      before.qr === snapshot(qrSheet),

    quota_cycles_restored:
      before.cycles === snapshot(cycles)

  };

  Logger.log(
    "REAL INTEGRATION CLEANUP:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify(cleanup, null, 2)
  );

  if (testError) {
    throw testError;
  }

  if (
    !testPassed ||
    !Object.values(cleanup).every(
      value => value === true
    )
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "REAL INTEGRATION OR CLEANUP FAILED"
    );
  }

  Logger.log(
    "REAL PROCESSING DRIVE INTEGRATION TEST PASSED"
  );
}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 4.03 - 4.06
   UPLOAD FLOW INTEGRATION READINESS

   TUJUAN:
   - Semak fungsi backend tersedia.
   - Semak tetapan sistem.
   - Semak struktur database.
   - Pastikan backend bersedia untuk
     integrasi upload peserta.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - READ ONLY.
   - Tidak membuat reservation.
   - Tidak menyimpan gambar.
   - Tidak mengubah kuota.
   - Tidak memaparkan ID atau token.
   - Jangan expose melalui doGet/doPost.
============================================ */


function testParticipantUploadIntegrationReadiness_() {

  // ---- 1. SENARAI FUNGSI DIPERLUKAN ----

  const requiredFunctions = {

    validateQrToken_:
      typeof validateQrToken_ === "function",

    getEventAvailability_:
      typeof getEventAvailability_ === "function",

    checkUploadEligibility_:
      typeof checkUploadEligibility_ === "function",

    validateUploadFile_:
      typeof validateUploadFile_ === "function",

    checkUploadIdempotency_:
      typeof checkUploadIdempotency_ === "function",

    getEffectiveUploadQuota_:
      typeof getEffectiveUploadQuota_ === "function",

    reserveUpload_:
      typeof reserveUpload_ === "function",

    startUploadProcessing_:
      typeof startUploadProcessing_ === "function",

    commitUploadProcessing_:
      typeof commitUploadProcessing_ === "function",

    assessStoredProcessingDriveRiskWithLock_:
      typeof assessStoredProcessingDriveRiskWithLock_
        === "function"

  };


  // ---- 2. SEMAK SCRIPT PROPERTIES ----

  const props =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  const spreadsheetId =
    props.getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  const rootFolderId =
    props.getProperty("ROOT_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID");

  const propertiesReady =
    Boolean(spreadsheetId && rootFolderId);


  // ---- 3. SEMAK DATABASE ----

  let databaseReady = false;
  let headersReady = false;
  let requiredSheetsReady = false;

  if (spreadsheetId) {

    try {

      const ss =
        SpreadsheetApp.openById(
          spreadsheetId
        );

      const expected = {

        EVENTS: 16,
        QR_SLOTS: 18,
        UPLOADS: 22,
        QUOTA_CYCLES: 13,
        SYSTEM_SETTINGS: 8,
        ADMIN_LOGS: 12

      };

      requiredSheetsReady =
        Object.keys(expected).every(
          name => Boolean(
            ss.getSheetByName(name)
          )
        );

      if (requiredSheetsReady) {

        headersReady =
          Object.keys(expected).every(
            name => {

              const sheet =
                ss.getSheetByName(name);

              const width =
                expected[name];

              const values =
                sheet.getRange(
                  1, 1, 1, width
                ).getValues()[0];

              return (
                values.length === width &&
                values.every(
                  value =>
                    typeof value === "string" &&
                    value.trim() !== ""
                )
              );

            }
          );

      }

      databaseReady =
        requiredSheetsReady &&
        headersReady;

    } catch (error) {

      databaseReady = false;

    }

  }


  // ---- 4. SEMAK FOLDER ROOT ----

  let rootFolderReady = false;

  if (rootFolderId) {

    try {

      const folder =
        DriveApp.getFolderById(
          rootFolderId
        );

      rootFolderReady =
        !folder.isTrashed();

    } catch (error) {

      rootFolderReady = false;

    }

  }


  // ---- 5. SEMAK KESEDIAAN FUNGSI ----

  const functionsReady =
    Object.values(
      requiredFunctions
    ).every(
      value => value === true
    );


  // ---- 6. RUMUSAN SELAMAT ----

  const summary = {

    functions_ready:
      functionsReady,

    script_properties_ready:
      propertiesReady,

    required_sheets_ready:
      requiredSheetsReady,

    sheet_headers_ready:
      headersReady,

    database_ready:
      databaseReady,

    root_folder_ready:
      rootFolderReady,

    reservation_live_enabled:
      false,

    public_upload_enabled:
      false,

    recovery_enabled:
      false

  };


  // ---- 7. PAPARKAN HASIL ----

  Logger.log(
    "PARTICIPANT UPLOAD INTEGRATION READINESS:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify(
      summary,
      null,
      2
    )
  );


  // ---- 8. JIKA FUNGSI TIDAK LENGKAP ----

  if (!functionsReady) {

    const missing =
      Object.keys(
        requiredFunctions
      ).filter(
        name =>
          requiredFunctions[name] !== true
      );

    Logger.log(
      "MISSING FUNCTIONS:"
    );

    Logger.log(
      JSON.stringify(missing)
    );

  }


  // ---- 9. KEPUTUSAN AKHIR ----

  const passed =
    functionsReady &&
    propertiesReady &&
    databaseReady &&
    rootFolderReady;

  if (!passed) {

    throw new Error(
      "PARTICIPANT UPLOAD INTEGRATION NOT READY"
    );

  }

  Logger.log(
    "PARTICIPANT UPLOAD INTEGRATION READINESS PASSED"
  );

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 4.07 - 4.10
   PARTICIPANT PRE-UPLOAD GATE

   TUJUAN:
   - Terima metadata permintaan upload.
   - Gunakan validation sedia ada.
   - Semak keputusan di bawah ScriptLock.
   - Pulangkan keputusan yang selamat.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - READ ONLY.
   - Tidak menyimpan gambar.
   - Tidak menulis rekod UPLOADS.
   - Tidak menempah kuota.
   - Tidak mengaktifkan LIVE.
   - Jangan tambah ke doGet/doPost.

   PENTING:
   Keputusan READY bukan reservation.
============================================ */


// ============================================
// 4.07 - FUNGSI PRA-UPLOAD
// ============================================

function prepareParticipantUpload_(uploadData) {

  // ---- 1. SAHKAN INPUT ----

  if (
    !uploadData ||
    typeof uploadData !== "object" ||
    Array.isArray(uploadData)
  ) {
    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "INVALID_UPLOAD_DATA",
      ready: false,
      saved: false,
      quota_reserved: false
    };
  }

  // ---- 2. PENGESAHAN TERKUNCI ----

  // Fungsi ini akan memanggil:
  // validateUploadReservation_()
  // melalui ScriptLock sedia ada.

  let validation;

  try {

    validation =
      validateUploadReservationWithLock_(
        uploadData
      );

  } catch (error) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "PRE_UPLOAD_VALIDATION_ERROR",
      ready: false,
      saved: false,
      quota_reserved: false
    };
  }

  // ---- 3. SEMAK KELAYAKAN ----

  if (
    !validation ||
    validation.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
    validation.eligible !== true ||
    validation.ready_for_reservation !== true
  ) {

    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code:
        validation &&
        typeof validation.code === "string"
          ? validation.code
          : "PRE_UPLOAD_NOT_ELIGIBLE",
      ready: false,
      saved: false,
      quota_reserved: false
    };
  }

  // ---- 4. KEPUTUSAN BERJAYA ----

  // Jangan pulangkan:
  // - qr_token
  // - idempotency_key
  // - lease_token
  // - ID dalaman

  return {
    status: "SUCCESS",
    code: "PRE_UPLOAD_READY",
    ready: true,

    qr_label: validation.qr_label,
    event_name: validation.event_name,
    cycle_number: validation.cycle_number,

    remaining_reservable_uploads:
      validation.remaining_reservable_uploads,

    saved: false,
    quota_reserved: false
  };

}


// ============================================
// 4.08 - UJIAN INPUT TIDAK SAH
// ============================================

function testParticipantPreUploadGate_() {

  // ---- 1. UJIAN INPUT KOSONG ----

  const nullInput =
    prepareParticipantUpload_(null);

  // ---- 2. UJIAN INPUT ARRAY ----

  const arrayInput =
    prepareParticipantUpload_([]);

  // ---- 3. UJIAN OBJEK KOSONG ----

  // Objek kosong perlu ditolak
  // oleh validateUploadFile_().

  const emptyObject =
    prepareParticipantUpload_({});

  // ---- 4. SEMAK PERLINDUNGAN ----

  const results = [
    nullInput,
    arrayInput,
    emptyObject
  ];

  const summary = {

    null_rejected:
      nullInput.status === "REJECTED" &&
      nullInput.ready === false,

    array_rejected:
      arrayInput.status === "REJECTED" &&
      arrayInput.ready === false,

    empty_object_rejected:
      emptyObject.status === "REJECTED" &&
      emptyObject.ready === false,

    no_upload_saved:
      results.every(r =>
        r.saved === false
      ),

    no_quota_reserved:
      results.every(r =>
        r.quota_reserved === false
      ),

    no_sensitive_fields:
      results.every(r =>
        ![
          "qr_token",
          "idempotency_key",
          "lease_token",
          "qr_id",
          "event_id",
          "cycle_id"
        ].some(key =>
          Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
            r, key
          )
        )
      )
  };

  Logger.log(
    "PARTICIPANT PRE-UPLOAD GATE TEST:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
  );

  if (
    !Object.values(summary).every(
      value => value === true
    )
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "PARTICIPANT PRE-UPLOAD GATE TEST FAILED"
    );
  }

  Logger.log(
    "PARTICIPANT PRE-UPLOAD GATE TEST PASSED"
  );

}

function testParticipantUploadMetadataIntegration_() {

  // ---- 1. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const spreadsheetId =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error(
      "SPREADSHEET_ID NOT CONFIGURED"
    );
  }

  const ss =
    SpreadsheetApp.openById(spreadsheetId);

  const qrSheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("QR_SLOTS");

  const uploadsSheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("UPLOADS");

  if (!qrSheet || !uploadsSheet) {
    throw new Error(
      "REQUIRED SHEETS MISSING"
    );
  }

  // ---- 2. CARI QR MEJA 01 ----

  const data =
    qrSheet.getDataRange().getValues();

  const headers = data[0];

  const labelIndex =
    headers.indexOf("qr_label");

  const tokenIndex =
    headers.indexOf("qr_token");

  const deletedIndex =
    headers.indexOf("deletion_status");

  if (
    labelIndex === -1 ||
    tokenIndex === -1 ||
    deletedIndex === -1
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "QR_SLOTS HEADERS INVALID"
    );
  }

  const matches =
    data.slice(1).filter(row =>
      row[labelIndex] === "Meja 01" &&
      row[deletedIndex] === "ACTIVE"
    );

  if (matches.length !== 1) {
    throw new Error(
      "MEJA 01 NOT FOUND OR DUPLICATED"
    );
  }

  const qrToken =
    matches[0][tokenIndex];

  // ---- 3. BINA METADATA JPEG ----

  // Ini metadata ujian sahaja.
  // Tiada kandungan gambar sebenar.

  const uploadData = {

    qr_token: qrToken,

    idempotency_key:
      Utilities.getUuid(),

    original_filename:
      "polaroid_test.jpg",

    file_mime_type:
      "image/jpeg",

    file_size_bytes:
      1024 * 1024

  };

  // ---- 4. UJI METADATA FAIL ----

  const fileResult =
    validateUploadFile_(uploadData);

  // ---- 5. UJI IDEMPOTENCY ----

  const keyResult =
    checkUploadIdempotency_(
      uploadData.idempotency_key
    );

  // ---- 6. UJI PRA-UPLOAD ----

  const preUpload =
    prepareParticipantUpload_(
      uploadData
    );

  // ---- 7. UJI ELIGIBILITY ----

  const eligibility =
    checkUploadEligibility_(
      qrToken
    );

  // ---- 8. RUMUSAN ----

  const summary = {

    jpeg_metadata_valid:
      fileResult.status === "VALID",

    idempotency_new:
      keyResult.status === "SUCCESS" &&
      keyResult.code === "NEW_REQUEST",

    event_not_started:
      eligibility.eligible === false &&
      eligibility.eligibility_code ===
        "EVENT_NOT_STARTED",

    pre_upload_blocked:
      preUpload.status === "REJECTED" &&
      preUpload.ready === false,

    no_upload_saved:
      preUpload.saved === false,

    no_quota_reserved:
      preUpload.quota_reserved === false,

    no_sensitive_fields:
      ![
        "qr_token",
        "idempotency_key",
        "lease_token",
        "qr_id",
        "event_id",
        "cycle_id"
      ].some(key =>
        Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
          preUpload,
          key
        )
      )

  };

  // ---- 9. PAPARKAN LOG SELAMAT ----

  Logger.log(
    "PARTICIPANT METADATA INTEGRATION:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
  );

  if (
    !Object.values(summary).every(
      value => value === true
    )
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "PARTICIPANT METADATA INTEGRATION FAILED"
    );
  }

  Logger.log(
    "PARTICIPANT METADATA INTEGRATION TEST PASSED"
  );

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 4.15 - 4.18
   INTERNAL LIVE UPLOAD RESERVATION

   TUJUAN:
   - Sahkan permintaan dalam ScriptLock.
   - Semak idempotency dan kuota.
   - Sahkan hubungan QR dan cycle.
   - Bina rekod RESERVED 22 kolum.
   - Simpan satu rekod ke UPLOADS.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - PRIVATE BACKEND ONLY.
   - Tidak dipanggil oleh doGet/doPost.
   - Tidak menyimpan gambar.
   - Tidak mengubah successful_uploads.
   - Tidak memintas jadual acara.
   - Tidak menggunakan nested ScriptLock.

   PENTING:
   LIVE mesti diminta secara eksplisit.
   Jangan paparkan lease token dalam log.
============================================ */


// ============================================
// 4.15 - SENARAI HEADER RASMI
// ============================================

const LIVE_RESERVATION_HEADERS = [
  "upload_id",
  "idempotency_key",
  "event_id",
  "qr_id",
  "cycle_id",
  "upload_status",
  "lease_token",
  "lease_expires_at",
  "original_filename",
  "file_mime_type",
  "file_size_bytes",
  "drive_file_id",
  "drive_file_name",
  "created_at",
  "started_at",
  "completed_at",
  "updated_at",
  "error_code",
  "error_message",
  "retry_count",
  "deleted_at",
  "deletion_status"
];


// ============================================
// 4.16 - FUNGSI BANTUAN DATABASE
// ============================================

function getInternalReservationSheet_(
  ss,
  sheetName,
  expectedHeaders
) {

  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(
    sheetName
  );

  if (!sheet) {
    throw new Error(
      "RESERVATION_SHEET_MISSING"
    );
  }

  const actualHeaders = sheet
    .getRange(
      1,
      1,
      1,
      expectedHeaders.length
    )
    .getValues()[0];

  const valid = expectedHeaders.every(
    (header, index) =>
      actualHeaders[index] === header
  );

  if (!valid) {
    throw new Error(
      "RESERVATION_HEADERS_INVALID"
    );
  }

  return sheet;
}


// ============================================
// 4.17 - RESERVATION LIVE DALAMAN
// ============================================

function reserveParticipantUploadInternal_(
  uploadData,
  enableLive = false
) {

  // ---- 1. SEKAT LIVE SECARA LALAI ----

  if (enableLive !== true) {
    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "INTERNAL_LIVE_NOT_ENABLED",
      saved: false,
      quota_reserved: false
    };
  }

  // ---- 2. DAPATKAN SCRIPT LOCK ----

  // Jangan gunakan
  // validateUploadReservationWithLock_()
  // di dalam lock ini.

  const lock =
    LockService.getScriptLock();

  if (!lock.tryLock(10000)) {
    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "UPLOAD_LOCK_BUSY",
      saved: false,
      quota_reserved: false
    };
  }

  try {

    // ---- 3. SAHKAN INPUT DI DALAM LOCK ----

    const validation =
      validateUploadReservation_(
        uploadData
      );

    if (
      validation.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
      validation.eligible !== true ||
      validation.ready_for_reservation !== true
    ) {
      return {
        status: "REJECTED",
        code:
          validation.code ||
          "RESERVATION_NOT_ELIGIBLE",
        saved: false,
        quota_reserved: false
      };
    }

    // ---- 4. SAHKAN TOKEN QR ----

    const tokenResult =
      validateQrToken_(
        uploadData.qr_token
      );

    if (tokenResult.status !== "VALID") {
      return {
        status: "REJECTED",
        code: "QR_NOT_VALID",
        saved: false,
        quota_reserved: false
      };
    }

    // ---- 5. BUKA DATABASE ----

    const spreadsheetId =
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

    if (!spreadsheetId) {
      throw new Error(
        "SPREADSHEET_ID_MISSING"
      );
    }

    const ss =
      SpreadsheetApp.openById(
        spreadsheetId
      );

    const qrSheet =
      getInternalReservationSheet_(
        ss,
        "QR_SLOTS",
        [
          "qr_id",
          "event_id",
          "qr_label",
          "qr_token",
          "qr_status",
          "max_uploads",
          "current_cycle_id",
          "drive_folder_id",
          "created_at",
          "updated_at",
          "created_by",
          "updated_by",
          "last_upload_at",
          "regenerated_at",
          "regenerated_by",
          "deleted_at",
          "deleted_by",
          "deletion_status"
        ]
      );

    const cycleSheet =
      getInternalReservationSheet_(
        ss,
        "QUOTA_CYCLES",
        [
          "cycle_id",
          "event_id",
          "qr_id",
          "cycle_number",
          "max_uploads",
          "cycle_status",
          "started_at",
          "ended_at",
          "created_at",
          "created_by",
          "closed_by",
          "reset_reason",
          "successful_uploads"
        ]
      );

    const uploadSheet =
      getInternalReservationSheet_(
        ss,
        "UPLOADS",
        LIVE_RESERVATION_HEADERS
      );

    // BATCH 5.29: Idempotency check INSIDE the reservation ScriptLock.
    // A simultaneous request may have passed the caller's earlier lookup.
    const reservationRows529 = uploadSheet.getDataRange().getValues();
    const existingKey529 = reservationRows529.slice(1).some(function(row) {
      return String(row[1]) === String(uploadData.idempotency_key);
    });
    if (existingKey529) {
      return {
        status: "REJECTED", code: "IDEMPOTENCY_ALREADY_EXISTS",
        saved: false, quota_reserved: false
      };
    }

    // ---- 6. CARI QR YANG SEPADAN ----

    const qrRows =
      qrSheet.getDataRange().getValues();

    const matches = qrRows
      .slice(1)
      .filter(row =>
        String(row[0]) ===
        tokenResult.qr_id
      );

    if (matches.length !== 1) {
      throw new Error(
        "QR_RECORD_INTEGRITY_ERROR"
      );
    }

    const qrRecord = matches[0];

    const eventId =
      String(qrRecord[1]);

    const cycleId =
      String(qrRecord[6]);

    if (
      !eventId ||
      !cycleId ||
      String(qrRecord[4]) !== "ACTIVE" ||
      String(qrRecord[17]) !== "ACTIVE"
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "QR_RECORD_NOT_ACTIVE"
      );
    }

    // ---- 7. SAHKAN CYCLE ----

    const cycleRows =
      cycleSheet
        .getDataRange()
        .getValues();

    const cycleMatches =
      cycleRows.slice(1).filter(row =>
        String(row[0]) === cycleId
      );

    if (cycleMatches.length !== 1) {
      throw new Error(
        "CYCLE_RECORD_INTEGRITY_ERROR"
      );
    }

    const cycle = cycleMatches[0];

    if (
      String(cycle[1]) !== eventId ||
      String(cycle[2]) !==
        tokenResult.qr_id ||
      String(cycle[5]) !== "ACTIVE"
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "CYCLE_RELATION_INVALID"
      );
    }

    // BATCH 5.29: Enforce one unexpired active upload lease per QR.
    // This check is made under the SAME ScriptLock as the new reservation.
    if (hasActiveQrLease529_(reservationRows529.slice(1), tokenResult.qr_id, Date.now())) {
      return {
        status: "REJECTED", code: "QR_UPLOAD_SESSION_BUSY",
        saved: false, quota_reserved: false
      };
    }

    // ---- 8. SAHKAN KUOTA SEKALI LAGI ----

    const quota =
      getEffectiveUploadQuota_(
        tokenResult.qr_id
      );

    if (
      quota.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
      quota.quota_status !== "AVAILABLE" ||
      quota.cycle_id !== cycleId ||
      quota.remaining_reservable_uploads <= 0
    ) {
      return {
        status: "REJECTED",
        code: "EFFECTIVE_QUOTA_FULL",
        saved: false,
        quota_reserved: false
      };
    }

    // ---- 9. JANA LEASE ----

    const lease =
      createUploadLease_();

    if (
      lease.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
      !lease.lease_token ||
      !lease.lease_expires_at ||
      !lease.lease_created_at
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "LEASE_CREATION_FAILED"
      );
    }

    // ---- 10. BINA REKOD RESERVED ----

    // Gunakan pembina rekod sedia ada.
    // Jangan log built.record atau built.row.

    const built =
      buildUploadReservationRow_({

        upload_id:
          Utilities.getUuid(),

        idempotency_key:
          uploadData.idempotency_key,

        event_id:
          eventId,

        qr_id:
          tokenResult.qr_id,

        cycle_id:
          cycleId,

        lease_token:
          lease.lease_token,

        lease_expires_at:
          lease.lease_expires_at,

        original_filename:
          uploadData.original_filename,

        file_mime_type:
          uploadData.file_mime_type,

        file_size_bytes:
          uploadData.file_size_bytes,

        created_at:
          lease.lease_created_at

      });

    if (
      built.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
      built.row.length !== 22
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "RESERVATION_ROW_BUILD_FAILED"
      );
    }

    // ---- 11. TULIS REKOD LIVE ----

    // Satu baris sahaja.
    // Lock masih dipegang.

    const targetRow =
      uploadSheet.getLastRow() + 1;

    uploadSheet
      .getRange(targetRow, 1, 1, 22)
      .setValues([built.row]);

    SpreadsheetApp.flush();

    // ---- 12. SAHKAN PENULISAN ----

    const stored =
      uploadSheet
        .getRange(targetRow, 1, 1, 22)
        .getValues()[0];

    if (
      stored[0] !==
        built.record.upload_id ||
      stored[1] !==
        built.record.idempotency_key ||
      stored[5] !== "RESERVED" ||
      stored[6] !==
        built.record.lease_token
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "RESERVATION_WRITE_UNVERIFIED"
      );
    }

    // ---- 13. PULANGKAN HASIL DALAMAN ----

    // Lease token diperlukan untuk
    // fasa PROCESSING yang akan datang.
    // Jangan log objek respons ini.

    return {
      status: "SUCCESS",
      code: "RESERVATION_LIVE_CREATED",

      saved: true,
      quota_reserved: true,

      upload_id:
        built.record.upload_id,

      lease_token:
        built.record.lease_token,

      lease_expires_at:
        built.record.lease_expires_at,

      upload_status: "RESERVED"
    };

  } catch (error) {

    // Jangan anggap kegagalan bermaksud
    // tiada rekod ditulis.
    // Kegagalan selepas setValues()
    // mungkin memerlukan reconciliation.

    console.error(
      "INTERNAL_RESERVATION_ERROR"
    );

    return {
      status: "ERROR",
      code: "RESERVATION_STATE_UNCERTAIN",
      saved: null,
      quota_reserved: null,
      requires_reconciliation: true
    };

  } finally {

    // ---- 14. LEPASKAN LOCK ----

    lock.releaseLock();

  }

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 4.18
   INTERNAL RESERVATION SAFETY TEST

   KESELAMATAN:
   - Tidak memaksa acara menjadi ACTIVE.
   - Tidak memintas jadual acara.
   - Tidak mencipta rekod ujian.
   - Tidak memaparkan token.
============================================ */

function testInternalLiveReservationSafety_() {

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID")
  );

  const qrSheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("QR_SLOTS");

  const uploadSheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("UPLOADS");

  const data =
    qrSheet.getDataRange().getValues();

  const headers = data[0];

  const labelIndex =
    headers.indexOf("qr_label");

  const tokenIndex =
    headers.indexOf("qr_token");

  const deletionIndex =
    headers.indexOf("deletion_status");

  const matches =
    data.slice(1).filter(row =>
      row[labelIndex] === "Meja 01" &&
      row[deletionIndex] === "ACTIVE"
    );

  if (matches.length !== 1) {
    throw new Error(
      "TEST_QR_NOT_UNIQUE"
    );
  }

  const uploadData = {
    qr_token:
      matches[0][tokenIndex],

    idempotency_key:
      Utilities.getUuid(),

    original_filename:
      "reservation_test.jpg",

    file_mime_type:
      "image/jpeg",

    file_size_bytes:
      1048576
  };

  // ---- 1. REKOD SEBELUM UJIAN ----

  const before =
    uploadSheet.getDataRange().getValues();

  // ---- 2. UJI LIVE DISABLED ----

  const disabled =
    reserveParticipantUploadInternal_(
      uploadData
    );

  // ---- 3. UJI JADUAL ACARA ----

  // Acara Meja 01 dijangka
  // belum bermula pada masa ujian.

  const availability =
    checkUploadEligibility_(
      uploadData.qr_token
    );

  if (
    availability.eligibility_code !==
    "EVENT_NOT_STARTED"
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "TEST_REQUIRES_FUTURE_EVENT"
    );
  }

  const blocked =
    reserveParticipantUploadInternal_(
      uploadData,
      true
    );

  // ---- 4. REKOD SELEPAS UJIAN ----

  const after =
    uploadSheet.getDataRange().getValues();

  const summary = {

    default_live_disabled:
      disabled.status === "REJECTED" &&
      disabled.code ===
        "INTERNAL_LIVE_NOT_ENABLED",

    future_event_blocked:
      blocked.status === "REJECTED" &&
      blocked.code ===
        "EVENT_NOT_STARTED",

    no_reservation_created:
      JSON.stringify(before) ===
      JSON.stringify(after),

    no_quota_reserved:
      disabled.quota_reserved === false &&
      blocked.quota_reserved === false,

    no_sensitive_output:
      ![
        "lease_token",
        "qr_token",
        "idempotency_key"
      ].some(key =>
        Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
          blocked,
          key
        )
      )
  };

  Logger.log(
    "INTERNAL LIVE RESERVATION SAFETY:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
  );

  if (
    !Object.values(summary).every(
      value => value === true
    )
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "INTERNAL RESERVATION SAFETY FAILED"
    );
  }

  Logger.log(
    "INTERNAL RESERVATION SAFETY TEST PASSED"
  );

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 4.19
   LIVE TEST ENVIRONMENT PREPARATION

   TUJUAN:
   - Semak konfigurasi database.
   - Semak folder ROOT.
   - Pastikan acara ujian tidak berganda.
   - Sediakan data acara ujian sementara.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - READ ONLY.
   - Tiada acara dicipta.
   - Tiada folder dicipta.
   - Tiada rekod dipadam.
   - Tiada token dipaparkan.

   PENTING:
   Nama acara ini dikhaskan untuk ujian.
============================================ */


const LIVE_UPLOAD_TEST_EVENT_NAME =
  "__QR_POLAROID_LIVE_UPLOAD_TEST_BATCH511__";


function prepareLiveUploadTestEnvironment_() {

  // ---- 1. SEMAK KONFIGURASI ----

  const props =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  const spreadsheetId =
    props.getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  const rootFolderId =
    props.getProperty("ROOT_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId || !rootFolderId) {
    throw new Error(
      "LIVE_TEST_CONFIGURATION_MISSING"
    );
  }

  // ---- 2. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const ss =
    SpreadsheetApp.openById(spreadsheetId);

  const requiredSheets = [
    "EVENTS",
    "QR_SLOTS",
    "QUOTA_CYCLES",
    "UPLOADS"
  ];

  for (const name of requiredSheets) {

    if (!ss.getSheetByName(name)) {
      throw new Error(
        "LIVE_TEST_SHEET_MISSING"
      );
    }

  }

  // ---- 3. SEMAK ROOT DRIVE ----

  // Hanya semak akses.
  // Tidak mencipta folder.

  const rootFolder =
    DriveApp.getFolderById(rootFolderId);

  rootFolder.getName();

  // ---- 4. SEMAK ACARA UJIAN SEDIA ADA ----

  const eventSheet =
    ss.getSheetByName("EVENTS");

  const eventData =
    eventSheet.getDataRange().getValues();

  const headers = eventData[0];

  const nameIndex =
    headers.indexOf("event_name");

  if (nameIndex === -1) {
    throw new Error(
      "EVENT_NAME_HEADER_MISSING"
    );
  }

  const existing = eventData
    .slice(1)
    .filter(row =>
      String(row[nameIndex]) ===
      LIVE_UPLOAD_TEST_EVENT_NAME
    );

  // Jika pernah dicipta, hentikan.
  // Jangan cipta acara kedua secara automatik.

  if (existing.length > 0) {
    return {
      status: "REJECTED",
      code: "LIVE_TEST_EVENT_ALREADY_EXISTS",
      ready: false,
      saved: false
    };
  }

  // ---- 5. SEDIAKAN TARIKH UJIAN ----

  const timezone =
    ss.getSpreadsheetTimeZone();

  const now = new Date();

  const yesterday =
    new Date(now.getTime() - 86400000);

  const tomorrow =
    new Date(now.getTime() + 86400000);

  const formatDate = date =>
    Utilities.formatDate(
      date,
      timezone,
      "yyyy-MM-dd"
    );

  // ---- 6. BINA DATA ACARA ----

  const eventDataForTest = {

    event_name:
      LIVE_UPLOAD_TEST_EVENT_NAME,

    start_date:
      formatDate(yesterday),

    end_date:
      formatDate(tomorrow),

    start_time:
      "00:00",

    end_time:
      "23:59",

    schedule_enabled:
      true

  };

  // ---- 7. UJI PEMBINA ACARA LAMA ----

  const prepared =
    createEvent_(
      eventDataForTest,
      true
    );

  if (
    prepared.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
    prepared.saved !== false
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "LIVE_TEST_EVENT_PREPARATION_FAILED"
    );
  }

  // ---- 8. PULANGKAN RUMUSAN SELAMAT ----

  return {
    status: "SUCCESS",
    code: "LIVE_TEST_ENVIRONMENT_READY",

    ready: true,
    saved: false,

    required_sheets_verified: true,
    root_folder_accessible: true,
    no_duplicate_test_event: true,
    event_record_prepared: true,

    test_schedule_enabled: true
  };

}


// ============================================
// 4.19 - UJIAN BERSEPADU
// ============================================

function testLiveUploadEnvironmentPreparation_() {

  const result =
    prepareLiveUploadTestEnvironment_();

  const summary = {

    environment_ready:

    sheets_verified:
      result.required_sheets_verified === true,

    drive_accessible:

      result.saved === false

  };

  Logger.log(
    "LIVE UPLOAD ENVIRONMENT PREPARATION:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
  );

  if (
    !Object.values(summary).every(
      value => value === true
    )
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "LIVE_UPLOAD_ENVIRONMENT_TEST_FAILED"
    );
  }

  Logger.log(
    "LIVE UPLOAD ENVIRONMENT TEST PASSED"
  );

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 4.20
   CREATE ISOLATED LIVE TEST FIXTURE

   PENTING:
   - Menulis data sebenar ke Sheets.
   - Mencipta folder sebenar di Drive.
   - Hanya dijalankan secara manual.
   - Tidak menyentuh acara utama.
   - Tidak menjalankan cleanup automatik.
   - Jangan sambungkan kepada doPost/doGet.

   Gunakan nama acara khas yang telah
   ditetapkan dalam Langkah 4.19.
============================================ */

function createLiveUploadTestFixture_() {

  // ---- 1. KAWAL OPERASI SERENTAK ----

  const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();

  if (!lock.tryLock(10000)) {
    throw new Error("TEST_FIXTURE_LOCK_BUSY");
  }

  try {

    // ---- 2. BUKA DATABASE ----

    const props =
      PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

    const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
      props.getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID")
    );

    const events = ss.getSheetByName("EVENTS");
    const qrSlots = ss.getSheetByName("QR_SLOTS");
    const cycles = ss.getSheetByName("QUOTA_CYCLES");

    if (!events || !qrSlots || !cycles) {
      throw new Error("TEST_DATABASE_INCOMPLETE");
    }

    // ---- 3. SEMAK HEADER RASMI ----

    const eventHeaders = [
      "event_id", "event_name",
      "start_date", "end_date",
      "start_time", "end_time",
      "schedule_enabled", "drive_folder_id",
      "event_status", "created_at",
      "updated_at", "updated_by",
      "deleted_at", "deleted_by",
      "deletion_status", "created_by"
    ];

    const qrHeaders = [
      "qr_id", "event_id", "qr_label",
      "qr_token", "qr_status",
      "max_uploads", "current_cycle_id",
      "drive_folder_id", "created_at",
      "updated_at", "created_by",
      "updated_by", "last_upload_at",
      "regenerated_at", "regenerated_by",
      "deleted_at", "deleted_by",
      "deletion_status"
    ];

    const cycleHeaders = [
      "cycle_id", "event_id", "qr_id",
      "cycle_number", "max_uploads",
      "cycle_status", "started_at",
      "ended_at", "created_at",
      "created_by", "closed_by",
      "reset_reason", "successful_uploads"
    ];

    function verifyHeaders(sheet, expected) {
      const actual = sheet.getRange(
        1, 1, 1, expected.length
      ).getValues()[0];

      if (!expected.every(
        (value, i) => actual[i] === value
      )) {
        throw new Error(
          "TEST_HEADER_MISMATCH_" +
          sheet.getName()
        );
      }
    }

    verifyHeaders(events, eventHeaders);
    verifyHeaders(qrSlots, qrHeaders);
    verifyHeaders(cycles, cycleHeaders);

    // ---- 4. CEGAH ACARA BERGANDA ----

    const existing = events.getDataRange()
      .getValues()
      .slice(1)
      .filter(row =>
        String(row[1]) ===
        LIVE_UPLOAD_TEST_EVENT_NAME
      );

    if (existing.length > 0) {
      throw new Error(
        "TEST_FIXTURE_ALREADY_EXISTS_" +
        "RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED"
      );
    }

    // ---- 5. SEDIAKAN JADUAL ACARA ----

    const timezone = ss.getSpreadsheetTimeZone();
    const now = new Date();

    const dateText = offset =>
      Utilities.formatDate(
        new Date(
          now.getTime() + offset * 86400000
        ),
        timezone,
        "yyyy-MM-dd"
      );

    const eventData = {
      event_name: LIVE_UPLOAD_TEST_EVENT_NAME,
      start_date: dateText(-1),
      end_date: dateText(1),
      start_time: "00:00",
      end_time: "23:59",
      schedule_enabled: true
    };

    // ---- 6. CIPTA ACARA DRAFT ----

    const eventResult =
      createEvent_(eventData, true);

    if (
      eventResult.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
      eventResult.saved !== false
    ) {
      throw new Error("TEST_EVENT_BUILD_FAILED");
    }

    const event = eventResult.event;

    const eventRow = eventHeaders.map(
      header => event[header]
    );

    events.appendRow(eventRow);
    SpreadsheetApp.flush();

    // ---- 7. CIPTA FOLDER ACARA ----

    // Fungsi lama membaca EVENTS.
    // Acara mesti sudah disimpan.

    const eventFolder = createEventFolder_(
      event.event_id
    );

    if (eventFolder.status !== "SUCCESS") {
      throw new Error("TEST_EVENT_FOLDER_FAILED");
    }

    // ---- 8. SEDIAKAN QR SLOT ----

    const slotResult = createQrSlot_({
      event_id: event.event_id,
      qr_label: "__LIVE_TEST_QR__",
      max_uploads: 2
    });

    if (
      slotResult.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
      slotResult.saved !== false
    ) {
      throw new Error("TEST_QR_BUILD_FAILED");
    }

    const slot = slotResult.slot;

    qrSlots.appendRow(
      qrHeaders.map(header => slot[header])
    );

    SpreadsheetApp.flush();

    // ---- 9. CIPTA FOLDER QR ----

    const qrFolder = createQrSlotFolder_(
      slot.qr_id
    );

    if (qrFolder.status !== "SUCCESS") {
      throw new Error("TEST_QR_FOLDER_FAILED");
    }

    // ---- 10. SEDIAKAN CYCLE 1 ----

    const cycleResult = createQuotaCycle_(
      slot.qr_id
    );

    if (
      cycleResult.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
      cycleResult.saved !== false
    ) {
      throw new Error("TEST_CYCLE_BUILD_FAILED");
    }

    const cycle = cycleResult.cycle;

    cycles.appendRow(
      cycleHeaders.map(
        header => cycle[header]
      )
    );

    SpreadsheetApp.flush();

    // ---- 11. CARI BARIS QR DAN EVENT ----

    // Semak ID unik, bukan nama sahaja.

    function findUniqueRow(sheet, id) {
      const rows = sheet.getDataRange()
        .getValues();

      const matches = [];

      for (let i = 1; i < rows.length; i++) {
        if (String(rows[i][0]) === id) {
          matches.push(i + 1);
        }
      }

      if (matches.length !== 1) {
        throw new Error(
          "TEST_RECORD_NOT_UNIQUE"
        );
      }

      return matches[0];
    }

    const eventRowNumber = findUniqueRow(
      events, event.event_id
    );

    const qrRowNumber = findUniqueRow(
      qrSlots, slot.qr_id
    );

    // ---- 12. HUBUNGKAN CYCLE ----

    qrSlots.getRange(
      qrRowNumber, 7
    ).setValue(cycle.cycle_id);

    // ---- 13. AKTIFKAN REKOD TERAKHIR ----

    // Aktifkan hanya selepas semua
    // folder dan cycle berjaya dicipta.

    qrSlots.getRange(
      qrRowNumber, 5
    ).setValue("ACTIVE");

    events.getRange(
      eventRowNumber, 9
    ).setValue("ACTIVE");

    SpreadsheetApp.flush();

    // ---- 14. SIMPAN PENANDA UJIAN ----

    // Hanya ID acara disimpan.
    // Token QR tidak disimpan
    // dalam Script Properties.

    props.setProperty(
      "LIVE_UPLOAD_TEST_511_EVENT_ID",
      event.event_id
    );

    Logger.log(
      "LIVE TEST FIXTURE CREATED"
    );

    return {
      status: "SUCCESS",
      code: "LIVE_TEST_FIXTURE_CREATED",
      created: true,
      event_active: true,
      qr_active: true,
      cycle_active: true,
      quota_limit: 2
    };

  } finally {

    lock.releaseLock();

  }
}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 4.21
   TEST REAL LIVE RESERVATION

   - Menulis SATU reservation sebenar.
   - Menggunakan fixture sementara.
   - Tidak menyimpan gambar.
   - Tidak memadam rekod ujian.
   - Jangan jalankan berulang kali.
============================================ */

function testRealLiveUploadReservation_() {

  const props =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  const testEventId = props.getProperty(
    "LIVE_UPLOAD_TEST_511_EVENT_ID"
  );

  if (!testEventId) {
    throw new Error(
      "TEST_FIXTURE_NOT_INITIALIZED"
    );
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
    props.getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID")
  );

  const events = ss.getSheetByName("EVENTS");
  const qrSlots = ss.getSheetByName("QR_SLOTS");
  const uploads = ss.getSheetByName("UPLOADS");

  // ---- 1. SAHKAN ACARA UJIAN ----

  const eventMatches = events
    .getDataRange()
    .getValues()
    .slice(1)
    .filter(row =>
      String(row[0]) === testEventId &&
      String(row[1]) ===
        LIVE_UPLOAD_TEST_EVENT_NAME &&
      String(row[8]) === "ACTIVE" &&
      String(row[14]) === "ACTIVE"
    );

  if (eventMatches.length !== 1) {
    throw new Error(
      "TEST_EVENT_NOT_UNIQUE_OR_ACTIVE"
    );
  }

  // ---- 2. CARI QR UJIAN ----

  const matches = qrSlots
    .getDataRange()
    .getValues()
    .slice(1)
    .filter(row =>
      String(row[1]) === testEventId &&
      String(row[2]) === "__LIVE_TEST_QR__" &&
      String(row[4]) === "ACTIVE" &&
      String(row[17]) === "ACTIVE"
    );

  if (matches.length !== 1) {
    throw new Error(
      "TEST_QR_NOT_UNIQUE_OR_ACTIVE"
    );
  }

  const qr = matches[0];

  // ---- 3. CEGAH UJIAN BERULANG ----

  const existing = uploads
    .getDataRange()
    .getValues()
    .slice(1)
    .filter(row =>
      String(row[2]) === testEventId
    );

  if (existing.length > 0) {
    throw new Error(
      "TEST_UPLOAD_ALREADY_EXISTS_" +
      "RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED"
    );
  }

  // ---- 4. SEMAK KELAYAKAN ----

  const eligibility = checkUploadEligibility_(
    qr[3]
  );

  if (
    eligibility.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
    eligibility.eligible !== true
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "TEST_EVENT_NOT_ELIGIBLE_" +
      (eligibility.eligibility_code || "UNKNOWN")
    );
  }

  // ---- 5. BINA METADATA UJIAN ----

  const uploadData = {
    qr_token: qr[3],
    idempotency_key: Utilities.getUuid(),
    original_filename: "live_test.jpg",
    file_mime_type: "image/jpeg",
    file_size_bytes: 1048576
  };

  const beforeQuota = getEffectiveUploadQuota_(
    qr[0]
  );

  if (
    beforeQuota.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
    beforeQuota.remaining_reservable_uploads !== 2
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "TEST_INITIAL_QUOTA_UNEXPECTED"
    );
  }

  // ---- 6. RESERVATION LIVE ----

  // Fungsi ini benar-benar menulis
  // rekod ke UPLOADS.

  const first = reserveParticipantUploadInternal_(
    uploadData,
    true
  );

  // Jangan log objek first.
  // Ia mengandungi lease token.

  if (
    first.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
    first.saved !== true
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "LIVE_RESERVATION_FAILED_" +
      (first.code || "UNKNOWN")
    );
  }

  // ---- 7. ULANG IDEMPOTENCY KEY ----

  const second = reserveParticipantUploadInternal_(
    uploadData,
    true
  );

  // ---- 8. SEMAK REKOD DISIMPAN ----

  const savedRows = uploads
    .getDataRange()
    .getValues()
    .slice(1)
    .filter(row =>
      String(row[2]) === testEventId
    );

  const afterQuota = getEffectiveUploadQuota_(
    qr[0]
  );

  const summary = {

    reservation_created:
      first.saved === true &&
      first.upload_status === "RESERVED",

    duplicate_blocked:
      second.status === "REJECTED" &&
      second.saved === false,

    exactly_one_record:
      savedRows.length === 1,

    record_is_reserved:
      savedRows.length === 1 &&
      savedRows[0][5] === "RESERVED",

    quota_reduced:
      afterQuota.status === "SUCCESS" &&
      afterQuota.remaining_reservable_uploads === 1,

    no_drive_file_yet:
      savedRows.length === 1 &&
      !savedRows[0][11],

    no_completion_yet:
      savedRows.length === 1 &&
      !savedRows[0][15]

  };

  Logger.log(
    "LIVE RESERVATION TEST:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
  );

  if (
    !Object.values(summary).every(
      value => value === true
    )
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "LIVE_RESERVATION_TEST_FAILED_" +
      "RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED"
    );
  }

  Logger.log(
    "LIVE RESERVATION TEST PASSED"
  );

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 4.22
   LIVE TEST RECONCILIATION

   READ ONLY.
   Tidak memadam rekod atau folder.
   Tidak memaparkan ID atau token.
============================================ */

function inspectLiveUploadTestFixture_() {

  const props =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  const eventId = props.getProperty(
    "LIVE_UPLOAD_TEST_511_EVENT_ID"
  );

  if (!eventId) {
    throw new Error(
      "TEST_EVENT_ID_NOT_REGISTERED"
    );
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
    props.getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID")
  );

  const events = ss.getSheetByName("EVENTS")
    .getDataRange().getValues().slice(1)
    .filter(row =>
      String(row[0]) === eventId &&
      String(row[1]) ===
        LIVE_UPLOAD_TEST_EVENT_NAME
    );

  const qrSlots = ss.getSheetByName("QR_SLOTS")
    .getDataRange().getValues().slice(1)
    .filter(row =>
      String(row[1]) === eventId &&
      String(row[2]) === "__LIVE_TEST_QR__"
    );

  const cycles = ss.getSheetByName("QUOTA_CYCLES")
    .getDataRange().getValues().slice(1)
    .filter(row =>
      String(row[1]) === eventId
    );

  const uploads = ss.getSheetByName("UPLOADS")
    .getDataRange().getValues().slice(1)
    .filter(row =>
      String(row[2]) === eventId
    );

  // ---- SAHKAN FOLDER ----

  function folderAccessible(folderId) {
    if (!folderId) return false;

    try {
      DriveApp.getFolderById(
        String(folderId)
      ).getName();

      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  const summary = {

    event_records: events.length,
    qr_records: qrSlots.length,
    cycle_records: cycles.length,
    upload_records: uploads.length,

    reserved_records:
      uploads.filter(row =>
        row[5] === "RESERVED"
      ).length,

    processing_records:
      uploads.filter(row =>
        row[5] === "PROCESSING"
      ).length,

    completed_records:
      uploads.filter(row =>
        row[5] === "COMPLETED"
      ).length,

    event_folder_accessible:
      events.length === 1 &&
      folderAccessible(events[0][7]),

    qr_folder_accessible:
      qrSlots.length === 1 &&
      folderAccessible(qrSlots[0][7]),

    no_drive_files_linked:
      uploads.every(row => !row[11]),

    cleanup_performed: false

  };

  Logger.log(
    "LIVE TEST RECONCILIATION:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
  );

  return summary;

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 4.23
   LIVE JPEG UPLOAD PREFLIGHT

   TUJUAN:
   - Mengesahkan fixture sementara.
   - Mengesahkan hubungan EVENT, QR dan CYCLE.
   - Memeriksa reservation sedia ada.
   - Memeriksa tempoh lease.
   - Memastikan folder QR boleh diakses.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - READ ONLY.
   - Tidak mencipta JPEG.
   - Tidak mengubah kuota.
   - Tidak mengubah status upload.
   - Tidak memadam sebarang data.
   - Tidak memaparkan ID atau token.
============================================ */

function testLiveJpegUploadPreflight_() {

  // ---- 1. BUKA KONFIGURASI ----

  const props =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  const spreadsheetId =
    props.getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  const testEventId =
    props.getProperty("LIVE_UPLOAD_TEST_511_EVENT_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId || !testEventId) {
    throw new Error(
      "LIVE_TEST_CONFIGURATION_MISSING"
    );
  }

  const ss =
    SpreadsheetApp.openById(spreadsheetId);

  // ---- 2. BACA JADUAL ----

  function readTable(name) {

    const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(name);

    if (!sheet) {
      throw new Error(
        "MISSING_TEST_SHEET_" + name
      );
    }

    const values =
      sheet.getDataRange().getValues();

    const headers = values[0];

    if (new Set(headers).size !== headers.length) {
      throw new Error(
        "DUPLICATE_HEADERS_" + name
      );
    }

    const records = values.slice(1).map(row => {

      const record = {};

      headers.forEach((header, index) => {
        record[header] = row[index];
      });

      return record;

    });

    return records;
  }

  const events = readTable("EVENTS");
  const qrSlots = readTable("QR_SLOTS");
  const cycles = readTable("QUOTA_CYCLES");
  const uploads = readTable("UPLOADS");

  // ---- 3. SAHKAN EVENT ----

  const eventMatches = events.filter(item =>
    String(item.event_id) === testEventId &&
    String(item.event_name) ===
      LIVE_UPLOAD_TEST_EVENT_NAME
  );

  if (eventMatches.length !== 1) {
    throw new Error(
      "TEST_EVENT_NOT_UNIQUE"
    );
  }

  const event = eventMatches[0];

  // ---- 4. SAHKAN QR ----

  const qrMatches = qrSlots.filter(item =>
    String(item.event_id) === testEventId &&
    String(item.qr_label) ===
      "__LIVE_TEST_QR__"
  );

  if (qrMatches.length !== 1) {
    throw new Error(
      "TEST_QR_NOT_UNIQUE"
    );
  }

  const qr = qrMatches[0];

  // ---- 5. SAHKAN CYCLE ----

  const cycleMatches = cycles.filter(item =>
    String(item.event_id) === testEventId &&
    String(item.qr_id) === String(qr.qr_id) &&
    String(item.cycle_id) ===
      String(qr.current_cycle_id)
  );

  if (cycleMatches.length !== 1) {
    throw new Error(
      "TEST_CYCLE_NOT_UNIQUE"
    );
  }

  const cycle = cycleMatches[0];

  // ---- 6. SAHKAN RESERVATION ----

  const testUploads = uploads.filter(item =>
    String(item.event_id) === testEventId
  );

  if (testUploads.length !== 1) {
    throw new Error(
      "TEST_RESERVATION_COUNT_UNEXPECTED"
    );
  }

  const upload = testUploads[0];

  // ---- 7. SEMAK LEASE ----

  const expiry = upload.lease_expires_at;

  const expiryMs = expiry instanceof Date
    ? expiry.getTime()
    : Date.parse(String(expiry || ""));

  const leaseValid =
    Number.isFinite(expiryMs) &&
    expiryMs > Date.now();

  // ---- 8. SAHKAN FOLDER ----

  let foldersAccessible = false;
  let folderHierarchyValid = false;

  try {

    const eventFolder = DriveApp.getFolderById(
      String(event.drive_folder_id)
    );

    const qrFolder = DriveApp.getFolderById(
      String(qr.drive_folder_id)
    );

    eventFolder.getName();
    qrFolder.getName();

    foldersAccessible = true;

    const parents = qrFolder.getParents();

    while (parents.hasNext()) {

      const parent = parents.next();

      if (
        parent.getId() ===
        eventFolder.getId()
      ) {
        folderHierarchyValid = true;
        break;
      }

    }

  } catch (error) {

    foldersAccessible = false;

  }

  // ---- 9. RUMUSAN SELAMAT ----

  const summary = {

    event_active:
      String(event.event_status) === "ACTIVE" &&
      String(event.deletion_status) === "ACTIVE",

    qr_active:
      String(qr.qr_status) === "ACTIVE" &&
      String(qr.deletion_status) === "ACTIVE",

    cycle_active:
      String(cycle.cycle_status) === "ACTIVE",

    reservation_exists:
      testUploads.length === 1,

    reservation_is_reserved:
      String(upload.upload_status) ===
      "RESERVED",

    reservation_matches_qr:
      String(upload.qr_id) ===
      String(qr.qr_id),

    reservation_matches_cycle:
      String(upload.cycle_id) ===
      String(cycle.cycle_id),

    lease_still_valid:
      leaseValid,

    folder_accessible:
      foldersAccessible,

    folder_hierarchy_valid:
      folderHierarchyValid,

    drive_file_not_linked:
      !upload.drive_file_id,

    no_completion_yet:
      !upload.completed_at,

    no_write_performed: true

  };

  Logger.log(
    "LIVE JPEG PREFLIGHT:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
  );

  // ---- 10. KEPUTUSAN ----

  const checks = Object.keys(summary);

  const failed = checks.filter(
    key => summary[key] !== true
  );

  if (failed.length > 0) {

    Logger.log(
      "PREFLIGHT REQUIRES ATTENTION"
    );

    Logger.log(
      "FAILED CHECKS: " +
      failed.join(", ")
    );

    return {
      status: "REQUIRES_ATTENTION",
      ready: false,
      failed_checks: failed
    };

  }

  Logger.log(
    "LIVE JPEG PREFLIGHT PASSED"
  );

  return {
    status: "SUCCESS",
    ready: true,
    checked: true,
    saved: false
  };

}

   KESELAMATAN:

   - Tidak memaparkan token QR atau lease.
============================================ */
