// ============================================
// 2. SEMAK JPEG DAN KUOTA
// ============================================

function testPrepareRealJpegUpload_() {

  // ---- A. JANA JPEG ----

  const blob = buildLiveTestJpegBlob_();
  const bytes = blob.getBytes();

  // ---- B. SAHKAN MAGIC BYTES ----

  // JPEG mesti bermula dengan FF D8 FF.
  // Penanda akhir lazimnya FF D9.

  const unsigned = value => value & 255;

  const jpegHeaderValid =
    bytes.length >= 4 &&
    unsigned(bytes[0]) === 255 &&
    unsigned(bytes[1]) === 216 &&
    unsigned(bytes[2]) === 255;

  const jpegEndValid =
    bytes.length >= 4 &&
    unsigned(bytes[bytes.length - 2]) === 255 &&
    unsigned(bytes[bytes.length - 1]) === 217;

  if (!jpegHeaderValid || !jpegEndValid) {
    throw new Error("TEST_JPEG_SIGNATURE_INVALID");
  }

  // ---- C. SAHKAN SAIZ ----

  const actualSize = bytes.length;

  if (actualSize < 100 || actualSize > 8388608) {
    throw new Error("TEST_JPEG_SIZE_INVALID");
  }

  // ---- D. BUKA DATABASE ----

  const props =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  const eventId = props.getProperty(
    "LIVE_UPLOAD_TEST_511_EVENT_ID"
  );

  const spreadsheetId = props.getProperty(
    "SPREADSHEET_ID"
  );

  if (!eventId || !spreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error("TEST_CONFIGURATION_MISSING");
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
    spreadsheetId
  );

  const qrSheet = ss.getSheetByName("QR_SLOTS");

  const values = qrSheet
    .getDataRange()
    .getValues();

  const headers = values[0];

  const idCol = headers.indexOf("qr_id");
  const eventCol = headers.indexOf("event_id");
  const labelCol = headers.indexOf("qr_label");

  if ([idCol, eventCol, labelCol].includes(-1)) {
    throw new Error("TEST_QR_HEADERS_INVALID");
  }

  // ---- E. CARI QR SEMENTARA ----

  const matches = values.slice(1).filter(row =>
    String(row[eventCol]) === eventId &&
    String(row[labelCol]) === "__LIVE_TEST_QR__"
  );

  if (matches.length !== 1) {
    throw new Error("TEST_QR_NOT_UNIQUE");
  }

  const qrId = String(matches[0][idCol]);

  // ---- F. SEMAK KUOTA ----

  const quota = getEffectiveUploadQuota_(qrId);

  if (quota.status !== "SUCCESS") {
    throw new Error("TEST_QUOTA_CHECK_FAILED");
  }

  const remaining = Number(
    quota.remaining_reservable_uploads
  );

  // ---- G. RUMUSAN ----

  const summary = {

    jpeg_generated: true,

    jpeg_header_valid: jpegHeaderValid,

    jpeg_end_valid: jpegEndValid,

    jpeg_mime_type: blob.getContentType(),

    jpeg_size_bytes: actualSize,

    qr_verified: true,

    quota_status: quota.quota_status,

    remaining_reservable_uploads: remaining,

    ready_for_new_reservation:
      quota.quota_status === "AVAILABLE" &&
      remaining >= 1,

    no_database_write: true,

    no_drive_write: true

  };

  Logger.log(
    "REAL JPEG UPLOAD PREPARATION:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
  );

  if (!summary.ready_for_new_reservation) {

    Logger.log(
      "NEW RESERVATION REQUIRES RECONCILIATION"
    );

    return {
      status: "REQUIRES_ATTENTION",
      ready: false,
      reason: "QUOTA_NOT_AVAILABLE"
    };

  }

  Logger.log(
    "REAL JPEG PREPARATION PASSED"
  );

  return {
    status: "SUCCESS",
    ready: true,
    actual_file_size: actualSize,
    saved: false
  };

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 4.25
   LIVE JPEG STORAGE AND COMPLETION

   TUJUAN:
   1. Cipta reservation kedua.
   2. Tukar RESERVED kepada PROCESSING.
   3. Simpan JPEG sebenar dalam folder QR.
   4. Simpan Drive File ID.
   5. Tukar status kepada COMPLETED.
   6. Selaraskan successful_uploads.
   7. Sahkan keputusan akhir.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - Ujian dalaman sahaja.
   - Jangan hubungkan kepada doPost/doGet.
   - Hanya fixture sementara dibenarkan.
   - Tidak memadam rekod atau fail.
   - Tidak memaparkan ID atau token.
   - Jangan reset Script Properties
     untuk memaksa ujian berulang.
============================================ */


function testLiveJpegStorageAndCompletion_() {

  // ---- 1. KONFIGURASI ----

  const props =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  const spreadsheetId =
    props.getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  const eventId =
    props.getProperty("LIVE_UPLOAD_TEST_511_EVENT_ID");

  if (!spreadsheetId || !eventId) {
    throw new Error("TEST_CONFIGURATION_MISSING");
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
    spreadsheetId
  );

  const eventSheet = ss.getSheetByName("EVENTS");
  const qrSheet = ss.getSheetByName("QR_SLOTS");
  const cycleSheet = ss.getSheetByName("QUOTA_CYCLES");
  const uploadSheet = ss.getSheetByName("UPLOADS");

  if (
    !eventSheet ||
    !qrSheet ||
    !cycleSheet ||
    !uploadSheet
  ) {
    throw new Error("TEST_SHEETS_MISSING");
  }

  // ---- 2. PEMBANTU BACA REKOD ----

  function readRecords(sheet) {

    const values =
      sheet.getDataRange().getValues();

    const headers = values[0];

    if (
      !headers.length ||
      new Set(headers).size !== headers.length
    ) {
      throw new Error("INVALID_TABLE_HEADERS");
    }

    return values.slice(1).map((row, index) => {

      const record = {
        _row: index + 2
      };

      headers.forEach((header, i) => {
        record[header] = row[i];
      });

      return record;

    });
  }

  function unique(items, code) {

    if (items.length !== 1) {
      throw new Error(code);
    }

    return items[0];
  }

  function setField(sheet, row, field, value) {

    const headers = sheet.getRange(
      1, 1, 1, sheet.getLastColumn()
    ).getValues()[0];

    const index = headers.indexOf(field);

    if (index === -1) {
      throw new Error(
        "MISSING_FIELD_" + field
      );
    }

    sheet.getRange(
      row,
      index + 1
    ).setValue(value);
  }

  // ---- 3. SAHKAN FIXTURE ----

  const event = unique(
    readRecords(eventSheet).filter(item =>
      String(item.event_id) === eventId &&
      String(item.event_name) ===
        LIVE_UPLOAD_TEST_EVENT_NAME
    ),
    "TEST_EVENT_INVALID"
  );

  const qr = unique(
    readRecords(qrSheet).filter(item =>
      String(item.event_id) === eventId &&
      String(item.qr_label) ===
        "__LIVE_TEST_QR__"
    ),
    "TEST_QR_INVALID"
  );

  const cycle = unique(
    readRecords(cycleSheet).filter(item =>
      String(item.event_id) === eventId &&
      String(item.qr_id) === String(qr.qr_id) &&
      String(item.cycle_id) ===
        String(qr.current_cycle_id)
    ),
    "TEST_CYCLE_INVALID"
  );

  if (
    String(event.event_status) !== "ACTIVE" ||
    String(event.deletion_status) !== "ACTIVE" ||
    String(qr.qr_status) !== "ACTIVE" ||
    String(qr.deletion_status) !== "ACTIVE" ||
    String(cycle.cycle_status) !== "ACTIVE"
  ) {
    throw new Error("TEST_FIXTURE_NOT_ACTIVE");
  }

  if (
    Number(qr.max_uploads) !== 2 ||
    Number(cycle.max_uploads) !== 2 ||
    Number(cycle.cycle_number) !== 1
  ) {
    throw new Error("TEST_QUOTA_CONFIG_INVALID");
  }

  // ---- 4. SAHKAN STRUKTUR DRIVE ----

  const rootFolderId =
    props.getProperty("ROOT_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID");

  if (!rootFolderId) {
    throw new Error("ROOT_FOLDER_MISSING");
  }

  const eventFolder = DriveApp.getFolderById(
    String(event.drive_folder_id)
  );

  const qrFolder = DriveApp.getFolderById(
    String(qr.drive_folder_id)
  );

  function hasParent(folder, parentId) {

    const parents = folder.getParents();

    while (parents.hasNext()) {
      if (parents.next().getId() === parentId) {
        return true;
      }
    }

    return false;
  }

  if (
    !hasParent(eventFolder, rootFolderId) ||
    !hasParent(
      qrFolder,
      String(event.drive_folder_id)
    )
  ) {
    throw new Error("TEST_FOLDER_HIERARCHY_INVALID");
  }

  // ---- 5. JANA JPEG SEBENAR ----

  const blob = buildLiveTestJpegBlob_();
  const bytes = blob.getBytes();

  const unsigned = value => value & 255;

  if (
    bytes.length < 100 ||
    bytes.length > 8388608 ||
    unsigned(bytes[0]) !== 255 ||
    unsigned(bytes[1]) !== 216 ||
    unsigned(bytes[2]) !== 255 ||
    unsigned(bytes[bytes.length - 1]) !== 217 ||
    unsigned(bytes[bytes.length - 2]) !== 255
  ) {
    throw new Error("TEST_JPEG_INVALID");
  }

  // ---- 6. GUNA IDEMPOTENCY KEY KEKAL ----

  // Key disimpan sebelum reservation.
  // Jika fungsi terganggu, cubaan semula
  // akan mencari reservation yang sama.

  const keyProperty =
    "LIVE_TEST_511_JPEG_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY";

  let idempotencyKey =
    props.getProperty(keyProperty);

  if (!idempotencyKey) {

    idempotencyKey = Utilities.getUuid();

    props.setProperty(
      keyProperty,
      idempotencyKey
    );

  }

  // ---- 7. CARI RESERVATION SEDIA ADA ----

  function findReservation() {

    const matches = readRecords(uploadSheet)
      .filter(item =>
        String(item.event_id) === eventId &&
        String(item.qr_id) === String(qr.qr_id) &&
        String(item.cycle_id) ===
          String(cycle.cycle_id) &&
        String(item.idempotency_key) ===
          idempotencyKey
      );

    if (matches.length > 1) {
      throw new Error(
        "DUPLICATE_TEST_RESERVATION"
      );
    }

    return matches[0] || null;
  }

  let reservation = findReservation();

  // ---- 8. CIPTA RESERVATION JIKA BELUM ADA ----

  if (!reservation) {

    const quota = getEffectiveUploadQuota_(
      String(qr.qr_id)
    );

    if (
      quota.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
      quota.quota_status !== "AVAILABLE" ||
      Number(
        quota.remaining_reservable_uploads
      ) < 1
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "TEST_QUOTA_NOT_AVAILABLE"
      );
    }

    const result =
      reserveParticipantUploadInternal_(
        {
          qr_token: String(qr.qr_token),
          idempotency_key: idempotencyKey,
          original_filename:
            "live_test_2x2.jpg",
          file_mime_type: "image/jpeg",
          file_size_bytes: bytes.length
        },
        true
      );

    // Jangan log result:
    // mungkin mengandungi lease token.

    reservation = findReservation();

    if (
      !reservation ||
      String(reservation.upload_status) !==
        "RESERVED"
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "RESERVATION_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED"
      );
    }

    // Semak metadata yang telah disimpan.

    if (
      String(reservation.file_mime_type) !==
        "image/jpeg" ||
      Number(reservation.file_size_bytes) !==
        bytes.length
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "RESERVATION_METADATA_MISMATCH"
      );
    }

  }

  // ---- 9. KUNCI PEMPROSESAN ----

  const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();

  if (!lock.tryLock(10000)) {
    throw new Error("TEST_PROCESSING_LOCK_BUSY");
  }

  try {

    // Baca semula di dalam lock.

    reservation = findReservation();

    if (!reservation) {
      throw new Error(
        "RESERVATION_DISAPPEARED"
      );
    }

    if (
      String(reservation.event_id) !== eventId ||
      String(reservation.qr_id) !==
        String(qr.qr_id) ||
      String(reservation.cycle_id) !==
        String(cycle.cycle_id) ||
      String(reservation.file_mime_type) !==
        "image/jpeg" ||
      Number(reservation.file_size_bytes) !==
        bytes.length ||
      String(reservation.deletion_status) !==
        "ACTIVE"
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "RESERVATION_INTEGRITY_FAILED"
      );
    }

    const status =
      String(reservation.upload_status);

    if (
      !["RESERVED", "PROCESSING", "COMPLETED"]
        .includes(status)
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "RESERVATION_STATUS_UNEXPECTED"
      );
    }

    // ---- 10. NAMA FAIL DETERMINISTIK ----

    const filename =
      "live_test_" +
      String(reservation.upload_id) +
      ".jpg";

    // ---- 11. SEMAK FAIL SEDIA ADA ----

    const matches =
      qrFolder.getFilesByName(filename);

    const foundFiles = [];

    while (matches.hasNext()) {
      foundFiles.push(matches.next());
    }

    if (foundFiles.length > 1) {
      throw new Error(
        "DUPLICATE_DRIVE_FILES_RECONCILE"
      );
    }

    let file = foundFiles[0] || null;

    if (
      reservation.drive_file_id &&
      file &&
      String(reservation.drive_file_id) !==
        file.getId()
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "DRIVE_FILE_ID_CONFLICT"
      );
    }

    if (
      reservation.drive_file_id &&
      !file
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "LINKED_DRIVE_FILE_NOT_FOUND"
      );
    }

    // ---- 12. JIKA SUDAH COMPLETED ----

    if (status === "COMPLETED") {

      if (!file) {
        throw new Error(
          "COMPLETED_FILE_MISSING"
        );
      }

      Logger.log(
        "TEST UPLOAD ALREADY COMPLETED"
      );

    } else {

      // ---- 13. SEMAK LEASE ----

      // Jika fail belum ada, lease mesti sah.
      // Jika fail sudah ada, recovery dibenarkan
      // hanya untuk PROCESSING.

      if (!file) {

        const expiry =
          reservation.lease_expires_at;

        const expiryMs =
          expiry instanceof Date
            ? expiry.getTime()
            : Date.parse(String(expiry));

        if (
          !Number.isFinite(expiryMs) ||
          expiryMs <= Date.now()
        ) {
          throw new Error(
            "TEST_LEASE_EXPIRED_RECONCILE"
          );
        }

      } else if (status !== "PROCESSING") {

        throw new Error(
          "EXISTING_FILE_STATE_UNEXPECTED"
        );

      }

      // ---- 14. TANDA PROCESSING ----

      if (status === "RESERVED") {

        setField(
          uploadSheet,
          reservation._row,
          "upload_status",
          "PROCESSING"
        );

        setField(
          uploadSheet,
          reservation._row,
          "started_at",
          new Date().toISOString()
        );

        SpreadsheetApp.flush();

      }

      // ---- 15. CIPTA FAIL JIKA BELUM ADA ----

      if (!file) {

        file = qrFolder.createFile(
          blob.copyBlob().setName(filename)
        );

      }

      // ---- 16. SAHKAN FAIL DRIVE ----

      if (
        file.getMimeType() !== "image/jpeg" ||
        Number(file.getSize()) !== bytes.length ||
        !hasParent(
          file,
          String(qr.drive_folder_id)
        )
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          "DRIVE_FILE_VERIFICATION_FAILED"
        );
      }

      // ---- 17. SIMPAN PAUTAN FAIL ----

      setField(
        uploadSheet,
        reservation._row,
        "drive_file_id",
        file.getId()
      );

      setField(
        uploadSheet,
        reservation._row,
        "drive_file_name",
        filename
      );

      SpreadsheetApp.flush();

      // ---- 18. COMMIT COMPLETED ----

      const completedAt =
        new Date().toISOString();

      setField(
        uploadSheet,
        reservation._row,
        "completed_at",
        completedAt
      );

      setField(
        uploadSheet,
        reservation._row,
        "updated_at",
        completedAt
      );

      // Status ditulis selepas metadata fail.

      setField(
        uploadSheet,
        reservation._row,
        "upload_status",
        "COMPLETED"
      );

      SpreadsheetApp.flush();

    }

    // ---- 19. SELARASKAN KUOTA ----

    // Kira daripada rekod COMPLETED sebenar.
    // Ini mengelakkan penambahan berganda
    // jika fungsi dijalankan semula.

    const completedCount =
      readRecords(uploadSheet).filter(item =>
        String(item.event_id) === eventId &&
        String(item.qr_id) ===
          String(qr.qr_id) &&
        String(item.cycle_id) ===
          String(cycle.cycle_id) &&
        String(item.upload_status) ===
          "COMPLETED" &&
        String(item.deletion_status) ===
          "ACTIVE"
      ).length;

    if (completedCount > 2) {
      throw new Error(
        "TEST_COMPLETED_COUNT_EXCEEDS_QUOTA"
      );
    }

    setField(
      cycleSheet,
      cycle._row,
      "successful_uploads",
      completedCount
    );

    SpreadsheetApp.flush();

  } finally {

    lock.releaseLock();

  }

  // ---- 20. PENGESAHAN AKHIR ----

  const finalReservation = findReservation();

  const finalCycle = unique(
    readRecords(cycleSheet).filter(item =>
      String(item.cycle_id) ===
        String(cycle.cycle_id)
    ),
    "FINAL_CYCLE_MISSING"
  );

  const finalFile = DriveApp.getFileById(
    String(finalReservation.drive_file_id)
  );

  const summary = {

    reservation_exists:
      !!finalReservation,

    upload_completed:
      finalReservation.upload_status ===
        "COMPLETED",

    drive_file_linked:
      !!finalReservation.drive_file_id,

    jpeg_mime_valid:
      finalFile.getMimeType() ===
        "image/jpeg",

    jpeg_size_matches:
      Number(finalFile.getSize()) ===
        bytes.length,

    successful_uploads:
      Number(finalCycle.successful_uploads),

    completed_at_saved:
      !!finalReservation.completed_at,

    cleanup_performed: false

  };

  Logger.log(
    "LIVE JPEG STORAGE TEST:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
  );

  if (
    !summary.reservation_exists ||
    !summary.upload_completed ||
    !summary.drive_file_linked ||
    !summary.jpeg_mime_valid ||
    !summary.jpeg_size_matches ||
    !summary.completed_at_saved ||
    summary.successful_uploads !== 1
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "LIVE_JPEG_FINAL_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED"
    );
  }

  Logger.log(
    "LIVE JPEG STORAGE AND COMPLETION PASSED"
  );

  return {
    status: "SUCCESS",
    code: "LIVE_JPEG_COMPLETED",
    saved: true,
    completed: true,
    verified: true
  };

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 4.26A
   LIVE TEST CLEANUP SAFETY AUDIT

   TUJUAN:
   - Kenal pasti fixture sementara.
   - Sahkan hubungan EVENTS, QR_SLOTS,
     QUOTA_CYCLES dan UPLOADS.
   - Sahkan folder dan fail Drive.
   - Kesan data asing atau pendua.
   - Tentukan sama ada cleanup selamat.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - READ ONLY.
   - Tiada deleteRow().
   - Tiada setTrashed().
   - Tiada perubahan Script Properties.
   - Tiada ID atau token dalam log.

   PENTING:
   Audit ini bukan arahan pemadaman.
============================================ */

function auditLiveTestCleanupSafety_() {

  // ---- 1. KONFIGURASI ----

  const props =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  const spreadsheetId =
    props.getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

  const rootFolderId =
    props.getProperty("ROOT_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID");

  const testEventId =
    props.getProperty("LIVE_UPLOAD_TEST_511_EVENT_ID");

  const testKey =
    props.getProperty(
      "LIVE_TEST_511_JPEG_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY"
    );

  if (
    !spreadsheetId ||
    !rootFolderId ||
    !testEventId ||
    !testKey
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "CLEANUP_AUDIT_CONFIGURATION_MISSING"
    );
  }

  const ss =
    SpreadsheetApp.openById(spreadsheetId);

  // ---- 2. PEMBANTU BACA JADUAL ----

  function readTable(name, requiredHeaders) {

    const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(name);

    if (!sheet) {
      throw new Error(
        "AUDIT_SHEET_MISSING_" + name
      );
    }

    const data =
      sheet.getDataRange().getValues();

    const headers = data[0];

    if (
      new Set(headers).size !== headers.length ||
      requiredHeaders.some(
        header => !headers.includes(header)
      )
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "AUDIT_HEADERS_INVALID_" + name
      );
    }

    return data.slice(1).map(row => {

      const record = {};

      headers.forEach((header, index) => {
        record[header] = row[index];
      });

      return record;

    });
  }

  const events = readTable("EVENTS", [
    "event_id", "event_name",
    "event_status", "deletion_status",
    "drive_folder_id"
  ]);

  const qrSlots = readTable("QR_SLOTS", [
    "qr_id", "event_id", "qr_label",
    "current_cycle_id", "drive_folder_id",
    "deletion_status"
  ]);

  const cycles = readTable("QUOTA_CYCLES", [
    "cycle_id", "event_id", "qr_id",
    "successful_uploads"
  ]);

  const uploads = readTable("UPLOADS", [
    "upload_id", "idempotency_key",
    "event_id", "qr_id", "cycle_id",
    "upload_status", "drive_file_id",
    "drive_file_name", "deletion_status"
  ]);

  // ---- 3. KUMPUL REKOD UJIAN ----

  const eventMatches = events.filter(item =>
    String(item.event_id) === testEventId
  );

  const qrMatches = qrSlots.filter(item =>
    String(item.event_id) === testEventId
  );

  const cycleMatches = cycles.filter(item =>
    String(item.event_id) === testEventId
  );

  const uploadMatches = uploads.filter(item =>
    String(item.event_id) === testEventId
  );

  const checks = {};

  checks.exactly_one_event =
    eventMatches.length === 1;

  checks.exactly_one_qr =
    qrMatches.length === 1;

  checks.exactly_one_cycle =
    cycleMatches.length === 1;

  checks.exactly_two_uploads =
    uploadMatches.length === 2;

  // Jangan akses rekod jika tidak unik.

  if (
    !checks.exactly_one_event ||
    !checks.exactly_one_qr ||
    !checks.exactly_one_cycle
  ) {
    Logger.log(
      "CLEANUP AUDIT BLOCKED: RECORD COUNT"
    );

    return {
      status: "BLOCKED",
      cleanup_allowed: false,
      checks: checks
    };
  }

  const event = eventMatches[0];
  const qr = qrMatches[0];
  const cycle = cycleMatches[0];

  // ---- 4. SAHKAN IDENTITI FIXTURE ----

  checks.event_name_valid =
    String(event.event_name) ===
    LIVE_UPLOAD_TEST_EVENT_NAME;

  checks.qr_label_valid =
    String(qr.qr_label) ===
    "__LIVE_TEST_QR__";

  checks.qr_belongs_to_event =
    String(qr.event_id) === testEventId;

  checks.cycle_belongs_to_qr =
    String(cycle.qr_id) ===
    String(qr.qr_id);

  checks.current_cycle_matches =
    String(qr.current_cycle_id) ===
    String(cycle.cycle_id);

  checks.quota_limit_is_two =
    Number(qr.max_uploads) === 2 &&
    Number(cycle.max_uploads) === 2;

  checks.successful_uploads_is_one =
    Number(cycle.successful_uploads) === 1;

  // ---- 5. SEMAK UPLOADS ----

  const completed = uploadMatches.filter(
    item =>
      String(item.upload_status) ===
      "COMPLETED"
  );

  const reserved = uploadMatches.filter(
    item =>
      String(item.upload_status) ===
      "RESERVED"
  );

  checks.one_completed =
    completed.length === 1;

  checks.one_reserved =
    reserved.length === 1;

  checks.all_uploads_match_qr =
    uploadMatches.every(item =>
      String(item.qr_id) ===
        String(qr.qr_id) &&
      String(item.cycle_id) ===
        String(cycle.cycle_id) &&
      String(item.deletion_status) ===
        "ACTIVE"
    );

  checks.completed_key_matches =
    completed.length === 1 &&
    String(completed[0].idempotency_key) ===
      testKey;

  checks.reserved_has_no_drive_file =
    reserved.length === 1 &&
    !reserved[0].drive_file_id;

  checks.completed_has_drive_file =
    completed.length === 1 &&
    !!completed[0].drive_file_id &&
    !!completed[0].completed_at;

  // ---- 6. KESAN RUJUKAN SILANG ----

  // Jangan benarkan cleanup jika terdapat
  // rekod lain yang menggunakan ID QR
  // atau cycle ujian.

  checks.no_foreign_qr_references =
    qrSlots.every(item =>
      String(item.qr_id) !==
        String(qr.qr_id) ||
      String(item.event_id) === testEventId
    );

  checks.no_foreign_cycle_references =
    cycles.every(item =>
      (
        String(item.cycle_id) !==
          String(cycle.cycle_id) &&
        String(item.qr_id) !==
          String(qr.qr_id)
      ) ||
      String(item.event_id) === testEventId
    );

  checks.no_foreign_upload_references =
    uploads.every(item =>
      (
        String(item.qr_id) !==
          String(qr.qr_id) &&
        String(item.cycle_id) !==
          String(cycle.cycle_id)
      ) ||
      String(item.event_id) === testEventId
    );

  // ---- 7. SAHKAN FOLDER DRIVE ----

  let driveChecksPassed = false;
  let driveFileCount = 0;
  let driveSubfolderCount = 0;

  try {

    const root =
      DriveApp.getFolderById(rootFolderId);

    const eventFolder =
      DriveApp.getFolderById(
        String(event.drive_folder_id)
      );

    const qrFolder =
      DriveApp.getFolderById(
        String(qr.drive_folder_id)
      );

    function hasParent(folder, parentId) {

      const parents = folder.getParents();

      while (parents.hasNext()) {

        if (
          parents.next().getId() === parentId
        ) {
          return true;
        }

      }

      return false;
    }

    checks.event_folder_under_root =
      hasParent(eventFolder, root.getId());

    checks.qr_folder_under_event =
      hasParent(
        qrFolder,
        eventFolder.getId()
      );

    // Sahkan nama folder tepat.

    checks.event_folder_name_valid =
      eventFolder.getName() ===
      String(event.event_name) +
      " [" + testEventId + "]";

    checks.qr_folder_name_valid =
      qrFolder.getName() ===
      String(qr.qr_label) +
      " [" + qr.qr_id + "]";

    // ---- 8. SENARAI KANDUNGAN QR ----

    const files = qrFolder.getFiles();

    const fileIds = [];

    while (files.hasNext()) {

      const file = files.next();

      fileIds.push(file.getId());
      driveFileCount++;

    }

    const subfolders = qrFolder.getFolders();

    while (subfolders.hasNext()) {
      subfolders.next();
      driveSubfolderCount++;
    }

    checks.one_jpeg_in_qr_folder =
      driveFileCount === 1;

    checks.no_qr_subfolders =
      driveSubfolderCount === 0;

    // ---- 9. SEMAK FAIL COMPLETED ----

    if (completed.length === 1) {

      const completedUpload = completed[0];

      const expectedName =
        "live_test_" +
        String(completedUpload.upload_id) +
        ".jpg";

      const file =
        DriveApp.getFileById(
          String(completedUpload.drive_file_id)
        );

      checks.completed_file_in_qr_folder =
        fileIds.length === 1 &&
        fileIds[0] === file.getId();

      checks.completed_filename_valid =
        file.getName() === expectedName &&
        String(
          completedUpload.drive_file_name
        ) === expectedName;

      checks.completed_file_is_jpeg =
        file.getMimeType() === "image/jpeg";

      checks.completed_file_size_valid =
        Number(file.getSize()) ===
        Number(
          completedUpload.file_size_bytes
        );

    } else {

      checks.completed_file_in_qr_folder =
        false;

      checks.completed_filename_valid =
        false;

      checks.completed_file_is_jpeg =
        false;

      checks.completed_file_size_valid =
        false;

    }

    // ---- 10. SEMAK FOLDER ACARA ----

    const eventFiles =
      eventFolder.getFiles();

    checks.no_files_in_event_root =
      !eventFiles.hasNext();

    const eventSubfolders =
      eventFolder.getFolders();

    let childFolderCount = 0;
    let expectedQrFolderFound = false;

    while (eventSubfolders.hasNext()) {

      const child = eventSubfolders.next();

      childFolderCount++;

      if (
        child.getId() === qrFolder.getId()
      ) {
        expectedQrFolderFound = true;
      }

    }

    checks.only_expected_qr_folder =
      childFolderCount === 1 &&
      expectedQrFolderFound;

    driveChecksPassed = true;

  } catch (error) {

    // Jangan dedahkan ID Drive atau
    // mesej ralat yang mungkin sensitif.

    checks.drive_inspection_completed =
      false;

  }

  if (driveChecksPassed) {
    checks.drive_inspection_completed = true;
  }

  // ---- 11. KEPUTUSAN AKHIR ----

  const failedChecks =
    Object.keys(checks).filter(
      key => checks[key] !== true
    );

  const cleanupAllowed =
    failedChecks.length === 0;

  const summary = {

    status:
      cleanupAllowed
        ? "AUDIT_PASSED"
        : "BLOCKED",

    cleanup_allowed: cleanupAllowed,

    event_records:
      eventMatches.length,

    qr_records:
      qrMatches.length,

    cycle_records:
      cycleMatches.length,

    upload_records:
      uploadMatches.length,

    completed_records:
      completed.length,

    reserved_records:
      reserved.length,

    drive_files_in_qr:
      driveFileCount,

    drive_subfolders_in_qr:
      driveSubfolderCount,

    failed_checks:
      failedChecks,

    cleanup_performed: false

  };

  Logger.log(
    "LIVE TEST CLEANUP SAFETY AUDIT:"
  );

  Logger.log(
    JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
  );

  if (cleanupAllowed) {

    Logger.log(
      "LIVE TEST CLEANUP AUDIT PASSED"
    );

  } else {

    Logger.log(
      "LIVE TEST CLEANUP BLOCKED"
    );

  }

  return summary;

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 4.26B
   CONTROLLED LIVE TEST SOFT CLEANUP

   TUJUAN:
   - Audit semula fixture sementara.
   - Pastikan reservation tidak lagi aktif.
   - Nyahaktifkan acara dan QR ujian.
   - Tutup quota cycle.
   - Tandakan rekod UPLOADS sebagai DELETED.
   - Pindahkan folder acara ke Drive Trash.
   - Kekalkan sejarah untuk pemulihan.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - Manual sahaja.
   - Tidak menggunakan deleteRow().
   - Tidak memadam fail secara kekal.
   - Tidak menerima ID daripada Web App.
   - Tidak memaparkan ID atau token.
   - Tidak menjalankan cleanup berulang.
============================================ */


function cleanupLiveUploadTestFixture_() {

  // ---- 1. DAPATKAN SCRIPT LOCK ----

  const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();

  if (!lock.tryLock(10000)) {
    throw new Error("CLEANUP_LOCK_BUSY");
  }

  try {

    // ---- 2. KONFIGURASI ----

    const props =
      PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

    const spreadsheetId =
      props.getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID");

    const testEventId =
      props.getProperty(
        "LIVE_UPLOAD_TEST_511_EVENT_ID"
      );

    const cleanupProperty =
      "LIVE_TEST_511_CLEANUP_STATE";

    if (!spreadsheetId || !testEventId) {
      throw new Error(
        "CLEANUP_CONFIGURATION_MISSING"
      );
    }

    // ---- 3. CEGAH CLEANUP BERULANG ----

    const existingState =
      props.getProperty(cleanupProperty);

    if (existingState) {
      throw new Error(
        "CLEANUP_ALREADY_STARTED_" +
        "RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED"
      );
    }

    // ---- 4. AUDIT SEMULA ----

    // Audit ini tidak memperoleh lock kedua.
    // Ia hanya membaca data sedia ada.

    const audit =
      auditLiveTestCleanupSafety_();

    if (
      audit.status !== "AUDIT_PASSED" ||
      audit.cleanup_allowed !== true
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "CLEANUP_SAFETY_AUDIT_FAILED"
      );
    }

    // ---- 5. BUKA JADUAL ----

    const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
      spreadsheetId
    );

    const eventSheet =
      ss.getSheetByName("EVENTS");

    const qrSheet =
      ss.getSheetByName("QR_SLOTS");

    const cycleSheet =
      ss.getSheetByName("QUOTA_CYCLES");

    const uploadSheet =
      ss.getSheetByName("UPLOADS");

    // ---- 6. PEMBANTU BACA JADUAL ----

    function readTable(sheet) {

      const values =
        sheet.getDataRange().getValues();

      const headers = values[0];

      if (
        new Set(headers).size !== headers.length
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          "CLEANUP_DUPLICATE_HEADERS"
        );
      }

      return values.slice(1).map(
        (row, index) => {

          const item = {
            _row: index + 2
          };

          headers.forEach((header, i) => {
            item[header] = row[i];
          });

          return item;

        }
      );
    }

    function unique(items, errorCode) {

      if (items.length !== 1) {
        throw new Error(errorCode);
      }

      return items[0];
    }

    function setField(
      sheet,
      rowNumber,
      fieldName,
      value
    ) {

      const headers = sheet.getRange(
        1,
        1,
        1,
        sheet.getLastColumn()
      ).getValues()[0];

      const index =
        headers.indexOf(fieldName);

      if (index === -1) {
        throw new Error(
          "CLEANUP_HEADER_MISSING"
        );
      }

      sheet.getRange(
        rowNumber,
        index + 1
      ).setValue(value);
    }

    // ---- 7. KENAL PASTI REKOD ----

    const event = unique(
      readTable(eventSheet).filter(item =>
        String(item.event_id) ===
          testEventId &&
        String(item.event_name) ===
          LIVE_UPLOAD_TEST_EVENT_NAME
      ),
      "CLEANUP_EVENT_NOT_UNIQUE"
    );

    const qr = unique(
      readTable(qrSheet).filter(item =>
        String(item.event_id) ===
          testEventId &&
        String(item.qr_label) ===
          "__LIVE_TEST_QR__"
      ),
      "CLEANUP_QR_NOT_UNIQUE"
    );

    const cycle = unique(
      readTable(cycleSheet).filter(item =>
        String(item.event_id) ===
          testEventId &&
        String(item.qr_id) ===
          String(qr.qr_id) &&
        String(item.cycle_id) ===
          String(qr.current_cycle_id)
      ),
      "CLEANUP_CYCLE_NOT_UNIQUE"
    );

    const uploads =
      readTable(uploadSheet).filter(item =>
        String(item.event_id) ===
          testEventId
      );

    if (uploads.length !== 2) {
      throw new Error(
        "CLEANUP_UPLOAD_COUNT_CHANGED"
      );
    }

    // ---- 8. PASTIKAN TIADA LEASE AKTIF ----

    // Reservation pertama mungkin masih
    // berada dalam status RESERVED.
    // Cleanup tidak dibenarkan selagi
    // lease tersebut belum tamat.

    const nowMs = Date.now();

    for (const upload of uploads) {

      const status =
        String(upload.upload_status);

      if (status === "PROCESSING") {
        throw new Error(
          "CLEANUP_PROCESSING_UPLOAD_FOUND"
        );
      }

      if (status === "RESERVED") {

        const expiry =
          upload.lease_expires_at;

        const expiryMs =
          expiry instanceof Date
            ? expiry.getTime()
            : Date.parse(String(expiry || ""));

        // Jika tarikh tidak boleh dibaca,
        // jangan andaikan lease tamat.

        if (
          !Number.isFinite(expiryMs) ||
          expiryMs > nowMs
        ) {
          throw new Error(
            "CLEANUP_RESERVATION_LEASE_ACTIVE"
          );
        }

      }

    }

    // ---- 9. SIMPAN PENANDA PERMULAAN ----

    // Selepas ini, jika proses gagal,
    // fungsi tidak akan dijalankan semula
    // secara automatik.

    props.setProperty(
      cleanupProperty,
      "STARTED"
    );

    // ---- 10. NYAHAKTIFKAN EVENT ----

    const now =
      new Date().toISOString();

    setField(
      eventSheet,
      event._row,
      "event_status",
      "INACTIVE"
    );

    setField(
      eventSheet,
      event._row,
      "deletion_status",
      "DELETED"
    );

    setField(
      eventSheet,
      event._row,
      "updated_at",
      now
    );

    // ---- 11. NYAHAKTIFKAN QR ----

    setField(
      qrSheet,
      qr._row,
      "qr_status",
      "INACTIVE"
    );

    setField(
      qrSheet,
      qr._row,
      "deletion_status",
      "DELETED"
    );

    setField(
      qrSheet,
      qr._row,
      "updated_at",
      now
    );

    SpreadsheetApp.flush();

    props.setProperty(
      cleanupProperty,
      "ACCESS_DISABLED"
    );

    // ---- 12. TUTUP QUOTA CYCLE ----

    setField(
      cycleSheet,
      cycle._row,
      "cycle_status",
      "CLOSED"
    );

    setField(
      cycleSheet,
      cycle._row,
      "ended_at",
      now
    );

    setField(
      cycleSheet,
      cycle._row,
      "closed_by",
      "MANUAL_TEST_CLEANUP"
    );

    setField(
      cycleSheet,
      cycle._row,
      "reset_reason",
      "TEMPORARY_TEST_CLEANUP"
    );

    // successful_uploads dikekalkan.
    // Jangan reset sejarah completion.

    // ---- 13. SOFT DELETE UPLOADS ----

    for (const upload of uploads) {

      setField(
        uploadSheet,
        upload._row,
        "deletion_status",
        "DELETED"
      );

      setField(
        uploadSheet,
        upload._row,
        "deleted_at",
        now
      );

      setField(
        uploadSheet,
        upload._row,
        "updated_at",
        now
      );

    }

    SpreadsheetApp.flush();

    props.setProperty(
      cleanupProperty,
      "SHEETS_ARCHIVED"
    );

    // ---- 14. PINDAHKAN FOLDER KE TRASH ----

    // Struktur folder sudah disahkan
    // dalam audit sebelum cleanup.
    // Hanya folder acara sementara
    // dipindahkan ke Trash.

    const folder = DriveApp.getFolderById(
      String(event.drive_folder_id)
    );

    folder.setTrashed(true);

    props.setProperty(
      cleanupProperty,
      "DRIVE_TRASHED"
    );

    // ---- 15. SAHKAN KEADAAN AKHIR ----

    const finalEvent = unique(
      readTable(eventSheet).filter(item =>
        String(item.event_id) ===
          testEventId
      ),
      "FINAL_EVENT_MISSING"
    );

    const finalQr = unique(
      readTable(qrSheet).filter(item =>
        String(item.qr_id) ===
          String(qr.qr_id)
      ),
      "FINAL_QR_MISSING"
    );

    const finalCycle = unique(
      readTable(cycleSheet).filter(item =>
        String(item.cycle_id) ===
          String(cycle.cycle_id)
      ),
      "FINAL_CYCLE_MISSING"
    );

    const finalUploads =
      readTable(uploadSheet).filter(item =>
        String(item.event_id) ===
          testEventId
      );

    const summary = {

      event_inactive:
        finalEvent.event_status ===
          "INACTIVE" &&
        finalEvent.deletion_status ===
          "DELETED",

      qr_inactive:
        finalQr.qr_status ===
          "INACTIVE" &&
        finalQr.deletion_status ===
          "DELETED",

      cycle_closed:
        finalCycle.cycle_status ===
          "CLOSED",

      upload_history_preserved:
        finalUploads.length === 2,

      uploads_soft_deleted:
        finalUploads.length === 2 &&
        finalUploads.every(item =>
          item.deletion_status ===
          "DELETED"
        ),

      successful_uploads_preserved:
        Number(
          finalCycle.successful_uploads
        ) === 1,

      event_folder_trashed:
        folder.isTrashed(),

      permanent_rows_deleted: false

    };

    const allPassed =
      Object.values(summary).every(
        value => value === true
      ) ||
      (
        Object.entries(summary).every(
          ([key, value]) =>
            key === "permanent_rows_deleted"
              ? value === false
              : value === true
        )
      );

    if (!allPassed) {
      throw new Error(
        "CLEANUP_FINAL_RECONCILIATION_FAILED"
      );
    }

    props.setProperty(
      cleanupProperty,
      "COMPLETED"
    );

    Logger.log(
      "LIVE TEST CLEANUP SUMMARY:"
    );

    Logger.log(
      JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
    );

    Logger.log(
      "LIVE TEST SOFT CLEANUP PASSED"
    );

    return {
      status: "SUCCESS",
      code: "LIVE_TEST_CLEANUP_COMPLETED",
      cleanup_completed: true,
      summary: summary
    };

  } finally {

    lock.releaseLock();

  }

}
/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 5.01
   SECURE ROUTER AUTOMATED TEST

   TUJUAN:
   - Uji request sah.
   - Uji JSON tidak sah.
   - Uji action tidak dikenali.
   - Uji upload awam disekat.
   - Uji had saiz.
   - Pastikan tiada data sensitif bocor.
============================================ */

function testSecurePostRouter_() {

  // ---- 1. PEMBANTU REQUEST SIMULASI ----

  function send(body) {

    const event = {
      postData: {
        contents: body
      }
    };

    const output = doPost(event);

    return JSON.parse(
      output.getContent()
    );

  }

  // ---- 2. PEMBANTU ASSERT ----

  function assert(condition, code) {

    if (!condition) {
      throw new Error(
        "ROUTER_TEST_FAILED_" + code
      );
    }

  }

  // ---- 3. TEST POST SAH ----

  const valid = send(
    JSON.stringify({
      action: "test_post",
      message: "Hello QR Polaroid"
    })
  );

  assert(
    valid.status === "SUCCESS" &&
    valid.code === "TEST_POST_SUCCESS",
    "VALID_POST"
  );

  // ---- 4. TEST UPLOAD DISEKAT ----

  const blockedUpload = send(
    JSON.stringify({
      action: "test_upload"
    })
  );

  assert(
    blockedUpload.code ===
      "UPLOAD_TEST_DISABLED",
    "UPLOAD_BLOCKED"
  );

  // ---- 5. TEST ACTION TIDAK DIKENALI ----

  const unknown = send(
    JSON.stringify({
      action: "reserveParticipantUploadInternal_"
    })
  );

  assert(
    unknown.code === "UNSUPPORTED_ACTION",
    "UNKNOWN_ACTION"
  );

  // ---- 6. TEST JSON ROSAK ----

  const invalidJson = send(
    "{invalid json"
  );

  assert(
    invalidJson.code === "INVALID_JSON",
    "INVALID_JSON"
  );

  // ---- 7. TEST NULL ----

  const nullRequest = send("null");

  assert(
    nullRequest.code ===
      "INVALID_REQUEST_FORMAT",
    "NULL_REQUEST"
  );

  // ---- 8. TEST ARRAY ----

  const arrayRequest = send("[]");

  assert(
    arrayRequest.code ===
      "INVALID_REQUEST_FORMAT",
    "ARRAY_REQUEST"
  );

  // ---- 9. TEST ACTION KOSONG ----

  const emptyAction = send(
    JSON.stringify({
      action: ""
    })
  );

  assert(
    emptyAction.code === "INVALID_ACTION",
    "EMPTY_ACTION"
  );

  // ---- 10. TEST INPUT TERLALU BESAR ----

  const largeRequest = send(
    JSON.stringify({
      action: "test_post",
      message: "A".repeat(3000)
    })
  );

  assert(
    largeRequest.code ===
      "REQUEST_TOO_LARGE",
    "LARGE_REQUEST"
  );

  // ---- 11. TEST JENIS MESEJ ----

  const invalidMessage = send(
    JSON.stringify({
      action: "test_post",
      message: {
        secret: "SHOULD_NOT_APPEAR"
      }
    })
  );

  assert(
    invalidMessage.code ===
      "INVALID_MESSAGE",
    "INVALID_MESSAGE"
  );

  // ---- 12. TEST TIADA KEBOCORAN ----

  const responses = [
    valid,
    blockedUpload,
    unknown,
    invalidJson,
    nullRequest,
    arrayRequest,
    emptyAction,
    largeRequest,
    invalidMessage
  ];

  const responseText =
    JSON.stringify(responses);

  assert(
    !responseText.includes(
      "SHOULD_NOT_APPEAR"
    ),
    "SENSITIVE_DATA_LEAK"
  );

  // ---- 13. KEPUTUSAN ----

  Logger.log(
    "SECURE POST ROUTER TEST PASSED"
  );

  Logger.log(
    "TOTAL TESTS PASSED: 10"
  );

  return {
    status: "SUCCESS",
    tests_passed: 10,
    database_modified: false,
    drive_modified: false
  };

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 5.02
   PARTICIPANT API RESPONSE CONTRACT

   TUJUAN:
   - Menyeragamkan respons API peserta.
   - Mengawal kod status yang dibenarkan.
   - Mengelakkan pendedahan data dalaman.

   KESELAMATAN:
   - Tiada operasi Sheets atau Drive.
   - Tiada perubahan doPost().
   - Tiada endpoint baharu diaktifkan.
============================================ */

function buildParticipantApiResponse_(
  action,
  code,
  data
) {

  // ---- 1. SENARAI ACTION ----

  const allowedActions = [
    "check_qr",
    "upload_jpeg",
    "upload_status"
  ];

  if (!allowedActions.includes(action)) {
    throw new Error("API_ACTION_INVALID");
  }

  // ---- 2. KOD RESPONS DIBENARKAN ----

  const allowedCodes = [
    "QR_AVAILABLE",
    "EVENT_NOT_STARTED",
    "EVENT_ENDED",
    "EVENT_INACTIVE",
    "QR_INACTIVE",
    "QUOTA_FULL",
    "INVALID_QR",
    "UPLOAD_COMPLETED",
    "UPLOAD_PROCESSING",
    "UPLOAD_NOT_FOUND",
    "UPLOAD_FAILED",
    "INVALID_FILE",
    "FILE_TOO_LARGE",
    "INVALID_REQUEST",
    "RATE_LIMITED",
    "SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE",
    "INTERNAL_ERROR"
  ];

  if (!allowedCodes.includes(code)) {
    throw new Error("API_CODE_INVALID");
  }

  // ---- 3. TENTUKAN STATUS ----

  const successCodes = [
    "QR_AVAILABLE",
    "UPLOAD_COMPLETED"
  ];

  const pendingCodes = [
    "UPLOAD_PROCESSING"
  ];

  let status = "ERROR";

  if (successCodes.includes(code)) {
    status = "SUCCESS";
  } else if (pendingCodes.includes(code)) {
    status = "PENDING";
  }

  // ---- 4. DATA AWAM DIBENARKAN ----

  // Jangan pulangkan objek database mentah.
  // Hanya medan yang disenaraikan dibenarkan.

  const allowedDataFields = [
    "eligible",
    "remaining_uploads",
    "upload_status"
  ];

  const safeData = {};

  if (
    data !== null &&
    typeof data === "object" &&
    !Array.isArray(data)
  ) {

    allowedDataFields.forEach(field => {

      if (
        Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
          data, field
        )
      ) {
        safeData[field] = data[field];
      }

    });

  }

  // ---- 5. BINA RESPONS ----

  return {
    status: status,
    action: action,
    code: code,
    data: safeData
  };

}

/* ============================================
   LANGKAH 5.03C-1
   TEMPORARY PAYLOAD TEST HANDLER

   TUJUAN:
   - Menguji penerimaan payload 64 KB.
   - Tidak menyimpan kandungan payload.
   - Tidak membaca atau menulis database.
   - Tidak mencipta fail Drive.

   NOTA:
   Fungsi ini sementara sahaja.
============================================ */

function handleTemporaryPayloadTest_(rawBody) {

  // ---- 1. HAD SAIZ KESELURUHAN ----

  const MAX_BODY_CHARS = 530000;

  if (
    typeof rawBody !== "string" ||
    rawBody.length > MAX_BODY_CHARS
  ) {
    return {
      status: "ERROR",
      code: "PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE"
    };
  }

  // ---- 2. BACA JSON ----

  let data;

  try {
    data = JSON.parse(rawBody);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      status: "ERROR",
      code: "INVALID_JSON"
    };
  }

  // ---- 3. VALIDASI ACTION DAN DATA ----

  const expectedLengths = {
    test_payload_64k: 65536,
    test_payload_512k: 524288
  };

  if (
    !data ||
    typeof data !== "object" ||
    Array.isArray(data) ||
    !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(expectedLengths, data.action) ||
    typeof data.payload !== "string" ||
    data.payload.length !== expectedLengths[data.action] ||
    !/^A+$/.test(data.payload)
  ) {
    return {
      status: "ERROR",
      code: "INVALID_TEST_PAYLOAD"
    };
  }

  // ---- 4. RESPONS TANPA DATA ASAL ----

  return {
    status: "SUCCESS",
    code: "PAYLOAD_TEST_PASSED",
    received_chars: data.payload.length,
    received_bytes: data.payload.length
  };

}




/* =====================================================
   LANGKAH 5.04A - PUBLIC QR CHECK (READ-ONLY)

   - Hanya menerima token QR 64 aksara hex.
   - Tidak mendedahkan token, ID dalaman atau rekod Sheets.
   - Tidak membuat reservation / menulis Sheets atau Drive.
   - Semua ralat dalaman dipulangkan secara generik.
===================================================== */

function handlePublicQrCheck_(requestData) {
  function response(code, data) {
    return buildParticipantApiResponse_("check_qr", code, data || {});
  }

  if (
    !requestData ||
    typeof requestData !== "object" ||
    Array.isArray(requestData) ||
    typeof requestData.qr_token !== "string" ||
    !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/i.test(requestData.qr_token)
  ) {
    return response("INVALID_QR", {eligible: false});
  }

  try {
    const result = checkUploadEligibility_(requestData.qr_token);
    if (!result || result.status !== "SUCCESS") {
      return response("SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE", {eligible: false});
    }

    if (result.eligible === true) {
      const remaining = Number(result.remaining_uploads);
      if (!Number.isInteger(remaining) || remaining < 1) {
        return response("SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE", {eligible: false});
      }
      return response("QR_AVAILABLE", {
        eligible: true,
        remaining_uploads: remaining
      });
    }

    const mapping = {
      INVALID_TOKEN: "INVALID_QR",
      QR_INACTIVE: "QR_INACTIVE",
      QUOTA_UNAVAILABLE: "QUOTA_FULL",
      EVENT_NOT_STARTED: "EVENT_NOT_STARTED",
      EVENT_ENDED: "EVENT_ENDED",
      EVENT_INACTIVE: "EVENT_INACTIVE"
    };
    const code = mapping[result.eligibility_code] || "SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE";
    return response(code, {eligible: false});

  } catch (error) {
    console.error("PUBLIC_QR_CHECK_FAILED");
    return response("SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE", {eligible: false});
  }
}

/* =====================================================
   LANGKAH 5.04A - UJIAN INPUT TIDAK SAH
   Ujian ini tidak membaca/menulis database.
===================================================== */

function testPublicQrCheckInput_() {
  const cases = [
    {},
    {action: "check_qr"},
    {action: "check_qr", qr_token: 123},
    {action: "check_qr", qr_token: "abc"},
    {action: "check_qr", qr_token: "g".repeat(64)}
  ];
  cases.forEach(function (data, index) {
    const result = handlePublicQrCheck_(data);
    if (
      result.action !== "check_qr" ||
      result.code !== "INVALID_QR" ||
      result.data.eligible !== false ||
      Object.keys(result.data).length !== 1
    ) {
      throw new Error("PUBLIC_QR_INPUT_TEST_FAILED_" + index);
    }
  });
  console.log("PUBLIC_QR_INPUT_TEST_PASSED_5_OF_5");
}


/* =====================================================
   LANGKAH 5.05A - PREFLIGHT UPLOAD JPEG (TANPA WRITE)
   - Belum dihubungkan kepada doPost.
   - Tidak menyentuh Google Sheets / Drive.
   - Menolak data Base64 rosak, metadata palsu dan JPEG
     yang tidak mempunyai penanda SOI/EOI.
   - Tidak membuktikan bahawa JPEG boleh didekod sepenuhnya.
===================================================== */
function validatePublicJpegPayload505_(request) {
  const reject = function(code) { return {status:'REJECTED',code:code}; };
  if (!request || typeof request !== 'object' || Array.isArray(request) ||
      request.action !== 'upload_jpeg' ||
      typeof request.qr_token !== 'string' ||
      !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/i.test(request.qr_token) ||
      typeof request.idempotency_key !== 'string' ||
      !/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(request.idempotency_key)) {
    return reject('INVALID_REQUEST');
  }
  if (request.file_mime_type !== 'image/jpeg' ||
      typeof request.original_filename !== 'string' ||
      request.original_filename.length < 1 ||
      request.original_filename.length > 180 ||
      /[\\/\x00-\x1f\x7f]/.test(request.original_filename)) {
    return reject('INVALID_FILE');
  }
  const size = request.file_size_bytes;
  if (!Number.isInteger(size) || size < 4) return reject('INVALID_FILE');
  if (size > 8 * 1024 * 1024) return reject('FILE_TOO_LARGE');
  const b64 = request.jpeg_base64;
  if (typeof b64 !== 'string') return reject('INVALID_FILE');
  const expectedLength = 4 * Math.ceil(size / 3);
  if (b64.length !== expectedLength || !/^[A-Za-z0-9+/]+={0,2}$/.test(b64)) {
    return reject('INVALID_FILE');
  }
  // Penanda JPEG sahaja; tidak decode fail penuh dalam preflight.
  if (!b64.startsWith('/9j/')) {
    // JPEG FF D8 FF menghasilkan prefix /9j/.
    return reject('INVALID_FILE');
  }
  // EOI FF D9 diperiksa selepas decode di peringkat penyimpanan.
  return {status:'VALID',code:'JPEG_PREFLIGHT_VALID',file_size_bytes:size};
}

function testPublicJpegPayload505_() {
  const base = {
    action:'upload_jpeg', qr_token:'a'.repeat(64),
    idempotency_key:'123e4567-e89b-42d3-a456-426614174000',
    original_filename:'test.jpg',file_mime_type:'image/jpeg',
    file_size_bytes:4,jpeg_base64:'/9j/2Q=='
  };
  const checks = [
    [base,'VALID'],
    [{...base,qr_token:'bad'},'INVALID_REQUEST'],
    [{...base,idempotency_key:'bad'},'INVALID_REQUEST'],
    [{...base,file_mime_type:'image/png'},'INVALID_FILE'],
    [{...base,file_size_bytes:8*1024*1024+1},'FILE_TOO_LARGE'],
    [{...base,jpeg_base64:'AAAAAA=='},'INVALID_FILE'],
    [{...base,original_filename:'../test.jpg'},'INVALID_FILE']
  ];
  checks.forEach(function(item,i) {
    const got=validatePublicJpegPayload505_(item[0]);
    if((item[1]==='VALID' ? got.status : got.code)!==item[1])throw new Error('JPEG_PREFLIGHT_TEST_FAILED_'+(i+1));
  });
  console.log('JPEG_PREFLIGHT_505_PASSED_7_OF_7');
}


/* =====================================================
   LANGKAH 5.05B - JAMBATAN PREFLIGHT -> RESERVATION DRY RUN
   KESELAMATAN:
   - TIDAK disambungkan kepada doPost(e).
   - TIDAK membuat reservation atau menulis ke Sheets/Drive.
   - Panggilan validateUploadReservation_ membaca database HANYA
     apabila payload lulus preflight dan metadata.
   - TIDAK mengembalikan qr_token, idempotency_key atau lease_token.
   - TIDAK menerima parameter untuk mengaktifkan LIVE.
===================================================== */
function preparePublicJpegReservation505B_(request) {
  // 1. Tolak payload rosak sebelum sebarang semakan database.
  const preflight = validatePublicJpegPayload505_(request);
  if (preflight.status !== 'VALID') {
    return {status:'REJECTED',code:preflight.code,ready:false,saved:false};
  }

  // 2. Gunakan validator metadata sebenar, bukan validasi pendua.
  const metadata = validateUploadFile_({
    original_filename:request.original_filename,
    file_mime_type:request.file_mime_type,
    file_size_bytes:request.file_size_bytes,
    idempotency_key:request.idempotency_key
  });
  if (metadata.status !== 'VALID') {
    return {status:'REJECTED',code:metadata.code,ready:false,saved:false};
  }

  // 3. Semak idempotency, QR, jadual acara dan kuota secara DRY RUN.
  //    Fungsi ini tidak memegang ScriptLock dan tidak menulis rekod.
  try {
    const reservation = validateUploadReservation_({
      qr_token:request.qr_token,
      idempotency_key:request.idempotency_key,
      original_filename:request.original_filename,
      file_mime_type:request.file_mime_type,
      file_size_bytes:request.file_size_bytes
    });
    if (reservation.status === 'SUCCESS' &&
        reservation.ready_for_reservation === true) {
      return {status:'VALID',code:'RESERVATION_PREFLIGHT_READY',
              ready:true,saved:false};
    }
    // Kod dalaman boleh mengandungi butiran status; jangan pantulkan
    // terus kepada pengguna awam. Ini fungsi dalaman sahaja.
    return {status:'REJECTED',code:'RESERVATION_NOT_ELIGIBLE',
            ready:false,saved:false};
  } catch (error) {
    // Jangan log payload atau maklumat pengecualian yang sensitif.
    console.error('JPEG_RESERVATION_PREFLIGHT_FAILED');
    return {status:'ERROR',code:'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE',ready:false,saved:false};
  }
}

/* =====================================================
   LANGKAH 5.05B - UJIAN SELAMAT TANPA DATABASE / WRITE
   Kes ujian semuanya gagal pada peringkat input, sebelum
   validateUploadReservation_() dipanggil.
===================================================== */
function testPublicJpegReservation505B_() {
  const base = {
    action:'upload_jpeg',qr_token:'a'.repeat(64),
    idempotency_key:'123e4567-e89b-42d3-a456-426614174000',
    original_filename:'test.jpg',file_mime_type:'image/jpeg',
    file_size_bytes:4,jpeg_base64:'/9j/2Q=='
  };
  const cases = [
    [{...base,qr_token:'invalid'},'INVALID_REQUEST'],
    [{...base,idempotency_key:'invalid'},'INVALID_REQUEST'],
    [{...base,file_mime_type:'image/png'},'INVALID_FILE'],
    [{...base,jpeg_base64:'AAAAAA=='},'INVALID_FILE'],
    [{...base,original_filename:'../test.jpg'},'INVALID_FILE'],
    [{...base,original_filename:'test.png'},'INVALID_FILENAME']
  ];
  cases.forEach(function(item,index) {
    const result = preparePublicJpegReservation505B_(item[0]);
    if (result.status !== 'REJECTED' || result.code !== item[1] ||
        result.ready !== false || result.saved !== false ||
        Object.keys(result).length !== 4) {
      throw new Error('JPEG_RESERVATION_505B_TEST_FAILED_'+(index+1));
    }
  });
  console.log('JPEG_RESERVATION_505B_PASSED_6_OF_6');
}

/* =====================================================
   LANGKAH 5.05C — UJIAN RESERVATION READ-ONLY (ACARA BELUM BERMULA)
   - Membaca QR_SLOTS sahaja untuk mendapatkan token Meja 01.
   - Memerlukan padanan tepat satu QR bagi acara ujian tetap.
   - Tidak mencetak token, UUID, ID atau butiran data dalaman.
   - Tidak membuat reservation / Drive write / Sheets write.
   - Tiada panggilan doPost; upload awam kekal DISABLED.
===================================================== */
function testPublicJpegReservation505C_() {
  const spreadsheetId = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties()
    .getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID');
  if (!spreadsheetId) throw new Error('505C_CONFIG_MISSING');
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(spreadsheetId);
  const slots = ss.getSheetByName('QR_SLOTS');
  const events = ss.getSheetByName('EVENTS');
  if (!slots || !events) throw new Error('505C_SHEETS_MISSING');

  const toRecords = function(sheet) {
    const values = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
    if (values.length < 2) return [];
    const keys = values[0].map(String);
    return values.slice(1).map(function(row) {
      const record = {};
      keys.forEach(function(key, i) { record[key] = row[i]; });
      return record;
    });
  };

  const eventRows = toRecords(events).filter(function(row) {
    return String(row.event_name) === 'QR Polaroid Test Event' &&
           String(row.deletion_status || '').toUpperCase() !== 'DELETED';
  });
  if (eventRows.length !== 1) throw new Error('505C_EVENT_NOT_UNIQUE');
  const matches = toRecords(slots).filter(function(row) {
    return String(row.event_id) === String(eventRows[0].event_id) &&
           String(row.qr_label) === 'Meja 01' &&
           String(row.deletion_status || '').toUpperCase() !== 'DELETED';
  });
  if (matches.length !== 1) throw new Error('505C_QR_NOT_UNIQUE');
  const token = String(matches[0].qr_token || '');
  if (!/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/i.test(token)) throw new Error('505C_QR_TOKEN_FORMAT');

  const request = {
    action: 'upload_jpeg',
    qr_token: token,
    idempotency_key: Utilities.getUuid(),
    original_filename: 'dry_run_505c.jpg',
    file_mime_type: 'image/jpeg',
    file_size_bytes: 4,
    jpeg_base64: '/9j/2Q=='
  };
  const result = preparePublicJpegReservation505B_(request);
  if (result.status !== 'REJECTED' ||
      result.code !== 'RESERVATION_NOT_ELIGIBLE' ||
      result.ready !== false || result.saved !== false) {
    throw new Error('505C_UNEXPECTED_RESULT_' + String(result.code || 'UNKNOWN'));
  }
  console.log('JPEG_RESERVATION_505C_READONLY_PASSED');
}


/* =====================================================
   LANGKAH 5.05D - PENYEDIAAN BYTES JPEG (DRY RUN)
   - Tidak dipanggil oleh doPost(e).
   - Tiada operasi Sheets, Drive, reservation atau kuota.
   - Base64 didekod dan saiz bytes disahkan.
   - SOI/EOI JPEG disemak; ini BUKAN decoder imej penuh.
   - Tidak memulangkan kandungan fail atau token kepada log.
===================================================== */
function prepareJpegBytes505D_(request) {
  const preflight = validatePublicJpegPayload505_(request);
  if (preflight.status !== 'VALID') {
    return {status:'REJECTED',code:preflight.code,ready:false};
  }
  let bytes;
  try {
    bytes = Utilities.base64Decode(request.jpeg_base64);
  } catch (error) {
    return {status:'REJECTED',code:'INVALID_FILE',ready:false};
  }
  if (!bytes || bytes.length !== request.file_size_bytes || bytes.length < 4) {
    return {status:'REJECTED',code:'INVALID_FILE',ready:false};
  }
  const unsigned = function(i) { return bytes[i] & 255; };
  if (unsigned(0)!==255 || unsigned(1)!==216 || unsigned(2)!==255 ||
      unsigned(bytes.length-2)!==255 || unsigned(bytes.length-1)!==217) {
    return {status:'REJECTED',code:'INVALID_FILE',ready:false};
  }
  // Hanya penanda dan saiz disahkan; data di tengah masih boleh rosak.
  return {status:'VALID',code:'JPEG_BYTES_READY',ready:true,
          file_size_bytes:bytes.length};
}

/* =====================================================
   UJIAN 5.05D - TIADA PENULISAN DATA
   Menggunakan JPEG 2x2 sedia ada daripada fungsi fixture lama.
   Jangan jalankan testLiveJpegStorageAndCompletion_() semula.
===================================================== */
function testPrepareJpegBytes505D_() {
  const blob = buildLiveTestJpegBlob_(); // Hanya bina Blob dalam memori.
  const bytes = blob.getBytes();
  const base = {
    action:'upload_jpeg',
    qr_token:'a'.repeat(64),
    idempotency_key:'123e4567-e89b-42d3-a456-426614174000',
    original_filename:'dry_run_505d.jpg',
    file_mime_type:'image/jpeg',
    file_size_bytes:bytes.length,
    jpeg_base64:Utilities.base64Encode(bytes)
  };
  const cases = [
    [base,'VALID'],
    [Object.assign({},base,{file_size_bytes:bytes.length+1}),'INVALID_FILE'],
    [Object.assign({},base,{jpeg_base64:'AAAA'}),'INVALID_FILE'],
    [Object.assign({},base,{file_mime_type:'image/png'}),'INVALID_FILE'],
    [Object.assign({},base,{qr_token:'invalid'}),'INVALID_REQUEST']
  ];
  cases.forEach(function(item,index) {
    const result=prepareJpegBytes505D_(item[0]);
    const expected=item[1];
    if ((expected==='VALID' ? result.status : result.code)!==expected ||
        result.ready!==(expected==='VALID')) {
      throw new Error('JPEG_BYTES_505D_TEST_FAILED_'+(index+1));
    }
  });
  // Base64 yang saiznya konsisten tetapi EOI diubah mesti ditolak.
  const damaged=bytes.slice();
  damaged[damaged.length-1]=0;
  const broken=Object.assign({},base,{jpeg_base64:Utilities.base64Encode(damaged)});
  const check=prepareJpegBytes505D_(broken);
  if (check.code!=='INVALID_FILE' || check.ready!==false) {
    throw new Error('JPEG_BYTES_505D_TEST_FAILED_6');
  }
  console.log('JPEG_BYTES_505D_DRYRUN_PASSED_6_OF_6');
}


/* =====================================================
   LANGKAH 5.05E - PELAN PENYIMPANAN JPEG (DRY RUN)
   Fungsi tulen: TIADA Sheets, Drive, Lock atau penulisan.
   Gunakan upload_id yang telah diwujudkan oleh reservation;
   jangan jana ID baharu ketika retry.
   Nama fail deterministik bagi upload_id yang sama.
   Pelan ini BUKAN kebenaran untuk menulis ke Drive.
===================================================== */
function prepareJpegStoragePlan505E_(uploadId, qrFolderId, fileSizeBytes) {
  // UUIDv4 daripada rekod UPLOADS; tidak menerima nama fail peserta.
  if (typeof uploadId !== 'string' ||
      !/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(uploadId)) {
    return {status:'REJECTED',code:'INVALID_UPLOAD_ID',ready:false};
  }
  // ID folder Drive hanya disahkan bentuk asas di sini;
  // pemilikan dan hierarki folder MESTI disemak di backend sebelum write.
  if (typeof qrFolderId !== 'string' ||
      !/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,200}$/.test(qrFolderId)) {
    return {status:'REJECTED',code:'INVALID_FOLDER_ID',ready:false};
  }
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(fileSizeBytes) ||
      fileSizeBytes < 4 || fileSizeBytes > 8*1024*1024) {
    return {status:'REJECTED',code:'INVALID_FILE_SIZE',ready:false};
  }
  const normalizedId = uploadId.toLowerCase();
  return {
    status:'VALID',code:'STORAGE_PLAN_READY',ready:true,
    upload_id:normalizedId,
    drive_file_name:'upload_' + normalizedId + '.jpg',
    qr_folder_id:qrFolderId,
    file_size_bytes:fileSizeBytes,
    mime_type:'image/jpeg',
    write_performed:false
  };
}

/* =====================================================
   UJIAN 5.05E - 6 KES TANPA AKSES GOOGLE DRIVE/SHEETS
===================================================== */
function testJpegStoragePlan505E_() {
  const id='123e4567-e89b-42d3-a456-426614174000';
  const folder='TestFolderId_1234567890';
  const good=prepareJpegStoragePlan505E_(id,folder,1024);
  if (good.status!=='VALID' || !good.ready || good.write_performed!==false ||
      good.drive_file_name!=='upload_'+id+'.jpg') {
    throw new Error('505E_TEST_FAILED_1');
  }
  const repeat=prepareJpegStoragePlan505E_(id.toUpperCase(),folder,1024);
  if (repeat.drive_file_name!==good.drive_file_name) {
    throw new Error('505E_TEST_FAILED_2');
  }
  const tests=[
    ['not-an-id',folder,1024,'INVALID_UPLOAD_ID'],
    [id,'bad',1024,'INVALID_FOLDER_ID'],
    [id,folder,0,'INVALID_FILE_SIZE'],
    [id,folder,8*1024*1024+1,'INVALID_FILE_SIZE']
  ];
  tests.forEach(function(item,i){
    const result=prepareJpegStoragePlan505E_(item[0],item[1],item[2]);
    if(result.code!==item[3] || result.ready!==false) {
      throw new Error('505E_TEST_FAILED_'+(i+3));
    }
  });
  console.log('JPEG_STORAGE_PLAN_505E_DRYRUN_PASSED_6_OF_6');
}

/* =====================================================
   LANGKAH 5.05F - PRA-SEMAKAN STORAN (READ-ONLY)
   Tidak dipanggil oleh doPost. Tiada write/lock.
   Keputusan READY bukan lesen untuk createFile: semak
   semula DI DALAM lock semasa operasi LIVE kelak.
===================================================== */
function decideJpegStorage505F_(record, plan, matchingFileCount) {
  const stop = function(code) {
    return {status:'REJECTED',code:code,ready:false,write_performed:false};
  };
  if (!record || !plan || plan.ready !== true ||
      record.upload_id !== plan.upload_id ||
      String(record.file_size_bytes) !== String(plan.file_size_bytes)) {
    return stop('STORAGE_RECORD_MISMATCH');
  }
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(matchingFileCount) || matchingFileCount < 0) {
    return stop('DRIVE_STATE_UNCERTAIN');
  }
  if (matchingFileCount > 1) return stop('DUPLICATE_DRIVE_FILES');
  const linkedId = String(record.drive_file_id || '').trim();
  if (linkedId || matchingFileCount === 1) {
    return stop('RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED');
  }
  const state = String(record.upload_status || '').toUpperCase();
  if (state === 'COMPLETED') return stop('UPLOAD_ALREADY_COMPLETED');
  if (state !== 'PROCESSING') return stop('UPLOAD_NOT_PROCESSING');
  return {status:'VALID',code:'PREWRITE_CHECK_READY',ready:true,
          write_performed:false};
}

/* =====================================================
   SEMAKAN SHEETS + DRIVE SEBENAR (BACA SAHAJA)
   uploadId hanya daripada rekod dalaman, bukan endpoint.
   Gagal tertutup jika data/folder tidak konsisten.
===================================================== */
function inspectJpegStorage505F_(uploadId) {
  const stop = function(code) {
    return {status:'REJECTED',code:code,ready:false,write_performed:false};
  };
  if (typeof uploadId !== 'string' ||
      !/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(uploadId)) {
    return stop('INVALID_UPLOAD_ID');
  }
  try {
    const dbId = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID');
    if (!dbId) return stop('DATABASE_NOT_CONFIGURED');
    const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(dbId);
    const uploads = ss.getSheetByName('UPLOADS');
    const slots = ss.getSheetByName('QR_SLOTS');
    if (!uploads || !slots) return stop('SHEET_MISSING');
    const read = function(sheet, required) {
      const values = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
      if (!values.length) throw new Error('HEADERS_MISSING');
      const headers = values[0].map(String);
      if (required.some(function(h){return headers.indexOf(h)<0;})) {
        throw new Error('HEADERS_INVALID');
      }
      return values.slice(1).filter(function(row){
        return row.some(function(v){return v!=='';});
      }).map(function(row){
        const result = {};
        headers.forEach(function(h,i){result[h]=row[i];});
        return result;
      });
    };
    const records = read(uploads,['upload_id','qr_id','upload_status',
      'file_size_bytes','drive_file_id','drive_file_name']);
    const matches = records.filter(function(r){
      return String(r.upload_id).toLowerCase()===uploadId.toLowerCase();
    });
    if (matches.length !== 1) return stop('UPLOAD_RECORD_NOT_UNIQUE');
    const record = matches[0];
    const qrMatches = read(slots,['qr_id','drive_folder_id']).filter(function(r){
      return String(r.qr_id)===String(record.qr_id);
    });
    if (qrMatches.length !== 1) return stop('QR_RECORD_NOT_UNIQUE');
    const folderId = String(qrMatches[0].drive_folder_id || '');
    const plan = prepareJpegStoragePlan505E_(uploadId.toLowerCase(),folderId,
      Number(record.file_size_bytes));
    if (!plan.ready) return stop('STORAGE_PLAN_INVALID');
    const storedName = String(record.drive_file_name || '').trim();
    if (storedName && storedName !== plan.drive_file_name) {
      return stop('STORAGE_FILENAME_MISMATCH');
    }
    // Enumerasi nama fail; Drive membenarkan nama pendua.
    const iterator = DriveApp.getFolderById(folderId)
      .getFilesByName(plan.drive_file_name);
    let count=0;
    while (iterator.hasNext()) {
      iterator.next();
      count++;
      if (count>1) break;
    }
    return decideJpegStorage505F_(record,plan,count);
  } catch(error) {
    // Jangan log token, folder ID atau butiran dalaman.
    return stop('STORAGE_INSPECTION_FAILED');
  }
}

function testJpegStoragePrecheck505F_() {

  const base={upload_id:id,file_size_bytes:1024,
              upload_status:'PROCESSING',drive_file_id:''};
  const copy=function(extra){return Object.assign({},base,extra||{});};
  const cases=[
    [copy(),0,'PREWRITE_CHECK_READY',true],
    [copy({upload_status:'COMPLETED'}),0,'UPLOAD_ALREADY_COMPLETED',false],
    [copy({upload_status:'RESERVED'}),0,'UPLOAD_NOT_PROCESSING',false],
    [copy(),1,'RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED',false],
    [copy(),2,'DUPLICATE_DRIVE_FILES',false],
    [copy({drive_file_id:'existing-id'}),0,'RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED',false],
    [copy({file_size_bytes:999}),0,'STORAGE_RECORD_MISMATCH',false]
  ];
  cases.forEach(function(item,i){
    const result=decideJpegStorage505F_(item[0],plan,item[1]);
    if (result.code!==item[2] || result.ready!==item[3] ||
        result.write_performed!==false) {

}


/* =====================================================
   PAKEJ 5.05G–5.05J — BATCH STORAGE SAFETY
   READ-ONLY + DRY RUN. TIADA laluan doPost baharu.
   5.05G: Semak rekod sebenar (ringkasan tanpa ID)
   5.05H: Tentukan status storan / fail pendua
   5.05I: Simulasi recovery dan keadaan tidak pasti
   5.05J: Satu ujian batch + audit baca sahaja

   PENTING: Ujian ini tidak mengubah Sheets/Drive.
   Keputusan READY bukan kebenaran untuk upload LIVE.
===================================================== */

// ---- KEPUTUSAN RECOVERY BERASASKAN STATUS DALAMAN ----
function decideJpegRecoveryBatch505_(input) {
  const stop = function(code) {
    return {code:code, can_write:false, needs_review:true};
  };
  if (!input || typeof input !== 'object') return stop('INVALID_STATE');
  const state = String(input.upload_status || '').toUpperCase();
  const count = input.matching_files;
  const linked = Boolean(String(input.drive_file_id || '').trim());
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count < 0) return stop('DRIVE_STATE_UNCERTAIN');
  if (count > 1) return stop('DUPLICATE_DRIVE_FILES');
  if (linked && count === 0) return stop('LINKED_FILE_NOT_IN_EXPECTED_FOLDER');
  if (linked || count === 1) return stop('RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED');
  if (state === 'COMPLETED') return stop('COMPLETED_WITHOUT_FILE');
  if (state === 'FAILED') return stop('FAILED_REQUIRES_REVIEW');
  if (state === 'RESERVED') return stop('RESERVATION_NOT_PROCESSING');
  if (state !== 'PROCESSING') return stop('UNKNOWN_UPLOAD_STATE');
  // READ-ONLY: calon untuk semakan LIVE kemudian, bukan izin createFile.
  return {code:'PREWRITE_CANDIDATE_ONLY',can_write:false,needs_review:false};
}

// ---- AUDIT REKOD SEBENAR TANPA MENDEDAHKAN TOKEN / ID ----
function auditJpegStorageReadOnlyBatch505_() {
  const result = {status:'READ_ONLY', checked:0, inspected:0,
    processing:0, reserved:0, completed:0, other:0,
    inspection_codes:{}, warnings:[]};
  try {
    const dbId = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID');
    if (!dbId) throw new Error('CONFIGURATION_MISSING');
    const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.openById(dbId).getSheetByName('UPLOADS');
    if (!sheet) throw new Error('UPLOADS_SHEET_MISSING');
    const values = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
    const headers = values[0].map(String);
    const required = ['upload_id','upload_status','deletion_status'];
    if (required.some(function(h){return headers.indexOf(h)<0;})) {
      throw new Error('UPLOADS_HEADERS_INVALID');
    }
    const idCol=headers.indexOf('upload_id');
    const stateCol=headers.indexOf('upload_status');
    const deleteCol=headers.indexOf('deletion_status');
    const candidates=[];
    for (let i=1;i<values.length;i++) {
      const row=values[i];
      if (!String(row[idCol]||'').trim()) continue;
      result.checked++;
      // Rekod dipadam tidak dijadikan calon pemeriksaan LIVE.
      if (String(row[deleteCol]||'').toUpperCase() !== 'ACTIVE') {
        result.other++;
        continue;
      }
      const state=String(row[stateCol]||'').toUpperCase();
      if (state==='PROCESSING') {
        result.processing++;
        candidates.push(String(row[idCol]));
      } else if (state==='RESERVED') result.reserved++;
      else if (state==='COMPLETED') result.completed++;
      else result.other++;
    }
    // Had audit untuk elak masa pelaksanaan panjang.
    const maxInspect=10;
    if (candidates.length>maxInspect) result.warnings.push('PROCESSING_AUDIT_LIMIT_REACHED');
    candidates.slice(0,maxInspect).forEach(function(uploadId){
      const inspection=inspectJpegStorage505F_(uploadId);
      const code=String(inspection.code||'UNKNOWN');
      result.inspection_codes[code]=(result.inspection_codes[code]||0)+1;
      result.inspected++;
    });
    if (result.inspection_codes.PREWRITE_CHECK_READY) {
      result.warnings.push('READY_IS_NOT_LIVE_WRITE_AUTHORIZATION');
    }
    return result;
  } catch (error) {
    // Elak log ralat yang mungkin mengandungi butiran dalaman.
    return {status:'AUDIT_FAILED',code:'READ_ONLY_AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE'};
  }
}

===================================================== */
function testJpegStorageBatch505_() {

    [{upload_status:'RESERVED',matching_files:0},'RESERVATION_NOT_PROCESSING'],
    [{upload_status:'PROCESSING',matching_files:-1},'DRIVE_STATE_UNCERTAIN'],
