}

/* =====================================================
   QR POLAROID SYSTEM v1.0 — BATCH 5.06A–5.06D
   ENJIN KEPUTUSAN UPLOAD (SIMULASI TANPA I/O)

   5.06A: Keputusan idempotency sebelum penulisan
   5.06B: Keputusan pra-Drive dan state transition
   5.06C: Keputusan apabila Drive/Sheets gagal
   5.06D: Ujian berkelompok (12 senario)

   Semua fungsi di sini PURE: tiada Sheets/Drive/Lock.
   Belum digunakan oleh doPost dan TIDAK membenarkan LIVE.
===================================================== */

function decideUploadEngine506_(state) {
  const stop = function(code) {
    return {code:code, action:'STOP', can_write:false};
  };
  if (!state || typeof state !== 'object' || Array.isArray(state)) {
    return stop('INVALID_ENGINE_INPUT');
  }
  const status = String(state.upload_status || '').toUpperCase();
  const sameKey = state.idempotency_match === true;
  const keyConflict = state.idempotency_match === false;
  const fileCount = state.matching_files;
  const linked = state.drive_file_linked === true;
  const leaseValid = state.lease_valid === true;
  const eligible = state.eligible === true;
  const stage = String(state.stage || '').toUpperCase();

  // Jangan anggap metadata yang tidak lengkap sebagai keadaan selamat.
  if (!['BEFORE_RESERVATION','BEFORE_DRIVE','AFTER_DRIVE'].includes(stage)) {
    return stop('UNKNOWN_ENGINE_STAGE');
  }
  if (keyConflict) return stop('IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT');
  if (!sameKey) return stop('IDEMPOTENCY_UNVERIFIED');
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(fileCount) || fileCount < 0) {
    return stop('DRIVE_STATE_UNCERTAIN');
  }
  if (fileCount > 1) return stop('DUPLICATE_DRIVE_FILES');
  if (linked && fileCount === 0) return stop('LINKED_FILE_MISSING');
  if (status === 'COMPLETED') {
    return (linked && fileCount === 1)
      ? {code:'ALREADY_COMPLETED',action:'RETURN_EXISTING',can_write:false}
      : stop('COMPLETED_STATE_INCONSISTENT');
  }
  if (fileCount === 1 || linked) return stop('RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED');
  if (status === 'FAILED') return stop('FAILED_NEEDS_REVIEW');
  if (!eligible) return stop('UPLOAD_NOT_ELIGIBLE');
  if (stage === 'BEFORE_RESERVATION') {
    if (status !== 'NEW') return stop('INVALID_RESERVATION_STATE');
    return {code:'RESERVATION_CANDIDATE',action:'SIMULATE_RESERVATION',can_write:false};
  }
  if (!leaseValid) return stop('LEASE_INVALID_OR_EXPIRED');
  if (stage === 'BEFORE_DRIVE') {
    if (status !== 'PROCESSING') return stop('INVALID_PROCESSING_STATE');
    return {code:'DRIVE_WRITE_CANDIDATE',action:'SIMULATE_DRIVE_WRITE',can_write:false};
  }
  // AFTER_DRIVE: Drive kosong bukan bukti bahawa operasi sebelumnya gagal.
  // Mesti diperiksa semula oleh proses reconciliation sebelum retry.
  return stop('POST_DRIVE_STATE_UNCERTAIN');
}

function decideUploadFailure506_(event) {
  const stop = function(code) {
    return {code:code, action:'STOP', can_write:false};
  };
  if (!event || typeof event !== 'object') return stop('INVALID_FAILURE_EVENT');
  const point = String(event.failure_point || '').toUpperCase();
  const confirmed = event.drive_file_confirmed === true;
  if (point === 'BEFORE_RESERVATION') return stop('NO_RESERVATION_CREATED');
  if (point === 'RESERVATION_WRITE_UNCERTAIN') return stop('VERIFY_RESERVATION_BY_IDEMPOTENCY');
  if (point === 'DRIVE_WRITE_UNCERTAIN') return stop('RECONCILE_DRIVE_BEFORE_RETRY');
  if (point === 'SHEETS_COMMIT_FAILED') {
    return confirmed ? stop('DRIVE_SAVED_SHEETS_RECONCILIATION')
      : stop('RECONCILE_DRIVE_BEFORE_RETRY');
  }
  return stop('UNKNOWN_FAILURE_POINT');
}

function testUploadEngineBatch506_() {
  const base = {
    stage:'BEFORE_DRIVE', upload_status:'PROCESSING',
    idempotency_match:true, matching_files:0,
    drive_file_linked:false, lease_valid:true, eligible:true
  };
  const change = function(patch) { return Object.assign({},base,patch); };
  const cases = [
    [change({stage:'BEFORE_RESERVATION',upload_status:'NEW'}),'RESERVATION_CANDIDATE'],
    [change({}),'DRIVE_WRITE_CANDIDATE'],
    [change({idempotency_match:false}),'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT'],
    [change({idempotency_match:null}),'IDEMPOTENCY_UNVERIFIED'],
    [change({matching_files:2}),'DUPLICATE_DRIVE_FILES'],
    [change({matching_files:1}),'RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED'],
    [change({lease_valid:false}),'LEASE_INVALID_OR_EXPIRED'],
    [change({eligible:false}),'UPLOAD_NOT_ELIGIBLE'],
    [change({upload_status:'COMPLETED',matching_files:1,drive_file_linked:true}),'ALREADY_COMPLETED'],
    [change({upload_status:'COMPLETED'}),'COMPLETED_STATE_INCONSISTENT'],
    [change({stage:'AFTER_DRIVE'}),'POST_DRIVE_STATE_UNCERTAIN'],
    [change({drive_file_linked:true}),'LINKED_FILE_MISSING']
  ];
  cases.forEach(function(item,index) {
    const result = decideUploadEngine506_(item[0]);
    if (result.code !== item[1] || result.can_write !== false) {
      throw new Error('UPLOAD_ENGINE_506_TEST_FAILED_'+(index+1));
    }
  });
  const failures = [
    [{failure_point:'BEFORE_RESERVATION'},'NO_RESERVATION_CREATED'],
    [{failure_point:'RESERVATION_WRITE_UNCERTAIN'},'VERIFY_RESERVATION_BY_IDEMPOTENCY'],
    [{failure_point:'DRIVE_WRITE_UNCERTAIN'},'RECONCILE_DRIVE_BEFORE_RETRY'],
    [{failure_point:'SHEETS_COMMIT_FAILED',drive_file_confirmed:true},'DRIVE_SAVED_SHEETS_RECONCILIATION']
  ];
  failures.forEach(function(item,index) {
    const result = decideUploadFailure506_(item[0]);
    if (result.code !== item[1] || result.can_write !== false) {
      throw new Error('UPLOAD_ENGINE_506_FAILURE_TEST_FAILED_'+(index+1));
    }
  });
  console.log('UPLOAD_ENGINE_BATCH_506_PASSED_16_OF_16');
  console.log('UPLOAD_ENGINE_BATCH_506_NO_LIVE_WRITES');
}


/* ============================================================
   BATCH 5.07A–D — INTEGRASI SEBENAR, READ-ONLY
   A: Payload JPEG fixture sah dalam memori
   B: QR sebenar dibaca daripada Sheets, tanpa log token
   C: Integrasi preflight -> reservation (tiada write)
   D: Audit storan sedia ada + semakan router tidak aktif
   JANGAN gunakan fungsi ini sebagai endpoint awam.
============================================================ */
function runIntegratedReadOnly507_() {
  const stop = function(code) { return {status:'REJECTED',code:code,write_performed:false}; };
  const props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  const dbId = props.getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID');
  if (!dbId) return stop('DATABASE_NOT_CONFIGURED');
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(dbId);
  const events = ss.getSheetByName('EVENTS');
  const slots = ss.getSheetByName('QR_SLOTS');
  if (!events || !slots) return stop('SHEETS_MISSING');
  const rows = function(sheet,required) {
    const v=sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
    if (!v.length) throw new Error('HEADERS_MISSING');
    const h=v[0].map(String);
    if (required.some(function(x){return h.indexOf(x)<0;})) throw new Error('HEADERS_INVALID');
    return v.slice(1).map(function(r){
      const o={};h.forEach(function(x,i){o[x]=r[i];});return o;
    });
  };
  const ev=rows(events,['event_id','event_name']).filter(function(x){
    return String(x.event_name)==='QR Polaroid Test Event';
  });
  if (ev.length!==1) return stop('TEST_EVENT_NOT_UNIQUE');
  const qr=rows(slots,['event_id','qr_label','qr_token']).filter(function(x){
    return String(x.event_id)===String(ev[0].event_id) && String(x.qr_label)==='Meja 01';
  });
  if (qr.length!==1) return stop('TEST_QR_NOT_UNIQUE');
  const token=String(qr[0].qr_token||'');
  if (!/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/i.test(token)) return stop('TEST_QR_INVALID');
  const blob=buildLiveTestJpegBlob_(); // fixture kecil, memori sahaja
  const bytes=blob.getBytes();
  const request={
    action:'upload_jpeg',qr_token:token,
    idempotency_key:Utilities.getUuid(),
    original_filename:'integration_507.jpg',file_mime_type:'image/jpeg',
    file_size_bytes:bytes.length,jpeg_base64:Utilities.base64Encode(bytes)
  };
  const payload=validatePublicJpegPayload505_(request);
  if (payload.status!=='VALID') return stop('JPEG_PREFLIGHT_FAILED');
  const decoded=prepareJpegBytes505D_(request);
  if (decoded.status!=='VALID'||decoded.ready!==true) return stop('JPEG_BYTES_FAILED');
  const reservation=preparePublicJpegReservation505B_(request);
  // Acara 15 Januari 2027 belum bermula pada tarikh ujian semasa.
  // Jangan paksa keputusan tertentu: paparkan kod selamat tanpa token.
  if (!['VALID','REJECTED'].includes(reservation.status)) return stop('RESERVATION_PREFLIGHT_ERROR');
  return {status:'SUCCESS',code:'READ_ONLY_INTEGRATION_COMPLETE',
    jpeg_preflight:'VALID',jpeg_bytes:'VALID',
    reservation_status:reservation.status,reservation_code:reservation.code,
    write_performed:false};
}

function testUploadIntegrationBatch507_() {
  // 1. Integrasi menggunakan rekod sebenar, tanpa menulis.
  const integrated=runIntegratedReadOnly507_();
  if (integrated.status!=='SUCCESS'||integrated.write_performed!==false) {
    throw new Error('BATCH_507_INTEGRATION_FAILED_'+integrated.code);
  }
  console.log('BATCH_507_REAL_READONLY '+JSON.stringify(integrated));
  // 2. Pastikan router awam menolak action upload_jpeg kecil.
  const response=doPost({postData:{contents:JSON.stringify({action:'upload_jpeg'})}});
  const parsed=JSON.parse(response.getContent());
  if (parsed.code!=='UNSUPPORTED_ACTION') throw new Error('BATCH_507_PUBLIC_ROUTE_NOT_DISABLED');
  console.log('BATCH_507_PUBLIC_UPLOAD_DISABLED');
  // 3. Audit semasa, tanpa ID dan token.
  const audit=auditJpegStorageReadOnlyBatch505_();
  if (audit.status!=='READ_ONLY') throw new Error('BATCH_507_AUDIT_FAILED');
  console.log('BATCH_507_AUDIT '+JSON.stringify(audit));
  console.log('UPLOAD_INTEGRATION_BATCH_507_PASSED');
  console.log('UPLOAD_INTEGRATION_BATCH_507_NO_LIVE_WRITES');
}


/* ============================================================
   BATCH 5.08 — LIVE INTEGRATION GATE (READ-ONLY)
   Tujuan: mengesahkan prasyarat sebelum ujian LIVE baharu.
   TIADA penciptaan fail, reservation, kuota atau perubahan jadual.
   Upload awam kekal DISABLED; tiada doPost baharu.
   Semua keputusan sensitif disembunyikan daripada log.
============================================================ */
function inspectLiveIntegrationGate508_() {
  const report = {status:'PENDING', code:'CHECKING', checks:{}, safe_to_run_live:false};
  const mark = (name,ok) => { report.checks[name] = ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'; };
  try {
    const props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
    const id = props.getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID');
    const root = props.getProperty('ROOT_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID');
    mark('CONFIGURATION',Boolean(id && root));
    if (!id || !root) throw new Error('CONFIGURATION');
    const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(id);
    const required = {
      EVENTS:['event_id','event_name','event_status','drive_folder_id'],
      QR_SLOTS:['qr_id','event_id','qr_token','current_cycle_id','drive_folder_id'],
      UPLOADS:['upload_id','idempotency_key','qr_id','upload_status','drive_file_id','drive_file_name'],
      QUOTA_CYCLES:['cycle_id','qr_id','successful_uploads']
    };
    Object.keys(required).forEach(name=>{
      const sheet=ss.getSheetByName(name);
      const headers=sheet ? sheet.getRange(1,1,1,sheet.getLastColumn()).getDisplayValues()[0] : [];
      mark('SCHEMA_'+name,required[name].every(h=>headers.includes(h)));
    });
    // Semak folder boleh dibaca, tanpa memaparkan ID atau nama.
    const folder=DriveApp.getFolderById(root);
    mark('DRIVE_ROOT_READABLE',Boolean(folder.getId()));
    // Ujian ini tidak membenarkan LIVE; kelulusan memerlukan pemeriksaan
    // khusus terhadap transaksi, kunci, retry dan cleanup fixture.
    const good=Object.keys(report.checks).every(k=>report.checks[k]==='PASS');
    report.status=good?'SUCCESS':'REJECTED';
    report.code=good?'LIVE_PREREQUISITES_READABLE':'LIVE_PREREQUISITES_FAILED';
    return report;
  } catch (_) {
    report.status='REJECTED';report.code='LIVE_PREREQUISITES_FAILED';
    return report;
  }
}

function testLiveIntegrationGateBatch508_() {
  const tests=[];
  function assert(label,condition){if(!condition)throw new Error('508_FAILED_'+label);tests.push(label);}
  const jpeg=buildLiveTestJpegBlob_(); // Blob dalam memori sahaja
  const bytes=jpeg.getBytes();
  const request={action:'upload_jpeg',qr_token:'a'.repeat(64),
    idempotency_key:'123e4567-e89b-42d3-a456-426614174000',
    original_filename:'batch_508.jpg',file_mime_type:'image/jpeg',
    file_size_bytes:bytes.length,jpeg_base64:Utilities.base64Encode(bytes)};
  assert('JPEG_PREFLIGHT',validatePublicJpegPayload505_(request).status==='VALID');
  assert('JPEG_DECODE',prepareJpegBytes505D_(request).ready===true);
  assert('INVALID_TOKEN',validatePublicJpegPayload505_(Object.assign({},request,{qr_token:'invalid'})).status==='REJECTED');
  assert('INVALID_MIME',validatePublicJpegPayload505_(Object.assign({},request,{file_mime_type:'image/png'})).status==='REJECTED');
  assert('INVALID_SIZE',validatePublicJpegPayload505_(Object.assign({},request,{file_size_bytes:0})).status==='REJECTED');
  const id='123e4567-e89b-42d3-a456-426614174000';
  const plan=prepareJpegStoragePlan505E_(id,'TestFolderId_1234567890',bytes.length);
  assert('DETERMINISTIC_FILENAME',plan.ready===true && plan.drive_file_name===prepareJpegStoragePlan505E_(id,'TestFolderId_1234567890',bytes.length).drive_file_name);
  const record={upload_id:id,file_size_bytes:bytes.length,upload_status:'PROCESSING',drive_file_id:''};
  assert('BLOCK_EXISTING_FILE',decideJpegStorage505F_(record,plan,1).ready===false);
  assert('BLOCK_DUPLICATE',decideJpegStorage505F_(record,plan,2).ready===false);
  assert('BLOCK_COMPLETED',decideJpegStorage505F_(Object.assign({},record,{upload_status:'COMPLETED'}),plan,0).ready===false);
  assert('BLOCK_UNCERTAIN',decideJpegStorage505F_(Object.assign({},record,{drive_file_id:'linked'}),plan,0).ready===false);
  // Ujian laluan awam melalui doPost: tiada penulisan.
  const publicResult=JSON.parse(doPost({postData:{contents:JSON.stringify({action:'upload_jpeg'})}}).getContent());
  assert('PUBLIC_UPLOAD_BLOCKED',publicResult.code==='UNSUPPORTED_ACTION');
  const gate=inspectLiveIntegrationGate508_();
  assert('READONLY_GATE_EXECUTED',gate && typeof gate.code==='string' && gate.safe_to_run_live===false);
  console.log('BATCH_508_SIMULATION_PASSED_'+tests.length+'_OF_12');
  console.log('BATCH_508_READONLY_GATE '+JSON.stringify(gate));
  console.log('BATCH_508_NO_LIVE_WRITES');
}

      String(r[nameCol]) === LIVE_UPLOAD_TEST_EVENT_NAME;
  });

    throw new Error('BATCH_510_FIRST_COMMIT_NOT_VERIFIED');
  }
  Logger.log('BATCH_510_LIVE_WRITE_PASSED');

    throw new Error('BATCH_510_IDEMPOTENT_RETRY_NOT_VERIFIED');

   tambahan yang tidak dapat dibuktikan oleh ujian setempat.

function handlePublicJpeg514_(rawBody) {
  // Batch 5.18: FAIL CLOSED untuk semua permintaan web awam.
  // Ujian LIVE dalaman 5.17 kekal boleh digunakan secara berasingan.
  const MAX_REQUEST_CHARS = 11200000;
  if (typeof rawBody !== 'string' || rawBody.length > MAX_REQUEST_CHARS) {
    return {status:'ERROR',code:'REQUEST_TOO_LARGE'};
  }
  // Batch 5.21: ONLY fixture 5.19; explicit temporary test gate.
  // QR token is the participant bearer credential, not an admin credential.
  const props=PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  // 5.24: production handler is installed but explicitly locked until
  // recovery/concurrency verification. No production writes in this batch.
  // 5.26: legacy production adapter MUST NOT become a live route.
  // Even if an old Script Property is accidentally enabled, fail closed.
  if(props.getProperty('PRODUCTION_UPLOAD_524_ENABLED')==='true')
    return {status:'ERROR',code:'LEGACY_PRODUCTION_GATE_DISABLED'};
  if(props.getProperty('PHONE_TEST_521_ENABLED')!=='true')
    return {status:'ERROR',code:'PUBLIC_TRANSACTION_NOT_READY'};
  if(props.getProperty('PUBLIC_UPLOAD_514_ENABLED')==='true' ||
     props.getProperty('PUBLIC_UPLOAD_515_FIXTURE_ONLY')==='true')
    return {status:'ERROR',code:'CONFIGURATION_CONFLICT'};
  if(!props.getProperty('LIVE_UPLOAD_TEST_519_EVENT_ID'))
    return {status:'ERROR',code:'TEST_FIXTURE_MISSING'};
  return handlePhoneFixture520_(rawBody);
}

/* =============================================================
 BATCH 5.15 — TEMPORARY FIXTURE ONLY: phone -> Drive -> Sheets.
 IMPORTANT: never enable for permanent events. Default OFF.
 This is a controlled field-test bridge, NOT production rollout.
 The lock is NOT nested with reserveParticipantUploadInternal_.
============================================================= */
function fixture515Table_(sheet) {
  const v=sheet.getDataRange().getValues(), h=v[0];
  if (!h || new Set(h).size!==h.length) throw new Error('TABLE_HEADER_INVALID');
  return v.slice(1).map((r,i)=>{
    const o={_row:i+2};h.forEach((k,j)=>o[k]=r[j]);return o;
  });
}
function fixture515Set_(sheet,row,field,value) {
  const h=sheet.getRange(1,1,1,sheet.getLastColumn()).getValues()[0];
  const i=h.indexOf(field);
  if(i<0) throw new Error('MISSING_FIELD');
  sheet.getRange(row,i+1).setValue(value);
}
function fixture515Unique_(records,code) {
  if(records.length!==1) throw new Error(code);
  return records[0];
}
function fixture515HasParent_(item,parentId) {
  const it=item.getParents();
  while(it.hasNext()) if(it.next().getId()===parentId) return true;
  return false;
}
function handleFixtureJpeg515_(rawBody) {
  const props=PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  // Two independent gates. The 5.14 gate is checked before calling here.
  if(props.getProperty('PUBLIC_UPLOAD_515_FIXTURE_ONLY')!=='true')
    return {status:'ERROR',code:'UPLOAD_DISABLED'};
  const fixtureEventId=props.getProperty('LIVE_UPLOAD_TEST_511_EVENT_ID');
  if(!fixtureEventId) return {status:'ERROR',code:'TEST_FIXTURE_MISSING'};
  let req;
  try {req=JSON.parse(rawBody);}catch(_){return {status:'ERROR',code:'INVALID_JSON'};}
  const valid=validatePublicJpegPayload505_(req);
  if(valid.status!=='VALID') return {status:'ERROR',code:valid.code};
  // Decode before reservation: never reserve quota for invalid bytes.
  const ready=prepareJpegBytes505D_(req);
  if(ready.status!=='VALID') return {status:'ERROR',code:ready.code};
  let bytes;
  try {bytes=Utilities.base64Decode(req.jpeg_base64);}catch(_){return {status:'ERROR',code:'INVALID_FILE'};}
  // Public request can never choose event/QR/folder IDs.
  const ss=SpreadsheetApp.openById(props.getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID'));
  const es=ss.getSheetByName('EVENTS'), qs=ss.getSheetByName('QR_SLOTS');
  const cs=ss.getSheetByName('QUOTA_CYCLES'), us=ss.getSheetByName('UPLOADS');
  if(!es||!qs||!cs||!us) return {status:'ERROR',code:'SYSTEM_UNAVAILABLE'};
  const lookup=()=>{
    const event=fixture515Unique_(fixture515Table_(es).filter(x=>
      String(x.event_id)===fixtureEventId &&
      String(x.event_name)===LIVE_UPLOAD_TEST_EVENT_NAME),'FIXTURE_EVENT_INVALID');
    const qr=fixture515Unique_(fixture515Table_(qs).filter(x=>
      String(x.event_id)===fixtureEventId &&
      String(x.qr_label)==='__LIVE_TEST_QR__' &&
      String(x.qr_token)===req.qr_token),'FIXTURE_QR_INVALID');
    const cycle=fixture515Unique_(fixture515Table_(cs).filter(x=>
      String(x.cycle_id)===String(qr.current_cycle_id) &&
      String(x.qr_id)===String(qr.qr_id) &&
      String(x.event_id)===fixtureEventId),'FIXTURE_CYCLE_INVALID');
    if(String(event.event_status)!=='ACTIVE'||String(event.deletion_status)!=='ACTIVE'||
       String(qr.qr_status)!=='ACTIVE'||String(qr.deletion_status)!=='ACTIVE'||
       String(cycle.cycle_status)!=='ACTIVE') throw new Error('FIXTURE_INACTIVE');
    if(Number(qr.max_uploads)!==2||Number(cycle.max_uploads)!==2)
      throw new Error('FIXTURE_QUOTA_CHANGED');
    const ef=DriveApp.getFolderById(String(event.drive_folder_id));
    const qf=DriveApp.getFolderById(String(qr.drive_folder_id));
    if(!fixture515HasParent_(ef,props.getProperty('ROOT_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID'))||
       !fixture515HasParent_(qf,String(event.drive_folder_id)))
      throw new Error('FOLDER_HIERARCHY_INVALID');
    return {event,qr,cycle,qf};
  };
  try {lookup();}catch(_){return {status:'ERROR',code:'FIXTURE_NOT_READY'};}
  // Reserve separately; reserveParticipantUploadInternal_ obtains its own lock.
  // Existing reservations are discovered first; retry does not reserve again.
  const find=()=>fixture515Table_(us).filter(x=>
    String(x.event_id)===fixtureEventId && String(x.idempotency_key)===req.idempotency_key);
  let matches=find();
  if(matches.length>1) return {status:'ERROR',code:'RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED'};
  if(matches.length===0) {
    const r=reserveParticipantUploadInternal_({
      qr_token:req.qr_token,idempotency_key:req.idempotency_key,
      original_filename:req.original_filename,file_mime_type:'image/jpeg',
      file_size_bytes:req.file_size_bytes
    },true);
    if(r.status!=='SUCCESS') {
      // Failure may occur after write; never infer no reservation was created.
      matches=find();
      if(matches.length!==1) return {status:'ERROR',code:'RESERVATION_RECHECK_REQUIRED'};
    }
  }
  const lock=LockService.getScriptLock();
  if(!lock.tryLock(10000)) return {status:'ERROR',code:'UPLOAD_BUSY'};
  try {
    const x=lookup();
    matches=find();
    if(matches.length!==1) throw new Error('RESERVATION_INTEGRITY');
    const u=matches[0];
    if(String(u.qr_id)!==String(x.qr.qr_id)||
       String(u.cycle_id)!==String(x.cycle.cycle_id)||
       String(u.deletion_status)!=='ACTIVE'||
       u.file_mime_type!=='image/jpeg'||Number(u.file_size_bytes)!==bytes.length||
       String(u.original_filename)!==req.original_filename)
      throw new Error('RESERVATION_METADATA_CONFLICT');
    const state=String(u.upload_status);
    if(!['RESERVED','PROCESSING','COMPLETED'].includes(state))
      throw new Error('UPLOAD_STATE_UNSAFE');
    const filename='upload_'+String(u.upload_id).toLowerCase()+'.jpg';
    const it=x.qf.getFilesByName(filename), files=[];
    while(it.hasNext()) files.push(it.next());
    if(files.length>1) throw new Error('DUPLICATE_FILES');
    let file=files[0]||null;
    if(u.drive_file_id && (!file||file.getId()!==String(u.drive_file_id)))
      throw new Error('DRIVE_LINK_CONFLICT');
    if(state==='COMPLETED') {
      if(!file) throw new Error('COMPLETED_FILE_MISSING');
    } else {
      if(state==='PROCESSING'&&!file) throw new Error('UNCERTAIN_PROCESSING');
      if(state==='RESERVED'&&file) throw new Error('UNEXPECTED_EXISTING_FILE');
      if(!file) {
        const expires=u.lease_expires_at instanceof Date ?
          u.lease_expires_at.getTime():Date.parse(String(u.lease_expires_at));
        if(!Number.isFinite(expires)||expires<=Date.now())
          throw new Error('LEASE_EXPIRED');
      }
      if(state==='RESERVED') {
        fixture515Set_(us,u._row,'upload_status','PROCESSING');
        fixture515Set_(us,u._row,'started_at',new Date().toISOString());
        SpreadsheetApp.flush();
      }
      if(!file) {
        const blob=Utilities.newBlob(bytes,'image/jpeg',filename);
        file=x.qf.createFile(blob);
      }
    }
    if(file.getMimeType()!=='image/jpeg'||Number(file.getSize())!==bytes.length||
       !fixture515HasParent_(file,String(x.qr.drive_folder_id)))
      throw new Error('FILE_VERIFICATION_FAILED');
    // On retry, do not silently accept different JPEG bytes of equal length.
    // A Drive file already exists: compare exact bytes (test fixture <=8MiB).
    const existing=file.getBlob().getBytes();
    if(existing.length!==bytes.length || existing.some((b,i)=>b!==bytes[i]))
      throw new Error('IDEMPOTENCY_CONTENT_CONFLICT');
    if(state!=='COMPLETED') {
      fixture515Set_(us,u._row,'drive_file_id',file.getId());
      fixture515Set_(us,u._row,'drive_file_name',filename);
      fixture515Set_(us,u._row,'completed_at',new Date().toISOString());
      fixture515Set_(us,u._row,'updated_at',new Date().toISOString());
      fixture515Set_(us,u._row,'upload_status','COMPLETED');
      SpreadsheetApp.flush();
    }
    const completed=fixture515Table_(us).filter(a=>
      String(a.event_id)===fixtureEventId &&
      String(a.qr_id)===String(x.qr.qr_id) &&
      String(a.cycle_id)===String(x.cycle.cycle_id) &&
      String(a.upload_status)==='COMPLETED' &&
      String(a.deletion_status)==='ACTIVE').length;
    if(completed>2) throw new Error('FIXTURE_QUOTA_OVERFLOW');
    fixture515Set_(cs,x.cycle._row,'successful_uploads',completed);
    SpreadsheetApp.flush();
    return {status:'SUCCESS',code:'UPLOAD_COMPLETED',data:{upload_status:'COMPLETED'}};
  } catch(_) {
    // Deliberately do not expose details, IDs, QR tokens, filenames or stack traces.
    return {status:'ERROR',code:'RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED'};
  } finally {lock.releaseLock();}
}

/* =============================================================
 BATCH 5.16 — READ-ONLY RELEASE AUDIT FOR FIXTURE 5.11
 No live writes, no properties changed, no token/ID logging.
============================================================= */
function testFixtureReadinessBatch516_() {
  const props=PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  const result={status:'BLOCKED',code:'FIXTURE_NOT_READY',publicUploadEnabled:false};
  if(props.getProperty('PUBLIC_UPLOAD_514_ENABLED')==='true'||
     props.getProperty('PUBLIC_UPLOAD_515_FIXTURE_ONLY')==='true') {
    throw new Error('BATCH_516_PUBLIC_GATES_MUST_BE_OFF');
  }
  const eventId=props.getProperty('LIVE_UPLOAD_TEST_511_EVENT_ID');
  if(!eventId) throw new Error('BATCH_516_FIXTURE_PROPERTY_MISSING');
  const ss=SpreadsheetApp.openById(props.getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID'));
  const es=ss.getSheetByName('EVENTS'), qs=ss.getSheetByName('QR_SLOTS');
  const cs=ss.getSheetByName('QUOTA_CYCLES'),us=ss.getSheetByName('UPLOADS');
  if(!es||!qs||!cs||!us) throw new Error('BATCH_516_SHEETS_MISSING');
  const events=fixture515Table_(es).filter(x=>String(x.event_id)===eventId &&
    String(x.event_name)===LIVE_UPLOAD_TEST_EVENT_NAME);
  if(events.length!==1) throw new Error('BATCH_516_EVENT_INTEGRITY');
  const event=events[0];
  const qrs=fixture515Table_(qs).filter(x=>String(x.event_id)===eventId &&
    String(x.qr_label)==='__LIVE_TEST_QR__');
  if(qrs.length!==1) throw new Error('BATCH_516_QR_INTEGRITY');
  const qr=qrs[0];
  const cycles=fixture515Table_(cs).filter(x=>String(x.cycle_id)===String(qr.current_cycle_id)&&
    String(x.qr_id)===String(qr.qr_id)&&String(x.event_id)===eventId);
  if(cycles.length!==1) throw new Error('BATCH_516_CYCLE_INTEGRITY');
  const cycle=cycles[0];
  const uploads=fixture515Table_(us).filter(x=>String(x.event_id)===eventId&&
    String(x.qr_id)===String(qr.qr_id)&&String(x.cycle_id)===String(cycle.cycle_id));
  const counts={RESERVED:0,PROCESSING:0,COMPLETED:0,OTHER:0};
  uploads.forEach(u=>{const s=String(u.upload_status);counts[s in counts?s:'OTHER']++;});
  const completed=uploads.filter(u=>String(u.upload_status)==='COMPLETED'&&
    String(u.deletion_status)==='ACTIVE');
  let verified=0, missing=0, invalid=0;
  const folder=DriveApp.getFolderById(String(qr.drive_folder_id));
  const eventFolder=DriveApp.getFolderById(String(event.drive_folder_id));
  const hierarchy=fixture515HasParent_(eventFolder,props.getProperty('ROOT_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID'))&&
    fixture515HasParent_(folder,String(event.drive_folder_id));
  completed.forEach(u=>{
    try {
      if(!u.drive_file_id || !u.drive_file_name) {missing++;return;}
      const file=DriveApp.getFileById(String(u.drive_file_id));
      if(file.getName()!==String(u.drive_file_name)||
         !fixture515HasParent_(file,String(qr.drive_folder_id))||
         file.getMimeType()!=='image/jpeg') invalid++;
      else verified++;
    }catch(_){missing++;}
  });
  const active=String(event.event_status)==='ACTIVE'&&
    String(event.deletion_status)==='ACTIVE'&&
    String(qr.qr_status)==='ACTIVE'&&String(qr.deletion_status)==='ACTIVE'&&
    String(cycle.cycle_status)==='ACTIVE';
  const quota=Number(cycle.max_uploads),stored=Number(cycle.successful_uploads);
  const quotaConsistent=Number.isInteger(quota)&&quota===2&&
    Number.isInteger(stored)&&stored===completed.length&&completed.length<=quota;
  const report={fixture_active:active,folder_hierarchy_valid:hierarchy,
    quota_limit:quota,quota_stored:stored,completed_count:completed.length,
    quota_consistent:quotaConsistent,upload_counts:counts,
    completed_drive_verified:verified,completed_drive_missing:missing,
    completed_drive_invalid:invalid,remaining_nominal:quota-completed.length,
    public_gates_off:true};
  Logger.log('BATCH_516_READONLY_AUDIT '+JSON.stringify(report));
  if(!hierarchy||!quotaConsistent||missing||invalid||!active||
     counts.PROCESSING>0||counts.OTHER>0||quota-completed.length<1) {
    Logger.log('BATCH_516_HOLD_NO_LIVE_WRITES');
    return {status:'BLOCKED',code:'FIXTURE_NEEDS_REVIEW',report:report};
  }
  Logger.log('BATCH_516_FIXTURE_PRECHECK_PASSED');
  Logger.log('BATCH_516_NO_LIVE_WRITES');
  return {status:'SUCCESS',code:'FIXTURE_READONLY_READY',report:report};
}

/* =============================================================
 BATCH 5.17 — CONTROLLED LIVE TRANSACTION USING FIXTURE 5.11
 Writes ONE JPEG to fixture only. Never opens public router.
 Run ONCE. On failure do not rerun before reconciliation.
============================================================= */
function testFixtureRealTransactionBatch517_() {
  const props=PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  if(props.getProperty('PUBLIC_UPLOAD_514_ENABLED')==='true' ||
     props.getProperty('PUBLIC_UPLOAD_515_FIXTURE_ONLY')==='true')
    throw new Error('BATCH_517_PUBLIC_GATES_MUST_BE_OFF');
  const audit=testFixtureReadinessBatch516_();
  if(!audit || audit.status!=='SUCCESS' || !audit.report ||
     audit.report.remaining_nominal!==1 ||
     audit.report.upload_counts.PROCESSING!==0 ||
     audit.report.upload_counts.RESERVED!==0)
    throw new Error('BATCH_517_FIXTURE_NOT_EXACTLY_ONE_FREE_SLOT');
  const eventId=props.getProperty('LIVE_UPLOAD_TEST_511_EVENT_ID');
  const ss=SpreadsheetApp.openById(props.getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID'));
  const qrs=fixture515Table_(ss.getSheetByName('QR_SLOTS')).filter(x=>
    String(x.event_id)===eventId && String(x.qr_label)==='__LIVE_TEST_QR__' &&
    String(x.qr_status)==='ACTIVE' && String(x.deletion_status)==='ACTIVE');
  if(qrs.length!==1 || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/i.test(String(qrs[0].qr_token)))
    throw new Error('BATCH_517_FIXTURE_QR_UNSAFE');
  const bytes=buildLiveTestJpegBlob_().getBytes();
  const request={action:'upload_jpeg',qr_token:String(qrs[0].qr_token),
    idempotency_key:Utilities.getUuid(),original_filename:'fixture517.jpg',
    file_mime_type:'image/jpeg',file_size_bytes:bytes.length,
    jpeg_base64:Utilities.base64Encode(bytes)};
  if(validatePublicJpegPayload505_(request).status!=='VALID' ||
     prepareJpegBytes505D_(request).status!=='VALID')
    throw new Error('BATCH_517_JPEG_INVALID');
  // Only the internal fixture handler is temporarily enabled; router 5.14 stays OFF.
  let first;
  props.setProperty('PUBLIC_UPLOAD_515_FIXTURE_ONLY','true');
  try { first=handleFixtureJpeg515_(JSON.stringify(request)); }
  finally { props.deleteProperty('PUBLIC_UPLOAD_515_FIXTURE_ONLY'); }
  if(!first || first.code!=='UPLOAD_COMPLETED') {
    Logger.log('BATCH_517_HOLD_RECONCILE_BEFORE_RETRY');
    throw new Error('BATCH_517_FIRST_WRITE_NOT_CONFIRMED');
  }
  Logger.log('BATCH_517_LIVE_UPLOAD_COMPLETED');
  // Retry is read-write idempotency check: no new Drive file or quota increment.
  let retry;
  props.setProperty('PUBLIC_UPLOAD_515_FIXTURE_ONLY','true');
  try { retry=handleFixtureJpeg515_(JSON.stringify(request)); }
  finally { props.deleteProperty('PUBLIC_UPLOAD_515_FIXTURE_ONLY'); }
  if(!retry || retry.code!=='UPLOAD_COMPLETED')
    throw new Error('BATCH_517_RETRY_UNCONFIRMED_RECONCILE');
  const sheet=ss.getSheetByName('UPLOADS');
  const matches=fixture515Table_(sheet).filter(x=>
    String(x.event_id)===eventId && String(x.idempotency_key)===request.idempotency_key);
  if(matches.length!==1 || String(matches[0].upload_status)!=='COMPLETED')
    throw new Error('BATCH_517_RECORD_INTEGRITY_FAILED');
  const finalAudit=testFixtureReadinessBatch516_();
  // Final audit is expected to HOLD because the fixture quota is now full.
  if(!finalAudit || !finalAudit.report || finalAudit.report.completed_count!==2 ||
     finalAudit.report.quota_stored!==2 || finalAudit.report.completed_drive_verified!==2 ||
     finalAudit.report.completed_drive_missing!==0 || finalAudit.report.completed_drive_invalid!==0)
    throw new Error('BATCH_517_FINAL_AUDIT_FAILED');
  Logger.log('BATCH_517_IDEMPOTENT_RETRY_PASSED');
  Logger.log('BATCH_517_QUOTA_AND_DRIVE_VERIFIED');
  Logger.log('BATCH_517_PUBLIC_ROUTER_REMAINS_DISABLED');
  Logger.log('BATCH_517_LIVE_TRANSACTION_PASSED');
  return {status:'SUCCESS',code:'BATCH_517_LIVE_TRANSACTION_PASSED'};
}

function createPhoneTestFixture519_() {
  const LIVE_UPLOAD_TEST_EVENT_NAME = "__QR_POLAROID_PHONE_TEST_519__";

  // ---- 1. KAWAL OPERASI SERENTAK ----

  const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();

  if (!lock.tryLock(10000)) {
    throw new Error("TEST_FIXTURE_LOCK_BUSY");
  }

  try {

    // ---- 2. BUKA DATABASE ----

    const props =
      PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

    const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(
      props.getProperty("SPREADSHEET_ID")
    );

    const events = ss.getSheetByName("EVENTS");
    const qrSlots = ss.getSheetByName("QR_SLOTS");
    const cycles = ss.getSheetByName("QUOTA_CYCLES");

    if (!events || !qrSlots || !cycles) {
      throw new Error("TEST_DATABASE_INCOMPLETE");
    }

    // ---- 3. SEMAK HEADER RASMI ----

    const eventHeaders = [
      "event_id", "event_name",
      "start_date", "end_date",
      "start_time", "end_time",
      "schedule_enabled", "drive_folder_id",
      "event_status", "created_at",
      "updated_at", "updated_by",
      "deleted_at", "deleted_by",
      "deletion_status", "created_by"
    ];

    const qrHeaders = [
      "qr_id", "event_id", "qr_label",
      "qr_token", "qr_status",
      "max_uploads", "current_cycle_id",
      "drive_folder_id", "created_at",
      "updated_at", "created_by",
      "updated_by", "last_upload_at",
      "regenerated_at", "regenerated_by",
      "deleted_at", "deleted_by",
      "deletion_status"
    ];

    const cycleHeaders = [
      "cycle_id", "event_id", "qr_id",
      "cycle_number", "max_uploads",
      "cycle_status", "started_at",
      "ended_at", "created_at",
      "created_by", "closed_by",
      "reset_reason", "successful_uploads"
    ];

    function verifyHeaders(sheet, expected) {
      const actual = sheet.getRange(
        1, 1, 1, expected.length
      ).getValues()[0];

      if (!expected.every(
        (value, i) => actual[i] === value
      )) {
        throw new Error(
          "TEST_HEADER_MISMATCH_" +
          sheet.getName()
        );
      }
    }

    verifyHeaders(events, eventHeaders);
    verifyHeaders(qrSlots, qrHeaders);
    verifyHeaders(cycles, cycleHeaders);

    // ---- 4. CEGAH ACARA BERGANDA ----

    const existing = events.getDataRange()
      .getValues()
      .slice(1)
      .filter(row =>
        String(row[1]) ===
        LIVE_UPLOAD_TEST_EVENT_NAME
      );

    if (existing.length > 0) {
      throw new Error(
        "TEST_FIXTURE_ALREADY_EXISTS_" +
        "RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED"
      );
    }

    // ---- 5. SEDIAKAN JADUAL ACARA ----

    const timezone = ss.getSpreadsheetTimeZone();
    const now = new Date();

    const dateText = offset =>
      Utilities.formatDate(
        new Date(
          now.getTime() + offset * 86400000
        ),
        timezone,
        "yyyy-MM-dd"
      );

    const eventData = {
      event_name: LIVE_UPLOAD_TEST_EVENT_NAME,
      start_date: dateText(-1),
      end_date: dateText(1),
      start_time: "00:00",
      end_time: "23:59",
      schedule_enabled: true
    };

    // ---- 6. CIPTA ACARA DRAFT ----

    const eventResult =
      createEvent_(eventData, true);

    if (
      eventResult.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
      eventResult.saved !== false
    ) {
      throw new Error("TEST_EVENT_BUILD_FAILED");
    }

    const event = eventResult.event;

    const eventRow = eventHeaders.map(
      header => event[header]
    );

    events.appendRow(eventRow);
    SpreadsheetApp.flush();

    // ---- 7. CIPTA FOLDER ACARA ----

    // Fungsi lama membaca EVENTS.
    // Acara mesti sudah disimpan.

    const eventFolder = createEventFolder_(
      event.event_id
    );

    if (eventFolder.status !== "SUCCESS") {
      throw new Error("TEST_EVENT_FOLDER_FAILED");
    }

    // ---- 8. SEDIAKAN QR SLOT ----

    const slotResult = createQrSlot_({
      event_id: event.event_id,
      qr_label: "__LIVE_TEST_QR__",
      max_uploads: 3
    });

    if (
      slotResult.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
      slotResult.saved !== false
    ) {
      throw new Error("TEST_QR_BUILD_FAILED");
    }

    const slot = slotResult.slot;

    qrSlots.appendRow(
      qrHeaders.map(header => slot[header])
    );

    SpreadsheetApp.flush();

    // ---- 9. CIPTA FOLDER QR ----

    const qrFolder = createQrSlotFolder_(
      slot.qr_id
    );

    if (qrFolder.status !== "SUCCESS") {
      throw new Error("TEST_QR_FOLDER_FAILED");
    }

    // ---- 10. SEDIAKAN CYCLE 1 ----

    const cycleResult = createQuotaCycle_(
      slot.qr_id
    );

    if (
      cycleResult.status !== "SUCCESS" ||
      cycleResult.saved !== false
    ) {
      throw new Error("TEST_CYCLE_BUILD_FAILED");
    }

    const cycle = cycleResult.cycle;

    cycles.appendRow(
      cycleHeaders.map(
        header => cycle[header]
      )
    );

    SpreadsheetApp.flush();

    // ---- 11. CARI BARIS QR DAN EVENT ----

    // Semak ID unik, bukan nama sahaja.

    function findUniqueRow(sheet, id) {
      const rows = sheet.getDataRange()
        .getValues();

      const matches = [];

      for (let i = 1; i < rows.length; i++) {
        if (String(rows[i][0]) === id) {
          matches.push(i + 1);
        }
      }

      if (matches.length !== 1) {
        throw new Error(
          "TEST_RECORD_NOT_UNIQUE"
        );
      }

      return matches[0];
    }

    const eventRowNumber = findUniqueRow(
      events, event.event_id
    );

    const qrRowNumber = findUniqueRow(
      qrSlots, slot.qr_id
    );

    // ---- 12. HUBUNGKAN CYCLE ----

    qrSlots.getRange(
      qrRowNumber, 7
    ).setValue(cycle.cycle_id);

    // ---- 13. AKTIFKAN REKOD TERAKHIR ----

    // Aktifkan hanya selepas semua
    // folder dan cycle berjaya dicipta.

    qrSlots.getRange(
      qrRowNumber, 5
    ).setValue("ACTIVE");

    events.getRange(
      eventRowNumber, 9
    ).setValue("ACTIVE");

    SpreadsheetApp.flush();

    // ---- 14. SIMPAN PENANDA UJIAN ----

    // Hanya ID acara disimpan.
    // Token QR tidak disimpan
    // dalam Script Properties.

    props.setProperty(
      "LIVE_UPLOAD_TEST_519_EVENT_ID",
      event.event_id
    );

    Logger.log(
      "LIVE TEST FIXTURE CREATED"
    );

    return {
      status: "SUCCESS",
      code: "LIVE_TEST_FIXTURE_CREATED",
      created: true,
      event_active: true,
      qr_active: true,
      cycle_active: true,
      quota_limit: 3
    };

  } finally {

    lock.releaseLock();

  }
}

/* BATCH 5.19 — CREATE A NEW ISOLATED PHONE TEST FIXTURE.
   Live writes: creates an event, QR slot, cycle, Drive folders.
   Does not upload a JPEG, change the permanent event or open public upload.
   Run ONCE only; on error, inspect partial records before rerunning.
*/
function testCreatePhoneFixtureBatch519_() {
  const props=PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  if(props.getProperty('LIVE_UPLOAD_TEST_519_EVENT_ID'))
    throw new Error('BATCH_519_ALREADY_CREATED_STOP');
  if(props.getProperty('PUBLIC_UPLOAD_514_ENABLED')==='true' ||
     props.getProperty('PUBLIC_UPLOAD_515_FIXTURE_ONLY')==='true')
    throw new Error('BATCH_519_PUBLIC_GATES_MUST_BE_OFF');
  const ss=SpreadsheetApp.openById(props.getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID'));
  const events=fixture515Table_(ss.getSheetByName('EVENTS'));
  if(events.some(x=>String(x.event_name)==='__QR_POLAROID_PHONE_TEST_519__'))
    throw new Error('BATCH_519_NAME_EXISTS_STOP_AND_AUDIT');
  Logger.log('BATCH_519_PRECHECK_PASSED');
  const result=createPhoneTestFixture519_();
  if(!result || result.status!=='SUCCESS' || result.created!==true)
    throw new Error('BATCH_519_CREATION_NOT_VERIFIED_STOP');
  const eventId=props.getProperty('LIVE_UPLOAD_TEST_519_EVENT_ID');
  if(!eventId)throw new Error('BATCH_519_MARKER_MISSING');
  const er=fixture515Table_(ss.getSheetByName('EVENTS')).filter(x=>String(x.event_id)===eventId);
  const qr=fixture515Table_(ss.getSheetByName('QR_SLOTS')).filter(x=>String(x.event_id)===eventId);
  const cycle=fixture515Table_(ss.getSheetByName('QUOTA_CYCLES')).filter(x=>String(x.event_id)===eventId);
  if(er.length!==1||qr.length!==1||cycle.length!==1 ||
     String(er[0].event_status)!=='ACTIVE'||String(qr[0].qr_status)!=='ACTIVE'||
     String(cycle[0].cycle_status)!=='ACTIVE'||Number(cycle[0].max_uploads)!==3)
    throw new Error('BATCH_519_CREATED_BUT_AUDIT_FAILED_STOP');
  Logger.log('BATCH_519_FRESH_PHONE_FIXTURE_CREATED');
  Logger.log('BATCH_519_QUOTA_3_READY');
  Logger.log('BATCH_519_PUBLIC_UPLOAD_STILL_DISABLED');
  return {status:'SUCCESS',code:'BATCH_519_FIXTURE_READY',liveWrites:true};
}


/* =============================================================
 BATCH 5.20 — LIVE INTERNAL SMOKE ON NEW 5.19 PHONE FIXTURE
 NO PUBLIC ROUTER CHANGES. ONE LIVE WRITE, one idempotent replay.
 The one-shot internal flag is restored even on failure.
============================================================= */
function handlePhoneFixture520_(rawBody) {
  const props=PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  // Two independent gates. The 5.14 gate is checked before calling here.
  if(props.getProperty('INTERNAL_520_ONE_SHOT')!=='true' &&
     props.getProperty('PHONE_TEST_521_ENABLED')!=='true')
    return {status:'ERROR',code:'UPLOAD_DISABLED'};
  const fixtureEventId=props.getProperty('LIVE_UPLOAD_TEST_519_EVENT_ID');
  if(!fixtureEventId) return {status:'ERROR',code:'TEST_FIXTURE_MISSING'};
  let req;
  try {req=JSON.parse(rawBody);}catch(_){return {status:'ERROR',code:'INVALID_JSON'};}
  const valid=validatePublicJpegPayload505_(req);
  if(valid.status!=='VALID') return {status:'ERROR',code:valid.code};
  // Decode before reservation: never reserve quota for invalid bytes.
  const ready=prepareJpegBytes505D_(req);
  if(ready.status!=='VALID') return {status:'ERROR',code:ready.code};
  let bytes;
  try {bytes=Utilities.base64Decode(req.jpeg_base64);}catch(_){return {status:'ERROR',code:'INVALID_FILE'};}
  // Public request can never choose event/QR/folder IDs.
  const ss=SpreadsheetApp.openById(props.getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID'));
  const es=ss.getSheetByName('EVENTS'), qs=ss.getSheetByName('QR_SLOTS');
  const cs=ss.getSheetByName('QUOTA_CYCLES'), us=ss.getSheetByName('UPLOADS');
  if(!es||!qs||!cs||!us) return {status:'ERROR',code:'SYSTEM_UNAVAILABLE'};
  const lookup=()=>{
    const event=fixture515Unique_(fixture515Table_(es).filter(x=>
      String(x.event_id)===fixtureEventId &&
      String(x.event_name)==='__QR_POLAROID_PHONE_TEST_519__'),'FIXTURE_EVENT_INVALID');
    const qr=fixture515Unique_(fixture515Table_(qs).filter(x=>
      String(x.event_id)===fixtureEventId &&
      String(x.qr_label)==='__LIVE_TEST_QR__' &&
      String(x.qr_token)===req.qr_token),'FIXTURE_QR_INVALID');
    const cycle=fixture515Unique_(fixture515Table_(cs).filter(x=>
      String(x.cycle_id)===String(qr.current_cycle_id) &&
      String(x.qr_id)===String(qr.qr_id) &&
      String(x.event_id)===fixtureEventId),'FIXTURE_CYCLE_INVALID');
    if(String(event.event_status)!=='ACTIVE'||String(event.deletion_status)!=='ACTIVE'||
       String(qr.qr_status)!=='ACTIVE'||String(qr.deletion_status)!=='ACTIVE'||
       String(cycle.cycle_status)!=='ACTIVE') throw new Error('FIXTURE_INACTIVE');
    if(Number(qr.max_uploads)!==3||Number(cycle.max_uploads)!==3)
      throw new Error('FIXTURE_QUOTA_CHANGED');
    const ef=DriveApp.getFolderById(String(event.drive_folder_id));
    const qf=DriveApp.getFolderById(String(qr.drive_folder_id));
    if(!fixture515HasParent_(ef,props.getProperty('ROOT_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID'))||
       !fixture515HasParent_(qf,String(event.drive_folder_id)))
      throw new Error('FOLDER_HIERARCHY_INVALID');
    return {event,qr,cycle,qf};
  };
  try {lookup();}catch(_){return {status:'ERROR',code:'FIXTURE_NOT_READY'};}
  // Reserve separately; reserveParticipantUploadInternal_ obtains its own lock.
  // Existing reservations are discovered first; retry does not reserve again.
  const find=()=>fixture515Table_(us).filter(x=>
    String(x.event_id)===fixtureEventId && String(x.idempotency_key)===req.idempotency_key);
  let matches=find();
  if(matches.length>1) return {status:'ERROR',code:'RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED'};
  if(matches.length===0) {
    const r=reserveParticipantUploadInternal_({
      qr_token:req.qr_token,idempotency_key:req.idempotency_key,
      original_filename:req.original_filename,file_mime_type:'image/jpeg',
      file_size_bytes:req.file_size_bytes
    },true);
    if(r.status!=='SUCCESS') {
      // Failure may occur after write; never infer no reservation was created.
      matches=find();
      if(matches.length!==1) return {status:'ERROR',code:'RESERVATION_RECHECK_REQUIRED'};
    }
  }
  const lock=LockService.getScriptLock();
  if(!lock.tryLock(10000)) return {status:'ERROR',code:'UPLOAD_BUSY'};
  try {
    const x=lookup();
    matches=find();
    if(matches.length!==1) throw new Error('RESERVATION_INTEGRITY');
    const u=matches[0];
    if(String(u.qr_id)!==String(x.qr.qr_id)||
       String(u.cycle_id)!==String(x.cycle.cycle_id)||
       String(u.deletion_status)!=='ACTIVE'||
       u.file_mime_type!=='image/jpeg'||Number(u.file_size_bytes)!==bytes.length||
       String(u.original_filename)!==req.original_filename)
      throw new Error('RESERVATION_METADATA_CONFLICT');
    const state=String(u.upload_status);
    if(!['RESERVED','PROCESSING','COMPLETED'].includes(state))
      throw new Error('UPLOAD_STATE_UNSAFE');
    const filename='upload_'+String(u.upload_id).toLowerCase()+'.jpg';
    const it=x.qf.getFilesByName(filename), files=[];
    while(it.hasNext()) files.push(it.next());
    if(files.length>1) throw new Error('DUPLICATE_FILES');
    let file=files[0]||null;
    if(u.drive_file_id && (!file||file.getId()!==String(u.drive_file_id)))
      throw new Error('DRIVE_LINK_CONFLICT');
    if(state==='COMPLETED') {
      if(!file) throw new Error('COMPLETED_FILE_MISSING');
    } else {
      if(state==='PROCESSING'&&!file) throw new Error('UNCERTAIN_PROCESSING');
      if(state==='RESERVED'&&file) throw new Error('UNEXPECTED_EXISTING_FILE');
      if(!file) {
        const expires=u.lease_expires_at instanceof Date ?
          u.lease_expires_at.getTime():Date.parse(String(u.lease_expires_at));
        if(!Number.isFinite(expires)||expires<=Date.now())
          throw new Error('LEASE_EXPIRED');
      }
      if(state==='RESERVED') {
        fixture515Set_(us,u._row,'upload_status','PROCESSING');
        fixture515Set_(us,u._row,'started_at',new Date().toISOString());
        SpreadsheetApp.flush();
      }
      if(!file) {
        const blob=Utilities.newBlob(bytes,'image/jpeg',filename);
        file=x.qf.createFile(blob);
      }
    }
    if(file.getMimeType()!=='image/jpeg'||Number(file.getSize())!==bytes.length||
       !fixture515HasParent_(file,String(x.qr.drive_folder_id)))
      throw new Error('FILE_VERIFICATION_FAILED');
    // On retry, do not silently accept different JPEG bytes of equal length.
    // A Drive file already exists: compare exact bytes (test fixture <=8MiB).
    const existing=file.getBlob().getBytes();
    if(existing.length!==bytes.length || existing.some((b,i)=>b!==bytes[i]))
      throw new Error('IDEMPOTENCY_CONTENT_CONFLICT');
    if(state!=='COMPLETED') {
      fixture515Set_(us,u._row,'drive_file_id',file.getId());
      fixture515Set_(us,u._row,'drive_file_name',filename);
      fixture515Set_(us,u._row,'completed_at',new Date().toISOString());
      fixture515Set_(us,u._row,'updated_at',new Date().toISOString());
      fixture515Set_(us,u._row,'upload_status','COMPLETED');
      SpreadsheetApp.flush();
    }
    const completed=fixture515Table_(us).filter(a=>
      String(a.event_id)===fixtureEventId &&
      String(a.qr_id)===String(x.qr.qr_id) &&
      String(a.cycle_id)===String(x.cycle.cycle_id) &&
      String(a.upload_status)==='COMPLETED' &&
      String(a.deletion_status)==='ACTIVE').length;
    if(completed>3) throw new Error('FIXTURE_QUOTA_OVERFLOW');
    fixture515Set_(cs,x.cycle._row,'successful_uploads',completed);
    SpreadsheetApp.flush();
    return {status:'SUCCESS',code:'UPLOAD_COMPLETED',data:{upload_status:'COMPLETED'}};
  } catch(_) {
    // Deliberately do not expose details, IDs, QR tokens, filenames or stack traces.
    return {status:'ERROR',code:'RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED'};
  } finally {lock.releaseLock();}
}

/* Batch 5.15 safe preflight: no writes and no property changes. */
function testPhoneFixtureTransactionBatch520_() {
  const props=PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  if(props.getProperty('PUBLIC_UPLOAD_514_ENABLED')==='true'||
     props.getProperty('PUBLIC_UPLOAD_515_FIXTURE_ONLY')==='true'||
     props.getProperty('INTERNAL_520_ONE_SHOT')==='true')
    throw new Error('BATCH_520_PUBLIC_OR_INTERNAL_GATE_ENABLED_STOP');
  const eventId=props.getProperty('LIVE_UPLOAD_TEST_519_EVENT_ID');
  if(!eventId) throw new Error('BATCH_520_FIXTURE_MISSING');
  const ss=SpreadsheetApp.openById(props.getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID'));
  const ev=fixture515Table_(ss.getSheetByName('EVENTS')).filter(x=>
    String(x.event_id)===eventId&&String(x.event_name)==='__QR_POLAROID_PHONE_TEST_519__');
  const qrs=fixture515Table_(ss.getSheetByName('QR_SLOTS')).filter(x=>
    String(x.event_id)===eventId&&String(x.qr_label)==='__LIVE_TEST_QR__');
  const cycles=fixture515Table_(ss.getSheetByName('QUOTA_CYCLES')).filter(x=>
    qrs.length===1&&String(x.cycle_id)===String(qrs[0].current_cycle_id));
  if(ev.length!==1||qrs.length!==1||cycles.length!==1||
     String(ev[0].event_status)!=='ACTIVE'||String(qrs[0].qr_status)!=='ACTIVE'||
     String(cycles[0].cycle_status)!=='ACTIVE'||Number(cycles[0].max_uploads)!==3)
    throw new Error('BATCH_520_FIXTURE_INTEGRITY_STOP');
  const uploads=fixture515Table_(ss.getSheetByName('UPLOADS')).filter(x=>
    String(x.event_id)===eventId);
  if(uploads.length!==0||Number(cycles[0].successful_uploads)!==0)
    throw new Error('BATCH_520_NOT_EMPTY_STOP_DO_NOT_REPEAT');
  const bytes=buildLiveTestJpegBlob_().getBytes();
  const request={action:'upload_jpeg',qr_token:String(qrs[0].qr_token),
    idempotency_key:Utilities.getUuid(),original_filename:'batch520_test.jpg',
    file_mime_type:'image/jpeg',file_size_bytes:bytes.length,
    jpeg_base64:Utilities.base64Encode(bytes)};
  if(validatePublicJpegPayload505_(request).status!=='VALID'||
     prepareJpegBytes505D_(request).status!=='VALID')
    throw new Error('BATCH_520_JPEG_INVALID');
  Logger.log('BATCH_520_PRECHECK_PASSED');
  let first,replay;
  props.setProperty('INTERNAL_520_ONE_SHOT','true');
  try {
    first=handlePhoneFixture520_(JSON.stringify(request));
    if(!first||first.code!=='UPLOAD_COMPLETED')
      throw new Error('BATCH_520_FIRST_WRITE_UNCONFIRMED_STOP_AND_RECONCILE');
    Logger.log('BATCH_520_LIVE_WRITE_PASSED');
    replay=handlePhoneFixture520_(JSON.stringify(request));
    if(!replay||replay.code!=='UPLOAD_COMPLETED')
      throw new Error('BATCH_520_REPLAY_UNCONFIRMED_STOP_AND_RECONCILE');
  } finally {props.deleteProperty('INTERNAL_520_ONE_SHOT');}
  const records=fixture515Table_(ss.getSheetByName('UPLOADS')).filter(x=>
    String(x.event_id)===eventId);
  const finalCycles=fixture515Table_(ss.getSheetByName('QUOTA_CYCLES')).filter(x=>
    String(x.cycle_id)===String(cycles[0].cycle_id));
  if(records.length!==1||String(records[0].upload_status)!=='COMPLETED'||
     finalCycles.length!==1||Number(finalCycles[0].successful_uploads)!==1)
    throw new Error('BATCH_520_POST_WRITE_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED');
  const file=DriveApp.getFileById(String(records[0].drive_file_id));
  if(file.getMimeType()!=='image/jpeg'||
     !fixture515HasParent_(file,String(qrs[0].drive_folder_id)))
    throw new Error('BATCH_520_DRIVE_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED');
  Logger.log('BATCH_520_IDEMPOTENCY_PASSED');
  Logger.log('BATCH_520_QUOTA_1_OF_3_VERIFIED');
  Logger.log('BATCH_520_PUBLIC_UPLOAD_STILL_DISABLED');
  Logger.log('BATCH_520_LIVE_INTERNAL_PASSED');
  return {status:'SUCCESS',code:'BATCH_520_LIVE_INTERNAL_PASSED',liveWrites:true};
}

 BATCH 5.21 — PHONE TEST GATE (fixture 5.19 ONLY)
 Safe read-only readiness before manually enabling the test.
 NOTE: Script Properties are NOT toggled automatically.
 Do not enable for permanent event; remove PHONE_TEST_521_ENABLED

}


/* ============================================================
 BATCH 5.23 — PRODUCTION QR RESOLVER (READ-ONLY, FAIL-CLOSED)
 Does not enable public upload. Does not reuse test fixture IDs.
 ============================================================ */
function resolveProductionQr523_(token) {
  if (typeof token !== 'string' || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/i.test(token))
    return {status:'REJECTED',code:'INVALID_QR'};
  const props=PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  const ss=SpreadsheetApp.openById(props.getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID'));
  const events=fixture515Table_(ss.getSheetByName('EVENTS'));
  const qrs=fixture515Table_(ss.getSheetByName('QR_SLOTS'));
  const cycles=fixture515Table_(ss.getSheetByName('QUOTA_CYCLES'));
  const matches=qrs.filter(q=>String(q.qr_token).toLowerCase()===token.toLowerCase());
  if(matches.length!==1) return {status:'REJECTED',code:'INVALID_QR'};
  const qr=matches[0];
  const evs=events.filter(e=>String(e.event_id)===String(qr.event_id));
  const cs=cycles.filter(c=>String(c.cycle_id)===String(qr.current_cycle_id)&&
    String(c.qr_id)===String(qr.qr_id)&&String(c.event_id)===String(qr.event_id));
  if(evs.length!==1||cs.length!==1) return {status:'REJECTED',code:'DATA_INTEGRITY_HOLD'};
  const ev=evs[0],cy=cs[0];
  if(String(ev.event_status)!=='ACTIVE'||String(ev.deletion_status)!=='ACTIVE'||
     String(qr.qr_status)!=='ACTIVE'||String(qr.deletion_status)!=='ACTIVE'||
     String(cy.cycle_status)!=='ACTIVE')
    return {status:'REJECTED',code:'INACTIVE'};
  // Check schedule using existing, already-tested eligibility logic. Do not
  // implement a second date parser with different timezone semantics.
  const eligibility=checkUploadEligibility_(token);
  if(!eligibility || eligibility.status!=='SUCCESS' || eligibility.eligible!==true)
    return {status:'REJECTED',code:(eligibility&&(eligibility.eligibility_code||eligibility.code))||'NOT_ELIGIBLE'};
  const max=Number(cy.max_uploads);
  if(!Number.isSafeInteger(max)||max<1||Number(qr.max_uploads)!==max)
    return {status:'REJECTED',code:'QUOTA_INTEGRITY_HOLD'};
  const root=props.getProperty('ROOT_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID');
  try {
    const eventFolder=DriveApp.getFolderById(String(ev.drive_folder_id));
    const qrFolder=DriveApp.getFolderById(String(qr.drive_folder_id));
    if(!fixture515HasParent_(eventFolder,root)||
       !fixture515HasParent_(qrFolder,String(ev.drive_folder_id)))
      return {status:'REJECTED',code:'FOLDER_INTEGRITY_HOLD'};
  } catch (_) {return {status:'REJECTED',code:'FOLDER_INTEGRITY_HOLD'};}
  // Return only server-side identifiers; NEVER expose this result directly
  // from a public API or log it.
  return {status:'READY',event_id:String(ev.event_id),qr_id:String(qr.qr_id),
    cycle_id:String(cy.cycle_id),folder_id:String(qr.drive_folder_id),max_uploads:max};
}

function testProductionResolverBatch523_() {
  const props=PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  if(props.getProperty('PHONE_TEST_521_ENABLED')==='true')
    throw new Error('PHONE_TEST_GATE_MUST_BE_OFF');
  if(props.getProperty('PUBLIC_UPLOAD_514_ENABLED')==='true'||
     props.getProperty('PUBLIC_UPLOAD_515_FIXTURE_ONLY')==='true')
    throw new Error('LEGACY_PUBLIC_GATES_MUST_BE_OFF');
  const bad=resolveProductionQr523_('invalid');
  if(bad.code!=='INVALID_QR')throw new Error('INVALID_TOKEN_NOT_REJECTED');

    if(!ss.getSheetByName(n))throw new Error('REQUIRED_SHEET_MISSING');
  });
  Logger.log('BATCH_523_PRODUCTION_RESOLVER_INSTALLED');
  Logger.log('BATCH_523_PUBLIC_UPLOAD_STILL_DISABLED');
  Logger.log('BATCH_523_NO_LIVE_WRITES');

}


/* =============================================================
 BATCH 5.24 — PRODUCTION TRANSACTION ADAPTER (FAIL CLOSED)
 This batch deliberately does not authorize live production writes.
 The prior fixture-only handler is not a production handler: it uses
 test IDs and has an unresolved PROCESSING/no-file recovery branch.
 Do NOT bypass the guard without a reviewed transaction implementation.
============================================================= */
function handleProductionJpeg524_(rawBody) {
  // This is a non-writing production adapter. It validates real requests,
  // resolves the intended QR, and returns a stable safe hold response.
  // A Script Property alone MUST NOT enable writes.
  if(typeof rawBody!=='string' || rawBody.length>11200000)
    return {status:'ERROR',code:'REQUEST_TOO_LARGE'};
  let request;
  try {request=JSON.parse(rawBody);}catch(_){return {status:'ERROR',code:'INVALID_JSON'};}
  if(!request || request.action!=='upload_jpeg')
    return {status:'ERROR',code:'UNSUPPORTED_ACTION'};
  const validation=validatePublicJpegPayload505_(request);
  if(validation.status!=='VALID')
    return {status:'ERROR',code:validation.code||'INVALID_FILE'};
  const decoded=prepareJpegBytes505D_(request);
  if(decoded.status!=='VALID')
    return {status:'ERROR',code:decoded.code||'INVALID_FILE'};
  const qr=resolveProductionQr523_(request.qr_token);
  if(qr.status!=='READY')
    return {status:'ERROR',code:qr.code||'NOT_ELIGIBLE'};
  // Never send internal event_id, qr_id, cycle_id or folder_id to client.
  return {status:'ERROR',code:'PRODUCTION_TRANSACTION_HOLD'};
}

function testProductionAdapterBatch524_() {
  const props=PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  if(props.getProperty('PRODUCTION_UPLOAD_524_ENABLED')==='true')
    throw new Error('BATCH_524_GATE_MUST_REMAIN_OFF');
  if(props.getProperty('PHONE_TEST_521_ENABLED')==='true')
    throw new Error('BATCH_524_PHONE_GATE_MUST_REMAIN_OFF');
  const invalid=handleProductionJpeg524_('{bad');
  if(invalid.code!=='INVALID_JSON')throw new Error('INVALID_JSON_NOT_REJECTED');
  const wrong=handleProductionJpeg524_('{"action":"test_post"}');
  if(wrong.code!=='UNSUPPORTED_ACTION')throw new Error('ACTION_NOT_REJECTED');
  const publicResult=handlePublicJpeg514_('{"action":"upload_jpeg"}');
  if(publicResult.code!=='PUBLIC_TRANSACTION_NOT_READY')
    throw new Error('PUBLIC_ROUTE_NOT_LOCKED');
  Logger.log('BATCH_524_PRODUCTION_ADAPTER_INSTALLED');
  Logger.log('BATCH_524_PRODUCTION_WRITES_BLOCKED');
  Logger.log('BATCH_524_NO_LIVE_WRITES');
  return {status:'SUCCESS',code:'BATCH_524_ADAPTER_READY',liveWrites:false};
}


/* ============================================================
 BATCH 5.25 — PRODUCTION TRANSACTION ENGINE (GUARDED)
 Code installed, but NOT enabled. No public writes in this batch.
 Reservation obtains its own ScriptLock. File processing obtains a
 separate lock, never nested. Uncertain PROCESSING without Drive
 file is held for reconciliation, not silently re-created.
 ============================================================ */
function handleProductionTransaction525_(rawBody) {
  const props=PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  // A separate, explicit production gate; NEVER enabled by this file.
  if(props.getProperty('PRODUCTION_TRANSACTION_525_ENABLED')!=='true')
    return {status:'ERROR',code:'PRODUCTION_TRANSACTION_HOLD'};
  if(props.getProperty('PHONE_TEST_521_ENABLED')==='true'||
     props.getProperty('PUBLIC_UPLOAD_514_ENABLED')==='true'||
     props.getProperty('PUBLIC_UPLOAD_515_FIXTURE_ONLY')==='true')
    return {status:'ERROR',code:'CONFIGURATION_CONFLICT'};
  let req;
  try {req=JSON.parse(rawBody);}catch(_){return {status:'ERROR',code:'INVALID_JSON'};}
  const valid=validatePublicJpegPayload505_(req);
  if(valid.status!=='VALID') return {status:'ERROR',code:valid.code};
  // Decode before reservation: never reserve quota for invalid bytes.
  const ready=prepareJpegBytes505D_(req);
  if(ready.status!=='VALID') return {status:'ERROR',code:ready.code};
  let bytes;
  try {bytes=Utilities.base64Decode(req.jpeg_base64);}catch(_){return {status:'ERROR',code:'INVALID_FILE'};}
  // Public request can never choose event/QR/folder IDs.
  const target=resolveProductionQr523_(req.qr_token);
  // Temporary test fixtures must never be used through production routing.
  const testEventIds=[props.getProperty('LIVE_UPLOAD_TEST_511_EVENT_ID'),
    props.getProperty('LIVE_UPLOAD_TEST_519_EVENT_ID')].filter(Boolean);
  if(target.status!=='READY') return {status:'ERROR',code:target.code||'NOT_ELIGIBLE'};
  if(testEventIds.indexOf(target.event_id)>=0) return {status:'ERROR',code:'TEST_EVENT_NOT_PRODUCTION'};
  const ss=SpreadsheetApp.openById(props.getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID'));
  const es=ss.getSheetByName('EVENTS'), qs=ss.getSheetByName('QR_SLOTS');
  const cs=ss.getSheetByName('QUOTA_CYCLES'), us=ss.getSheetByName('UPLOADS');
  if(!es||!qs||!cs||!us) return {status:'ERROR',code:'SYSTEM_UNAVAILABLE'};
  const lookup=()=>{
    const event=fixture515Unique_(fixture515Table_(es).filter(x=>
      String(x.event_id)===target.event_id),'EVENT_INTEGRITY');
    const qr=fixture515Unique_(fixture515Table_(qs).filter(x=>
      String(x.qr_id)===target.qr_id && String(x.event_id)===target.event_id &&
      String(x.qr_token).toLowerCase()===req.qr_token.toLowerCase()),'QR_INTEGRITY');
    const cycle=fixture515Unique_(fixture515Table_(cs).filter(x=>
      String(x.cycle_id)===target.cycle_id && String(x.qr_id)===target.qr_id &&
      String(x.event_id)===target.event_id),'CYCLE_INTEGRITY');
    if(String(event.event_status)!=='ACTIVE'||String(event.deletion_status)!=='ACTIVE'||
       String(qr.qr_status)!=='ACTIVE'||String(qr.deletion_status)!=='ACTIVE'||
       String(cycle.cycle_status)!=='ACTIVE'||
       String(qr.current_cycle_id)!==target.cycle_id) throw new Error('TARGET_INACTIVE');
    const max=Number(cycle.max_uploads);
    if(!Number.isSafeInteger(max)||max<1||Number(qr.max_uploads)!==max)
      throw new Error('QUOTA_INTEGRITY');
    const ef=DriveApp.getFolderById(String(event.drive_folder_id));
    const qf=DriveApp.getFolderById(String(qr.drive_folder_id));
    if(!fixture515HasParent_(ef,props.getProperty('ROOT_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID'))||
       !fixture515HasParent_(qf,String(event.drive_folder_id)))
      throw new Error('FOLDER_HIERARCHY_INVALID');
    return {event,qr,cycle,qf,max};
  };
  try {lookup();}catch(_){return {status:'ERROR',code:'TARGET_NOT_READY'};}
  // Reserve separately; reserveParticipantUploadInternal_ obtains its own lock.
  // Existing reservations are discovered first; retry does not reserve again.
  const find=()=>fixture515Table_(us).filter(x=>
    String(x.event_id)===target.event_id && String(x.idempotency_key)===req.idempotency_key);
  let matches=find();
  if(matches.length>1) return {status:'ERROR',code:'RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED'};
  if(matches.length===0) {
    const r=reserveParticipantUploadInternal_({
      qr_token:req.qr_token,idempotency_key:req.idempotency_key,
      original_filename:req.original_filename,file_mime_type:'image/jpeg',
      file_size_bytes:req.file_size_bytes
    },true);
    if(r.status!=='SUCCESS') {
      // Failure may occur after write; never infer no reservation was created.
      matches=find();
      if(matches.length!==1) return {status:'ERROR',code:'RESERVATION_RECHECK_REQUIRED'};
    }
  }
  const lock=LockService.getScriptLock();
  if(!lock.tryLock(10000)) return {status:'ERROR',code:'UPLOAD_BUSY'};
  try {
    const x=lookup();
    matches=find();
    if(matches.length!==1) throw new Error('RESERVATION_INTEGRITY');
    const u=matches[0];
    if(String(u.qr_id)!==String(x.qr.qr_id)||
       String(u.cycle_id)!==String(x.cycle.cycle_id)||
       String(u.deletion_status)!=='ACTIVE'||
       u.file_mime_type!=='image/jpeg'||Number(u.file_size_bytes)!==bytes.length||
       String(u.original_filename)!==req.original_filename)
      throw new Error('RESERVATION_METADATA_CONFLICT');
    const state=String(u.upload_status);
    if(state!=='COMPLETED') {
      const fresh=resolveProductionQr523_(req.qr_token);
      if(fresh.status!=='READY'||fresh.cycle_id!==target.cycle_id)
        throw new Error('ELIGIBILITY_CHANGED');
    }
    if(!['RESERVED','PROCESSING','COMPLETED'].includes(state))
      throw new Error('UPLOAD_STATE_UNSAFE');
    const filename='upload_'+String(u.upload_id).toLowerCase()+'.jpg';
    const it=x.qf.getFilesByName(filename), files=[];
    while(it.hasNext()) files.push(it.next());
    if(files.length>1) throw new Error('DUPLICATE_FILES');
    let file=files[0]||null;
    if(u.drive_file_id && (!file||file.getId()!==String(u.drive_file_id)))
      throw new Error('DRIVE_LINK_CONFLICT');
    if(state==='COMPLETED') {
      if(!file) throw new Error('COMPLETED_FILE_MISSING');
    } else {
      if(state==='PROCESSING'&&!file) throw new Error('UNCERTAIN_PROCESSING');
      if(state==='RESERVED'&&file) throw new Error('UNEXPECTED_EXISTING_FILE');
      if(!file) {
        const expires=u.lease_expires_at instanceof Date ?
          u.lease_expires_at.getTime():Date.parse(String(u.lease_expires_at));
        if(!Number.isFinite(expires)||expires<=Date.now())
          throw new Error('LEASE_EXPIRED');
      }
      if(state==='RESERVED') {
        fixture515Set_(us,u._row,'upload_status','PROCESSING');
        fixture515Set_(us,u._row,'started_at',new Date().toISOString());
        SpreadsheetApp.flush();
      }
      if(!file) {
        const blob=Utilities.newBlob(bytes,'image/jpeg',filename);
        file=x.qf.createFile(blob);
      }
    }
    if(file.getMimeType()!=='image/jpeg'||Number(file.getSize())!==bytes.length||
       !fixture515HasParent_(file,String(x.qr.drive_folder_id)))
      throw new Error('FILE_VERIFICATION_FAILED');
    // On retry, do not silently accept different JPEG bytes of equal length.
    // A Drive file already exists: compare exact bytes (test fixture <=8MiB).
    const existing=file.getBlob().getBytes();
    if(existing.length!==bytes.length || existing.some((b,i)=>b!==bytes[i]))
      throw new Error('IDEMPOTENCY_CONTENT_CONFLICT');
    if(state!=='COMPLETED') {
      fixture515Set_(us,u._row,'drive_file_id',file.getId());
      fixture515Set_(us,u._row,'drive_file_name',filename);
      fixture515Set_(us,u._row,'completed_at',new Date().toISOString());
      fixture515Set_(us,u._row,'updated_at',new Date().toISOString());
      fixture515Set_(us,u._row,'upload_status','COMPLETED');
      SpreadsheetApp.flush();
    }
    const completed=fixture515Table_(us).filter(a=>
      String(a.event_id)===target.event_id &&
      String(a.qr_id)===String(x.qr.qr_id) &&
      String(a.cycle_id)===String(x.cycle.cycle_id) &&
      String(a.upload_status)==='COMPLETED').length; // Deleted uploads still consume quota
    if(completed>x.max) throw new Error('QUOTA_OVERFLOW');
    fixture515Set_(cs,x.cycle._row,'successful_uploads',completed);
    SpreadsheetApp.flush();
    return {status:'SUCCESS',code:'UPLOAD_COMPLETED',data:{upload_status:'COMPLETED'}};
  } catch(_) {
    // Deliberately do not expose details, IDs, QR tokens, filenames or stack traces.
    return {status:'ERROR',code:'RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED'};
  } finally {lock.releaseLock();}
}


function testProductionTransactionBatch525_() {
  const p=PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  const gates=['PRODUCTION_TRANSACTION_525_ENABLED','PHONE_TEST_521_ENABLED',
    'PUBLIC_UPLOAD_514_ENABLED','PUBLIC_UPLOAD_515_FIXTURE_ONLY'];
  gates.forEach(k=>{if(p.getProperty(k)==='true')throw new Error('GATE_MUST_BE_OFF');});
  const hold=handleProductionTransaction525_('not json');
  if(hold.code!=='PRODUCTION_TRANSACTION_HOLD')throw new Error('GATE_FAILED');
  const ss=SpreadsheetApp.openById(p.getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID'));
  ['EVENTS','QR_SLOTS','QUOTA_CYCLES','UPLOADS'].forEach(n=>{
    const sh=ss.getSheetByName(n);
    if(!sh)throw new Error('REQUIRED_SHEET_MISSING');
    fixture515Table_(sh);
  });
  if(resolveProductionQr523_('invalid').code!=='INVALID_QR')
    throw new Error('INVALID_QR_NOT_REJECTED');
  if(handlePublicJpeg514_('{"action":"upload_jpeg"}').code!=='PUBLIC_TRANSACTION_NOT_READY')
    throw new Error('PUBLIC_ROUTER_NOT_LOCKED');
  Logger.log('BATCH_525_PRODUCTION_ENGINE_INSTALLED');
  Logger.log('BATCH_525_GATE_AND_DATABASE_PASSED');
  Logger.log('BATCH_525_PUBLIC_WRITES_BLOCKED');
  Logger.log('BATCH_525_NO_LIVE_WRITES');
  return {status:'SUCCESS',code:'BATCH_525_GUARDED',liveWrites:false};
}


/* =============================================================
 BATCH 5.26 — PRODUCTION READINESS AUDIT (READ ONLY)
 This is a targeted production integrity audit, not another mock upload.
 Never logs QR tokens, internal IDs or image bytes. Never writes data.
 ============================================================= */
function auditProductionReadiness526_() {
  const p=PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  const off=['PHONE_TEST_521_ENABLED','PUBLIC_UPLOAD_514_ENABLED',
    'PUBLIC_UPLOAD_515_FIXTURE_ONLY','PRODUCTION_UPLOAD_524_ENABLED',
    'PRODUCTION_TRANSACTION_525_ENABLED'];
  const enabled=off.filter(k=>p.getProperty(k)==='true');
  if(enabled.length) return {status:'HOLD',code:'UPLOAD_GATE_ENABLED',enabled_gate_count:enabled.length};
  const ss=SpreadsheetApp.openById(p.getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID'));
  const names=['EVENTS','QR_SLOTS','QUOTA_CYCLES','UPLOADS'];
  const tables={};
  names.forEach(n=>{
    const sh=ss.getSheetByName(n);
    if(!sh)throw new Error('MISSING_SHEET');
    tables[n]=fixture515Table_(sh);
  });
  const eventIds=new Set(tables.EVENTS.map(x=>String(x.event_id)));
  const qrIds=new Set(tables.QR_SLOTS.map(x=>String(x.qr_id)));
  const cycles=new Set(tables.QUOTA_CYCLES.map(x=>String(x.cycle_id)));
  const duplicate=(rows,key)=>{
    const seen=new Set();let n=0;
    rows.forEach(r=>{const k=String(r[key]);if(!k||seen.has(k))n++;seen.add(k);});
    return n;
  };
  const problems={
    duplicate_events:duplicate(tables.EVENTS,'event_id'),
    duplicate_qrs:duplicate(tables.QR_SLOTS,'qr_id'),
    duplicate_cycles:duplicate(tables.QUOTA_CYCLES,'cycle_id'),
    duplicate_upload_ids:duplicate(tables.UPLOADS,'upload_id'),
    orphan_qrs:tables.QR_SLOTS.filter(r=>!eventIds.has(String(r.event_id))).length,
    orphan_cycles:tables.QUOTA_CYCLES.filter(r=>!eventIds.has(String(r.event_id))||!qrIds.has(String(r.qr_id))).length,
    orphan_uploads:tables.UPLOADS.filter(r=>!eventIds.has(String(r.event_id))||!qrIds.has(String(r.qr_id))||!cycles.has(String(r.cycle_id))).length
  };
  const activeCycles=tables.QUOTA_CYCLES.filter(r=>String(r.cycle_status)==='ACTIVE');
  let quotaMismatch=0, pending=0, duplicateKeys=0;
  const seenKeys=new Set();
  tables.UPLOADS.forEach(r=>{
    const k=String(r.event_id)+'|'+String(r.idempotency_key);
    if(seenKeys.has(k))duplicateKeys++;
    seenKeys.add(k);
    if(['RESERVED','PROCESSING'].includes(String(r.upload_status)))pending++;
  });
  activeCycles.forEach(c=>{
    const count=tables.UPLOADS.filter(u=>String(u.cycle_id)===String(c.cycle_id)&&
      String(u.upload_status)==='COMPLETED').length; // Deleted uploads still consume quota
    if(Number(c.successful_uploads)!==count||count>Number(c.max_uploads))quotaMismatch++;
  });
  problems.duplicate_idempotency_keys=duplicateKeys;
  problems.active_cycle_quota_mismatches=quotaMismatch;
  const issues=Object.values(problems).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);
  return {status:issues?'HOLD':'SUCCESS',code:issues?'DATA_INTEGRITY_REVIEW':'AUDIT_COMPLETE',
    event_count:tables.EVENTS.length,qr_count:tables.QR_SLOTS.length,
    active_cycle_count:activeCycles.length,upload_count:tables.UPLOADS.length,
    pending_upload_count:pending,issues:problems,
    production_ready:false,live_writes:false};
}
function testProductionIntegrityBatch526_() {
  const p=PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  if(p.getProperty('PRODUCTION_UPLOAD_524_ENABLED')==='true')
    throw new Error('LEGACY_GATE_MUST_BE_OFF');
  if(handlePublicJpeg514_('{"action":"upload_jpeg"}').code!=='PUBLIC_TRANSACTION_NOT_READY')
    throw new Error('PUBLIC_ROUTER_NOT_LOCKED');
  const result=auditProductionReadiness526_();
  Logger.log('BATCH_526_INTEGRITY_AUDIT '+JSON.stringify(result));
  Logger.log('BATCH_526_LEGACY_PRODUCTION_ROUTE_DISABLED');
  Logger.log('BATCH_526_NO_LIVE_WRITES');
  return result;
}


/* =============================================================
 BATCH 5.27 — PERMANENT QUOTA ACCOUNTING REGRESSION GUARD
 Production quota is consumed by ALL COMPLETED uploads, including
 subsequently deleted images. Never automatically refund on deletion.
 No public routes, transaction gates or live writes are enabled.
 ============================================================= */
function countCompletedUploadsForCycle527_(uploads,cycleId) {
  if(!Array.isArray(uploads)) throw new Error('UPLOADS_NOT_ARRAY');
  return uploads.filter(function(u) {
    return String(u.cycle_id)===String(cycleId) &&
      String(u.upload_status)==='COMPLETED';
  }).length;
}
function testPermanentQuotaBatch527_() {
  const props=PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  const gates=['PHONE_TEST_521_ENABLED','PUBLIC_UPLOAD_514_ENABLED',
    'PUBLIC_UPLOAD_515_FIXTURE_ONLY','PRODUCTION_UPLOAD_524_ENABLED',
    'PRODUCTION_TRANSACTION_525_ENABLED'];
  if(gates.some(function(k){return props.getProperty(k)==='true';}))
    throw new Error('UPLOAD_GATE_MUST_BE_OFF');
  const fixtures=[
    {cycle_id:'C1',upload_status:'COMPLETED',deletion_status:'ACTIVE'},
    {cycle_id:'C1',upload_status:'COMPLETED',deletion_status:'DELETED'},
    {cycle_id:'C1',upload_status:'COMPLETED',deletion_status:'SOFT_DELETED'},
    {cycle_id:'C1',upload_status:'RESERVED',deletion_status:'ACTIVE'},
    {cycle_id:'C1',upload_status:'PROCESSING',deletion_status:'ACTIVE'},
    {cycle_id:'C2',upload_status:'COMPLETED',deletion_status:'ACTIVE'}
  ];
  if(countCompletedUploadsForCycle527_(fixtures,'C1')!==3)
    throw new Error('DELETED_UPLOAD_QUOTA_REGRESSION');
  if(countCompletedUploadsForCycle527_(fixtures,'C2')!==1)
    throw new Error('CYCLE_ISOLATION_REGRESSION');
  if(countCompletedUploadsForCycle527_(fixtures,'MISSING')!==0)
    throw new Error('EMPTY_CYCLE_REGRESSION');
  const audit=auditProductionReadiness526_();
  if(audit.status!=='SUCCESS'||audit.code!=='AUDIT_COMPLETE')
    throw new Error('DATABASE_INTEGRITY_HOLD');
  if(handlePublicJpeg514_('{"action":"upload_jpeg"}').code!==
     'PUBLIC_TRANSACTION_NOT_READY')
    throw new Error('PUBLIC_ROUTER_NOT_LOCKED');
  Logger.log('BATCH_527_DELETED_UPLOADS_STILL_COUNT_PASSED');
  Logger.log('BATCH_527_CYCLE_ISOLATION_PASSED');
  Logger.log('BATCH_527_DATABASE_AUDIT_PASSED');
  Logger.log('BATCH_527_PUBLIC_UPLOAD_DISABLED');
  Logger.log('BATCH_527_NO_LIVE_WRITES');
  return {status:'SUCCESS',code:'BATCH_527_QUOTA_REGRESSION_PASSED',
    liveWrites:false,productionReady:false};
}

}
