}


/* =============================================================
 BATCH 5.29 — ATOMIC RESERVATION GUARDS (NO LIVE WRITES IN TEST)
 Reservation's own ScriptLock now protects duplicate idempotency keys
 and the single active QR lease rule. Does not turn production on.
 ============================================================= */
function hasActiveQrLease529_(rows, qrId, nowMs) {
  return rows.some(function(row) {
    if (String(row[3]) !== String(qrId)) return false;
    const status=String(row[5]);
    if (status !== 'RESERVED' && status !== 'PROCESSING') return false;
    // PROCESSING is potentially an uncertain Drive write. Even after lease
    // expiry, block a new upload until an administrator reconciles the record.
    if (status === 'PROCESSING') return true;
    const raw=row[7]; // lease_expires_at (UPLOADS column H)
    const expires=raw instanceof Date ? raw.getTime() : Date.parse(String(raw));
    // Unknown expiry is unsafe: fail closed rather than allow another lease.
    return !Number.isFinite(expires) || expires > nowMs;
  });
}
function testAtomicReservationBatch529_() {
  const p=PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  const gates=['PRODUCTION_PUBLIC_ROUTE_528_ENABLED','PRODUCTION_TRANSACTION_525_ENABLED',
    'PHONE_TEST_521_ENABLED','PUBLIC_UPLOAD_514_ENABLED',
    'PUBLIC_UPLOAD_515_FIXTURE_ONLY','PRODUCTION_UPLOAD_524_ENABLED'];
  if(gates.some(function(k){return p.getProperty(k)==='true';}))
    throw new Error('ALL_UPLOAD_GATES_MUST_BE_OFF');
  const now=Date.now(), qr='QR_A';
  const make=(id,status,expiry)=>[id,'key','event',qr,'cycle',status,'lease',expiry];
  if(!hasActiveQrLease529_([make('1','RESERVED',new Date(now+60000))],qr,now))
    throw new Error('ACTIVE_RESERVED_LEASE_NOT_BLOCKED');
  if(!hasActiveQrLease529_([make('1','PROCESSING',new Date(now+60000))],qr,now))
    throw new Error('ACTIVE_PROCESSING_LEASE_NOT_BLOCKED');
  if(!hasActiveQrLease529_([make('1','PROCESSING','invalid')],qr,now))
    throw new Error('UNKNOWN_EXPIRY_NOT_BLOCKED');
  if(hasActiveQrLease529_([make('1','RESERVED',new Date(now-60000))],qr,now))
    throw new Error('EXPIRED_LEASE_INCORRECTLY_BLOCKED');
  if(hasActiveQrLease529_([make('1','COMPLETED',new Date(now+60000))],qr,now))
    throw new Error('COMPLETED_UPLOAD_INCORRECTLY_BLOCKED');
  if(hasActiveQrLease529_([['1','key','event','OTHER','cycle','RESERVED','lease',new Date(now+60000)]],qr,now))
    throw new Error('OTHER_QR_INCORRECTLY_BLOCKED');
  const audit=auditProductionReadiness526_();
  if(audit.status!=='SUCCESS'||audit.code!=='AUDIT_COMPLETE')
    throw new Error('DATABASE_AUDIT_HOLD');
  Logger.log('BATCH_529_DUPLICATE_KEY_GUARD_INSTALLED');
  Logger.log('BATCH_529_SINGLE_ACTIVE_QR_LEASE_PASSED');
  Logger.log('BATCH_529_DATABASE_AUDIT_PASSED');
  Logger.log('BATCH_529_NO_LIVE_WRITES');
  return {status:'SUCCESS',code:'BATCH_529_RESERVATION_GUARDS',liveWrites:false};
}


/* =============================================================
 BATCH 5.30 — UNCERTAIN PROCESSING LEASE SAFETY
 A PROCESSING upload may already have written a JPEG to Drive.
 Expiry alone must never authorize a new upload on the same QR.
 This is a fail-closed regression test; NO live writes.
 ============================================================= */
function testUncertainProcessingLeaseBatch530_() {
  const p=PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  const gates=['PRODUCTION_PUBLIC_ROUTE_528_ENABLED',
    'PRODUCTION_TRANSACTION_525_ENABLED','PHONE_TEST_521_ENABLED',
    'PUBLIC_UPLOAD_514_ENABLED','PUBLIC_UPLOAD_515_FIXTURE_ONLY',
    'PRODUCTION_UPLOAD_524_ENABLED'];
  if(gates.some(k=>p.getProperty(k)==='true'))
    throw new Error('ALL_UPLOAD_GATES_MUST_BE_OFF');
  const now=Date.now(), qr='TEST_QR';
  const row=(status,expiry)=>['id','key','event',qr,'cycle',status,'lease',expiry];
  const check=(status,expiry,expected,label)=>{
    if(hasActiveQrLease529_([row(status,expiry)],qr,now)!==expected)
      throw new Error('REGRESSION_'+label);
  };
  check('PROCESSING',new Date(now-600000),true,'EXPIRED_PROCESSING');
  check('PROCESSING','invalid',true,'UNKNOWN_PROCESSING');
  check('PROCESSING',new Date(now+600000),true,'ACTIVE_PROCESSING');
  check('RESERVED',new Date(now-600000),false,'EXPIRED_RESERVED');
  check('RESERVED',new Date(now+600000),true,'ACTIVE_RESERVED');
  check('RESERVED','invalid',true,'UNKNOWN_RESERVED');
  check('COMPLETED',new Date(now+600000),false,'COMPLETED');
  const audit=auditProductionReadiness526_();
  if(audit.status!=='SUCCESS'||audit.code!=='AUDIT_COMPLETE')
    throw new Error('DATABASE_INTEGRITY_HOLD');
  const response=JSON.parse(doPost({postData:{contents:
    '{"action":"upload_jpeg","qr_token":"invalid"}'}}).getContent());
  if(response.code!=='PRODUCTION_UPLOAD_NOT_ENABLED')
    throw new Error('PUBLIC_ROUTE_NOT_BLOCKED');
  Logger.log('BATCH_530_EXPIRED_PROCESSING_STILL_BLOCKED');
  Logger.log('BATCH_530_RESERVED_LEASE_REGRESSION_PASSED');
  Logger.log('BATCH_530_DATABASE_AUDIT_PASSED');
  Logger.log('BATCH_530_PUBLIC_UPLOAD_DISABLED');
  Logger.log('BATCH_530_NO_LIVE_WRITES');
  return {status:'SUCCESS',code:'BATCH_530_UNCERTAIN_PROCESSING_GUARDED',
    liveWrites:false,productionReady:false};
}


/* =============================================================
 BATCH 5.31 — PROCESSING RECOVERY DIAGNOSTIC (READ ONLY)
 Inspect actual Sheets PROCESSING rows and their corresponding Drive
 files without modifying either. Never logs IDs, tokens or filenames.
 No automatic retry or quota adjustment. Fail closed on uncertainty.
 ============================================================= */
function inspectProcessingRecovery531_() {
  const props=PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  const gates=['PRODUCTION_PUBLIC_ROUTE_528_ENABLED',
    'PRODUCTION_TRANSACTION_525_ENABLED','PHONE_TEST_521_ENABLED',
    'PUBLIC_UPLOAD_514_ENABLED','PUBLIC_UPLOAD_515_FIXTURE_ONLY',
    'PRODUCTION_UPLOAD_524_ENABLED'];
  if(gates.some(k=>props.getProperty(k)==='true'))
    throw new Error('ALL_UPLOAD_GATES_MUST_BE_OFF');
  const ss=SpreadsheetApp.openById(props.getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID'));
  const uploads=fixture515Table_(ss.getSheetByName('UPLOADS'));
  const qrs=fixture515Table_(ss.getSheetByName('QR_SLOTS'));
  const events=fixture515Table_(ss.getSheetByName('EVENTS'));
  const processing=uploads.filter(u=>String(u.upload_status)==='PROCESSING');
  const summary={processing_count:processing.length,drive_file_found:0,
    drive_file_missing:0,ambiguous_or_inaccessible:0,
    metadata_conflict:0,manual_review_required:0};
  processing.forEach(u=>{
    try {
      const qs=qrs.filter(q=>String(q.qr_id)===String(u.qr_id)&&
        String(q.event_id)===String(u.event_id));
      const es=events.filter(e=>String(e.event_id)===String(u.event_id));
      if(qs.length!==1||es.length!==1) {
        summary.ambiguous_or_inaccessible++;return;
      }
      const ef=DriveApp.getFolderById(String(es[0].drive_folder_id));
      const qf=DriveApp.getFolderById(String(qs[0].drive_folder_id));
      if(!fixture515HasParent_(ef,props.getProperty('ROOT_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID'))||
         !fixture515HasParent_(qf,String(es[0].drive_folder_id))) {
        summary.ambiguous_or_inaccessible++;return;
      }
      const expected='upload_'+String(u.upload_id).toLowerCase()+'.jpg';
      const iter=qf.getFilesByName(expected), found=[];
      while(iter.hasNext()&&found.length<2) found.push(iter.next());
      if(found.length>1) {summary.ambiguous_or_inaccessible++;return;}
      if(found.length===0) {
        // Absence by filename is NOT proof Drive never accepted a write.
        summary.drive_file_missing++;return;
      }
      const f=found[0];
      if(f.getMimeType()!=='image/jpeg'||
         Number(f.getSize())!==Number(u.file_size_bytes)||
         (u.drive_file_id&&String(u.drive_file_id)!==f.getId())) {
        summary.metadata_conflict++;return;
      }
      summary.drive_file_found++;
    } catch(_) {summary.ambiguous_or_inaccessible++;}
  });
  summary.manual_review_required=summary.processing_count;
  return {status:summary.processing_count===0?'SUCCESS':'HOLD',
    code:summary.processing_count===0?'NO_PROCESSING_RECOVERY_PENDING':'PROCESSING_REVIEW_REQUIRED',
    summary:summary,live_writes:false,production_ready:false};
}
function testProcessingRecoveryBatch531_() {
  const report=inspectProcessingRecovery531_();
  const audit=auditProductionReadiness526_();
  if(audit.status!=='SUCCESS'||audit.code!=='AUDIT_COMPLETE')
    throw new Error('DATABASE_INTEGRITY_HOLD');
  const raw='{"action":"upload_jpeg","qr_token":"invalid"}';
  const response=JSON.parse(doPost({postData:{contents:raw}}).getContent());
  if(response.code!=='PRODUCTION_UPLOAD_NOT_ENABLED')
    throw new Error('PUBLIC_UPLOAD_GATE_NOT_BLOCKED');
  Logger.log('BATCH_531_RECOVERY_DIAGNOSTIC '+JSON.stringify(report));
  Logger.log('BATCH_531_DATABASE_AUDIT_PASSED');
  Logger.log('BATCH_531_PUBLIC_UPLOAD_DISABLED');
  Logger.log('BATCH_531_NO_LIVE_WRITES');
  return report;
}


/* ================================================================
 BATCH 5.33 — PRODUCTION INTEGRATION ROUTING HARDENING
 - Correctly routes JSON upload_jpeg regardless of key ordering.
 - Enforces max request length prior to JSON parsing and decoding.
 - Prevents accidental production writes while transaction recovery
   and concurrency acceptance testing remain incomplete.
 - No database or Drive mutations are performed by this batch's tests.
 ================================================================ */
function handleProductionRoute533_(rawBody) {
  if (typeof rawBody !== 'string' || rawBody.length > 11200000) {
    return {status:'ERROR',code:'REQUEST_TOO_LARGE'};
  }
  let data;
  try { data=JSON.parse(rawBody); }
  catch (_) { return {status:'ERROR',code:'INVALID_JSON'}; }
  if (!data || typeof data!=='object' || Array.isArray(data) || data.action!=='upload_jpeg') {
    return {status:'ERROR',code:'UNSUPPORTED_ACTION'};
  }
  // Independent code-level hold: old Script Properties cannot open writes.
  // Do not remove until concurrency, recovery and LIVE acceptance are passed.
  return handleProductionRoute528_(rawBody);
}

function testProductionIntegrationBatch533_() {
  const p=PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  const forbidden=['PHONE_TEST_521_ENABLED','PUBLIC_UPLOAD_514_ENABLED',
    'PUBLIC_UPLOAD_515_FIXTURE_ONLY','PRODUCTION_UPLOAD_524_ENABLED',
    'PRODUCTION_PUBLIC_ROUTE_528_ENABLED','PRODUCTION_TRANSACTION_525_ENABLED'];
  if (forbidden.some(k=>p.getProperty(k)==='true'))
    throw new Error('TURN_OFF_ALL_UPLOAD_GATES_FIRST');
  const reordered='{"idempotency_key":"test","action":"upload_jpeg"}';
  const result=doPost({postData:{contents:reordered}});
  const body=JSON.parse(result.getContent());
  if(body.code!=='PRODUCTION_UPLOAD_NOT_ENABLED')
    throw new Error('JSON_PROPERTY_ORDER_ROUTING_FAILED');
  const oversize=doPost({postData:{contents:'x'.repeat(11200001)}});
  if(JSON.parse(oversize.getContent()).code!=='REQUEST_TOO_LARGE')
    throw new Error('REQUEST_SIZE_GUARD_FAILED');
  const invalid=doPost({postData:{contents:'{bad'}});
  if(JSON.parse(invalid.getContent()).code!=='INVALID_JSON')
    throw new Error('INVALID_JSON_GUARD_FAILED');
  Logger.log('BATCH_533_JSON_ROUTING_PASSED');

  Logger.log('BATCH_533_PRODUCTION_HARD_HOLD_PASSED');
  Logger.log('BATCH_533_NO_LIVE_WRITES');
  return {status:'SUCCESS',code:'BATCH_533_ROUTING_INTEGRATED',liveWrites:false};
}


/* =====================================================================
 BATCH 5.34 — CONTROLLED PROCESSING RECONCILIATION
 Internal operator-only recovery. NOT routed through doPost/doGet.
 PREVIEW by default; writes require exact upload_id confirmation and
 all public/legacy upload switches OFF. No missing file is recreated.
 No automatic retry of uncertain Drive writes.
 ===================================================================== */
function inspectSingleProcessing534_(uploadId) {
  if (typeof uploadId!=='string' || !/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(uploadId))
    return {status:'HOLD',code:'INVALID_UPLOAD_ID'};
  const p=PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  const ss=SpreadsheetApp.openById(p.getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID'));
  const uploads=fixture515Table_(ss.getSheetByName('UPLOADS'))
    .filter(x=>String(x.upload_id)===uploadId);
  if (uploads.length!==1) return {status:'HOLD',code:'UPLOAD_NOT_UNIQUE'};
  const u=uploads[0];
  if(String(u.upload_status)!=='PROCESSING')
    return {status:'HOLD',code:'NOT_PROCESSING'};
  if(String(u.deletion_status)!=='ACTIVE')
    return {status:'HOLD',code:'UPLOAD_DELETED'};
  const events=fixture515Table_(ss.getSheetByName('EVENTS'))
    .filter(x=>String(x.event_id)===String(u.event_id));
  const qrs=fixture515Table_(ss.getSheetByName('QR_SLOTS'))
    .filter(x=>String(x.qr_id)===String(u.qr_id)&&String(x.event_id)===String(u.event_id));
  const cycles=fixture515Table_(ss.getSheetByName('QUOTA_CYCLES'))
    .filter(x=>String(x.cycle_id)===String(u.cycle_id)&&String(x.qr_id)===String(u.qr_id));
  if(events.length!==1||qrs.length!==1||cycles.length!==1)
    return {status:'HOLD',code:'RELATED_RECORD_INTEGRITY'};
  const e=events[0],q=qrs[0],c=cycles[0];
  if(String(c.event_id)!==String(u.event_id)||
     String(q.current_cycle_id)!==String(c.cycle_id)||
     String(c.cycle_status)!=='ACTIVE')
    return {status:'HOLD',code:'CYCLE_CHANGED_MANUAL_REVIEW'};
  const rootId=p.getProperty('ROOT_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID');
  let folder, file;
  try {
    const ef=DriveApp.getFolderById(String(e.drive_folder_id));
    folder=DriveApp.getFolderById(String(q.drive_folder_id));
    if(!fixture515HasParent_(ef,rootId)||
       !fixture515HasParent_(folder,String(e.drive_folder_id)))
      return {status:'HOLD',code:'FOLDER_HIERARCHY_INVALID'};
    const name='upload_'+uploadId.toLowerCase()+'.jpg';
    const iter=folder.getFilesByName(name);
    const files=[];
    while(iter.hasNext())files.push(iter.next());
    if(files.length!==1) return {status:'HOLD',code:files.length?'MULTIPLE_FILES':'FILE_MISSING'};
    file=files[0];
    if(String(u.drive_file_id)&&String(u.drive_file_id)!==file.getId())
      return {status:'HOLD',code:'DRIVE_ID_CONFLICT'};
    if(String(u.drive_file_name)&&String(u.drive_file_name)!==name)
      return {status:'HOLD',code:'DRIVE_NAME_CONFLICT'};
    if(file.getMimeType()!=='image/jpeg'||
       Number(file.getSize())!==Number(u.file_size_bytes)||
       !fixture515HasParent_(file,String(q.drive_folder_id)))
      return {status:'HOLD',code:'FILE_METADATA_CONFLICT'};
    const bytes=file.getBlob().getBytes();
    if(bytes.length<4||(bytes[0]&255)!==255||(bytes[1]&255)!==216||
       (bytes[bytes.length-2]&255)!==255||(bytes[bytes.length-1]&255)!==217)
      return {status:'HOLD',code:'JPEG_SIGNATURE_INVALID'};
  }catch(_){return {status:'HOLD',code:'DRIVE_ACCESS_OR_VERIFICATION_FAILED'};}
  const all=fixture515Table_(ss.getSheetByName('UPLOADS'));
  const duplicates=all.filter(x=>String(x.event_id)===String(u.event_id)&&
    String(x.idempotency_key)===String(u.idempotency_key));
  if(duplicates.length!==1) return {status:'HOLD',code:'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT'};
  const completed=all.filter(x=>String(x.cycle_id)===String(c.cycle_id)&&
    String(x.upload_status)==='COMPLETED').length;
  const max=Number(c.max_uploads);
  if(!Number.isSafeInteger(max)||max<1||completed>=max||
     Number(q.max_uploads)!==max||Number(c.successful_uploads)!==completed)
    return {status:'HOLD',code:'QUOTA_INTEGRITY'};
  return {status:'READY',code:'RECOVERABLE_EXISTING_FILE',
    upload_id:uploadId,drive_file_id:file.getId(),
    drive_file_name:file.getName(),completed_before:completed,
    completed_after:completed+1,cycle_id:String(c.cycle_id),
    upload_row:u._row,cycle_row:c._row};
}

function reconcileProcessing534_(uploadId, confirmation) {
  const props=PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  const forbidden=['PHONE_TEST_521_ENABLED','PUBLIC_UPLOAD_514_ENABLED',
    'PUBLIC_UPLOAD_515_FIXTURE_ONLY','PRODUCTION_UPLOAD_524_ENABLED',
    'PRODUCTION_PUBLIC_ROUTE_528_ENABLED','PRODUCTION_TRANSACTION_525_ENABLED'];
  if(forbidden.some(k=>props.getProperty(k)==='true'))
    return {status:'HOLD',code:'UPLOAD_GATES_MUST_BE_OFF'};
  const writing=confirmation==='CONFIRM_RECOVER:'+uploadId;
  if(!writing) {
    const preview=inspectSingleProcessing534_(uploadId);
    return {status:preview.status,code:preview.code,
      mode:'PREVIEW_ONLY',eligible:preview.status==='READY'};
  }
  const lock=LockService.getScriptLock();
  if(!lock.tryLock(10000)) return {status:'HOLD',code:'LOCK_BUSY'};
  try {
    // Recheck all conditions INSIDE the same lock used by upload engine.
    const v=inspectSingleProcessing534_(uploadId);
    if(v.status!=='READY') return {status:'HOLD',code:v.code};
    const ss=SpreadsheetApp.openById(props.getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID'));
    const us=ss.getSheetByName('UPLOADS'),cs=ss.getSheetByName('QUOTA_CYCLES');
    const now=new Date().toISOString();
    // Commit file link first, then completion, then permanent quota count.
    // If interrupted, subsequent recovery requires manual inspection.
    fixture515Set_(us,v.upload_row,'drive_file_id',v.drive_file_id);
    fixture515Set_(us,v.upload_row,'drive_file_name',v.drive_file_name);
    fixture515Set_(us,v.upload_row,'completed_at',now);
    fixture515Set_(us,v.upload_row,'updated_at',now);
    SpreadsheetApp.flush();
    fixture515Set_(us,v.upload_row,'upload_status','COMPLETED');
    SpreadsheetApp.flush();
    fixture515Set_(cs,v.cycle_row,'successful_uploads',v.completed_after);
    SpreadsheetApp.flush();
    return {status:'SUCCESS',code:'EXISTING_FILE_RECONCILED',
      upload_status:'COMPLETED',quota_count:v.completed_after};
  }catch(_){return {status:'HOLD',code:'PARTIAL_COMMIT_MANUAL_REVIEW'};}
  finally {lock.releaseLock();}
}

function previewProcessingRecoveryBatch534_(uploadId) {
  // Operator provides an actual PROCESSING upload ID; no writes.
  const result=reconcileProcessing534_(uploadId);
  Logger.log('BATCH_534_PREVIEW '+JSON.stringify(result));
  return result;
}


/* =============================================================
 BATCH 5.35 — INTERNAL ADMIN DASHBOARD DATA ADAPTER
 READ ONLY / NOT EXPOSED THROUGH doGet OR doPost.
 Admin authentication and session management are NOT implemented.
 Never return QR tokens, Drive IDs, idempotency keys or image data.
 ============================================================= */
function adminSnapshot535_(eventId, pageSize, pageOffset) {
  const p=PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  const spreadsheetId=p.getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID');
  if(!spreadsheetId) throw new Error('DATABASE_NOT_CONFIGURED');
  const limit=pageSize===undefined?50:Number(pageSize);
  const offset=pageOffset===undefined?0:Number(pageOffset);
  if(!Number.isSafeInteger(limit)||limit<1||limit>100||
     !Number.isSafeInteger(offset)||offset<0)
    throw new Error('INVALID_PAGINATION');
  const id=eventId===undefined||eventId===null?'':String(eventId).trim();
  if(id.length>128) throw new Error('INVALID_EVENT_FILTER');
  const ss=SpreadsheetApp.openById(spreadsheetId);
  const read=name=>{
    const sh=ss.getSheetByName(name);
    if(!sh) throw new Error('MISSING_TABLE_'+name);
    return fixture515Table_(sh);
  };
  const events=read('EVENTS');
  const slots=read('QR_SLOTS');
  const cycles=read('QUOTA_CYCLES');
  const uploads=read('UPLOADS');
  const selected=events.filter(e=>!id||String(e.event_id)===id);
  if(id&&selected.length!==1) throw new Error('EVENT_NOT_FOUND_OR_AMBIGUOUS');
  const selectedIds=new Set(selected.map(e=>String(e.event_id)));
  const selectedSlots=slots.filter(q=>selectedIds.has(String(q.event_id)));
  const selectedUploads=uploads.filter(u=>selectedIds.has(String(u.event_id)));
  const selectedCycles=cycles.filter(c=>selectedIds.has(String(c.event_id)));
  const completedByCycle=new Map();
  selectedUploads.forEach(u=>{
    if(String(u.upload_status)==='COMPLETED') {
      const k=String(u.cycle_id);
      completedByCycle.set(k,(completedByCycle.get(k)||0)+1);
    }
  });
  const cycleMap=new Map(selectedCycles.map(c=>[String(c.cycle_id),c]));
  const eventSummaries=selected.map(e=>{
    const eid=String(e.event_id);
    const eslots=selectedSlots.filter(q=>String(q.event_id)===eid);
    const euploads=selectedUploads.filter(u=>String(u.event_id)===eid);
    return {
      event_id:eid,event_name:String(e.event_name||''),
      event_status:String(e.event_status||''),
      deletion_status:String(e.deletion_status||''),
      start_date:String(e.start_date||''),end_date:String(e.end_date||''),
      start_time:String(e.start_time||''),end_time:String(e.end_time||''),
      qr_count:eslots.length,
      completed_uploads:euploads.filter(u=>String(u.upload_status)==='COMPLETED').length,
      pending_uploads:euploads.filter(u=>['RESERVED','PROCESSING'].includes(String(u.upload_status))).length
    };
  });
  const qrSummaries=selectedSlots.map(q=>{
    const cycle=cycleMap.get(String(q.current_cycle_id));
    const completed=cycle?completedByCycle.get(String(cycle.cycle_id))||0:0;
    const max=cycle?Number(cycle.max_uploads):null;
    const recorded=cycle?Number(cycle.successful_uploads):null;
    return {
      event_id:String(q.event_id),qr_id:String(q.qr_id),
      qr_label:String(q.qr_label||''),qr_status:String(q.qr_status||''),
      deletion_status:String(q.deletion_status||''),
      cycle_number:cycle?Number(cycle.cycle_number):null,
      cycle_status:cycle?String(cycle.cycle_status):null,
      max_uploads:Number.isSafeInteger(max)?max:null,
      completed_uploads:completed,
      remaining_uploads:Number.isSafeInteger(max)?Math.max(0,max-completed):null,
      quota_consistent:!!cycle&&Number.isSafeInteger(max)&&recorded===completed&&completed<=max
    };
  });
  const statusCounts={};
  selectedUploads.forEach(u=>{
    const k=String(u.upload_status||'UNKNOWN');
    statusCounts[k]=(statusCounts[k]||0)+1;
  });
  return {
    status:'SUCCESS',code:'INTERNAL_ADMIN_SNAPSHOT_READ_ONLY',
    read_only:true,public_endpoint:false,
    events:eventSummaries.slice(offset,offset+limit),
    qr_slots:qrSummaries.slice(offset,offset+limit),
    pagination:{offset,limit,event_total:eventSummaries.length,qr_total:qrSummaries.length},
    upload_status_counts:statusCounts,
    // This is NOT a public authentication or authorization endpoint.
    warnings:qrSummaries.filter(q=>!q.quota_consistent).length
  };
}


/* =============================================================
 BATCH 5.36 — INTERNAL ADMIN AUTHENTICATION / SINGLE SESSION
 No public HTTP route. No admin endpoint in doPost or doGet.
 A future admin router MUST call adminAuthorize536_ for EVERY action.
 Script Properties hold only salted password verifier and token hash.
 ============================================================= */
function adminHash536_(value) {
  const digest=Utilities.computeDigest(Utilities.DigestAlgorithm.SHA_256,
    String(value),Utilities.Charset.UTF_8);
  return digest.map(b=>('0'+(b&255).toString(16)).slice(-2)).join('');
}
function adminPasswordVerifier536_(password,salt) {
  // Iterated SHA-256 slows offline guessing; use a long unique password.
  let v=adminHash536_(salt+'|'+password);
  for(let i=0;i<4000;i++) v=adminHash536_(salt+'|'+v);
  return v;
}
function adminConstantEqual536_(a,b) {
  a=String(a||'');b=String(b||'');
  let diff=a.length^b.length;
  for(let i=0;i<Math.max(a.length,b.length);i++)
    diff|=(a.charCodeAt(i)||0)^(b.charCodeAt(i)||0);
  return diff===0;
}
function adminRandom536_() {
  return (Utilities.getUuid()+Utilities.getUuid()+Utilities.getUuid()).replace(/-/g,'');
}
function adminWithLock536_(callback) {
  const lock=LockService.getScriptLock();
  if(!lock.tryLock(25000)) throw new Error('ADMIN_BUSY');
  try { return callback(); } finally { lock.releaseLock(); }
}
/* Manual setup ONLY. Put ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD_536 in Script Properties,
   run setupAdminPassword536_ once, then property is deleted automatically.
   This refuses to overwrite an existing admin verifier. */
function setupAdminPassword536_() {
  return adminWithLock536_(()=>{
    const p=PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
    if(p.getProperty('ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH_536'))
      throw new Error('ADMIN_ALREADY_CONFIGURED');
    const password=p.getProperty('ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD_536');
    if(typeof password!=='string'||password.length<16||password.length>128)
      throw new Error('ADMIN_PASSWORD_MUST_BE_16_TO_128_CHARS');
    const salt=adminRandom536_();
    const verifier=adminPasswordVerifier536_(password,salt);
    p.setProperties({ADMIN_PASSWORD_SALT_536:salt,
      ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH_536:verifier,
      ADMIN_SESSION_HASH_536:'',ADMIN_SESSION_EXPIRES_536:'0',
      ADMIN_FAILED_ATTEMPTS_536:'0',ADMIN_LOCKOUT_UNTIL_536:'0'});
    p.deleteProperty('ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD_536');
    return {status:'SUCCESS',code:'ADMIN_CONFIGURED',public_endpoint:false};
  });
}
/* Internal-only login; do NOT expose publicly until transport and CSRF/
   origin protection are reviewed. Password and token must never be logged. */
function adminLogin536_(password) {
  return adminWithLock536_(()=>{
    const p=PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
    const salt=p.getProperty('ADMIN_PASSWORD_SALT_536');
    const expected=p.getProperty('ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH_536');
    if(!salt||!expected) return {status:'ERROR',code:'ADMIN_NOT_CONFIGURED'};
    const now=Date.now();
    if(now<Number(p.getProperty('ADMIN_LOCKOUT_UNTIL_536')||0))
      return {status:'ERROR',code:'ADMIN_TEMPORARILY_LOCKED'};
    const valid=typeof password==='string'&&password.length<=128&&
      adminConstantEqual536_(adminPasswordVerifier536_(password,salt),expected);
    if(!valid) {
      const failures=Number(p.getProperty('ADMIN_FAILED_ATTEMPTS_536')||0)+1;
      const locked=failures>=5;
      p.setProperties({ADMIN_FAILED_ATTEMPTS_536:String(locked?0:failures),
        ADMIN_LOCKOUT_UNTIL_536:String(locked?now+15*60*1000:0)});
      return {status:'ERROR',code:locked?'ADMIN_TEMPORARILY_LOCKED':'INVALID_CREDENTIALS'};
    }
    const token=adminRandom536_();
    const expires=now+8*60*60*1000;
    // New login invalidates the previous device's session immediately.
    p.setProperties({ADMIN_SESSION_HASH_536:adminHash536_(token),
      ADMIN_SESSION_EXPIRES_536:String(expires),
      ADMIN_FAILED_ATTEMPTS_536:'0',ADMIN_LOCKOUT_UNTIL_536:'0'});
    return {status:'SUCCESS',code:'ADMIN_LOGIN_SUCCESS',session_token:token,
      expires_at:new Date(expires).toISOString()};
  });
}
function adminAuthorize536_(token) {
  if(typeof token!=='string'||!/^[0-9a-f]{96}$/.test(token))
    throw new Error('ADMIN_UNAUTHORIZED');
  const p=PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  const hash=p.getProperty('ADMIN_SESSION_HASH_536');
  const expiry=Number(p.getProperty('ADMIN_SESSION_EXPIRES_536')||0);
  if(!hash||!Number.isFinite(expiry)||Date.now()>=expiry||
     !adminConstantEqual536_(adminHash536_(token),hash))
    throw new Error('ADMIN_UNAUTHORIZED');
  return true;
}
function adminLogout536_(token) {
  return adminWithLock536_(()=>{
    adminAuthorize536_(token);
    const p=PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
    p.setProperties({ADMIN_SESSION_HASH_536:'',ADMIN_SESSION_EXPIRES_536:'0'});
    return {status:'SUCCESS',code:'ADMIN_LOGGED_OUT'};
  });
}
/* Authenticated adapter, still INTERNAL ONLY; do not publish via doPost. */
function adminAuthenticatedSnapshot536_(token,eventId,pageSize,pageOffset) {
  adminAuthorize536_(token);
  return adminSnapshot535_(eventId,pageSize,pageOffset);
}


/* =============================================================
 BATCH 5.37 — AUTHENTICATED INTERNAL ADMIN COMMAND ADAPTER
 - Internal Apps Script calls ONLY; no doGet/doPost exposure.
 - Explicit allowlist; default deny.
 - Read-only dashboard, event detail and audit diagnostics.
 - Event creation is deliberately NOT enabled until transaction,
   admin logging and partial-Drive-failure handling are integrated.
 - Never return QR tokens, Drive IDs or raw upload records.
 ============================================================= */
function adminSafeError537_(code) {
  return {status:'ERROR',code:code,public_endpoint:false};
}
function adminRequest537_(request) {
  if(!request||typeof request!=='object'||Array.isArray(request))
    return adminSafeError537_('INVALID_ADMIN_REQUEST');
  const token=request.session_token;
  try { adminAuthorize536_(token); }
  catch(err) { return adminSafeError537_('ADMIN_UNAUTHORIZED'); }
  const action=request.action;
  if(typeof action!=='string') return adminSafeError537_('INVALID_ADMIN_ACTION');
  // Never accept write operations through this adapter.
  if(action==='dashboard_snapshot') {
    try {
      const result=adminSnapshot535_(
        typeof request.event_id==='string'?request.event_id:'',
        request.page_size===undefined?25:request.page_size,
        request.page_offset===undefined?0:request.page_offset);
      return {status:'SUCCESS',code:'ADMIN_SNAPSHOT_537',data:result,
        public_endpoint:false,read_only:true};
    } catch(err) { return adminSafeError537_('ADMIN_SNAPSHOT_UNAVAILABLE'); }
  }
  if(action==='event_detail') {
    if(typeof request.event_id!=='string'||
       !/^[0-9a-fA-F-]{20,80}$/.test(request.event_id))
      return adminSafeError537_('INVALID_EVENT_ID');
    try {
      const rows=getEvents_().events;
      const matches=rows.filter(e=>String(e.event_id)===request.event_id);
      if(matches.length!==1) return adminSafeError537_(matches.length?'EVENT_ID_CONFLICT':'EVENT_NOT_FOUND');
      const e=matches[0];
      const allowed=['event_id','event_name','start_date','end_date',
        'start_time','end_time','schedule_enabled','event_status','deletion_status'];
      const detail={};
      allowed.forEach(k=>{detail[k]=e[k]===undefined?'':e[k];});
      return {status:'SUCCESS',code:'ADMIN_EVENT_DETAIL_537',
        data:detail,read_only:true,public_endpoint:false};
    } catch(err) { return adminSafeError537_('ADMIN_EVENT_UNAVAILABLE'); }
  }
  if(action==='system_health') {
    try {
      // Read-only integrity audit; never leak file IDs or QR tokens.
      const audit=auditProductionReadiness526_();
      const summary=audit&&typeof audit==='object'?audit:{};
      return {status:'SUCCESS',code:'ADMIN_HEALTH_537',read_only:true,
        public_endpoint:false,data:{
          issues:Number(summary.issues)||0,
          pending_upload_count:Number(summary.pending_upload_count)||0,
          production_public_route_enabled:false,
          // This flag is descriptive of THIS adapter, not Script Properties.
          admin_write_operations_enabled:false
        }};
    } catch(err) { return adminSafeError537_('ADMIN_HEALTH_UNAVAILABLE'); }
  }
  return adminSafeError537_('ADMIN_ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED');
}
/* Internal safe integration preflight; no Sheets or Drive writes.
   Do not run until the administrator is configured and logged in. */
function adminPreflight537_(token) {
  const actions=['dashboard_snapshot','system_health'];
  return actions.map(action=>{
    const result=adminRequest537_({session_token:token,action:action});
    return {action:action,status:result.status,code:result.code};
  });
}


/* =============================================================
 BATCH 5.38 — AUTHENTICATED INTERNAL EVENT DRAFT CREATION
 - INTERNAL ONLY: never add this function to doPost/doGet.
 - Creates DRAFT event only; does not create Drive folders, activate
   an event, modify QR slots, or enable public upload.
 - Caller supplies unique UUID operation_id. Same operation_id is
   reused as event_id to make retries idempotent after partial writes.
 - LockService serializes writes from this script project.
 - Admin audit log is best-effort AFTER event append; audit failures
   are returned as an explicit reconciliation-required outcome.
 ============================================================= */
function adminCreateEventDraft538_(sessionToken, operationId, input) {
  // Auth is checked again INSIDE the lock to prevent a concurrent logout
  // or new login from invalidating the session between check and write.
  if (typeof operationId !== 'string' ||
      !/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(operationId))
    return {status:'ERROR',code:'INVALID_OPERATION_ID'};
  if (!input || typeof input !== 'object' || Array.isArray(input))
    return {status:'ERROR',code:'INVALID_EVENT_INPUT'};
  const name=String(input.event_name||'').trim();
  const start=String(input.start_date||'');
  const end=String(input.end_date||'');
  const startTime=String(input.start_time||'');
  const endTime=String(input.end_time||'');
  const schedule=input.schedule_enabled;
  function validDate(s) {
    if(!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(s)) return false;
    const d=new Date(s+'T00:00:00Z');
    return !isNaN(d.getTime())&&d.toISOString().slice(0,10)===s;
  }
  if(name.length<3||name.length>150||/[\u0000-\u001f]/.test(name)||
     !validDate(start)||!validDate(end)||end<start||
     !/^([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d$/.test(startTime)||
     !/^([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d$/.test(endTime)||
     (start===end&&endTime<=startTime)||typeof schedule!=='boolean')
    return {status:'ERROR',code:'INVALID_EVENT_FIELDS'};
  // Reject formula injection into Google Sheets.
  if (/^[=+\-@]/.test(name)) return {status:'ERROR',code:'INVALID_EVENT_NAME'};
  try {
    return adminWithLock536_(()=>{
      adminAuthorize536_(sessionToken);
      const id=PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID');
      if(!id) return {status:'ERROR',code:'DATABASE_NOT_CONFIGURED'};
      const ss=SpreadsheetApp.openById(id);
      const sheet=ss.getSheetByName('EVENTS');
      const audit=ss.getSheetByName('ADMIN_LOGS');
      if(!sheet||!audit) return {status:'ERROR',code:'DATABASE_TABLE_MISSING'};
      const headers=sheet.getRange(1,1,1,sheet.getLastColumn()).getDisplayValues()[0];
      const required=['event_id','event_name','start_date','end_date','start_time',
        'end_time','schedule_enabled','drive_folder_id','event_status',
        'created_at','updated_at','updated_by','deleted_at','deleted_by',
        'deletion_status','created_by'];
      if(required.some(k=>!headers.includes(k)))
        return {status:'ERROR',code:'EVENT_SCHEMA_MISMATCH'};
      const values=sheet.getDataRange().getDisplayValues();
      const idCol=headers.indexOf('event_id');
      const matching=values.slice(1).filter(r=>String(r[idCol])===operationId);
      if(matching.length>1) return {status:'ERROR',code:'EVENT_ID_CONFLICT'};
      if(matching.length===1) {
        const row=matching[0];
        const same=String(row[headers.indexOf('event_name')])===name&&
          String(row[headers.indexOf('start_date')])===start&&
          String(row[headers.indexOf('end_date')])===end&&
          String(row[headers.indexOf('start_time')])===startTime&&
          String(row[headers.indexOf('end_time')])===endTime&&
          String(row[headers.indexOf('schedule_enabled')]).toLowerCase()===String(schedule);
        return same?{status:'SUCCESS',code:'EVENT_DRAFT_ALREADY_EXISTS',event_id:operationId,
          warning:'VERIFY_ADMIN_AUDIT_LOG'}:
          {status:'ERROR',code:'OPERATION_ID_REUSED_WITH_DIFFERENT_INPUT'};
      }
      const now=new Date().toISOString();
      const record={event_id:operationId,event_name:name,start_date:start,
        end_date:end,start_time:startTime,end_time:endTime,
        schedule_enabled:schedule,drive_folder_id:'',event_status:'DRAFT',
        created_at:now,updated_at:now,updated_by:'ADMIN',deleted_at:'',
        deleted_by:'',deletion_status:'ACTIVE',created_by:'ADMIN'};
      sheet.appendRow(headers.map(k=>Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(record,k)?record[k]:''));
      SpreadsheetApp.flush();
      // Event already exists at this point; never repeat the append if audit fails.
      try {
        const auditHeaders=audit.getRange(1,1,1,audit.getLastColumn()).getDisplayValues()[0];
        const requiredAudit=['log_id','timestamp','admin_id','action','entity_type',
          'entity_id','event_id','action_status','previous_value','new_value',
          'details','error_message'];
        if(requiredAudit.some(k=>!auditHeaders.includes(k)))
          throw new Error('AUDIT_SCHEMA_MISMATCH');
        const entry={log_id:Utilities.getUuid(),timestamp:now,admin_id:'ADMIN',
          action:'CREATE_EVENT_DRAFT',entity_type:'EVENT',entity_id:operationId,
          event_id:operationId,action_status:'SUCCESS',previous_value:'',
          new_value:'DRAFT',details:'operation_id='+operationId,error_message:''};
        audit.appendRow(auditHeaders.map(k=>Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(entry,k)?entry[k]:''));
        SpreadsheetApp.flush();
      } catch(auditError) {
        console.error('ADMIN_EVENT_538_AUDIT_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED');
        return {status:'ERROR',code:'EVENT_CREATED_AUDIT_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED',
          event_id:operationId};
      }
      return {status:'SUCCESS',code:'EVENT_DRAFT_CREATED',event_id:operationId,
        event_status:'DRAFT',drive_folder_created:false};
    });
  } catch(error) {
    console.error('ADMIN_EVENT_538_FAILED');
    return {status:'ERROR',code:String(error&&error.message)==='ADMIN_UNAUTHORIZED'?
      'ADMIN_UNAUTHORIZED':'ADMIN_EVENT_WRITE_FAILED_RETRY_SAME_OPERATION_ID'};
  }
}


/* =============================================================
 BATCH 5.39 — INTERNAL EVENT FOLDER PROVISIONING
 - Authenticated internal-only operation; never expose in doPost.
 - Only DRAFT events may be provisioned.
 - Reuses an existing uniquely named folder after interrupted writes.
 - Fails closed on ambiguous folders or hierarchy mismatch.
 - No event activation, no QR changes, no public uploads.
 ============================================================= */
function adminProvisionEventFolder539_(sessionToken, eventId) {
  if(typeof eventId!=='string'||
     !/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(eventId))
    return {status:'ERROR',code:'INVALID_EVENT_ID'};
  try {
    return adminWithLock536_(()=>{
      adminAuthorize536_(sessionToken);
      const props=PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
      const spreadsheetId=props.getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID');
      const rootId=props.getProperty('ROOT_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID');
      if(!spreadsheetId||!rootId) return {status:'ERROR',code:'BACKEND_NOT_CONFIGURED'};
      const ss=SpreadsheetApp.openById(spreadsheetId);
      const sheet=ss.getSheetByName('EVENTS');
      const audit=ss.getSheetByName('ADMIN_LOGS');
      if(!sheet||!audit) return {status:'ERROR',code:'DATABASE_TABLE_MISSING'};
      const headers=sheet.getRange(1,1,1,sheet.getLastColumn()).getDisplayValues()[0];
      const required=['event_id','event_name','event_status','deletion_status',
        'drive_folder_id','updated_at','updated_by'];
      if(required.some(k=>!headers.includes(k)))
        return {status:'ERROR',code:'EVENT_SCHEMA_MISMATCH'};
      const auditHeaders=audit.getRange(1,1,1,audit.getLastColumn()).getDisplayValues()[0];
      const requiredAudit=['log_id','timestamp','admin_id','action','entity_type',
        'entity_id','event_id','action_status','previous_value','new_value',
        'details','error_message'];
      if(requiredAudit.some(k=>!auditHeaders.includes(k)))
        return {status:'ERROR',code:'AUDIT_SCHEMA_MISMATCH'};
      const data=sheet.getDataRange().getDisplayValues();
      const matches=[];
      for(let i=1;i<data.length;i++)
        if(String(data[i][headers.indexOf('event_id')])===eventId) matches.push(i);
      if(matches.length!==1)
        return {status:'ERROR',code:matches.length?'EVENT_ID_CONFLICT':'EVENT_NOT_FOUND'};
      const rowIndex=matches[0]+1;
      const row=data[matches[0]];
      if(row[headers.indexOf('event_status')]!=='DRAFT'||
         row[headers.indexOf('deletion_status')]!=='ACTIVE')
        return {status:'ERROR',code:'EVENT_NOT_ELIGIBLE'};
      const name=String(row[headers.indexOf('event_name')]||'').trim();
      if(!name||/[/\\\u0000-\u001f]/.test(name))
        return {status:'ERROR',code:'INVALID_EVENT_NAME'};
      const root=DriveApp.getFolderById(rootId);
      const expectedName=name+' ['+eventId+']';
      const savedId=String(row[headers.indexOf('drive_folder_id')]||'').trim();
      let folder;
      let recovered=false;
      if(savedId) {
        folder=DriveApp.getFolderById(savedId);
        if(folder.isTrashed()||folder.getName()!==expectedName)
          return {status:'ERROR',code:'FOLDER_METADATA_CONFLICT'};
        const parents=folder.getParents();
        let parentMatches=0;
        while(parents.hasNext()) if(parents.next().getId()===rootId) parentMatches++;
        if(parentMatches!==1) return {status:'ERROR',code:'FOLDER_PARENT_CONFLICT'};
        return {status:'SUCCESS',code:'EVENT_FOLDER_ALREADY_LINKED',event_id:eventId};
      }
      const found=root.getFoldersByName(expectedName);
      const candidates=[];
      while(found.hasNext()) {
        const candidate=found.next();
        if(!candidate.isTrashed()) candidates.push(candidate);
        if(candidates.length>1) break;
      }
      if(candidates.length>1) return {status:'ERROR',code:'AMBIGUOUS_EVENT_FOLDERS'};
      if(candidates.length===1) {folder=candidates[0];recovered=true;}
      else folder=root.createFolder(expectedName);
      // The folder may already exist even if this write fails. Retry by event ID.
      sheet.getRange(rowIndex,headers.indexOf('drive_folder_id')+1).setValue(folder.getId());
      const now=new Date().toISOString();
      sheet.getRange(rowIndex,headers.indexOf('updated_at')+1).setValue(now);
      sheet.getRange(rowIndex,headers.indexOf('updated_by')+1).setValue('ADMIN');
      SpreadsheetApp.flush();
      try {
        const entry={log_id:Utilities.getUuid(),timestamp:now,admin_id:'ADMIN',
          action:'PROVISION_EVENT_FOLDER',entity_type:'EVENT',entity_id:eventId,
          event_id:eventId,action_status:'SUCCESS',previous_value:'',
          new_value:'FOLDER_LINKED',details:recovered?'RECOVERED_EXISTING_FOLDER':'CREATED_FOLDER',
          error_message:''};
        audit.appendRow(auditHeaders.map(k=>Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(entry,k)?entry[k]:''));
        SpreadsheetApp.flush();
      } catch(auditError) {
        console.error('ADMIN_539_AUDIT_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED');
        return {status:'ERROR',code:'FOLDER_LINKED_AUDIT_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED',event_id:eventId};
      }
      return {status:'SUCCESS',code:recovered?'EVENT_FOLDER_RECOVERED':'EVENT_FOLDER_CREATED',
        event_id:eventId};
    });
  } catch(error) {
    console.error('ADMIN_539_PROVISION_FAILED');
    return {status:'ERROR',code:String(error&&error.message)==='ADMIN_UNAUTHORIZED'?
      'ADMIN_UNAUTHORIZED':'FOLDER_PROVISION_FAILED_RETRY_SAME_EVENT_ID'};
  }
}


/* =============================================================
 BATCH 5.40 — INTERNAL QR SLOT + FIRST QUOTA CYCLE PROVISIONING
 One authenticated admin operation; public routes unchanged.
 Operation ID is the QR ID: retries reconcile partial writes.
 Does not activate event, QR or public upload.
 ============================================================= */
function adminProvisionQrSlot540_(sessionToken, eventId, operationId, input) {
  const uuid=/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
  if(typeof eventId!=='string'||!uuid.test(eventId)||
     typeof operationId!=='string'||!uuid.test(operationId))
    return {status:'ERROR',code:'INVALID_OPERATION_OR_EVENT_ID'};
  if(!input||typeof input!=='object'||Array.isArray(input))
    return {status:'ERROR',code:'INVALID_SLOT_INPUT'};
  const label=String(input.qr_label||'').trim();
  const quota=Number(input.max_uploads);
  if(label.length<2||label.length>100||/[/\\\u0000-\u001f]/.test(label)||
     !Number.isSafeInteger(quota)||quota<1||quota>1000)
    return {status:'ERROR',code:'INVALID_LABEL_OR_QUOTA'};
  try {
    return adminWithLock536_(()=>{
      adminAuthorize536_(sessionToken);
      const props=PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
      const sid=props.getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID');
      const rootId=props.getProperty('ROOT_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID');
      if(!sid||!rootId) return {status:'ERROR',code:'BACKEND_NOT_CONFIGURED'};
      const ss=SpreadsheetApp.openById(sid);
      const get=name=>{
        const sh=ss.getSheetByName(name);
        if(!sh) throw new Error('MISSING_TABLE_'+name);
        const h=sh.getRange(1,1,1,sh.getLastColumn()).getDisplayValues()[0];
        const rows=sh.getDataRange().getDisplayValues();
        return {sh,h,rows,objects:rows.slice(1).map((r,i)=>({
          row:i+2,record:Object.fromEntries(h.map((k,j)=>[k,r[j]]))
        })).filter(x=>Object.values(x.record).some(v=>v!==''))};
      };
      const ev=get('EVENTS'),qr=get('QR_SLOTS'),cy=get('QUOTA_CYCLES'),au=get('ADMIN_LOGS');
      const required={EVENTS:['event_id','event_status','deletion_status','drive_folder_id'],
        QR_SLOTS:['qr_id','event_id','qr_label','qr_token','qr_status','max_uploads',
          'current_cycle_id','drive_folder_id','created_at','updated_at','created_by',
          'updated_by','deletion_status'],
        QUOTA_CYCLES:['cycle_id','event_id','qr_id','cycle_number','max_uploads',
          'cycle_status','started_at','created_at','created_by','successful_uploads'],
        ADMIN_LOGS:['log_id','timestamp','admin_id','action','entity_type',
          'entity_id','event_id','action_status','previous_value','new_value','details','error_message']};
      for(const [name,t] of Object.entries({EVENTS:ev,QR_SLOTS:qr,QUOTA_CYCLES:cy,ADMIN_LOGS:au}))
        if(required[name].some(k=>!t.h.includes(k)))
          return {status:'ERROR',code:'SCHEMA_MISMATCH_'+name};
      const events=ev.objects.filter(x=>x.record.event_id===eventId);
      if(events.length!==1) return {status:'ERROR',code:'EVENT_NOT_FOUND_OR_AMBIGUOUS'};
      const event=events[0].record;
      if(event.event_status!=='DRAFT'||event.deletion_status!=='ACTIVE')
        return {status:'ERROR',code:'EVENT_NOT_DRAFT'};
      const eventFolderId=String(event.drive_folder_id||'');
      if(!eventFolderId) return {status:'ERROR',code:'EVENT_FOLDER_NOT_PROVISIONED'};
      const parent=DriveApp.getFolderById(eventFolderId);
      if(parent.isTrashed()) return {status:'ERROR',code:'EVENT_FOLDER_TRASHED'};
      const parents=parent.getParents();let rootMatches=0;
      while(parents.hasNext()) if(parents.next().getId()===rootId) rootMatches++;
      if(rootMatches!==1) return {status:'ERROR',code:'EVENT_FOLDER_PARENT_MISMATCH'};
      const matches=qr.objects.filter(x=>x.record.qr_id===operationId);
      if(matches.length>1) return {status:'ERROR',code:'QR_ID_CONFLICT'};
      let slot=matches.length?matches[0]:null;
      if(slot) {
        const r=slot.record;
        if(r.event_id!==eventId||r.qr_label!==label||Number(r.max_uploads)!==quota||
           r.deletion_status!=='ACTIVE'||r.qr_status!=='DRAFT')
          return {status:'ERROR',code:'OPERATION_ID_INPUT_CONFLICT'};
        if(!/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/i.test(String(r.qr_token||'')))
          return {status:'ERROR',code:'EXISTING_TOKEN_INVALID'};
      } else {
        if(qr.objects.some(x=>x.record.event_id===eventId&&
           x.record.qr_label.toLowerCase()===label.toLowerCase()&&
           x.record.deletion_status==='ACTIVE'))
          return {status:'ERROR',code:'QR_LABEL_ALREADY_EXISTS'};
        const token=(Utilities.getUuid()+Utilities.getUuid()).replace(/-/g,'');
        if(qr.objects.some(x=>x.record.qr_token===token))
          return {status:'ERROR',code:'TOKEN_COLLISION'};
        const now=new Date().toISOString();
        const record={qr_id:operationId,event_id:eventId,qr_label:label,qr_token:token,
          qr_status:'DRAFT',max_uploads:quota,current_cycle_id:'',drive_folder_id:'',
          created_at:now,updated_at:now,created_by:'ADMIN',updated_by:'ADMIN',
          last_upload_at:'',regenerated_at:'',regenerated_by:'',deleted_at:'',
          deleted_by:'',deletion_status:'ACTIVE'};
        qr.sh.appendRow(qr.h.map(k=>Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(record,k)?record[k]:''));
        SpreadsheetApp.flush();
        slot={row:qr.sh.getLastRow(),record};
      }
      // A unique, deterministic folder name allows safe retry after interrupted writes.
      const folderName=label+' ['+operationId+']';
      const saved=String(slot.record.drive_folder_id||'');
      let folder;
      if(saved) {
        folder=DriveApp.getFolderById(saved);
        if(folder.isTrashed()||folder.getName()!==folderName)
          return {status:'ERROR',code:'QR_FOLDER_METADATA_CONFLICT'};
        const p=folder.getParents();let n=0;
        while(p.hasNext()) if(p.next().getId()===eventFolderId) n++;
        if(n!==1) return {status:'ERROR',code:'QR_FOLDER_PARENT_CONFLICT'};
      } else {
        const found=parent.getFoldersByName(folderName);const candidates=[];
        while(found.hasNext()) {const f=found.next();if(!f.isTrashed()) candidates.push(f);
          if(candidates.length>1) break;}
        if(candidates.length>1) return {status:'ERROR',code:'AMBIGUOUS_QR_FOLDERS'};
        folder=candidates.length?candidates[0]:parent.createFolder(folderName);
        qr.sh.getRange(slot.row,qr.h.indexOf('drive_folder_id')+1).setValue(folder.getId());
        SpreadsheetApp.flush();
      }
      const related=cy.objects.filter(x=>x.record.qr_id===operationId);
      if(related.length>1) return {status:'ERROR',code:'MULTIPLE_QUOTA_CYCLES_REVIEW'};
      let cycleId=String(slot.record.current_cycle_id||'');
      if(related.length===1) {
        const c=related[0].record;
        if(c.event_id!==eventId||c.cycle_number!=='1'||
           Number(c.max_uploads)!==quota||c.cycle_status!=='ACTIVE'||
           Number(c.successful_uploads)!==0||
           (cycleId&&cycleId!==c.cycle_id))
          return {status:'ERROR',code:'EXISTING_CYCLE_CONFLICT'};
        cycleId=c.cycle_id;
      } else {
        if(cycleId) return {status:'ERROR',code:'MISSING_LINKED_CYCLE'};
        cycleId=Utilities.getUuid();const now=new Date().toISOString();
        const c={cycle_id:cycleId,event_id:eventId,qr_id:operationId,cycle_number:1,
          max_uploads:quota,cycle_status:'ACTIVE',started_at:now,ended_at:'',
          created_at:now,created_by:'ADMIN',closed_by:'',reset_reason:'',
          successful_uploads:0};
        cy.sh.appendRow(cy.h.map(k=>Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(c,k)?c[k]:''));
        SpreadsheetApp.flush();
      }
      if(!slot.record.current_cycle_id) {
        qr.sh.getRange(slot.row,qr.h.indexOf('current_cycle_id')+1).setValue(cycleId);
        SpreadsheetApp.flush();
      }
      const alreadyLogged=au.objects.some(x=>x.record.action==='PROVISION_QR_SLOT'&&
        x.record.entity_id===operationId&&x.record.action_status==='SUCCESS');
      if(!alreadyLogged) {
        const now=new Date().toISOString();
        const log={log_id:Utilities.getUuid(),timestamp:now,admin_id:'ADMIN',
          action:'PROVISION_QR_SLOT',entity_type:'QR_SLOT',entity_id:operationId,
          event_id:eventId,action_status:'SUCCESS',previous_value:'',
          new_value:'DRAFT',details:'QR slot, folder and initial cycle provisioned',error_message:''};
        au.sh.appendRow(au.h.map(k=>Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(log,k)?log[k]:''));
        SpreadsheetApp.flush();
      }
      return {status:'SUCCESS',code:'QR_SLOT_PROVISIONED',event_id:eventId,
        qr_id:operationId,qr_status:'DRAFT',cycle_number:1,max_uploads:quota,
        public_upload_enabled:false};
    });
  } catch(error) {
    console.error('ADMIN_QR_540_FAILED');
    return {status:'ERROR',code:String(error&&error.message)==='ADMIN_UNAUTHORIZED'?
      'ADMIN_UNAUTHORIZED':'QR_PROVISION_INTERRUPTED_RETRY_SAME_OPERATION_ID'};
  }
}

/* =============================================================
 INTEGRATION 5.43 — EVENT / QR READINESS + GUARDED ACTIVATION
 Internal admin HTML Service only. No public doPost changes.
 Both ADMIN_UI_541_ENABLED and ADMIN_WRITES_541_ENABLED must be true.
 Requires explicit confirmation equal to event ID.
 ============================================================= */
function adminEventReadiness543_(sessionToken,eventId) {
  try {
    adminAuthorize536_(sessionToken);
    if(typeof eventId!=='string'||!/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(eventId))
      return {status:'ERROR',code:'INVALID_EVENT_ID'};
    const p=PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
    const ss=SpreadsheetApp.openById(p.getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID'));
    const read=name=>{
      const sh=ss.getSheetByName(name);
      if(!sh) throw new Error('MISSING_TABLE');
      const h=sh.getRange(1,1,1,sh.getLastColumn()).getDisplayValues()[0];
      return {sh,h,records:sh.getDataRange().getDisplayValues().slice(1).map((r,i)=>({row:i+2,v:Object.fromEntries(h.map((k,j)=>[k,r[j]]))}))};
    };
    const ev=read('EVENTS'),qr=read('QR_SLOTS'),cy=read('QUOTA_CYCLES'),up=read('UPLOADS');
    const matches=ev.records.filter(x=>x.v.event_id===eventId);
    if(matches.length!==1) return {status:'ERROR',code:'EVENT_MISSING_OR_DUPLICATE'};
    const event=matches[0].v, problems=[];
    if(event.deletion_status!=='ACTIVE') problems.push('EVENT_DELETED');
    if(!['DRAFT','ACTIVE'].includes(event.event_status)) problems.push('EVENT_STATUS_INVALID');
    if(String(event.schedule_enabled).toLowerCase()!=='true') problems.push('SCHEDULE_MUST_BE_ENABLED');
    const dateOk=s=>/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(s)&&!isNaN(Date.parse(s+'T00:00:00Z'))&&new Date(s+'T00:00:00Z').toISOString().slice(0,10)===s;
    const timeOk=s=>/^([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d$/.test(s);
    if(!dateOk(event.start_date)||!dateOk(event.end_date)||!timeOk(event.start_time)||!timeOk(event.end_time)||
       event.end_date<event.start_date||(event.end_date===event.start_date&&event.end_time<=event.start_time))
      problems.push('INVALID_EVENT_SCHEDULE');
    const root=p.getProperty('ROOT_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID');
    let eventFolder=null;
    try {
      if(!root||!event.drive_folder_id) throw new Error('NO_FOLDER');
      eventFolder=DriveApp.getFolderById(event.drive_folder_id);
      if(eventFolder.isTrashed()) throw new Error('TRASHED');
      let found=false,parents=eventFolder.getParents();
      while(parents.hasNext()) if(parents.next().getId()===root) found=true;
      if(!found) throw new Error('PARENT');
    } catch(e) {problems.push('EVENT_FOLDER_INVALID');}
    const slots=qr.records.filter(x=>x.v.event_id===eventId&&x.v.deletion_status==='ACTIVE');
    if(!slots.length) problems.push('NO_QR_SLOTS');
    const ids=new Set(),tokens=new Set();
    slots.forEach(s=>{
      const v=s.v;
      if(ids.has(v.qr_id)||tokens.has(v.qr_token)) problems.push('DUPLICATE_QR');
      ids.add(v.qr_id);tokens.add(v.qr_token);
      if(!['DRAFT','ACTIVE'].includes(v.qr_status)||!/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/i.test(v.qr_token)) problems.push('QR_INVALID');
      const matches=cy.records.filter(c=>c.v.cycle_id===v.current_cycle_id&&c.v.qr_id===v.qr_id&&c.v.event_id===eventId);
      if(matches.length!==1||matches[0].v.cycle_status!=='ACTIVE') problems.push('QR_CYCLE_INVALID');
      else {
        const c=matches[0].v;
        const completed=up.records.filter(u=>u.v.cycle_id===c.cycle_id&&u.v.upload_status==='COMPLETED').length;
        if(!Number.isSafeInteger(Number(c.max_uploads))||Number(c.max_uploads)<1||
           Number(c.successful_uploads)!==completed||completed>Number(c.max_uploads)) problems.push('QUOTA_INCONSISTENT');
      }
      try {
        if(!eventFolder||!v.drive_folder_id) throw new Error('NO_QR_FOLDER');
        const folder=DriveApp.getFolderById(v.drive_folder_id);
        if(folder.isTrashed()) throw new Error('TRASHED');
        let parent=false,it=folder.getParents();
        while(it.hasNext()) if(it.next().getId()===event.drive_folder_id) parent=true;
        if(!parent) throw new Error('PARENT');
      } catch(e) {problems.push('QR_FOLDER_INVALID');}
    });
    if(up.records.some(u=>u.v.event_id===eventId&&['RESERVED','PROCESSING'].includes(u.v.upload_status)))
      problems.push('PENDING_TRANSACTIONS');
    return {status:'SUCCESS',code:'EVENT_READINESS_543',event_id:eventId,
      event_status:event.event_status,qr_count:slots.length,ready:problems.length===0,
      problems:Array.from(new Set(problems)),read_only:true};
  } catch(e) {return {status:'ERROR',code:'READINESS_UNAVAILABLE'};}
}
function adminUiEventReadiness543(token,eventId) {
  if(PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperty('ADMIN_UI_541_ENABLED')!=='true')
    return {status:'ERROR',code:'ADMIN_UI_DISABLED'};
  return adminEventReadiness543_(token,eventId);
}
function adminUiActivateEvent543(token,eventId,confirmation) {
  const p=PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  if(p.getProperty('ADMIN_UI_541_ENABLED')!=='true'||p.getProperty('ADMIN_WRITES_541_ENABLED')!=='true')
    return {status:'ERROR',code:'ADMIN_WRITES_DISABLED'};
  if(typeof eventId!=='string'||confirmation!==eventId)
    return {status:'ERROR',code:'EXPLICIT_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED'};
  try {
    return adminWithLock536_(()=>{
      adminAuthorize536_(token);
      const check=adminEventReadiness543_(token,eventId);
      if(check.status!=='SUCCESS'||!check.ready) return {status:'ERROR',code:'EVENT_NOT_READY',problems:check.problems||[]};
      if(check.event_status==='ACTIVE') return {status:'SUCCESS',code:'ALREADY_ACTIVE',event_id:eventId};
      if(check.event_status!=='DRAFT') return {status:'ERROR',code:'EVENT_NOT_DRAFT'};
      const ss=SpreadsheetApp.openById(p.getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID'));
      const e=ss.getSheetByName('EVENTS'),q=ss.getSheetByName('QR_SLOTS'),a=ss.getSheetByName('ADMIN_LOGS');
      const tab=sh=>({h:sh.getRange(1,1,1,sh.getLastColumn()).getDisplayValues()[0],rows:sh.getDataRange().getDisplayValues()});
      const et=tab(e),qt=tab(q),at=tab(a);
      const ix=(t,k)=>{const i=t.h.indexOf(k);if(i<0) throw new Error('MISSING_COLUMN');return i;};
      const er=et.rows.slice(1).map((r,i)=>({r,n:i+2})).filter(x=>x.r[ix(et,'event_id')]===eventId);
      if(er.length!==1||er[0].r[ix(et,'event_status')]!=='DRAFT') return {status:'ERROR',code:'EVENT_CHANGED'};
      const qrRows=qt.rows.slice(1).map((r,i)=>({r,n:i+2})).filter(x=>x.r[ix(qt,'event_id')]===eventId&&x.r[ix(qt,'deletion_status')]==='ACTIVE');
      const now=new Date().toISOString();
      // Activate QR slots first; if interrupted, retry can reconcile the partial state.
      qrRows.forEach(x=>{
        const status=x.r[ix(qt,'qr_status')];
        if(status==='DRAFT') q.getRange(x.n,ix(qt,'qr_status')+1).setValue('ACTIVE');
        else if(status!=='ACTIVE') throw new Error('QR_STATUS_CHANGED');
        if(qt.h.includes('updated_at')) q.getRange(x.n,ix(qt,'updated_at')+1).setValue(now);
      });
      SpreadsheetApp.flush();
      e.getRange(er[0].n,ix(et,'event_status')+1).setValue('ACTIVE');
      if(et.h.includes('updated_at')) e.getRange(er[0].n,ix(et,'updated_at')+1).setValue(now);
      if(et.h.includes('updated_by')) e.getRange(er[0].n,ix(et,'updated_by')+1).setValue('ADMIN');
      SpreadsheetApp.flush();
      const log={log_id:Utilities.getUuid(),timestamp:now,admin_id:'ADMIN',action:'ACTIVATE_EVENT',
        entity_type:'EVENT',entity_id:eventId,event_id:eventId,action_status:'SUCCESS',
        previous_value:'DRAFT',new_value:'ACTIVE',details:'Admin confirmed event and QR activation',error_message:''};
      a.appendRow(at.h.map(k=>Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(log,k)?log[k]:''));
      SpreadsheetApp.flush();
      return {status:'SUCCESS',code:'EVENT_ACTIVATED',event_id:eventId,qr_activated:qrRows.length};
    });
  } catch(e) {console.error('ADMIN_ACTIVATION_543_INTERRUPTED');return {status:'ERROR',code:'ACTIVATION_INTERRUPTED_REVIEW_REQUIRED'};}
}


/* ==============================================================
  RELEASE CANDIDATE 5.46 — AUTHENTICATED READ-ONLY GALLERY / QR EXPORT
  This does not activate uploads, reset quotas or mutate tokens.
  Gallery returns metadata only; Drive files remain private.
  QR export exposes live bearer tokens ONLY to authenticated admin.
  Do not print the returned payload in logs.
============================================================== */
function adminReadTable546_(ss,name) {
  const sh=ss.getSheetByName(name);
  if(!sh) throw new Error('MISSING_TABLE');
  const values=sh.getDataRange().getDisplayValues();
  const headers=values[0]||[];
  return values.slice(1).filter(r=>r.some(v=>v!=='')).map(r=>
    Object.fromEntries(headers.map((k,i)=>[k,r[i]||''])));
}
function adminUiGallery546(token,eventId,offset) {
  if(PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperty('ADMIN_UI_541_ENABLED')!=='true')
    return {status:'ERROR',code:'ADMIN_UI_DISABLED'};
  try {
    adminAuthorize536_(token);
    if(typeof eventId!=='string'||!/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(eventId))
      return {status:'ERROR',code:'INVALID_EVENT_ID'};
    if(!Number.isSafeInteger(offset)||offset<0||offset>100000)
      return {status:'ERROR',code:'INVALID_OFFSET'};
    const ss=SpreadsheetApp.openById(PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID'));
    const events=adminReadTable546_(ss,'EVENTS');
    if(!events.some(e=>e.event_id===eventId&&e.deletion_status==='ACTIVE'))
      return {status:'ERROR',code:'EVENT_NOT_FOUND'};
    const slots=adminReadTable546_(ss,'QR_SLOTS');
    const labels=new Map(slots.filter(q=>q.event_id===eventId).map(q=>[q.qr_id,q.qr_label]));
    const records=adminReadTable546_(ss,'UPLOADS')
      .filter(u=>u.event_id===eventId&&u.upload_status==='COMPLETED')
      .sort((a,b)=>String(b.completed_at).localeCompare(String(a.completed_at)));
    return {status:'SUCCESS',code:'GALLERY_METADATA_ONLY',total:records.length,
      offset:offset,limit:50,items:records.slice(offset,offset+50).map(u=>({
        upload_id:u.upload_id,qr_label:labels.get(u.qr_id)||'QR tidak diketahui',
        completed_at:u.completed_at,filename:u.drive_file_name||u.original_filename,
        deleted:u.deletion_status!=='ACTIVE',file_size_bytes:Number(u.file_size_bytes)||0
      }))};
  } catch(e) {return {status:'ERROR',code:'GALLERY_UNAVAILABLE'};}
}
function adminUiQrExport546(token,eventId) {
  if(PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperty('ADMIN_UI_541_ENABLED')!=='true')
    return {status:'ERROR',code:'ADMIN_UI_DISABLED'};
  try {
    adminAuthorize536_(token);
    if(typeof eventId!=='string'||!/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(eventId))
      return {status:'ERROR',code:'INVALID_EVENT_ID'};
    const ss=SpreadsheetApp.openById(PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID'));
    const events=adminReadTable546_(ss,'EVENTS');
    if(!events.some(e=>e.event_id===eventId&&e.deletion_status==='ACTIVE'))
      return {status:'ERROR',code:'EVENT_NOT_FOUND'};
    const slots=adminReadTable546_(ss,'QR_SLOTS').filter(q=>
      q.event_id===eventId&&q.deletion_status==='ACTIVE'&&

    if(slots.some(q=>!/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/i.test(q.qr_token)))

    return {status:'SUCCESS',code:'QR_TOKEN_EXPORT_SENSITIVE',
