        qr_token:q.qr_token,max_uploads:Number(q.max_uploads)||0}))};
  } catch(e) {return {status:'ERROR',code:'QR_EXPORT_UNAVAILABLE'};}
}


/* ==============================================================
 RC 5.47 — DRAFT-ONLY QR TOKEN ROTATION
 Does not touch active QR, uploads, quotas, folders, or event schedule.
 Protected by admin session, admin write switch and script lock.
 Do NOT use as a replacement for live token regeneration.
 ============================================================== */
function adminUiRotateDraftToken547(token,eventId,qrId,confirmation) {
  const props=PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  if(props.getProperty('ADMIN_UI_541_ENABLED')!=='true'||
     props.getProperty('ADMIN_WRITES_541_ENABLED')!=='true')
    return {status:'ERROR',code:'ADMIN_WRITES_DISABLED'};
  const uuid=/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
  if(![eventId,qrId].every(v=>typeof v==='string'&&uuid.test(v))||confirmation!==qrId)
    return {status:'ERROR',code:'INVALID_ID_OR_CONFIRMATION'};
  try {
    return adminWithLock536_(()=>{
      adminAuthorize536_(token);
      const ss=SpreadsheetApp.openById(props.getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID'));
      const load=name=>{
        const sh=ss.getSheetByName(name);if(!sh)throw Error('MISSING_TABLE');
        const h=sh.getRange(1,1,1,sh.getLastColumn()).getDisplayValues()[0];
        const rows=sh.getDataRange().getDisplayValues().slice(1).map((r,i)=>({
          row:i+2,rec:Object.fromEntries(h.map((k,j)=>[k,r[j]||'']))}));
        return {sh,h,rows};
      };
      const ev=load('EVENTS'),qr=load('QR_SLOTS'),up=load('UPLOADS'),au=load('ADMIN_LOGS');
      const required={EVENTS:['event_id','event_status','deletion_status'],
        QR_SLOTS:['qr_id','event_id','qr_token','qr_status','deletion_status','updated_at','updated_by','regenerated_at','regenerated_by'],
        UPLOADS:['qr_id'],ADMIN_LOGS:['log_id','timestamp','admin_id','action','entity_type','entity_id','event_id','action_status','previous_value','new_value','details','error_message']};
      for(const [name,t] of Object.entries({EVENTS:ev,QR_SLOTS:qr,UPLOADS:up,ADMIN_LOGS:au}))
        if(required[name].some(k=>!t.h.includes(k)))return {status:'ERROR',code:'SCHEMA_MISMATCH_'+name};
      const events=ev.rows.filter(x=>x.rec.event_id===eventId);
      const slots=qr.rows.filter(x=>x.rec.qr_id===qrId);
      if(events.length!==1||slots.length!==1)return {status:'ERROR',code:'AMBIGUOUS_OR_MISSING_RECORD'};
      const e=events[0].rec,q=slots[0].rec;
      if(e.event_status!=='DRAFT'||e.deletion_status!=='ACTIVE'||
         q.event_id!==eventId||q.qr_status!=='DRAFT'||q.deletion_status!=='ACTIVE')
        return {status:'ERROR',code:'DRAFT_ONLY'};
      if(up.rows.some(x=>x.rec.qr_id===qrId))return {status:'ERROR',code:'UPLOAD_HISTORY_PRESENT'};
      if(!/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/i.test(String(q.qr_token)))
        return {status:'ERROR',code:'INVALID_EXISTING_TOKEN'};
      let newToken='';
      for(let i=0;i<4;i++) {
        const candidate=(Utilities.getUuid()+Utilities.getUuid()).replace(/-/g,'');
        if(!qr.rows.some(x=>x.rec.qr_token===candidate)){newToken=candidate;break;}
      }
      if(!newToken) return {status:'ERROR',code:'TOKEN_COLLISION'};
      const now=new Date().toISOString();
      // Audit intent FIRST. If token write fails, manual reconciliation is required.
      const log={log_id:Utilities.getUuid(),timestamp:now,admin_id:'ADMIN',
        action:'ROTATE_DRAFT_QR_TOKEN',entity_type:'QR_SLOT',entity_id:qrId,event_id:eventId,
        action_status:'INTENT',previous_value:'[REDACTED]',new_value:'[REDACTED]',
        details:'Draft-only rotation; reconcile after interruption',error_message:''};
      au.sh.appendRow(au.h.map(k=>Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(log,k)?log[k]:''));
      SpreadsheetApp.flush();
      const auditRow=au.sh.getLastRow();
      qr.sh.getRange(slots[0].row,qr.h.indexOf('qr_token')+1).setValue(newToken);
      qr.sh.getRange(slots[0].row,qr.h.indexOf('regenerated_at')+1).setValue(now);
      qr.sh.getRange(slots[0].row,qr.h.indexOf('regenerated_by')+1).setValue('ADMIN');
      qr.sh.getRange(slots[0].row,qr.h.indexOf('updated_at')+1).setValue(now);
      qr.sh.getRange(slots[0].row,qr.h.indexOf('updated_by')+1).setValue('ADMIN');
      SpreadsheetApp.flush();
      au.sh.getRange(auditRow,au.h.indexOf('action_status')+1).setValue('SUCCESS');
      SpreadsheetApp.flush();
      return {status:'SUCCESS',code:'DRAFT_TOKEN_ROTATED',event_id:eventId,qr_id:qrId,
        warning:'Previously exported QR links are invalid; re-export links'};
    });
  } catch(e) {
    console.error('DRAFT_TOKEN_ROTATION_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED');
    return {status:'ERROR',code:'ROTATION_INTERRUPTED_REVIEW_AUDIT'};
  }
}


/* RC 5.48 — MANUAL QUOTA RESET, FAIL-CLOSED / DRAFT-ONLY.
   ACTIVE QR reset deliberately deferred until live upload concurrency is verified.
   Idempotency: operationId is the new cycle ID. Never reuses an old cycle.
   Only DRAFT QR with no UPLOADS history may be reset in this candidate.
*/
function adminUiResetDraftQuota548(token,eventId,qrId,operationId,newQuota,confirmation) {
  const props=PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  if(props.getProperty('ADMIN_UI_541_ENABLED')!=='true'||
     props.getProperty('ADMIN_WRITES_541_ENABLED')!=='true')
    return {status:'ERROR',code:'ADMIN_WRITES_DISABLED'};
  const uuid=/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
  if(![eventId,qrId,operationId].every(x=>typeof x==='string'&&uuid.test(x))||
     confirmation!==qrId||!Number.isSafeInteger(newQuota)||newQuota<1||newQuota>1000)
    return {status:'ERROR',code:'INVALID_INPUT_OR_CONFIRMATION'};
  try {
    return adminWithLock536_(()=>{
      adminAuthorize536_(token);
      const sid=props.getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID');if(!sid)throw Error('MISSING_DATABASE');
      const ss=SpreadsheetApp.openById(sid);
      const table=name=>{
        const sh=ss.getSheetByName(name);if(!sh)throw Error('MISSING_TABLE');
        const h=sh.getRange(1,1,1,sh.getLastColumn()).getDisplayValues()[0];
        const records=sh.getDataRange().getDisplayValues().slice(1).map((v,i)=>({
          row:i+2,rec:Object.fromEntries(h.map((k,j)=>[k,v[j]||'']))}));
        return {sh,h,records};
      };
      const ev=table('EVENTS'),qr=table('QR_SLOTS'),cy=table('QUOTA_CYCLES'),up=table('UPLOADS'),au=table('ADMIN_LOGS');
      const needed={EVENTS:['event_id','event_status','deletion_status'],
        QR_SLOTS:['qr_id','event_id','qr_status','deletion_status','current_cycle_id','max_uploads','updated_at','updated_by'],
        QUOTA_CYCLES:['cycle_id','event_id','qr_id','cycle_number','max_uploads','cycle_status','started_at','ended_at','created_at','created_by','closed_by','reset_reason','successful_uploads'],
        UPLOADS:['qr_id'],ADMIN_LOGS:['log_id','timestamp','admin_id','action','entity_type','entity_id','event_id','action_status','previous_value','new_value','details','error_message']};
      for(const [name,t] of Object.entries({EVENTS:ev,QR_SLOTS:qr,QUOTA_CYCLES:cy,UPLOADS:up,ADMIN_LOGS:au}))
        if(needed[name].some(k=>!t.h.includes(k)))return {status:'ERROR',code:'SCHEMA_MISMATCH_'+name};
      const e=ev.records.filter(x=>x.rec.event_id===eventId),q=qr.records.filter(x=>x.rec.qr_id===qrId);
      if(e.length!==1||q.length!==1)return {status:'ERROR',code:'MISSING_OR_DUPLICATE_RECORD'};
      if(e[0].rec.event_status!=='DRAFT'||e[0].rec.deletion_status!=='ACTIVE'||
         q[0].rec.event_id!==eventId||q[0].rec.qr_status!=='DRAFT'||q[0].rec.deletion_status!=='ACTIVE')
        return {status:'ERROR',code:'DRAFT_ONLY'};
      if(up.records.some(x=>x.rec.qr_id===qrId))return {status:'ERROR',code:'UPLOAD_HISTORY_PRESENT'};
      const history=cy.records.filter(x=>x.rec.qr_id===qrId);
      if(history.some(x=>x.rec.event_id!==eventId))return {status:'ERROR',code:'CYCLE_EVENT_MISMATCH'};
      const existing=history.filter(x=>x.rec.cycle_id===operationId);
      if(existing.length>1)return {status:'ERROR',code:'DUPLICATE_OPERATION_ID'};
      if(existing.length===1) {
        const r=existing[0].rec;
        if(r.max_uploads!==String(newQuota))return {status:'ERROR',code:'OPERATION_ID_CONFLICT'};
        if(q[0].rec.current_cycle_id===operationId&&r.cycle_status==='ACTIVE'&&
           q[0].rec.max_uploads===String(newQuota))
          return {status:'SUCCESS',code:'RESET_ALREADY_COMPLETED',cycle_id:operationId};
        return {status:'ERROR',code:'PARTIAL_RESET_MANUAL_RECONCILIATION'};
      }
      if(cy.records.some(x=>x.rec.cycle_id===operationId))return {status:'ERROR',code:'OPERATION_ID_USED_ELSEWHERE'};
      const current=history.filter(x=>x.rec.cycle_id===q[0].rec.current_cycle_id);
      if(current.length!==1||current[0].rec.cycle_status!=='ACTIVE'||
         history.filter(x=>x.rec.cycle_status==='ACTIVE').length!==1||
         !Number.isSafeInteger(Number(current[0].rec.cycle_number))||
         history.some(x=>!Number.isSafeInteger(Number(x.rec.cycle_number))))
        return {status:'ERROR',code:'CYCLE_INTEGRITY_REVIEW_REQUIRED'};
      if(history.some(x=>Number(x.rec.successful_uploads)!==0))
        return {status:'ERROR',code:'NONZERO_HISTORICAL_QUOTA_REVIEW'};
      const next=Math.max(...history.map(x=>Number(x.rec.cycle_number)))+1;
      const now=new Date().toISOString();
      const audit={log_id:Utilities.getUuid(),timestamp:now,admin_id:'ADMIN',action:'RESET_DRAFT_QUOTA',
        entity_type:'QR_SLOT',entity_id:qrId,event_id:eventId,action_status:'INTENT',
        previous_value:current[0].rec.cycle_id,new_value:operationId,
        details:'DRAFT-only reset; review partial state if interrupted',error_message:''};
      au.sh.appendRow(au.h.map(k=>audit[k]??''));SpreadsheetApp.flush();
      const auditRow=au.sh.getLastRow();
      const write=(t,row,key,value)=>t.sh.getRange(row,t.h.indexOf(key)+1).setValue(value);
      // Close old cycle first. If interrupted, do not allow upload or repeat reset blindly.
      write(cy,current[0].row,'cycle_status','CLOSED');
      write(cy,current[0].row,'ended_at',now);
      write(cy,current[0].row,'closed_by','ADMIN');
      write(cy,current[0].row,'reset_reason','MANUAL_DRAFT_RESET');
      SpreadsheetApp.flush();
      const record={cycle_id:operationId,event_id:eventId,qr_id:qrId,cycle_number:next,
        max_uploads:newQuota,cycle_status:'ACTIVE',started_at:now,ended_at:'',created_at:now,
        created_by:'ADMIN',closed_by:'',reset_reason:'',successful_uploads:0};
      cy.sh.appendRow(cy.h.map(k=>record[k]??''));SpreadsheetApp.flush();
      write(qr,q[0].row,'current_cycle_id',operationId);
      write(qr,q[0].row,'max_uploads',newQuota);
      write(qr,q[0].row,'updated_at',now);
      write(qr,q[0].row,'updated_by','ADMIN');
      SpreadsheetApp.flush();
      write(au,auditRow,'action_status','SUCCESS');SpreadsheetApp.flush();
      return {status:'SUCCESS',code:'DRAFT_QUOTA_RESET',cycle_id:operationId,cycle_number:next,max_uploads:newQuota};
    });
  } catch(e) {
    console.error('DRAFT_QUOTA_RESET_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED');
    return {status:'ERROR',code:'RESET_INTERRUPTED_REVIEW_AUDIT'};
  }
}


/* RC 5.49 — READ-ONLY SYSTEM SETTINGS / RELEASE PREFLIGHT
   Deliberately does not change settings or production flags.
   Exposes only a small, non-sensitive allowlist to authenticated admin.
*/
function adminUiSettings549(token) {
  if(PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperty('ADMIN_UI_541_ENABLED')!=='true')
    return {status:'ERROR',code:'ADMIN_UI_DISABLED'};
  try {
    adminAuthorize536_(token);
    const id=PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID');
    if(!id) return {status:'ERROR',code:'DATABASE_NOT_CONFIGURED'};
    const ss=SpreadsheetApp.openById(id);
    const sh=ss.getSheetByName('SYSTEM_SETTINGS');
    if(!sh)return {status:'ERROR',code:'SETTINGS_TABLE_MISSING'};
    const data=sh.getDataRange().getDisplayValues();
    const headers=data[0]||[];
    const required=['setting_key','setting_value','value_type','is_editable'];
    if(required.some(k=>!headers.includes(k)))return {status:'ERROR',code:'SETTINGS_SCHEMA_MISMATCH'};
    const allowed=new Set(['default_quota','jpeg_quality','max_file_size_bytes','max_image_resolution','lease_seconds','qr_format']);
    const result=[];
    for(const row of data.slice(1)) {
      const obj=Object.fromEntries(headers.map((k,i)=>[k,row[i]||'']));
      if(!allowed.has(String(obj.setting_key).toLowerCase()))continue;
      result.push({key:obj.setting_key,value:String(obj.setting_value).slice(0,120),
        type:obj.value_type,editable:String(obj.is_editable).toLowerCase()==='true'});
    }
    return {status:'SUCCESS',code:'SETTINGS_READ_ONLY',settings:result,
      note:'Tetapan belum boleh diubah melalui dashboard'};
  }catch(e){return {status:'ERROR',code:'SETTINGS_READ_FAILED'};}
}
function adminUiPreflight549(token) {
  if(PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperty('ADMIN_UI_541_ENABLED')!=='true')
    return {status:'ERROR',code:'ADMIN_UI_DISABLED'};
  try {
    adminAuthorize536_(token);
    const p=PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
    const checks=[];
    const add=(name,ok)=>checks.push({name:name,pass:!!ok});
    const sid=p.getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID');
    const root=p.getProperty('ROOT_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID');
    add('Spreadsheet configured',!!sid);
    add('Drive root configured',!!root);
    add('Admin password configured',!!p.getProperty('ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH_536'));
    add('Public upload locked',p.getProperty('PRODUCTION_PUBLIC_ROUTE_528_ENABLED')!=='true');
    add('Production transaction locked',p.getProperty('PRODUCTION_TRANSACTION_525_ENABLED')!=='true');
    if(sid){
      const ss=SpreadsheetApp.openById(sid);
      for(const name of ['EVENTS','QR_SLOTS','UPLOADS','QUOTA_CYCLES','SYSTEM_SETTINGS','ADMIN_LOGS'])
        add('Sheet '+name,!!ss.getSheetByName(name));
    }
    return {status:'SUCCESS',code:'PREFLIGHT_READ_ONLY',checks:checks,
      ready_for_production:false,note:'Semakan ini bukan pengganti ujian transaksi dan keselamatan LIVE'};
  }catch(e){return {status:'ERROR',code:'PREFLIGHT_FAILED'};}
}

/* 5.55 DEVELOPMENT HOLD: isolated admin gallery/settings adapters.
   No public upload route is enabled. Soft delete only: Drive file retained. */
function adminReadTable555_(ss,name){
  const sh=ss.getSheetByName(name);if(!sh)throw Error('MISSING_'+name);
  const data=sh.getDataRange().getDisplayValues();const h=data.shift();
  return {sh:sh,h:h,rows:data.map((a,i)=>({row:i+2,rec:Object.fromEntries(h.map((k,j)=>[k,a[j]||'']))}))};
}
function adminUiThumbnail555(token,eventId,uploadId){
  if(PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperty('ADMIN_UI_541_ENABLED')!=='true')return {status:'ERROR',code:'ADMIN_UI_DISABLED'};
  try{
    adminAuthorize536_(token);
    if(!/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(eventId)||!/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(uploadId))return {status:'ERROR',code:'INVALID_ID'};
    const ss=SpreadsheetApp.openById(PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID'));
    const events=adminReadTable555_(ss,'EVENTS').rows;
    if(!events.some(x=>x.rec.event_id===eventId&&x.rec.deletion_status==='ACTIVE'))return {status:'ERROR',code:'EVENT_NOT_FOUND'};
    const matches=adminReadTable555_(ss,'UPLOADS').rows.filter(x=>x.rec.upload_id===uploadId&&x.rec.event_id===eventId&&x.rec.upload_status==='COMPLETED'&&x.rec.deletion_status==='ACTIVE');
    if(matches.length!==1)return {status:'ERROR',code:'IMAGE_NOT_AVAILABLE'};
    const fileId=matches[0].rec.drive_file_id;
    if(!/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{15,100}$/.test(fileId))return {status:'ERROR',code:'INVALID_FILE_REFERENCE'};
    const file=DriveApp.getFileById(fileId);
    if(file.getMimeType()!=='image/jpeg')return {status:'ERROR',code:'NOT_JPEG'};
    // Prevent excessive server response; not a resized thumbnail.
    if(file.getSize()>350000)return {status:'ERROR',code:'PREVIEW_TOO_LARGE'};
    const blob=file.getBlob();
    return {status:'SUCCESS',code:'PRIVATE_JPEG_PREVIEW',data_url:'data:image/jpeg;base64,'+Utilities.base64Encode(blob.getBytes())};
  }catch(e){return {status:'ERROR',code:'PREVIEW_UNAVAILABLE'};}
}
function adminUiSoftDelete555(token,eventId,uploadId,confirmation){
  const p=PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  if(p.getProperty('ADMIN_UI_541_ENABLED')!=='true'||p.getProperty('ADMIN_WRITES_541_ENABLED')!=='true')return {status:'ERROR',code:'ADMIN_WRITES_DISABLED'};
  if(confirmation!==uploadId||!/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(eventId)||!/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(uploadId))return {status:'ERROR',code:'INVALID_CONFIRMATION'};
  try{return adminWithLock536_(()=>{
    adminAuthorize536_(token);
    const ss=SpreadsheetApp.openById(p.getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID'));
    const ev=adminReadTable555_(ss,'EVENTS'),up=adminReadTable555_(ss,'UPLOADS'),logs=adminReadTable555_(ss,'ADMIN_LOGS');
    if(!ev.rows.some(x=>x.rec.event_id===eventId&&x.rec.deletion_status==='ACTIVE'))return {status:'ERROR',code:'EVENT_NOT_FOUND'};
    const matches=up.rows.filter(x=>x.rec.event_id===eventId&&x.rec.upload_id===uploadId&&x.rec.upload_status==='COMPLETED');
    if(matches.length!==1)return {status:'ERROR',code:'UPLOAD_NOT_FOUND'};
    const m=matches[0];if(m.rec.deletion_status!=='ACTIVE')return {status:'ERROR',code:'ALREADY_DELETED'};
    const needed=['deleted_at','deletion_status'];if(needed.some(k=>!up.h.includes(k)))return {status:'ERROR',code:'SCHEMA_MISMATCH'};
    const logFields=['log_id','timestamp','admin_id','action','entity_type','entity_id','event_id','action_status','previous_value','new_value','details','error_message'];
    if(logFields.some(k=>!logs.h.includes(k)))return {status:'ERROR',code:'AUDIT_SCHEMA_MISMATCH'};
    const now=new Date().toISOString();
    const audit={log_id:Utilities.getUuid(),timestamp:now,admin_id:'ADMIN',action:'SOFT_DELETE_UPLOAD',entity_type:'UPLOAD',entity_id:uploadId,event_id:eventId,action_status:'INTENT',previous_value:'ACTIVE',new_value:'DELETED',details:'Metadata-only soft deletion; Drive JPEG retained; quota unchanged',error_message:''};
    logs.sh.appendRow(logs.h.map(k=>audit[k]||''));SpreadsheetApp.flush();
    const auditRow=logs.sh.getLastRow();
    try{
      up.sh.getRange(m.row,up.h.indexOf('deletion_status')+1).setValue('DELETED');
      up.sh.getRange(m.row,up.h.indexOf('deleted_at')+1).setValue(now);
      SpreadsheetApp.flush();
      logs.sh.getRange(auditRow,logs.h.indexOf('action_status')+1).setValue('SUCCESS');
      return {status:'SUCCESS',code:'SOFT_DELETED_QUOTA_UNCHANGED'};
    }catch(e){return {status:'ERROR',code:'PARTIAL_WRITE_RECONCILE_AUDIT'};}
  });}catch(e){return {status:'ERROR',code:'DELETE_UNAVAILABLE'};}
}
function adminUiSaveSetting555(token,key,value,confirmation){
  const p=PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  if(p.getProperty('ADMIN_UI_541_ENABLED')!=='true'||p.getProperty('ADMIN_WRITES_541_ENABLED')!=='true')return {status:'ERROR',code:'ADMIN_WRITES_DISABLED'};
  const rules={default_quota:v=>Number.isInteger(Number(v))&&Number(v)>=1&&Number(v)<=1000,
    jpeg_quality:v=>Number.isFinite(Number(v))&&Number(v)>=0.4&&Number(v)<=0.95,
    max_file_size_bytes:v=>Number.isInteger(Number(v))&&Number(v)>=100000&&Number(v)<=8000000,
    max_image_resolution:v=>Number.isInteger(Number(v))&&Number(v)>=480&&Number(v)<=4096,
    lease_seconds:v=>Number.isInteger(Number(v))&&Number(v)>=60&&Number(v)<=600};
  if(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rules,key)||typeof value!=='string'||!rules[key](value)||confirmation!==key)return {status:'ERROR',code:'INVALID_SETTING'};
  try{return adminWithLock536_(()=>{
    adminAuthorize536_(token);
    const ss=SpreadsheetApp.openById(p.getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID'));
    const t=adminReadTable555_(ss,'SYSTEM_SETTINGS'),logs=adminReadTable555_(ss,'ADMIN_LOGS');
    if(['setting_key','setting_value','is_editable','updated_at','updated_by'].some(k=>!t.h.includes(k)))return {status:'ERROR',code:'SCHEMA_MISMATCH'};
    if(['log_id','timestamp','admin_id','action','entity_type','entity_id','event_id','action_status','previous_value','new_value','details','error_message'].some(k=>!logs.h.includes(k)))return {status:'ERROR',code:'AUDIT_SCHEMA_MISMATCH'};
    const matches=t.rows.filter(x=>x.rec.setting_key===key);
    if(matches.length!==1||String(matches[0].rec.is_editable).toLowerCase()!=='true')return {status:'ERROR',code:'SETTING_NOT_EDITABLE'};
    const m=matches[0],now=new Date().toISOString();
    const audit={log_id:Utilities.getUuid(),timestamp:now,admin_id:'ADMIN',action:'UPDATE_SYSTEM_SETTING',entity_type:'SYSTEM_SETTING',entity_id:key,event_id:'',action_status:'INTENT',previous_value:m.rec.setting_value,new_value:value,details:'Allowlisted settings edit',error_message:''};
    logs.sh.appendRow(logs.h.map(k=>audit[k]||''));SpreadsheetApp.flush();const auditRow=logs.sh.getLastRow();
    try{
      t.sh.getRange(m.row,t.h.indexOf('setting_value')+1).setValue(value);
      t.sh.getRange(m.row,t.h.indexOf('updated_at')+1).setValue(now);
      t.sh.getRange(m.row,t.h.indexOf('updated_by')+1).setValue('ADMIN');
      SpreadsheetApp.flush();logs.sh.getRange(auditRow,logs.h.indexOf('action_status')+1).setValue('SUCCESS');
      return {status:'SUCCESS',code:'SETTING_UPDATED',key:key,value:value};
    }catch(e){return {status:'ERROR',code:'PARTIAL_WRITE_RECONCILE_AUDIT'};}
  });}catch(e){return {status:'ERROR',code:'SETTINGS_WRITE_UNAVAILABLE'};}
}
